>     date: '2010-12-09T14:09:37-06:00',
>     body: 'This achievement will require a little coordination amongst your group and a little bit of luck.  Think of this fight as a Netherspite encounter from Karazhan.  As the beam channels onto a target, they quickly build up stacks of a debuff.  After ~20 seconds, the beam target will reach 100 stacks and evolve into a massive Dragonkin and become mind controlled by the boss.  Normally this fight is done without letting a single Zealot evolve, but this achievement requires you to allow all 3 to evolve before defeating Corla.\n' +
>       '\n' +
>       '[b]However, having more than one Dragonkin up at any time will most likely lead to your group wiping.[/b]\n' +
>       '\n' +
>       'To prevent multiple Evolved Dragonkin from spawning all at once, you need to have TWO group members intercept the pink/purple beam and allow the debuff to stack on themselves.  These two group members should step out of the stream when they reach ~75 stacks and let the Zealot absorb the beams until your debuff falls off.  When the debuff wears off, step back into the beam to prevent the Zealot from evolving too early.  Repeat this and allow only one Dragonkin to evolve at a time.\n' +
>       '\n' +
>       "When a Dragonkin spawns, he will IMMEDIATELY Shadow Strike the first person on his aggro table - usually a healer.  The Shadow Strike will blink the Dragonkin towards the target, dealing massive damage which can one shot their targets.  [b]THIS MUST BE INTERRUPTED THE MOMENT THE DRAGONKIN SPAWNS.[/b]  The Evolved Dragonkin will also randomly stun a member of your group, so anyone who is 'beam tanking' needs to be mindful of the stuns and not wait until the last moment before stepping out.  Kill all three Evolved Dragonkin and then the boss.  Good luck!"

When your healer feels comfortable again with enough mana, unleash the second add, this can be either the ranged of the melee one, whichever you prefer. >       '\r\n' +
>       'Used army of the dead (without glyph so they taunt) after the other two zealots evolve to keep them off me while popping any other dps cooldowns (raise dead, dancing rune weapon, etc). \r\n' +
>       '\r\n' +
>       'By the time AOD had finished first evolved was down and second was on 10% and fight was manageable from there.'

>       '\r\n' +
>       "Start at the middle add, and tank the beam until you hit 30ish stacks, and then head to the right beam. All this time make sure you're throwing incinerates at the boss to build up embers. \r\n" +
>       '\r\n' +

>       '\r\n' +

> {"id":5284,"comments":[{"id":1208542,"r":4,"n":0,"b":"Ascendant Lord Obsidius is the final boss of Blackrock Caverns.\nCrepuscular Veil is the ability used by the adds which reduce healing received by 24% each stack, making it hard to be tanked by the main tank.\n\nThe best strategy for this achievement is having the DPS'ers \"rotate\" the \"tanking\" of the adds, as Crepuscular Veil only lasts 4 seconds, it will be enough to have the stacks drop before you get them back to the first of the rotation.\n\nBe aware that during the fight, Obsidius will switch places with one of the adds, so have the tank ready to switch to that add and the player stacking the debuff pick up where the boss was."},{"id":1218677,"r":5,"n":0,"b":"Ascendant Lord Obsidius is found at the end of Blackrock Caverns along with 3 'shadows' of himself.  When engaged, his 3 shadows will chase their targets around while channeling Crepuscular Veil onto them.  Think of his shadows as you would the shadow orbs from the Prince encounter in ICC - the last person to perform a hostile act against them will be targeted and chased.  However, the adds will channel onto ANYONE who is within range of them, so they need to be kited around the room while the rest of your group defeats Obsidius.\n\nThis means that a ranged caster or hunter is ideally suited for this thankless task.  If you do not have a ranged damage dealer, then you can use a FoKing Rogue with Crippling Poison or a Warrior spamming Piercing Howl to snare the adds and maintain aggro.  Having a frost trap or earth bind totem will help as well.  Every 33%, Obsidius will change places with one of his shadows.  The tank should quickly pick Obsidius back up while the kiter quickly picks up the new shadow.  Repeat this twice and you will earn this achievement."},{"id":1222355,"r":56,"n":7,"b":"The 3 adds will channel a beam (not interruptable and while moving) that stacks the relevant debuff on anyone in melee range, even if that person is not their current target. They don't attack highest threat, instead attacking the most recent threat. Adds can be snared, but not rooted or crowd controlled. \n\nOne person needs to be assigned to kiting and cannot be near the adds. The kite path must not take the adds through the group.\n\nOur group stacked on the boss. We had a moonkin kiting, spamming moonfire for super cheap (also keeping dots on the boss when possible). We kited in a _large_ circle around the boss, 30ish yards to either side. A warrior with piercing howl would run out every so often and snare them. The rest is just making sure the boss is taunted after he swaps and the adds get grouped up again. Body & Soul from a holy priest (potentially Leap of Faith from any priest) can help your team catch up.\n\nThe boss has a thunderclap that snares movement; this must be dispelled if it lands on your kiter, but it can be outranged. Don't bother dispelling it from others. Do dispell Twilight Corruption as this is cheaper than healing the dot. \n\nTracking this achieve will let you know if it fails. The text will turn red upon failure. \n\nFinally, the boss hits like air. A dps could swap gear and stances and easily tank him. Done correctly, this fight requires almost no healing."},{"id":1224749,"r":6,"n":1,"b":"This is so freakin' easy. The adds ARE rootable (at least for my moonkin-insta-roots) and you may as well use Frost Nova to keep them in place.\r\nAdditionally, mark the adds so you can identify them after a swap.\r\n\r\nKite Combo was Frost Mage (Add 1+2) and Moonkin (Add 3). As a Moonkin I could almost completely nuke instead of kiting, since my add was rooted.\r\n\r\nAdditionally: keep any pets away, they count and turn on your achievment tracker as it shows you if it failed."},{"id":1230877,"r":1,"n":2,"b":"Put away all pets, they will ruin it for you. We had a mage elemental out that wrecked it for us."},{"id":1250904,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"just easily kited this as a survival hunter with entrapment. \n\nspam ice trap and snake trap for slowing and a full 4 seconds aoe root effect. keep using multi shot to maintain threat.\n\n\nafter the boss died i got a \"achievement what\" from my group, very entertaining."},{"id":1251976,"r":69,"n":0,"b":"Those who wonder why there is dwarf icon on this achievement its simply because early on beta Ascendant Lord Obsidius and its adds had iron dwarf skin so the achievement icon kinda stayed as dwarf."},{"id":1258728,"r":4,"n":1,"b":"A frost mage can easily kite all three of the assistants by speccing into Improved Cone of Cold.  Between Cone of Cold, Frost Nova, and the water elemental's Freeze ability, the mage will rarely get touched.  All it takes to pick up an assistant once Obsidius transfers himself is an Ice Lance.  To top it off, he can throw random Frostfire bolts and Deep Freeze casts at the boss that he gets from procs.\n\nI am dual-specced PvE fire and PvP frost, and merely swapped over to my 2nd spec to do this fight."},{"id":1259057,"r":-2,"n":0,"b":"Quite easy to do with a shaman. (Preferably an enhancement shaman). Get initial aggro on the adds, drop Earthbind and run laps around the adds in the back with instant Ghost Wolf. Can decurse yourself and pop Shamanistic Rage if you get hit with the thunderclap. Toss out Unleash Elements to pick up the 3rd add when he switches. Would only recommend it if your group isn't lacking in dps, as it could potentially drag out the fight too long without your added dps on the boss."},{"id":1275927,"r":7,"n":3,"b":"Easiest way to do this is to have a druid in the raid.  Have the druid (any spec, even main tank) pop Nature's Grace, wait until 10-15seconds are left on buff, then get aggro on all three adds.  Wait until NG procs on all three adds then run away.  When NG comes off cooldown, use it again (even if adds are still rooted).  They'll hit you before the buff wears off.  Rinse and repeat.\r\n\r\nUsing this strat, all three adds are permanently rooted, by one single player, with very little kiting involved.  It also allows all three DPS to be engaged the whole fight instead of losing one due to kiting."},{"id":1276307,"r":7,"n":0,"b":"Easily done as a fire mage.  Pull by LBing all 3 adds, and kite them to the entrance of beauty’s room.  When they get close, blast wave them, then blink through them, and run back to the boss's spawn.  Scorch and LB the one that switches with the boss, then blast wave and blink through again.  Use frost nova and ice block if you get into trouble.\r\n\r\nThe adds seem to be rootable and snareable, but they cannot be stunned, disoriented, or encased (ring of frost, hunter trap, ect)"},{"id":1310442,"r":12,"n":0,"b":"Frost Mages doing the kiting: make sure your pet DOES NOT run through the adds, learned that the hard way..."},{"id":1316770,"r":5,"n":0,"b":"This achievement is really easy to get with a Frost Mage in your group who knows how to play frost, just get your pet out and put it on passive and then start the fight. Use your pet's Freeze and then use your Frost Nova and then Cone of Cold. Really really easy achievement."},{"id":1321014,"r":4,"n":0,"b":"Doable with a rogue as well, at least if the rogue is Mut spec. Crippling poison on both weapons and thrown means you can spam FoK when one of the adds gets close and usually slow it down before it gets in range to use Crepuscular Veil, or if it gets in range only one or two stacks.\r\n\r\nThe reason this works better as assassination rogue is because of talents that let you apply melee weapon poisons on FoK (much higher chance to apply crippling poison) as well as extra run speed, however other rogue specs may be able to do it."},{"id":1338475,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"Frost Death Knight kiting using Howling Blast with Chillblains - achievement nicely done. Just run and recast HB from safe 30 yard range."},{"id":1342030,"r":5,"n":0,"b":"Did this today as a Survival Hunter.\r\n\r\nI suppose it's doable by one person, but any extra CC is a huge help. Controlling the adds isn't too bad, but when the boss trades places with 1 add you might get hit by a Thunderclap which can cause you to get hit by adds.\r\n\r\nMake sure you're using Frost Trap and Snake Trap on cooldown. Spec into Entrapment so that both traps will stun the adds for 4 secs when they're triggered. Because of the way the adds work (they hit the last thing that hit them), your snakes will pull aggro on them which gives you some time.\r\n\r\nInstruct the group to resist cleaves on the boss when he's switching with an add. If they hit the add that takes the boss' place it's difficult to pull him off in time to prevent 4 stacks.\r\n\r\nI wanted to try using a Turtle with Thunderclap or something to pull the aggro on the adds, but I didn't want to risk him getting stacks of the debuff and it breaking the achievement."},{"id":1347863,"r":4,"n":0,"b":"Did this achievement on my Shadow Priest. \r\nAssuming the boss is tanked in the middle, you can throw up Inner Will (10% movement increase) and kite the adds around the boss in a circle. Just in-case you get the thunderclap debuff on you, you can always cleanse it yourself. I got the debuff to 2 stacks at max, for not cleansing thunderclap soon enough."},{"id":1363398,"r":4,"n":0,"b":"Just got this achievy, using a Warrior tanking the boss. Myself(surv hunter) and a DK switched off kiting the adds everytime the Boss tookover one of the adds bodies. A good tip is to always have a frost trap down even when the DK was kiting.\r\n\r\nGood luck!"},{"id":1369718,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"I do not have this achievement yet, but I was talking to my guild's tank and he said a shaman healer pug just went into ghost wolf and kited the adds around, and because my tank is quite geared and the boss does not hit hard he didn't need any heals the entire fight."},{"id":1394330,"r":6,"n":2,"b":"This achievement is extremely easy if you have a frost mage in the party.\n\nAs a frost mage, all I needed to do was to chain freeze the mobs full time. Start off by:\n\n1) Setting the pet on passive. You do not want your pet to get the debuff. \n2) Aggro the adds. Have the tank pick up the boss off you.\n3) Use your Water Elemental's nova on all three adds.\n4) Once the nova breaks, wait for them to come to you( judge your distance) and Cone of Cold. You should've talented [spell=12489]\n5) Once Cone of Cold breaks, wait for them to come to you and Frost Nova. You should blink after this action because the mobs will hit you with the debuff and you do not want it to add up.\n6) Once the boss switch places with the adds, Ice Lance the add to grab aggro off the tank. The tank should be taunting the boss off you.\n7) Stay away from the boss and keep the adds away from the party.\n8) Rinse and repeat. \n\nNOTE: Try to keep the adds away from the party or explain to your party members beforehand to not attack the adds at all during the entire fight and try to stay away from them at all times.\nHINT: [spell=31570] and [item=42737] will really help in this fight. If you're an engineer, [spell=55016] will help as well.\n\nThe easiest achievement for a frost mage, hands down."},{"id":1410763,"r":-5,"n":1,"b":"[url=http://www.wowhead.com/spell=122/frost-nova][Frost Nova][/url] + [url=http://www.wowhead.com/spell=34477/misdirection][Misdirection][/url]"},{"id":1522410,"r":-2,"n":0,"b":"Quite easily solo kited as a warlock that has Curse of Exhaustion. Also having the ach on tracked is a sure way to know if you have failed or not. Hope this helps!"},{"id":1558921,"r":3,"n":1,"b":"Couldn't a dps (maybe the lowest one) shoot the adds and run up the dungeon and as far as they can go? Assuming the mobs are killed. Or would the boss still switch with a minion regardless of out of range or out of sight?"},{"id":1610962,"r":10,"n":0,"b":"Didnt read through all the comments tbh, but if your having trouble with this achievement, you can \"ping-pong\" the adds between 2 players.\r\nWe used 2 hunters to bounce the adds between!\r\n\r\nSurvival Hunter - Me - DPS\r\nMarksmanship Hunter - DPS\r\nFeral Druid - Tank\r\nHoly Paladin - Healer\r\nEnhancement Shaman - DPS\r\n\r\nMe and the other hunter stood relatively far apart, but keeping each other in a certain range, then we each planted a Frost Trap (Slowing Trap) between us (Alternated for CDs) and we Multi-shotted the adds, so they would attack us, but move through the Frost, giving the other hunter enough time to do some damage to the boss, then we would swap, placing another Frost Trap while, just before the other ran out!\r\n\r\nAchievement Earned: Ascendant Descending!\r\n\r\nRemember, this is just how we did it, as we were having problems at first, who knows, maybe it will help, but then again it may not... this was posted just to help, not to say \"this is how you SHOULD do it!\""},{"id":1644135,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"THEY CAN BE ROOTED."},{"id":1656276,"r":2,"n":0,"b":"I wiped serval times on this.\r\n\r\nHave on party member kite all three shadows around the room. If he gets hit 4 times you lose the achievement. Frost mages, hunters, and natures grasp druids work great. \r\n\r\nGood luck!"},{"id":1764348,"r":5,"n":0,"b":"Best to have a full group (Tank +1) (Healer +1) (DPS +3) Have a ranged player like a hunter or mage pull the boss and his 3 gaurds, tank should then use a taunt to pull the boss off of the ranged player. You should first mark each of the gaurds with a brightly colored marker to make sure you dont lose one of them, the ranged player should kite them throughout the room and use rooting spells to slow them down. If they touch you the stacks start. and Jsuk they walk faster than average, as if they have aspects of the pack. So you may want to try using a hunter as a kiter."},{"id":1775112,"r":8,"n":1,"b":"Solo'd this achievement by kiting them around the room. Didn't get even one stack, but I wasn't awarded the achievement either. Seems like you either have to have more than one player in a group, or pets aren't allowed to get stacks either."},{"id":1858658,"r":5,"n":0,"b":"This can be done solo.\r\nJust completed this as 85 Disc Priest.\r\nA few tidbits: \r\n-void tendrils will root the 3 adds, but the tendril gets 4 stacks of Crepuscular Veil causing you to fail the achievement\r\n-boss will despawn once you get to the top of the ridge overlooking the forge (where Karsh Steelbender is)\r\n-you can easily outrun the adds between inner will and body and soul.  boss can slow you with a thunderclap (dispellable), a daze, and a stun.  tricky part is making sure you put enough distance between you and the adds when he does one of those.  otherwise, just keep running laps from top to bottom keeping sw:p, holy fire and penance up"},{"id":1867541,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"Duo'd with a warlock and resto druid. I just ran along the outside in cat form moonfiring when he switched places with one, warlocked nuked the boss. Only took a few minutes. Good luck!"},{"id":1880704,"r":2,"n":0,"b":"Just soloed it as a frost dk.\r\n\r\nMake sure you have the chillblains talent, then just save your howling blasts for the three adds.  You should be able to kite around in a big circle while keeping the adds snared and using obliterate/frost strike on the boss to kill him.\r\n\r\nHaving a healing potion and using lichborne/deathcoil was helpful, as this boss still does a decent bit of damage to a dps class."},{"id":1907172,"r":2,"n":0,"b":"[b]90 Surv Hunter / 542 iLevel [/b]\r\n\r\nObviously very easy at this level of gear. I failed previously (weeks ago) first time I tried due to pet getting stacks. If you're BM, just dismiss pet and go to Surv or MM spec."},{"id":1933774,"r":4,"n":0,"b":"Solo'd this as a 90 Blood Dk. Used [spell=50041 domain=www] and used the chains of ice to root the adds in place. Be sure to clear the room so you can kite the boss all around the room."},{"id":1935549,"r":6,"n":0,"b":"easily can be soloed  rogue at 5x.\r\npick toss, deadly throw and burst talents and run around the room.\r\nCloak of shadows removes the debuff."},{"id":1949036,"r":2,"n":0,"b":"I was able to pull this off solo with my paladin.  I attempted to solo as prot first, but the multiple slows and stuns make this very difficult.\r\n\r\nI switched to Holy and was able to pull it off due to being able to cleanse [spell=76186].  Since you can cast Judgement without facing the target, I was simply able to run in circles and cast Judgement behind me.  It took a few minutes, but was quite simple."},{"id":1980399,"r":3,"n":0,"b":"I wouldn't underestimate this fight for lvl 90. The matter is not only a DPS for quicker boss kill but the ability to kite in circles. My Mage 556 ilvl started with Fire spec in favor to dot the boss and kill him faster. But then I had to switch to Frost for better CC and won.\nSome tips to make your mage life easier:\n- macro /tar Ascendant Lord to be able to target him when he is switching with one of the adds\n- track your achievement, it shows if it failed.\n- Put your Ele on passive and leave by the lava pool. You can use extra Freeze when you are in range. If you have to Iceblock dismiss your pet and summon back. Otherwise the mobs run straight to it and the achievement can be put in risk. When the pet is re-summoned it stays back by the lava.\n- Darkwater Potion/Swiftness Potion just in case you get stuck when the boss is switching the place with one of his minions\n- Seems like Ring of Frost not working on the adds:(\n- PVP trinket\n- Blazing Speed\n- use Blink wisely:)))"},{"id":1980707,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"Void Tendrils will cause a fail... just found that out..."},{"id":1987211,"r":-1,"n":0,"b":"Got this today - solo.\r\n\r\n90 BM Hunter.\r\n\r\nI didn't feel like \"running\" the whole dungeon - so I stealthed my way through straight to him.  After killing all the adds in the tunnel and around him - I dismissed my pet.  Basically - I shot a Ice Trap right in front of him.  Then pulled with a multi-shot - hitting everything at once.  He came straight for me - and his adds got slowed by the Ice Trap so it gave me a few to back up, then disengage, and single target him.  I actually failed the first time because when he knocks you down/stuns you - it's hard to recover, move and shoot before the adds bear down on you...\r\n\r\nBut the second time I was able to recover fast enough to lay down another Ice Trap and disengage - giving me enough space to lay him out.\r\n\r\nSo that's my advice.  Pull with a SLOW on the adds - and just back up while you're single targeting him to death.  It gets tricky with the mirror effect and the stun but it's easily doable once you learn the timing of everything (especially the timing vs. your cds).\r\n\r\nGood luck getting the mount!\r\n(This was the last ach for me actually)"},{"id":1996470,"r":0,"n":0,"b":"Solo'd as a 550 Surv hunter with pet. Stacks on pet didn't seem to count as fail. Sent pet in first, started kiting when they aggro'd me using disengage and freezing trap. Deterrence wil prevent new stacks from coming up so I used it to make the debuff wear off. Also used feign death to reset my threat and get a little bit of space. Still a bit of a chaotic encounter though."},{"id":2017527,"r":102,"n":3,"b":"For all of you wondering, yes, one shotting him works."},{"id":2021045,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"I will share my experience with you. \r\nJust did this on my warrior alone. \r\n\r\nCharged boss and leaped when he switched form (ran from adds as well). Charged back on him when he reappear, used my engi belt and ran again and charged him 3rd time and killed him second before they got 4 stacks on me. \r\n\r\nCheers. \r\nLaylla."},{"id":2026897,"r":5,"n":0,"b":"Quite easy for frost DK, set Army of Dead onto boss, wait one second for them to get adds aggro and rang kill boss. Done within 5 seconds."},{"id":2026945,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"Ret pal, I sicced a [item=86570] on him, similar to the DK's strat above with the army of the dead.  Works like a charm."},{"id":2089722,"r":5,"n":0,"b":"Just to toss in how this goes for pure casters at 100 (ilvl 655 Lock). Wait for him to down Raz. Then hit him with your best shot. Fire away. Poor Raz though."},{"id":2141947,"r":15,"n":0,"b":"As of patch 6.1, the achievement is easy to get, especially for ranged classes. If you nuke the boss fast enough there's no issue, though as a melee if you're not able to one-two shot this may require some kiting."},{"id":2227994,"r":0,"n":0,"b":"Very easy, just got it. 693 arcane mage. Spammed my arcane blast until it started to cast, then spammed supernova while arcane blast was casting. dead boss. enjoy :)"},{"id":2313532,"r":0,"n":0,"b":"[pre]\n[zone=4926] achievements\n[u]                                                                        [/u]    \n[u][achievement=5281]    |[/u]                              |\n[u][achievement=5282]                  |[/u]                              |\n[u][achievement=5283]                     |[/u] https://youtu.be/fGfzyI0_Qy8 |\n[u][b][achievement=5284]   [/b]               |                              [/u]|                  \n[/pre]"},{"id":2490657,"r":2,"n":0,"b":"I confirm that now this can be easily one shot."},{"id":2559306,"r":10,"n":1,"b":"Solo at 110: wait for Raz (the angry giant) to kill the mobs he wants. Then one shot the boss. No aggro, no kiting, no trouble.\r\n\r\nI used a bear druid, killed boss from range with a Moonfire (single target, not buffed by the [item=144295] legendary). Got the achieve."}]}{"id":5287,"comments":[{"id":1161964,"r":133,"n":12,"b":"there are 3 groups with 20mobs in each right infront of the boss, pull all of these, nuke them down at same time, score achievement."},{"id":1237563,"r":29,"n":0,"b":"Adds killed by the gravity well appear to neither count for the achievement nor trigger it's timer to start."},{"id":1238398,"r":8,"n":0,"b":"We just did this. Its very important. There are 60 adds."},{"id":1259254,"r":66,"n":0,"b":"Not everything is a reference to some item of pop culture. Sometimes, it's just a rather well known saying that's been around for a long time."},{"id":1264556,"r":13,"n":1,"b":"if you have a mage, can be made easier using Ring of Frost.  just pull them all into it, freeze them, pull the boss, aoe and kill"},{"id":1268734,"r":-1,"n":0,"b":"Had a pali bubble me and ran in and agroed the boss. Then proceeded to kill all the adds , got the achive then finished off the boss."},{"id":1315109,"r":-5,"n":1,"b":"Seems similar to the achievement [achievement=1872 domain=www] for the WOTLK equivalent [achievement=2136 domain=www]"},{"id":1328464,"r":6,"n":0,"b":"Just as a note, it might be a good idea to have someone with a non-channeled AoE keep the boss targeted to interrupt the first Force Grip. Even though the mobs have ~16k hp, one dead dps (or God forbid, tank) can screw up your timing."},{"id":1375527,"r":-6,"n":0,"b":"Did this yesterday as an arms warrior. Tank aggro'd the boss (and all the adds ofc), I hit sweeping strikes and bladestorm. After three seconds i died with 73k dps 0.o"},{"id":1420645,"r":-2,"n":2,"b":"Tank ran in,  engaged boss, pulled all the adds.\n\n@#$%ing gravity well instant spawned, killed a dozen Disciples right on the $%^&ing boss pull. \n\nNo acheive."},{"id":1458683,"r":0,"n":3,"b":"Anybody else have a problem with failing this on the first attempt and not having the adds respawn? We've tried resetting the instance and everything with no luck. Surprised no one else seems to have run into this problem yet."},{"id":1593432,"r":13,"n":0,"b":"Was doing achievements with some buddies earlier and we accidentally aggro'd the adds without the boss and kill them, so we just moved to the next heroic without killing her.\r\n\r\nI went back about an hour later (I'm a hunter) and noticed that they add respawned. I sent my pet in, Aggro'd her, and started to AoE the adds; but they killed my pet in a heartbeat. But I had a stroke of good fortune when she used the gravity well, which killed the adds AND got me credit for the achievement. It would seem the ones killed in the vortex now count. So good luck all."},{"id":1863442,"r":1,"n":2,"b":"As of patch 5.3, this and other time based achievements are bugged. Still waiting on a hotfix."},{"id":1867532,"r":-5,"n":0,"b":"Just tried it, I killed all the ones at the start before agroing the boss so I don't know if those ones count but they didn't for me. But the ones that spawn during the fight do count though. The most I managed to get solo is 42 so far. The gravity wells are a pain in the ass and as a blood dk they eventually overrun my self healing so I haven't gotten the achievement yet."},{"id":1868665,"r":11,"n":1,"b":"You get credit for every devout follower you kill after you engage the High Priestess. So you can gather up a ton from the room before her and then all the ones in front of her, then hit her and AOE all the followers down and get the achievement even if gravity well kills a few. I must have had 80+ there when I AOEed so getting 60 is easy."},{"id":1934015,"r":238,"n":6,"b":"Don't be dumb like me: BEGIN the encounter by hitting the boss [i]before[/i] you kill all the Disciples."},{"id":2009585,"r":-6,"n":1,"b":"Can anyone advise if this is soloable (by a non-tank) now?"},{"id":2018673,"r":42,"n":0,"b":"Update for 6.0+ players wanting to solo this. You will need to pull boss first! Achievement will not count if you simply run up and burn down the mobs. It does say in the achievement to kill them \"During\" the encounter so be sure you are in combat with boss when you burn down the 3 sets of mobs there good luck on your achieve! :)"},{"id":2021485,"r":0,"n":8,"b":"Has anyone completed this recently?\r\n\r\nI have tried this 10+ times and almost 100% confident its bugged.\r\n\r\nRemoved cloak and trinkets and headpiece with capicitor gem.\r\n\r\nAggro boss, hit boss. All adds are now alive and grouped up around me. Kill all in a single blow with Crimson Tempest.\r\n\r\nNo achievement. Did this exact attempt the same way like 6 times. Then I played around with other attempts, like using gravity well, not hitting boss, not aggroing boss, etc...\r\n\r\nOut of permutations to try.\r\n\r\nThis also spanned a Tuesday maintenance and server reset.\r\n\r\nBugged."},{"id":2026927,"r":2,"n":1,"b":"I managed to solo this today on my hunter. I made sure pet was on passive (a lot of achievements fail if your pet actually makes the killing hit - might be the same for other pet classes). \r\n\r\n[ol]\r\n[li]Gather all of the disciples leading up to and all in front of the boss[/li]\r\n[li]Used auto shot to agro boss[/li]\r\n[li]Used explosive trap and barrage to nuke them all down[/li]\r\n[li]Killed boss as normal[/li]\r\n[/ol]\r\n\r\nNOTE: As someone said earlier, disciples dying in the bosses AoE spell won't count. So make sure you kill them all quickly and by yourself."},{"id":2066024,"r":32,"n":1,"b":"Easily soloable now.\r\n\r\nDo NOT kill the adds before the boss, do it AFTER you've aggroed her. Make sure YOU are the one killing the adds. If the boss kills them, it won't count towards the achievement.\r\n\r\nShould you mess up, DO NOT kill the boss. If you leave her alive and come back to the instance after about an hour, all the adds respawn for a second chance. :)"},{"id":2068306,"r":7,"n":2,"b":"Ok, if anyone was silly enough to engage those adds before the fight and don't feel like waiting around for them to re-spawn.\r\nThis achievement is possible to complete with the extra adds that come running during the fight.\r\nJust keep kiting the boss and adds away from the aoe and also the stones that she throws in the 2nd phase.\r\n\r\nI used the below macro to see how many adds were up (it counts the nameplates on screen), then just aoe'd once I had enough.\r\n\r\n/run local count = 0 for i = 0, 10000, 1 do if _G[\"NamePlate\"..i] ~= nil and _G[\"NamePlate\"..i]:IsVisible() then count = count + 1 end end print(count)"},{"id":2192437,"r":0,"n":0,"b":"Tried this today on my 100 Shaman. Just dropping a totem, even after aggroing the boss - does NOT work. You're going to have to target boss, Flame Shock, Lava Lash"},{"id":2311340,"r":4,"n":0,"b":"Level 100 Balance Druid, failed multiple times when dragging all the followers from before her and the ones in front of her, then hitting her.  She very quickly got her purple spell off and killed all the followers.  \r\nWhat worked was to drag all the followers by just running through them, walk up to her and let her talk, then she becomes red, quickly AOE everyone down before she can get the full circle spell complete. Think the key is somehow related to letting her talk, and the fractional time between her turning red and walking toward you. Worked like a charm.\r\n\r\nI did not have to strike her before beginning my AOE"},{"id":2332644,"r":55,"n":2,"b":"To anyone having problems with this particular achievement:\r\n\r\nI tried this multiple times, solo, and it never went off when I killed the minions, even after pulling the boss. However, I changed one thing, and I was able to get it.\r\n\r\n1.) Pull followers in the room before boss\r\n2.) Pull followers in front of boss\r\n3.) Pull boss\r\n4.) Kill 1, and only 1, follower to start the timer\r\n5.) AoE other followers\r\n6.) Achieve\r\n7.) Kill Boss\r\n\r\nHopefully this is helpful to some of you! Happy hunting!"},{"id":2334366,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"Fairly simple to get this as a level 100. As a paladin all I did was gathered the 100 [npc=42428]s in [npc=42333]'s room and the room before, taunted the boss with [spell=62124] and immediately dropped [spell=135517]. Achievement got, just like that :)"},{"id":2343837,"r":0,"n":0,"b":"As a hunter, can i freeze trap her to start the instances and then kill the disciples? cause once that is off cd she attacks"},{"id":2500393,"r":2,"n":0,"b":"I was a bit stuck on this one because after you pull her she immediately casts Gravity Well and then kill all the followers. Then I immediately used my [url=http://www.wowhead.com/item=144259/kiljaedens-burning-wish]trinket[/url] and win!"},{"id":2550825,"r":3,"n":0,"b":"As 963 ilvl mage. Pull the boss using 'Spellsteal', shimmer to 3 grps, 'Frost Nova', 'Frozen Orb'. Done !"},{"id":2554821,"r":8,"n":1,"b":"Took a few different tries at 110. On the successful attempt I gathered all the mobs from the first room and while running through the mobs in front of her I taunted the boss. She said a word or two and I swiped the mobs. Win! She will not face pull that I could tell so find a way to pull her at a distance without killing her."},{"id":2578960,"r":5,"n":0,"b":"As a 110 Affliction lock I pulled all the Followers and went back as far as I could, put up a Demonic Gateway right in front of the High Priestess and went through to aggro her, when they caught up to her I killed everything. Achievement achieved."},{"id":2583556,"r":6,"n":0,"b":"110 Holy Priest. Rounded up all the followers in room before and in front of her. Cast \"Dispell Magic\" on boss and immediately used \"Holy Nova\" aoe on followers. Got achievement."},{"id":3128060,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"You need to aggro first, then kill stack of mobs or NO achievment."},{"id":3231398,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"Just did this as a Brewmaster Monk. I gathered up all of the mobs, including those in the room before the boss. Dropped the Black Ox Statue on the boss from a distance, and immediately burned down the followers with Rushing Jade Wind, then nuked the boss."},{"id":3236468,"r":4,"n":0,"b":"Make sure you have agro on the boss before you kill all 60 mobs."},{"id":5669608,"r":3,"n":0,"b":"If you're having trouble soloing this at max-level without one-shotting [npc=42333], simply use the [item=46725] sold by the [url=https://www.wowhead.com/item=46725/red-rider-air-rifle#sold-by]various toymakers[/url] throughout Azeroth. I ran through the group of [npc=42428]s in the Chamber of Fanatics right before the room where Azil is, gathered up all the ones in front of her, and then hit her once with the rifle. Before she could come down the platform to where I was, I did a quick AoE on the followers and was instantly rewarded the achievement.\n\nThis little pellet gun, along with the [item=97919] [i](which severely reduces player damage, but has to be used prior to starting combat)[/i], have been my go-to items for completing achievements & quests when I can't insta-kill the mobs. [item=137663] is another good one to keep in mind, but - unlike the gun & the shrinker - the foam sword can't be used in dungeons."},{"id":5706994,"r":5,"n":0,"b":"Today I got this by pulling the 3 groups in front of the boss,  hitting the boss with the Fruit Basket toy, nuking the trash then killing the boss."},{"id":5758383,"r":3,"n":0,"b":"Done this today, super easy without any items as Druid.\r\n\r\n1. Jump next to the boss platform to pull him\r\n2. Aggro all NPCs in front of the boss\r\n3. Wait for boss to start casting a spell, as soon as he starts he won't move for few seconds\r\n4. Move away from boss and kill all NPCs - Achievement done\r\n5. Kill the boss"},{"id":6041656,"r":5,"n":0,"b":"There are more than enough cultists in the 3 groups in front of the boss and in the room before. Round them all up before aggroing the boss, taunt the boss from a distance and instantly AOE the mobs down without killing the boss."},{"id":6218432,"r":3,"n":0,"b":"[b]Did this today on my level 80 mage[/b].\n\n>Ran through the room before the boss to body pull all the adds\n>Then ran to the the boss room to body pull the rest.\n>Positioned far away enough from the boss\n>Waited for them to properly gather around me.\n>Targeted the boss - used [spell=2139] (Interrupt) to pull the boss without damaging.\n>Clicked [spell=1449]\n>Got achievement.\n>Kill boss."}]}

> [{"id":5288,"count":48,"profit":[{"id":2063513,"r":14,"n":2,"b":"Doing this for [achievement=4845]. I can confirm that as of 6.0 (and at lvl100) any form of tactics are redundant.\r\n\r\n1. Jump in.\r\n2. Nuke.\r\n3. Profit."}]},{"id":5289,"count":54,"profit":[]},{"id":5290,"count":33,"profit":[]},{"id":5291,"count":57,"profit":[]},{"id":5292,"count":131,"profit":[{"id":1389194,"r":5,"n":0,"b":"By far the easiest (albeit the most time consuming) method we used out of the three times I've had to get this achievement, was the method of burning his shield.  The problem is that people are running out of mana due to a lot of damage going around, however our Shammy healer stated that it was easy to heal through.  To reiterate, here's what we did exactly:\r\n\r\n1) Normal group build-- 3 dps, 1 tank, 1 healer (350 ilvl).  It definitely requires a decently geared group. We had a mage or shaman for time-warp or heroism in all cases, and at least 1 if not 2 ranged dps. All dps were 12k+ avg dps on most heroic bosses.\r\n\r\n2) We planned ahead, deciding that the tank would mark the purple melee adds in the order they spawned as [Skull], [Cross], [Square].  That would be the kill order when the time came. (this is where the methods differ).\r\n\r\n3) We ran in together and face pulled the boss, blowing CDs immediately (including time-warp), which gave us a few seconds to blast down his health before the shield went up.  Every second of this is 2 minutes with the shield up.\r\n\r\n4) We began to burn his health down through the shield, blowing CDs as they came up.  We killed the gray caster adds as close to the edge as possible to prevent damage from storms.\r\n\r\n5) As the melee adds spawned, the tank picked them up, marked them accordingly, and tanked them away from the group.  He slowly brought them down to ~20% health.\r\n\r\n---Slow Method---\r\n6) We Nuked through the shield (-90% damage) for around 8 minutes, until we got him down to 100K HP, and started working on the adds.  We killed skull first, then cross, then square, stacking on the tank for the debuff, so that after square died, Siamat's shield went down.\r\n\r\n7) The tank quickly taunted him to prevent us from getting killed, and then we nuked him and we were able to kill him in seconds without much damage.  In fact, we killed him before we stopped bouncing.  Everyone in the group got the achievement (after 2 attempts).  Healing was intense when all three melee adds were up, however with the casters going down fast, it wasn't much of a problem.\r\n\r\n---Fast method--\r\n\r\n6) We nuked through the shield for around 4 minutes until we reached something around 40%, then started on the adds.  This time, we killed Square first (starting in reverse order from how they spawned), triggering the shield to drop.  It took just long enough to drop that we were able to take the debuff. \r\n\r\n7) Tank taunted boss quickly to reduce group damage.  We were able to range nuke him during the bounce and get back just in time to kill Cross, and obtain the second stack of the debuff. We burned the boss for another 15 seconds, and killed Skull and obtained the final stack. This is where it got sticky.  We wiped once from too much damage, and twice from not killing him before the stack wore off. BE READY TO STOP ALL DAMAGE AND WIPE IN A SECOND'S NOTICE.  You'll need to save a second or third round of CDs for this point and save time-warp/heroism for this part as well.\r\n\r\n8) ?\r\n\r\n9) PROFIT!\r\n\r\nAnother, faster method was to burn the boss only before the shield goes up and between each add using the order of reverse of spawn order (not trying to burn through shield at all), but this requires a lot of dps and probably won't happen with most uncoordinated groups.  VOIP communication was crucial for this achievement.  I would say this was by far the most demanding of all the Cata glory achievements."}]},{"id":5293,"count":59,"profit":[]},{"id":5294,"count":19,"profit":[]},{"id":5295,"count":40,"profit":[]},{"id":5296,"count":25,"profit":[]},{"id":5298,"count":24,"profit":[]}]

Works best for ranged DPS who can walk around for the first two.\r\n\r\n1 & 2:  Get these from [npc=43873].  There are two in the area where you fight the dragon, usually at the outer edge of the area (for me, one was by the entrance, the other near where you exit to the next area of the dungeon).\r\n\r\nTo get them, stand under them and wait for a wandering tornado to toss you in the air, and then just click on the orb while up there.  The problem with these two orbs is fighting the boss while doing it: conventional wisdom says to be near the boss and shift position to take advantage of the wind that speeds you up or slows you down.  Naturally, this will be nearly impossible for melee and anyone that needs to channel stuff, but ranged folks (especially those with fire-and-forget stuff, like warlocks with DOTs) can do this easier.\r\n\r\n3 & 4:  I wait until [npc=43875] is dead, so that nobody has to wait on me for a silly achievement.  Then, staying in the dungeon, go back to the beginning and jump on the left-hand tornado near the dungeon entrance.  You'll be near the bridge with the swirly orbs that knock you around unless you attack with weapons.\r\n\r\nThere should be 2 orbs here, on the side of the bridge.  To get them, you need the orbs to knock you over to them; jumping off and clicking doesn't seem to be enough to get to them.  So, attack an orb enough to stop it for a moment.  Then, use camera angle to make sure you are directly between the bridge orb and the one you're  trying to get, and facing out to the one you're getting.  When the bridge orb fires up again and knocks you over the side, you should fly straight at the golden orb; just click like crazy to try and catch it before you start the sequence where you get sent back to dungeon entrance.  This may take a few tries, but these are some of the easiest orbs to catch.\r\n\r\n5+:  The rest is pretty much your choice.  The last third section of the dungeon has up to three golden orbs off the sides of the spiral ramps going up and down.  Just get the speed buff the little tornado gives you, and run-jump off the side to get the orb.  My advice is to run-jump from a slightly higher angle than straight from the side, to give you more clearance and distance.\r\n\r\nThere are other orbs, too, but they may not be quite as easy to get; I leave that to the judgement of the individual player.\r\n\r\n\r\nGood luck!"},{"id":1696261,"r":10,"n":0,"b":"a guide to all orbs \r\n\r\nhttp://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_A5Rv3xF33k"},{"id":1779326,"r":-15,"n":1,"b":"Here is a good and simple Youtube guide for 5 orbs! http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_A5Rv3xF33k"},{"id":1845920,"r":-1,"n":0,"b":"This achieve was pretty easy to get. No idea what the cause was."},{"id":1297973,"r":2,"n":0,"b":"Basically how this works is is in the first and second phase, the phoenix leaves fire behind. In the shadow phase, our tank ran in large circles with the shadowy phoenix, while our DPS did our best to kill as many as we can, trying to stun them in the fire and killing them. 2 were killed outside of fire, and as soon as we got the third one everyone in the group got the achievement, so there no need to kill the boss."},{"id":1709998,"r":4,"n":0,"b":"The Soul Fragments spawn off every member of the party, including the tank.  Right after spawning, they don't move for several seconds and have a purplish link to the fire bird.  (when spawned, there is a screen announcement indicating which player the Fragment is coming from, not sure if this from the addon DBM or from the encounter itself) [b]The purple link makes it easy for the tank to see where and how many Fragments have spawned.[/b]   The Soul Fragments are on a one way course to the bird that is stuck to the tank like glue--they buff the bird if they reach it.\r\n\r\nAs per the achievement, your group has to burn down the Fragments after they walk through fire (their name will change to Burning Soul).  The difficulty in this is kiting the bird away from the Fragments (so they don't buff the bird and disappear), kiting the Fragments through the fire, and DPSing the Burning Souls fast enough.  Also, even with fast DPS, the adds spawn quick enough so that there will likely be 2 or 3 Fragments out by the time the third one is downed, so the kiting can get hairy.\r\n\r\n***\r\nIn this end, it is helpful to have all ranged stack towards one side of the arena; melee, too, should go there if there is enough ranged DPS to down the add quickly after walking through the fire.  This becomes even easier if, in Phase 1, the tank slowly kites the fire bird/egg down the center of the arena producing a longitudinal wall of fire.  Stacking the other members on the opposite side of the fire wall gives some much needed space between the adds and the bird, making the kite much easier and quicker.\r\n***\r\n\r\nHowever, a Fragment spawning off the tank makes the kiting more difficult since the tank has to cross to the other side of the fire, increasing the chance that a spawn off another member will inadvertently merge with the bird.  If that was the first spawn, it's not really an issue; if it was the second or third spawn, and there are already a few Soul Fragments out, it would probably easier to sacrifice it to the bird so that the other Soul Fragments can walk through the fire.  When done with this method, the tank doesn't have to move much at all and the entire encounter becomes rather simple.\r\n\r\n[b]If your group is over geared (or contains PUGs who don't follow directions well), instruct everyone not to attack the fire bird AT ALL, don't use AOE, etc. since killing the bird ends the phase and the achievement run will be a failure.[/b]  If your healer is having a difficult time, the bird could be DPSed down to 50% or so, but this also takes DPS away from the Soul Fragments.  In that case, it would be safer just to focus on the achievement first and risk a wipe.\r\n\r\nOne final comment: this is a personal achievement that does not reset between encounters.  This explains how one party member can complete the achievement on the first or second kill.\r\n\r\n[i](I PUGed almost every achievement for Glory of the Cataclysm Hero, and this was the second to last one that I completed-- the last being Ascendant Descendant.  At the end of Cataclysm, not many people in Trade chat were interested in completing these.  Most group members would at least try this achievement, usually not following directions well.)[/i]"},{"id":1772033,"r":9,"n":1,"b":"As of right now it seems to be bugged. Hooray!"},{"id":1830325,"r":61,"n":4,"b":"You can despawn the boss by running away around the corner. He will respawn after 1 min or so.\n\nThe achievement works this way... A dark blue Phoenix will spawn, which must be kept alive until the achievement is done (which will display during the fight after finishing it). If he dies before, follow my first hint. Even at lvl 90 there is a fail limit. ^^\n\nGL with the achievement."},{"id":2016910,"r":41,"n":2,"b":"I did this as level 90 balance druid.\n\nEngaged High Prophet Barim and a Phoenix spawned and leaving a trail of fire behind him. I kited the phoenix around just to have a little bit of fire everywhere.\n\nBoss dropped to 50% hp and ripped my soul from my body. This starts phase 2. \n\nI was sent to spirit realm? shadow realm? spirit world? w.e... There was a shadowy phoenix that followed me around, left him alone for now. \n\nShadowy copies of myself started spawning and walked towards the phoenix, [b]these shadowformed bastards are the ones needed for the achievement.[/b] I kited them so they would walk through the fire that was left around from the phoenix at the start of the fight.\n\nAfter those shadow replicates stepped into fire, they got a debuff and I killed them. Repeated this 3 times and got the achievement. After that I finished the shadowphoenix and boss.\n\nnote: One of the shadow souls didn't catch fire when I was doing this achievement so I actually had to kill 4 of those in the spirit realm. So if you for w.e. reason miss some, dw there will be more than needed for the achievement.\n\nAlso be sure that you get the achievement before proceeding to kill the shadowy phoenix. Here are the steps to complete this:\n\n1. During phase 1, a red phoenix will spawn.  It leaves fire on the ground.  Make sure a single fire spot is on the ground before damaging the boss to 50%.\n2. During phase 2, a purple phoenix will spawn. It will spawn copies of yourself named Soul Fragment which will walk toward you.  Position yourself between the phoenix and the fire that was spawned in Phase 1, the name of the Soul Fragment will change to Burning Fragment.\n3.  Kill 3 Burning Fragments.  Done, achievement earned."},{"id":2315418,"r":3,"n":0,"b":"[pre][zone=5396] Achievements\r\n[u]                                                                   [/u]\r\n[u][achievement=5291]              |    https://youtu.be/37RWYUMuNNs |[/u]\r\n[u][achievement=5290]           |    https://youtu.be/oIsYURRfHy4 |[/u]\r\n[u][achievement=5292]                 |    https://youtu.be/islaxPO-fmE |[/u]\r\n[/pre]"},{"id":2360017,"r":9,"n":0,"b":"At level 100 dk, I stripped naked and used a low level weapon to get him to half health. I summoned my ghoul to help finish Barim off."},{"id":2543732,"r":50,"n":3,"b":"TLDR: \r\n\r\n1) Walk up to the boss and wait for the red phoenix\r\n\r\n2) Drag the red phoenix around so there's fire on the ground\r\n\r\n3) Punch the boss to just below 50% hp and wait for the purple phoenix \r\n\r\n4) Wait for the purple phoenix to spawn copies of you, drag them through the red phoenix's fire, then kill them. \r\n\r\nYou'll get the achieve as soon as you've killed three copies; before the boss is dead."},{"id":2857082,"r":8,"n":1,"b":"I'm going to say this achieve is, at the very least, glitchy. I am a hunter, so I MD with a single punch to my pet so I could have his big body out of the way...that won't trigger what you need, so wait. You need the fire bird to make it's appearance and drag it around a little bit and leave fire spots for the souls to walk through. I found clustering them up was best, rather than being satisfied with gambling I was a master of guiding them through one or two spots. \n\nAfter I did this, I went and punched him one more time and this tossed me into the 'bow to me', and this sets you where you want. Now purple/shadow bird is going to make it's appearance, and you want to drag this thing over to the fire and this is where I found it glitchy. The souls would spawn, and you'd see 'burning' pop and unpop while they were still in the fire. I just killed, and the most ironic one of all was one that wasn't even walking in the fire, nor changed...I was running out of time, and I just thought. \"Screw it...it's going to be a FD reset anyway.\" To my surprise I got it. \n\nSo I really don't know what is up with this achieve [other than I'm glad I'm done with it]. My advice is even if they don't have the name burning in it, but are burning or you are close to end like I was and have nothing to loose...hey, just go for it [the achieve will go off before killing the boss, so you know if you've succeeded and whether you will need to reset or not]."},{"id":3205011,"r":37,"n":4,"b":"This achievement, even nowadays, in BFA is quite \"tricky\" to be done. I failed a few times due the fact that i got confused in the comments i read,so here is my experience:\n\nFirst of all,[b] remove all gear[/b]. Even naked, you have a chance to kill the boss with normal hit in one-shot (it happened to me 2 times). Secondly, clear all the trash nearby the boss, to avoid \"confusion\" and mistakes. \nOnce everything is cleared, start moving nearby the boss until he starts the combat. \nStage 1: the boss will summon a fire phoenix, that phoenix will drop fire patches on the ground, once you got 3-4 patches, hit the boss ([b]with normal hits, not skills because you can one-shot him[/b]) to lower him bellow 50% HP to enter stage 2.\nStage 2: the boss will summon a [npc=43927] , a \"dark-purple phoenix\" that will cast [spell=82255] on you, which will summon a \"spirit clone\" of yourself. This clone is called [npc=115113] and will target you and move slowly towards you. Now, what you need to do is to direct the [npc=115113] towards the fire patches on the ground. When the [npc=115113] will be on fire, he will get a short duration debuff and it will turn into a [b]Burning Soul[/b]. When it is turned into [b]Burning Soul[/b], use a instant cast spell to kill it fast, because after a few seconds (5 sec i think), the Soul will disappear. \nRepeat it until you kill [b]3 Burning Souls[/b] and voila...you got the achievement. \n\nP.S. : i did it with my 120 shaman. Once the the [npc=115113] was up, i was targeting it and waiting to turn into a[b] Burning Soul[/b] and instantly killing him with Flame Shock once the turned."},{"id":3229745,"r":20,"n":2,"b":"I just did this on a level 120 fire mage. It was actually much easier than when I attempted it on my 120 assassination rogue and failed, here's how I did it:\n\n[ol]\n[li]First off remove all of your clothes. I keep a default equipment set that contails all my gear pre-naked, and then another set called \"naked\" where all my equips are off.[/li]\n[li]Engage the fight by standing near/on the boss.[/li]\n[li]Hit F1 so that you're targeting yourself. Kite the boss to the top stairs, and just stand there. Don't do anything or attack anything[/li]\n[li]Let the boss summon his \"phoenix\" (Ashes of Alar looking bird). Still stand and don't do anything yet.[/li]\n[li]Let the phoenix drop those fire balls onto the ground, cluster them all in the same spot.[/li]\n[li]Once a few have dropped from the phoenix, re-engage the boss and hit him with one and only one scorch. This should get him down to 50-ish percent to start stage 2.[/li]\n[li]Hit F1 again to re-target yourself[/li]\n[li]A purple phoenix pops up and summons mirror images of you called soul fragments. Target the fragment as soon as it pops up, don't wait. Try to kite the fragment in a straight line through the fire and towards you, so stand behind the previously dropped fire.[/li]\n[li]As soon as the soul fragment walks into the fire, it turns into a burning soul. Hit a Fire blast IMMEDIATELY[/li]\n[li]You need to do this 2 more times in order to get the achievement. The achievement actually dings before you finish the boss, so you will definitely know when you get it and if you havent.[/li]\n[li]Note that the fragments sometimes merge with the harbinger, and there's nothing you can do there except wait for another soul fragment to pop up.[/li]\n[li]Soul fragments will pop up for as long as the harbinger/purple bird is [b]*NOT DEAD*[u][/u][/b] so do not target the harbinger until the achievement pops[/li]\n[/ol]\n\nI hope this helps people. Just remember to be patient and set yourself up so that the soul fragments walk into the fire to become burning souls and remember, you don't have to move on to the next stage of the fight until the achievement dings, so that bird will poop out soul fragments as long as you still haven't gotten it."},{"id":3236247,"r":12,"n":0,"b":"first get naked, test your meele dmg on nearby mobs to see how hard u hit so u dont one-shot the boss.\n\nOnce that's out of the way, pull the boss, wait until the boss puts FIRE ON THE GROUND. Right away, a purple phoenix will summon a bunch of shadowy copies of yourself.\nMove those 3 shadowy copies to the fire and kill them immediately.\n\nThen kill the boss and you are set"},{"id":5178128,"r":4,"n":0,"b":"Strangely, the mob name changes back and forth between \"Soul Fragment\" and \"Burning Soul\" when it touches the fire. \r\n\r\nDespite this, what you're really looking for is it's debuff called Burning Soul. The timer on this was very strict. We killed him as his energy rolled back over to 100."},{"id":1230573,"r":32,"n":0,"b":"For an actual strategy...\n\nEither 1 tank 4 dps or 4 dps 1 healer. We did it with 1 tank 4 dps. DPS need to be at least 12k, tank around 5-6k. Bloodlust needed obviously.\n\nNow, this fight has a bit of RNG. The boss has 100 focus, he use focus each time he use an ability (fire tornadoes, heroic leap, orb summoning, etc. Basically everything except auto attack). So the trick is to hope that he actually use abilities that can be interrupted, so he doesn't lose focus on abilities that can't be interrupted. Also, if you interrupt one of his ability with Counterspell, he will not lose any focus for 8 seconds (since he's interrupted for that long). Interrupts recommending are Counterspell, Shield Bash and Spell Lock (from a felhunter).\n\nAnother trick is to tank him in the corner of the room, so he spend more time walking to the middle to begin recharging. Position yourself accordingly so you don't lose dps time moving.\n\nNote: to get the achievement, you simply have to kill him before he totally complete his AoE when he's charging. It's very easy to see, he gain a buff when he  recharges. If that buff runs out, you've failed the achievement."},{"id":1233664,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"We had it hardly, 4 dps 1 heal (MK-lock-enh sham-uh dk-holy pal) kick all spells and use BL Intelligently, we used it at 10 foca, (we was still on us)\nThere was almost nothing HP in time grants\nhttp://img24.imageshack.us/img24/6685/rajhhf.jpg"},{"id":1238881,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"Got this achievement very easily using the following strategy, not even bloodlust is needed:\n\nWe kited the boss all the way to the middle of the stairs (he resets if you kite him further), kept interrupting his casts until he hit low energy.\n\nAs soon as he started moving, all our dps used a swiftness potion, giving us ten more seconds of dps time before he reaches the middle and starts channeling.\n\nSetup:\n\nProt war\nFeral druid\nMuti Rogue\nFrost DK\nHoly priest\n\nHealer just healed, tank stayed in tank spec + gear\n\nWe got the boss down before he even recharged half of his energy this way, and none of our damage dealers had even close to 20k dps."},{"id":1239974,"r":-2,"n":0,"b":"4 dps 1 heal\r\n\r\nMage/Boomkin/Hunter/Ret/Prot Warrior\r\n\r\n18.4, 17.6, 12.3, 11.7, 8.3k dps\r\n\r\nKilled it after about maybe 10 energy regen, so plenty of time."},{"id":1240803,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"Group comp: ret pally tank, destro lock, frost mage, feral druid and holy paladin.  Used lust when he had around 20 focus left, tanked him near the wall.  Failed and missed the achievement by literally ~ 1 second.  All of our dps was sitting at ~17k dps... pure RNG fail.\n\nUpdate: Got the achieve a couple days ago.  He needs to cast at least 2 spells that you can interrupt in order to do it.  If he doesn't use two abilities with cast times then just reset him.  This achievement is not really about high dps.  When we got the achievement he actually used 3 abilities that we were able to interrupt.  Our grp comp was a paladin healer, destro lock (20k dps), affliction lock (myself 17k dps), mage (17k dps), and a druid tank (10k dps).  We popped hero @ around 20 focus left, after we interrupted his third cast.  Waiting till the very end of the cast to interrupt and tanking him in the corner of the room will give you the most dps time in phase 1.  Good luck."},{"id":1244197,"r":2,"n":0,"b":"Enh shammy, Fury Warrior, Lock, Mage, DK.  Dk pops army.  Hero.  GO!.  dead. Interrupt the casts as often as possible, ensures he stays in the first phase long enough, as he retains energy if the interrupt is successful.\n\nWe got him down to about ~40% before he went to cast this aoe. Lust at 40 focus and I tanked him in a far corner so that he had further to walk to begin his recharge cycle.  \n\nRNG is definitely a factor as, in theory, you could get him well past 50% health before he runs out of focus or he could still be at 70% just due to using uninterruptable abilities thus draining him more quickly of his focus.\n\nWe had two DKs in the group and we considered using two armies at the start to \"tank\" while I went Fury for additional dps (single target prot warrior dps is meh).  We got it with a traditional setup so it didn't seem to matter.  I suppose an \"ideal\" setup might include a disc priest to Smite/Atonement heal and at least one DK for army or even a hunter for a pet.  He really doesn't hit all that hard to you don't need a \"real\" tank for the first phase."},{"id":1347503,"r":2,"n":0,"b":"just got this achievement:\r\n\r\nhunter ~20k dps\r\nboomkin ~19k dps\r\nmage ~15k dps\r\npally tank ~6k dps\r\n\r\nblew lust at 20 energy\r\nblew cooldowns and everything we had dps wise during the recharge phase and nuked with ~35 energy to go!"},{"id":1353553,"r":2,"n":0,"b":"completed this achievement today with a pug.  group composition: mage, rogue, boomkin, dk tank, priest healer.  both the tank and the healer spec'd dps and we tanked the boss in the corner of the room.  we interrupted anything we could and blew all of our cooldowns when he migrated to the centre of the room and started his aoe recharge ability.  defeated rahj on the first try with the achievement and with everyone still alive.  \r\n\r\ndps meter - \r\nmage: 25,606\r\nrogue: 20,604\r\ndruid: 8,459\r\ndk: 8,059\r\npriest: 7,079\r\n\r\ngood luck!"},{"id":1365180,"r":2,"n":0,"b":"me priest healer switched to dps\r\npriest: 20k\r\nlock:19k\r\nhunter:15k:\r\nshaman: 12k\r\npally:6k\r\n\r\n\r\nlusted when he walked to the center, so should've lusted sooner, but we got it anyway."},{"id":1389174,"r":2,"n":0,"b":"We managed to complete this achievement using a DK tank with 12K dps, a super bursty 20K dps ret pally, a resto shaman, a pro face busting 22K dps arcane mage, and a fail 5k dps hunter who just wanted a free ride to the achievement.  We only got to interrupt one ability, so we really had to push it during the recharge phase.\r\n\r\nSince you gain 100% damage increase on Rajh during this phase, and the phase lasts 20 seconds, its important to try and gauge some time before this ability starts (hard to say, since he can start walking to the middle anytime between 0 and 10 energy).  We got lucky and timed it perfectly so we got a good amount of time-warp running before he started walking.  We tanked him on the edge of the star so he'd walk further.  Once he started casting the recharge, we blew our 20 sec damage CDs, and we were able to take full advantage of these AND time-warp.  It was flawless and a best case scenario type situation, but we downed him at 95 energy, so it was close, despite our decent dps.\r\n\r\nBut the result was that we downed him with good ol' fashioned pew pew pew, and one good interrupt.  No tricks, no luck, we just broke his face (and our fingers) to get it."},{"id":2021331,"r":28,"n":4,"b":"in 6.0 just zerg it, piece of cake."},{"id":2166703,"r":5,"n":0,"b":"Not that hard for 100.\r\n\r\nFirst of all, I got panic because of all the comments - to zerg or not to zerg... It's the big blue glass plate on the ground between the hall leading to Anraphet and the hall leading outside to Ptah. I think any of the glowing transporters drop you at the elevator. Use the control box on the side of the elevator to request a lift to the second floor and you're there."},{"id":5380812,"r":3,"n":0,"b":"Just hit him and done ;)"}]}{"id":5296,"comments":[{"id":1117145,"r":110,"n":10,"b":"When an object speeds up, it gains mass. \r\nThat extra mass requires extra energy to speed up. \r\nBy the time the object reaches the speed of light its mass will be infinite and thus require an infinite amount of energy to to increase its speed. \r\nSince nothing can be bigger then infinity, nothing can travel faster then the speed of light."},{"id":1117796,"r":56,"n":1,"b":"Sandurz: Prepare ship for light speed!\r\nDark Helmet: No, no, no, light speed is too slow.\r\nSandurz: Light speed, too slow?\r\nDark Helmet: Yes. We're gonna have to go right to... [i][b]ludicrous speed! [/b][/i]\r\n       — Spaceballs"},{"id":1118927,"r":7,"n":0,"b":"The Vault of Lights event begins when you talk to Brann in front of the door.\r\n\r\nYou need to kill the 4 elemental sub-bosses, along with the final boss that is summoned.\r\n\r\nStart moving immediately after the door is opened to the first elemental. The troggs in the room constantly respawn, so avoid them as much as possible. Any troggs you aggro, bring them with you to the elementals."},{"id":1130566,"r":-2,"n":1,"b":"Queen anyone?"},{"id":1218659,"r":69,"n":1,"b":"This event starts the moment Brann opens the door, giving you 5 minutes to kill all 4 of the Elemental Warders and opening the far door.  The initial role-play will take off 10 seconds from the timer, so you need to move quickly and drag the Trogg groups with you as you engage the various lieutenants.  Each of these Trogg packs will respawn very quickly (think of the flame room in BRD).  A good group can avoid all but 4 packs of Troggs (the ones on the stairs).\n\n[b]Of the 4 Elemental Warders, only the Fire Warder is particularly dangerous.[/b]  When he channels Raging Inferno ([spell=77241 domain=www]), the group needs to move away from him as it will quickly kill even the hardiest of tanks in a few seconds.  He also randomly casts Lava Eruption ([spell=91161 domain=www]) on the floor which deals 40k+ damage.  The Lava Eruption can be avoided by watching for the small lava pool on the ground.\n\nIf you can kill the 4th lieutenant with ~20 seconds remaining on the achievement timer, then this achievement will auto complete at the conclusion of the small role-play event when the doors opens.  It is not necessary to kill Anraphet in the time alotted (~4:30), so you do not have to pull him immediately, giving your group time to regain their mana and rebuff if needed."},{"id":1237388,"r":13,"n":2,"b":"This achievement isn't particularly difficult, it just doesn't allow for mistakes. Which there isn't much to watch out for, anyways. The fire elemental is the only threatening boss that might hinder your group's progress if you have an unfocused group member.\n\nIf you stay level-headed the entire way through, skip simple trogg packs, and move relatively smoothly through it all, then you should easily acquire the achievement. If your DPS is lacking you may need to try some tricks such as killing the boss as you drag it to the next boss.\n\nAlso, despite previous statements, the final boss does not need to die. The time the ending roleplay takes seems to be about 21 seconds, so you want to aim for earlier than that figure.\n[s]\nAlso, if for some reason a party member dies at the end, should you had rushed too fast or just got reckless, that party member will not receive the achievement unless alive. Make sure to use the roleplaying time to resurrect them immediately.[/s]"},{"id":1247716,"r":3,"n":0,"b":"Hey guys here a video if you wanna check it out! Includes basic explanation and some hopefully helpful tips.\r\n\r\n[code]http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uDVtlho8X7Q[/code]"},{"id":1255555,"r":30,"n":1,"b":"[quote][small]Unfortunately, you're not quite right, as it is entirely possible to move faster than light, if you can go faster than 17 m/s you're fine.\n\nFrom Wikipedia's page on Superfluids: \"In 1999, one type of superfluid was used to trap light and greatly reduce its speed. In an experiment performed by Lene Hau, light was passed through a Bose-Einstein condensed gas of sodium (analogous to a superfluid) and found to be slowed to 17 m/s (61.2 km/h) from its normal speed of 299,792,458 metres per second in vacuum.\"[/small][/quote]\n\nWell that's cheating isn't it?\nI'm sure I could swim faster than Micheal Phelps if I threw him into a vat of molasses, while I swam in nice clear water."},{"id":1256124,"r":0,"n":0,"b":"We just tried this achi. Even if you do everything perfect, you might still lack a few seconds because of the tight timer.\r\n\r\nMy group had also like 10 seconds left when the last mini boss died but it wasn't enough."},{"id":1261293,"r":-1,"n":1,"b":"You need to actually beat this in 4 minutes and 42 seconds as there is a 18 second delay after defeating the last boss of the mini-bosses."},{"id":1278334,"r":0,"n":0,"b":"Well just a heads up for all if u are dead when the 4th elemental dies and do not get rezzed immediatly you will not get the achievement.. just happend to me i sent a ticket in!"},{"id":1278757,"r":19,"n":0,"b":"Faster than the speed of light is a song by Yngwie Malmsteen which also is 4 minutes and 30 seconds, the same time as the time alotted (active game time) for completing this achievement."},{"id":1296545,"r":5,"n":0,"b":"Brotip: You can use [url=http://www.wowhead.com/item=9172]Invisibility potion[/url] to avoid very big pack of troggs. Unfortunately, only once, but it still helps a lot. :)"},{"id":1301162,"r":18,"n":1,"b":"Zone Buff: Map of the Architects (Increase movement speed by about 21%)\r\nRequires: Tol’vir Hieroglyphic turned in at Large Stone Obelisk\r\n\r\nI failed a couple times...then forked over the hieroglyphic.  My group just finished with a second to spare.  Now I have my achievement mount.  Definitely worth it for me."},{"id":1304513,"r":-1,"n":0,"b":"An early bubble on the tank during the water guy wiped my group once when we had multi trogg packs.  Just something to be aware of."},{"id":1307601,"r":0,"n":0,"b":"[quote]According to Einstein's Relativity, the faster you are, the slower time passes to you. If your speed is like 70%, 80% of the light's speed, time will pass really slow for you.[/quote]\r\n\r\n... as seen by an observer in a stationary reference frame. As seen from your own co-moving reference frame, you are stationary and time passes as normal, wheras the rest of the world is moving and thus time here passes more slowly.\r\n\r\nRelativity is wonderful, no?"},{"id":1339884,"r":2,"n":1,"b":"Hello guys I can confirm a few of the above comments. The keys to beating this is good dps and speed. \r\n\r\nThings you will need to bring:\r\n\r\nSwiftness Potion - 4 per member\r\nLesser Invisibility Potion - 1 per member\r\nTol'vir Hieroglyphic - 1 total + a max archeologist\r\n\r\nOur strat was to start Bran giving us 4:30 to complete this achievement. As soon as the door opens pop a swiftness potion and head to the right. You may receive one pack of Troggs but just head right to the boss. If you have a moonkin in the group he can kill the lesser Troggs with a single volley of mushrooms, focus most damage on the mini-boss however.\r\n\r\nAfter this first boss pop your second swiftness potion and head right across to the second mini-boss. Avoid the troggs by walking around. Once this is done you will need to use your invisibility potion once coming upon the big middle gap. Walk as fast as possible to the left again and go right to where the boss would be, invisibility should wear off by this time. If there is any aggro from Troggs just AoE them as before.\r\n\r\nFinally, use another swiftness potion if off cooldown and avoid Troggs again to kill the last boss. We had 40 seconds on the clock after killing it using this strategy and received the achievement as soon as the main boss started his speech. Good Luck!"},{"id":1353526,"r":0,"n":0,"b":"This is a pure (high) dps race. No potions, tricks, skips... pick 3 top dps of your guild/friends including 1 AoE and you are done, go straight to the elementals, doesn't matter if there are more or less troggs, you nuke everything on your way and start moving to next elemental when previous one is about to die. You have 4:30 for the gauntlet, not 5,10s are consumed while Brann opens door, 20s are consumed until boss door opens. If you finish the run (last elemental) with less than 25-30 seconds left you fail (although you didn't, according to achievement description). GM said it's an issue but they don't have a tracking method for it so he said there isn't a ETA for a hotfix or patch. Just overpower it with 354+ ppl"},{"id":1357222,"r":0,"n":0,"b":"Did it today with:\r\n\r\nBlood DK (Tank) ~ 9.1k DPS\r\nRet Paladin - 9.9k DPS\r\nEhn Shammy - 13k DPS\r\nBoomkin - 8.1k DPS\r\n\r\nWe use any crazy strategies with Invisibility potions at all. I would run up and Blood Boil the Troggs we were running passed (D&D if it was up) and keep heading towards the first elemental while AoEing the adds on us. Once I grabbed the first elemental I just started walking backwards towards the next elemental. Doing this for each allowed us to down the elemental about halfway to the next.\r\n\r\nThis method should work fine as long as you have decent DPS and a good AoE tank. We killed the last elemental with a minute and four seconds left on the timer."},{"id":1375509,"r":5,"n":2,"b":"As of the latest hotfix this achievement does no longer require you to have at least 20-25 sec left on the timer after you've killed the 4th boss - you're now awarded the achievement immediately upon its death."},{"id":1387284,"r":-6,"n":0,"b":"Either this is bugged and does not work the same for everyone or the data is vastly incorrect. \nI received this achievement while healing on my shaman, Fementis. We just killed them rather quickly as everyone seemed to be well geared and knew what to do and we moved seamlessly from elemental to elemental. \nThis was a random dungeon for me and only the tank and a DPS were in the same guild. We killed the last elemental with seven seconds left according to the achievement timer (one of the DPS was tracking all the achievements for the dungeon) and instantly received the achievement when he died.\n\nI don't read the patch notes much so it seems that Silkfire is correct."},{"id":1947848,"r":1,"n":1,"b":"It would seem there is some issue soloing this achievement due to the water elemental's habit of sticking you in a bubble. For some classes this will make it almost impossible to do alone. If you are working on these achievements for the meta you're best off taking a group of 3 in anyway due to the first boss achieve needing that many.\r\n\r\nAttempted today as guardian druid, got stuck twice. There may be some items or abilities that could break you out but I had none that I could figure out."},{"id":2025531,"r":7,"n":0,"b":"This is impossible not to achieve at this point.  Run to each of the 4 alcoves, kill the elemental there, achievement earned.  It took me less than 1:30 to finish."},{"id":2314729,"r":-1,"n":0,"b":"[pre][zone=4945] Achievements\r\n[u]                                                                            [/u]\r\n[u][achievement=5296]         |    https://youtu.be/14LE70H11Tw |[/u]\r\n[u][achievement=5293]                       |    https://youtu.be/7T0V98yEFtw |[/u]\r\n[u][achievement=5294]      |    https://youtu.be/islaxPO-fmE |[/u]\r\n[u][achievement=5295]                           |    https://youtu.be/ABTDfAna2aU |[/u]\r\n[/pre]"}]}{"id":5298,"comments":[{"id":1170634,"r":18,"n":0,"b":"But how do you get the yolk out then?"},{"id":1217221,"r":7,"n":1,"b":"Adds cannot be frost nova'd"},{"id":1218750,"r":27,"n":0,"b":"On live, [b]the adds CAN NOT be rooted, but they CAN be slowed[/b]. Simply burn down the adds before they begin channeling and then kill the boss."},{"id":1247701,"r":5,"n":1,"b":"Did this fight with a Rogue (me) using Crippling Poison on the throw weapon and spamming FoK as the adds spawned. Slowed them for a great while and we had no problems nuking them down before they started to channel."},{"id":1255738,"r":0,"n":0,"b":"This was a shockingly easy achievement.\r\n\r\nUsing an SV hunter, Mut Rogue, and Destro Lock, we killed the adds each time before they even split. Then slowed the adds and proceed to nuke them. The adds died shortly after seperating."},{"id":1292243,"r":-3,"n":0,"b":"Very easy with decent DPS \r\n\r\nGroup Comp:\r\n\r\nProt Pally (fail tank)\r\nFury Warrior (me, my offspec)\r\nArcane Mage \r\nSpriest\r\nResto sham\r\n\r\nDid this in a random heroic group that me and my friend (the pally) got put into.\r\nMage slowed the left add as your facing the door and nuked it\r\nMe and the Priest got the right add. I kept Hamstring up at all times on the add and used Colossus Smash to make sure i could take it down easily (didn't really need the spriest, i did most of the work haha)\r\nIf the mage wasn't done with his add by the time I killed mine, I intercepted over and finished it off.\r\n\r\nYou have to kill the adds before they even start to channel their abilities on the eggs or the achievement will fail."},{"id":1319863,"r":4,"n":0,"b":"Frost mages are very helpful for obtaining this achievement.  A decent frost mage can cast Deep Freeze on one of the adds for a massive (60-100k) crit.  Most random groups I've been in have gotten this achievement just because of how easy it is for me to massively slow an add and burst down the other add."},{"id":1344824,"r":4,"n":0,"b":"Snares are pretty much a must to do this achive, unless you got some really crazy dps."},{"id":1347870,"r":4,"n":0,"b":"If you don't have that high of dps, having a hunter to frost trap isn't the best possible option of slowing the adds, as the slowing effect will cancel out any *worse* snares (hamstring)."},{"id":1351185,"r":3,"n":0,"b":"Get a rogue. What's more is that with the talent vile poisons (which many rogues have specced 1/2) they have a 50% chance to put crippling poison on the adds whenever another poison hits. So sprint+CloS FoKFoKFoK and both adds will be slowed by 70%. After that it's easy."},{"id":1420563,"r":8,"n":0,"b":"I suspect Mr. Durden wouldn't agree with the overly optimistic stance of whoever named this achievement."},{"id":1421353,"r":3,"n":0,"b":"Honestly, our group didn't have amazing dps OR snares. we DID, however, make killing them quick a priority. Then we just burned erudax down as quickly as we could.\r\n\r\nWeren't even aware of this achieve, so pleasantly surprised when it dinged. \r\n\r\nWe were a pug, but lucky to have nice and decent players."},{"id":1446015,"r":3,"n":0,"b":"its true if everyone just prioritizes killing they adds they go down quick enough, you did get lucky in your pug though, every time i do this one i get one person who actually tries to kill them fast and the rest just kinda half assedly throw some deeps at them, its so frustrating to lose this fight because people let the boss get healed huge amounts before they smarten up, also im a blood tank so i throw chains on one but still 4 outta 5 times im just like omg nice job boss healed for like a million hp"},{"id":1694926,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"We prepared well for this, put up markers, assigned dps to ads and figured out how to slow them.
