> {"id":5288,"comments":[{"id":1152986,"r":114,"n":5,"b":"For anyone under the age of 35, the title of this achievement references the chorus of the song \"FM\" by Steely Dan."},{"id":1161954,"r":47,"n":4,"b":"this achievement is done by jumping as the casts finishes, that way you dont get rooted in place.\r\nKinda like that trash mobs in stonecore, be in the air as the casts finishes, and you dont get rooted."},{"id":1218739,"r":61,"n":2,"b":"Throughout the fight, Asaad will randomly cast Static Cling.  Just before the cast time is finished, jump off the ground and you will avoid the root.  Then simply move into the 'safe zones' to avoid the storms and repeat the process.\r\n\r\nNote: [b]This is an INDIVIDUAL achievement.[/b]  If one person fails the rest of the group can still get it!"},{"id":1219305,"r":20,"n":2,"b":"[url=http://www.wowhead.com/spell=1706][b]Levitate[/b][/url] trivializes this achievement. While it's easy to do it without Levitate, a dedicated priest can easily help any non-tank with latency issues or slow reaction times get this achivevement. Simply buff it before the fight and any time someone gets hit by the Chain Lightning."},{"id":1244537,"r":25,"n":1,"b":"This achievement is very simple once you understand how it all works. You are looking for a cast called 'Static Cling' - it is about a 1 second cast.\r\n\r\nThe first static cling will be cast a few seconds into the fight. To ensure that no one messes it up, simply have everyone stand still and wait for the cast. As soon as you see the cast, jump. From then on, he will always cast the cling after a chain lightning. Simply wait for the chain lightning to finish casting, and then as soon as you see the cling, jump.\r\n\r\n[b][u]You are most likely jumping too late, not early.[/u][/b]"},{"id":1255559,"r":37,"n":6,"b":"I got the achievement simply by spamming the hell out of my space bar. I didn't even wait for the boss to start casting Static Cling, I just jumped thoughout the fight. Either I was incredibly lucky or the game doesn't have the time to notice that you have landed before you jump again."},{"id":1279667,"r":140,"n":7,"b":"Q: How do you avoid static cling in real life?\n\nA: Bounce\n\nThe answer to this Achievement is not timing or anything like that. All you do is spam your jump button during and after the cast. In other words \"Bounce\" to avoid Static Cling. I realized the answer to this achievement while doing my laundry. So far I have successfully avoided static cling 5 times in a row using this method."},{"id":1313968,"r":31,"n":0,"b":"For any dks out there looking to get this achievey, listen up! Using [spell=48707] will make you immune to [spell=87618] but it [b][i][u]WILL NOT[/u][/i] [/b] count as you completely avoiding the spell. You're better off just jumping. Unless you lost your spacebar in a horrible spacebar losing accident. Then good luck to you.\r\n\r\nSrsly tho, AMS doesn't work for the achievey, but it will avoid the effect."},{"id":1968527,"r":7,"n":1,"b":"Soloed as a 562 Enhancement shaman on level 90. Pop heroism, ascendance and nuke him in 8 seconds and got the achievement."},{"id":2063513,"r":14,"n":2,"b":"Doing this for [achievement=4845]. Profit."},{"id":2070688,"r":-2,"n":0,"b":"Perhaps a reference to Steely Dan's song \"FM\" (with the lyrics \"No static at all\")?"},{"id":2077778,"r":56,"n":0,"b":"An update for anyone like me who was late to the party: no strategy is needed anymore at level 100. You should fight [/i]everything [i]with fire.\"\r\n-Jaya Ballard, task mage[/i]"},{"id":1218746,"r":153,"n":10,"b":"When you enter the 'spirit world' at 50%, a Dark Hatchling will spawn.  Every few seconds, a soul fragment will spawn that channels a heal on the Dark Hatchling.  Let 3 spawn, then move them into the flame patches transforming them into Burning Souls.  Kill them and then kill the boss to earn your Achievement!"},{"id":1241326,"r":94,"n":1,"b":"There is [b]no[/b] mob called a \"Burning Soul\" - The achievement requires you to kill three [i]soul fragments[/i] which have the burning soul debuff. The burning soul debuff is gained when they move over a flame patch left by the phoenixes in phase 1.\r\n\r\nWhile in the spirit phase players will occasionally get a debuff informing them that their soul is splitting. When this happens the player should position them self so that there is a fire between them and the phoenix. The debuff on the fragment will continually refresh itself while it is in the fire and will last five seconds after the fragment leaves the fire."},{"id":1259732,"r":48,"n":2,"b":"Hot icon. Literally."},{"id":1830325,"r":61,"n":4,"b":"You can despawn the boss by running away around the corner. He will respawn after 1 min or so.\n\nThe achievement works this way... In P1 you must kill the fiery bird, so that he will leave a fire pool. After you nuke the boss until 50% P2 begins. A dark blue Phoenix will spawn, which must be kept alive until the achievement is done (which will display during the fight after finishing it). If he dies before, follow my first hint. No need to wait for a second ID until tomorrow. ^^\n\nIn P2 little ghosts of yourself will spawn (77k Health points). They must be kited into the fire and die before they reach the Phoenix. They will get a debuff which name i forgot. If they die too late, the Phoenix consumes them and gets stronger by 10%. Even at lvl 90 there is a fail limit. ^^\n\nGL with the achievement."},{"id":2016910,"r":41,"n":2,"b":"I did this as level 90 balance druid.\n\nEngaged High Prophet Barim and a Phoenix spawned and leaving a trail of fire behind him. I kited the phoenix around just to have a little bit of fire everywhere.\n\nBoss dropped to 50% hp and ripped my soul from my body. This starts phase 2. \n\nI was sent to spirit realm? shadow realm? spirit world? w.e... There was a shadowy phoenix that followed me around, left him alone for now. \n\nShadowy copies of myself started spawning and walked towards the phoenix, [b]these shadowformed bastards are the ones needed for the achievement.[/b] I kited them so they would walk through the fire that was left around from the phoenix at the start of the fight.\n\nAfter those shadow replicates stepped into fire, they got a debuff and I killed them. Repeated this 3 times and got the achievement. After that I finished the shadowphoenix and boss.\n\nnote: One of the shadow souls didn't catch fire when I was doing this achievement so I actually had to kill 4 of those in the spirit realm. So if you for w.e. reason miss some, dw there will be more than needed for the achievement.\n\nAlso be sure that you get the achievement before proceeding to kill the shadowy phoenix. The achievement is granted instantly, not after the boss is dead."},{"id":2025535,"r":127,"n":6,"b":"Ok, everyone is making this WAY more complicated than it should be.  Here are the steps to complete this:\n\n1. During phase 1, a red phoenix will spawn.  It leaves fire on the ground.  Make sure a single fire spot is on the ground before damaging the boss to 50%.\n2. During phase 2, a purple phoenix will spawn. It will spawn copies of yourself named Soul Fragment which will walk toward you.  Position yourself between the phoenix and the fire that was spawned in Phase 1, the name of the Soul Fragment will change to Burning Fragment.\n3.  Kill 3 Burning Fragments.  Done, achievement earned."},{"id":2315418,"r":3,"n":0,"b":"[pre][zone=5396] Achievements\r\n[u]                                                                   [/u]\r\n[u][achievement=5291]              |    https://youtu.be/37RWYUMuNNs |[/u]\r\n[u][achievement=5290]           |    https://youtu.be/oIsYURRfHy4 |[/u]\r\n[u][achievement=5292]                 |    https://youtu.be/islaxPO-fmE |[/u]\r\n[/pre]"},{"id":2360017,"r":9,"n":0,"b":"At level 100 dk, I stripped naked and used a low level weapon to get him to half health. Then was able to get to spirit sequence to kill the 3 spirits of me. I summoned my ghoul to help finish Barim off."},{"id":2543732,"r":50,"n":3,"b":"TLDR: \r\n\r\n1) Walk up to the boss and wait for the red phoenix\r\n\r\n2) Drag the red phoenix around so there's fire on the ground\r\n\r\n3) Punch the boss to just below 50% hp and wait for the purple phoenix \r\n\r\n4) Wait for the purple phoenix to spawn copies of you, drag them through the red phoenix's fire, then kill them. \r\n\r\nYou'll get the achieve as soon as you've killed three copies; before the boss is dead."},{"id":2857082,"r":8,"n":1,"b":"I'm going to say this achieve is, at the very least, glitchy. As a 120, I stripped down to no gear [including weapon] so not to kill him. I am a hunter, so I MD with a single punch to my pet so I could have his big body out of the way...that won't trigger what you need, so wait. You need the fire bird to make it's appearance and drag it around a little bit and leave fire spots for the souls to walk through. I found clustering them up was best, rather than being satisfied with gambling I was a master of guiding them through one or two spots. \n\nAfter I did this, I went and punched him one more time and this tossed me into the 'bow to me', and this sets you where you want. Now purple/shadow bird is going to make it's appearance, and you want to drag this thing over to the fire and this is where I found it glitchy. The souls would spawn, and you'd see 'burning' pop and unpop while they were still in the fire. I just killed, and the most ironic one of all was one that wasn't even walking in the fire, nor changed...I was running out of time, and I just thought. \"Screw it...it's going to be a FD reset anyway.\" To my surprise I got it. \n\nSo I really don't know what is up with this achieve [other than I'm glad I'm done with it]. My advice is even if they don't have the name burning in it, but are burning or you are close to end like I was and have nothing to loose...hey, just go for it [the achieve will go off before killing the boss, so you know if you've succeeded and whether you will need to reset or not]."},{"id":3205011,"r":37,"n":4,"b":"This achievement, even nowadays, in BFA is quite \"tricky\" to be done. I failed a few times due the fact that i got confused in the comments i read,so here is my experience:\n\nFirst of all,[b] remove all gear[/b]. Even naked, you have a chance to kill the boss with normal hit in one-shot (it happened to me 2 times). Secondly, clear all the trash nearby the boss, to avoid \"confusion\" and mistakes. \nOnce everything is cleared, start moving nearby the boss until he starts the combat. \nStage 1: the boss will summon a fire phoenix, that phoenix will drop fire patches on the ground, once you got 3-4 patches, hit the boss ([b]with normal hits, not skills because you can one-shot him[/b]) to lower him bellow 50% HP to enter stage 2.\nStage 2: the boss will summon a [npc=43927] , a \"dark-purple phoenix\" that will cast [spell=82255] on you, which will summon a \"spirit clone\" of yourself. This clone is called [npc=115113] and will target you and move slowly towards you. Now, what you need to do is to direct the [npc=115113] towards the fire patches on the ground. When the [npc=115113] will be on fire, he will get a short duration debuff and it will turn into a [b]Burning Soul[/b]. When it is turned into [b]Burning Soul[/b], use a instant cast spell to kill it fast, because after a few seconds (5 sec i think), the Soul will disappear. \nRepeat it until you kill [b]3 Burning Souls[/b] and voila...you got the achievement. \n\nP.S. : i did it with my 120 shaman. Once the the [npc=115113] was up, i was targeting it and waiting to turn into a[b] Burning Soul[/b] and instantly killing him with Flame Shock once the turned."},{"id":3229745,"r":20,"n":2,"b":"I just did this on a level 120 fire mage. It was actually much easier than when I attempted it on my 120 assassination rogue and failed, here's how I did it:\n\n[ol]\n[li]First off remove all of your clothes. I keep a default equipment set that contails all my gear pre-naked, and then another set called \"naked\" where all my equips are off.[/li]\n[li]Engage the fight by standing near/on the boss.[/li]\n[li]Hit F1 so that you're targeting yourself. Kite the boss to the top stairs, and just stand there. Don't do anything or attack anything[/li]\n[li]Let the boss summon his \"phoenix\" (Ashes of Alar looking bird). Still stand and don't do anything yet.[/li]\n[li]Let the phoenix drop those fire balls onto the ground, cluster them all in the same spot.[/li]\n[li]Once a few have dropped from the phoenix, re-engage the boss and hit him with one and only one scorch. This should get him down to 50-ish percent to start stage 2.[/li]\n[li]Hit F1 again to re-target yourself[/li]\n[li]A purple phoenix pops up and summons mirror images of you called soul fragments. Target the fragment as soon as it pops up, don't wait. Try to kite the fragment in a straight line through the fire and towards you, so stand behind the previously dropped fire.[/li]\n[li]As soon as the soul fragment walks into the fire, it turns into a burning soul. Hit a Fire blast IMMEDIATELY[/li]\n[li]You need to do this 2 more times in order to get the achievement. The achievement actually dings before you finish the boss, so you will definitely know when you get it and if you havent.[/li]\n[li]Note that the fragments sometimes merge with the harbinger, and there's nothing you can do there except wait for another soul fragment to pop up.[/li]\n[li]Soul fragments will pop up for as long as the harbinger/purple bird is [b]*NOT DEAD*[u][/u][/b] so do not target the harbinger until the achievement pops[/li]\n[/ol]\n\nI hope this helps people. Just remember to be patient and set yourself up so that the soul fragments walk into the fire to become burning souls and remember, you don't have to move on to the next stage of the fight until the achievement dings, so that bird will poop out soul fragments as long as you still haven't gotten it."},{"id":3236247,"r":12,"n":0,"b":"first get naked, test your meele dmg on nearby mobs to see how hard u hit so u dont one-shot the boss.\n\nOnce that's out of the way, pull the boss, wait until the boss puts FIRE ON THE GROUND. After that, simple get the boss down to 50%. Right away, a purple phoenix will summon a bunch of shadowy copies of yourself.\nMove those 3 shadowy copies to the fire and kill them immediately.\n\nThen kill the boss and you are set"},{"id":5178128,"r":4,"n":0,"b":"Strangely, the mob name changes back and forth between \"Soul Fragment\" and \"Burning Soul\" when it touches the fire. \r\n\r\nDespite this, what you're really looking for is it's debuff called Burning Soul. Killing it with that debuff active counts, even though the mob is named Soul Fragment again."},{"id":5677412,"r":1,"n":1,"b":"Finally done today on a level 70 warlock. Had to remove all gear including weapons/trinkets and punch the boss down because even just the standard auto attack with a weapon was one-shotting him."},{"id":5827417,"r":3,"n":1,"b":"70 hunter was too high dmg even with every single piece of gear removed. I tried to go in with a hunter that was level 42 but I kept getting the error that I needed to be level 73 to get in :/ So I went in with a level 50 mage. I didn't remove any pieces of gear (I have almost full heirloom minus a ring). I was able to auto attack the boss without killing it in one shot. Got my achievement, GL everybody."},{"id":6032690,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"Extremely easy if done with a lvl 40 char. I used my shaman, lowered his health, waited for the soul fragments to appear, led them to the fire where they turned into burning souls, flame shocked them 3 times and that was it. \r\n\r\nIn most cases you are probably lvl 80. Remove your weapons, use the voodoo toy, once you have lowered his health below 50% do what i mentioned above."},{"id":6065766,"r":13,"n":3,"b":"If you want to do this at max level, get the toy [item=97919]. \r\nTake all gear off, use the item, and pull the boss. \r\n\r\nWait to make sure a fire pool comes out during the first phase. \r\nThen punch the boss down to 50%, while you are \"shrunk\" from the toy, you will do less damage, so you don't 1 shot the boss even at max level. \r\nAt 50%, I recommend removing the buff from the toy so you can easily run around as needed, you shouldn't need to withhold your damage anymore. Just make sure the achieve pops before you touch the boss again."},{"id":6370555,"r":5,"n":0,"b":"As of midnight, being fully naked with [url=https://www.wowhead.com/item=8956/oil-of-immolation]Oil of Immolation[/url] broth boss to 53%, rest 4% hp can be lowered slowly with [url=https://www.wowhead.com/item=86607/goblin-dragon-gun-mark-ii]Goblin Dragon Gun, Mark II[/url]"}]}{"id":5294,"comments":[{"id":1128370,"r":61,"n":0,"b":"some achievements arent made to be challenging, just fun"},{"id":1218667,"r":42,"n":0,"b":"Be sure you kill the final trash mobs in the sand before hopping on your Camels to engage Ptah.  Once all trash mobs are defeated, have your entire party hop onto their own Camel.  The Camel gives you faster run speed, and the ability to cast while moving.\n\nEngage Ptah in the center of the room.  [b]There are TWO abilities that he uses that can dismount you from your Camel: Earth Spike and \"Quicksand\".[/b]  Earth Spike is only done in Phase 1 when he is active, and the Quicksand was up when he splits into two.  You can EASILY see the Earth Spike (looks like a cloud of dark dust on the ground) and the Quicksand (swirling sand graphic on the ground).  As long as you stay aware of what is going on in the fight, you will easily earn this achievement."},{"id":1883332,"r":24,"n":0,"b":"if you are soloing the achievement and for some reason you lose your camel you can simply go down the stairs next to the boss (where you came from) it will reset the fight and you will be able to take another camel if there is one or more left"},{"id":1931601,"r":-5,"n":0,"b":"Easily soloed now. Am I wrong or did they change it?"},{"id":2314731,"r":-5,"n":0,"b":"[pre][zone=4945] Achievements\r\n[u]                                                                            [/u]\r\n[u][achievement=5296]         |    https://youtu.be/14LE70H11Tw |[/u]\r\n[u][achievement=5293]                       |    https://youtu.be/7T0V98yEFtw |[/u]\r\n[u][achievement=5294]      |    https://youtu.be/islaxPO-fmE |[/u]\r\n[u][achievement=5295]                           |    https://youtu.be/ABTDfAna2aU |[/u]\r\n[/pre]"}]}{"id":5295,"comments":[{"id":1117089,"r":121,"n":0,"b":"..Lich!"},{"id":1230573,"r":32,"n":0,"b":"For an actual strategy...\n\nEither 1 tank 4 dps or 4 dps 1 healer. We did it with 1 tank 4 dps. DPS need to be at least 12k, tank around 5-6k. Bloodlust needed obviously.\n\nNow, this fight has a bit of RNG. The boss has 100 focus, he use focus each time he use an ability (fire tornadoes, heroic leap, orb summoning, etc. Basically everything except auto attack). So the trick is to hope that he actually use abilities that can be interrupted, so he doesn't lose focus on abilities that can't be interrupted. Also, if you interrupt one of his ability with Counterspell, he will not lose any focus for 8 seconds (since he's interrupted for that long). Interrupts recommending are Counterspell, Shield Bash and Spell Lock (from a felhunter).\n\nAnother trick is to tank him in the corner of the room, so he spend more time walking to the middle to begin recharging. Position yourself accordingly so you don't lose dps time moving.\n\nNote: to get the achievement, you simply have to kill him before he totally complete his AoE when he's charging. It's very easy to see, he gain a buff when he  recharges. If that buff runs out, you've failed the achievement."},{"id":2021331,"r":28,"n":4,"b":"in 6.0 just zerg it, piece of cake."},{"id":2166703,"r":5,"n":0,"b":"Not that hard for 100.\r\n\r\nFirst of all, I got panic because of all the comments - to zerg or not to zerg... Rajh need to be traited with care - show him your light spell (for example [url=http://www.wowhead.com/spell=20271]Judgment[/url], I used it and it worked perfectly), and wait. Small debuff will show up under his portrait, and his orange ( thisone under health) bar will be charging to full. Before it's done, you need to show him that you can hit hard too ;) Done, you got achievement. That's all.\r\n\r\ntl;dr: one not-heavy hit, wait for his buff on him and orange bar to go to full again, hit fast and hard, gz."},{"id":2276980,"r":-4,"n":0,"b":"...beach!"},{"id":2309217,"r":7,"n":0,"b":"At 100 - tapped him some - I druid melee'd him to about 50% (not sure if it matters). Has anyone else had this issue?"},{"id":5233626,"r":9,"n":1,"b":"Solo'd easily as a 60 Druid in Shadowlands.  \r\n1: Take gear off\r\n2: Make a target macro, including a single target ability you can use to kill the rats mine for example was:\r\n\r\n/target Mine Rat\r\n/cast [harm] Moonfire\r\n\r\n3: Walk over top of the boss to begin combat, sit and wait for him to pick you up and charge.  Once he does this, the rats spawn and you can begin spamming your macro to kill the rats.  \r\n\r\n4: Ez Achievement\r\n\r\n\r\nNotes: If you kill the Lumbering Oaf by mistake, you won't be able to continue the achievement.  To fix this, you can simply click the door to run out of the boss room and it will reset the fight once Helix chases you out, or rides on your head as you run out. You can start the fight over again and pick up where you left off.  I reset the fight one time and got my last 6 kills I needed after resetting.\r\n\r\nHappy achievementing :)"},{"id":5854249,"r":7,"n":0,"b":"Macro only for the Mine Rat's, so you don't accidentally kill Helix Gearbreaker or Lumbering Oaf.\r\n\r\n/cleartarget\r\n/target Mine Rat\r\n/cleartarget [dead]\r\n/stopmacro [noexists]\r\n/run PlaySound(12867); SetRaidTarget(\"target\", 01); \r\n/point\r\n/cast [harm] Auto Attack"},{"id":6032732,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"You don't have to remove gear or anything. Be sure to bring a good tank and healer, though, since the fight will take quite some time without the Prototype Reaper's damage."},{"id":1226717,"r":0,"n":0,"b":"We tried it today, and if the watcher gets hit below 90% at any time since you picked it up, be it the trash before or during the encounter, the achievement fails. The reaper isn't even damaged by the elementals, so all the person has to do is avoid the whirlwind, and they won't even need heals. Just tank the boss on the ramp, and keep the elementals on the bottom. Piece of cake."},{"id":1299987,"r":18,"n":0,"b":"[u]This is a guide for Prototype users[/u]\n\nI did this my 1st time I used the [npc=49208] and it is a piece of cake if you know what its abilities are.\nIt has an energy bar (steam pressure) just like DK Runic power or Warrior Rage that fills up when you use the 1st ability and empties when you use the other two. The difference is that it doesn't decay when you are out of battle.\n\nThe Prototype has 3 abilities as you see them in the action bar:\n1. [spell=91723]: It's your main DPS hit. It generates 20 energy every time used.\n2. [spell=91726]: It's your opening move where you can charge & stun the [npc=49229]. It uses 40 energy and the important thing to know is that it can be used it at 0 distance.\n3. [spell=91727]: Deals damage and knocks the elemental back. Uses 20 energy. You will never use it exept from emergencies where you can knock an elemental down from the ramp.\n[u]\nStrategy[/u]\nThe elementals will always spawn behind the steam pump and by completely ignoring you will try to go up the ramp. The most delicate part of the encounter is the 1st elemental where you don't have energy. Stand near the pump to pick it up quick and use the 1-1-2 rotation while moving together with the elemental. From the 2nd and on and as long as you have at least 40 energy use the charge first (2-1-1 rotation) and the achievement is yours as long as everything goes smooth upstairs :)\n\nP.S. If you are quick (and risky) you can squize a 3rd Strike before the charge (2-1-1-1 rotation) and have an excess of 20 energy after every rotation."},{"id":1314771,"r":-2,"n":0,"b":"This is a VERY simple achievement.\n\n1) The prototype reaper takes no damage during the actual boss fight.  Because of that, you need to leave the vehicle alone until you clear the 4 trash reapers, just to avoid the damage done.\n\n2) During the boss fight, tank the BOSS halfway or all the way up the ramp, it doesn't matter where, as long as he can't reach the prototype with a whirlwind or harvest.\n\n3) Before engaging, ask your group if anyone is good at using the vehicle.  There aren't many abilities, and as long as you stun them and kill them accordingly, nobody should take damage from the adds.  (Prototype doesn't take damage from adds).\n\nNote:  If anyone noticed that they didn't get the achievement after the fight, even when the prototype stayed above 90%, it's because you used the prototype on adds.  They have a nasty aoe, just use your actual characters to dps until the trash is gone.  When the prototype gets hurt by the trash, its hp restores after combat is over."},{"id":1334977,"r":0,"n":2,"b":"Has the prototype reaper charge been nerfed in the 4.0.6 patch?\nAccording to a comment above, the adds can be completely stunlocked, but when I tried this today the charge had diminishing returns, lasting 4 sec, then 2 sec, then 1 etc if used multiple times on the same target.\n\nCan anyone confirm this? As this was my first time controlling the prototype reaper I can't tell if this has always been the case.\n\nEdit: Took a look at the patch notes and saw that adds now spawn 33% faster when the boss is enraged, but it says nothing about the charge ability."},{"id":1372769,"r":0,"n":0,"b":"I just completed this without even knowing it existed.\r\n\r\nI was the tank.  However, we had a hunter.  Pets take 90% reduced damage from all the boss attacks, so I got the reaper and the hunter pet got to tank.  (This leaves 3 DPS on the boss, instead of two.)  So, we didn't use the prototype on the trash.  This is why we got the achievement.\r\n\r\nThis was my first time in the prototype.   It's that easy to do.\r\n\r\nI tried bringing the prototype down and leaving it there to hop into after I downed the last trash.  Wrong.  Without a pilot, it just ran up to where it started.  I had to pull the last trash up there in order to be near it and hop in as the boss fight started.\r\n\r\nAfter that, it was simple.  I just used 1-1-2 to stun and kill the slag adds.  If one got too far up the ramp, I used 3 to knock it off the ramp and back to the bottom.\r\n\r\nTwo of the damage-dealers got eaten by the boss special abilities, but we still one-shotted it and i got surprised by the achievement.\r\n\r\nLesson:  Don't use the prototype on the trash.\r\n\r\nWhat I don't know is if the achievement works for people not in the prototype.  The wording makes it sound like it would, but the achievements didn't pop up for the other folks in the party.  It's possible that they were out of range or already had it, of course."},{"id":1393377,"r":0,"n":0,"b":"I'm not sure if this is broken, or if I'm just unobservant, but my group killed this guy with me in the reaper, and as far as I know I didn't even receive any damage. Simply do not save the next NPC and wait till you guys wipe, this is a slower way to do it.\r\n\r\n\r\n\r\nStep 6. a. Make sure you don't save the NPC, then you will be wiped and then DO NOT RELEASE. Yea, sounds like Ghostcrawler."},{"id":1230790,"r":28,"n":2,"b":"Last night we did this achievement without any real CC.\r\nBear druid tank\r\nenhance shaman\r\nmage\r\npriest heals\r\nfrost dk with a blood offspec\r\n\r\nNormally I would use more cc, but seeing how the mage ice cc is only 10 seconds, and sheep doesn't work on undead... we only had shackle as a viable cc.  \r\n\r\nI ended up pulling the boss back down the hallway before his chamber, around a corner and all the way to the second set of stairs.  The DK, in his tanking spec and gear held the adds just outside the bosses room at the bottom of those stairs.  Heals stood at the corner so that she could heal both the DK and I.  When the DK became overwhelmed we used the mages 10 second cc to buy us time to finish the boss off.\r\n\r\nThe entire fight the adds were line of sight from the boss and therefore unable to buff/heal him.\r\n\r\nYou may find this strat useful in getting the achievement or just getting the boss down if you lack proper crowd control.  We were just trying to kill him and were oblivious to the achievement until we received it."},{"id":1334374,"r":16,"n":0,"b":"With patch 4.0.6 all the previous tactics are useless. If you get him to LoS the adds, he gets a buff called Separation Anxiety which increases his dmg by 200%. The way we did it was cc 1 add, interrupt and kill the other, and the others coming. It was not easy at all, but with a setup that can interrupt often (f.e. shaman) and some1 that can cc undead, it's doable."},{"id":1397333,"r":32,"n":1,"b":"the wording of tis achievement is VERY missleading.\r\n\r\nThe boss can gain a buff called \"Unholy power\" and once he has 3 stacks of it he gains \"Unholy Empowerment\" wich lets him use 2 special skills.\r\n\r\nnow the thing is, he can gain stacks of unholy power via 2 ways. A: the adds cast it on him, or B: he uses a skill called Malefic Strike wich gives him a stack.\r\n\r\nis IMPOSIBLE to prevent him from gaining \"Unholy Empowerment\" because he can and will use Malefic strike on the tank and gain his stacks. The goal of the achievement then is [u][b]NOT[/b][/u] to prevent him from gaining the buff, but to prevent [b][u]THE ADDS[/u][/b] from casting it.\r\n\r\nI saw this today because we pulled him, burned the adds in less than 10 seconds (we had good DPS) and after the adds were dead but before new ones spawned, he already had gained 3 stacks of unholy empowerment.\r\n\r\nso..... To recap, prevent THE ADDS from casting anything to the boss, (its a 2.5 sec cast so interrupting it shoudn't be a problem) and kill the boss. If he gets unholy power stacks on his own due to malefic strike (Wich will happen regardless of what you do) you still win, as long as no add has casted anything on him at all.\r\n\r\nAlso, all the above strategies that involved moving the boss out of his room no longer work. Should you pull him outside his room, he will enrage dealing 200% more damage and 1shoting everyone.\r\n\r\nThe strategy that works is really simple:\r\n\r\n\r\nYou will need at least 2 DPS capable of interrupting, have 1 DPS take care of interrupting the officer, and 1 to interrupt the guardsman, have all 3 DPS burn the adds as soon as they spawn, and then get back on killing the boss.\r\n\r\nSimple as that. Some good gear may be needed to burn the adds fast enough as they respawn every 45 seconds."},{"id":1500872,"r":22,"n":0,"b":"[i][u][b]I THREW IT ON THE GROUND![/b][/u][/i]\r\n\r\n[small]props to the one who knows what i mean..[/small]"},{"id":1932641,"r":7,"n":0,"b":"Managed to solo him down (90 mage) without killing the adds, just opening up on him. Have your tank taunt and blow a cooldown and kill two complete sets of Ghouls.  Once you have killed 12, simply kill the boss and earn your easy achievement!"},{"id":1235649,"r":16,"n":1,"b":"Just a small note, you do actually need to KILL the boss in order to get the achievment.\r\nWe had around 30 ghouls killed when someone noticed that."},{"id":1238422,"r":63,"n":8,"b":"This ones actually super simple.\r\n\r\n[b]Range / Healers[/b] - stand on the stairs you first walk in on. \r\n[b]Tank[/b] - tanks boss at the bottom of the stairs of the platform the boss starts on. The key part is to face him facing the bottom of the staircase that leads to your range/healer.\r\n\r\nWhenever the boss pops out the adds, right after he will start his pistol barrage. The tank steps to the backside or side,  and all dps remains on the boss. The adds will aggro to the healer forcing them to run up the stairs. The bosses barrage will take them out as they attempt. Rinse and repeat."},{"id":1885766,"r":56,"n":1,"b":"[b]Solo lvl 90 Hunter / Patch 5.3[/b]\r\n\r\nEngage the boss with minimal DPS, wait until ghouls spawn, when he cast the pistol barrage, drag the ghouls in it... That's it!\r\n\r\nThe only \"challenge\" as a 90 is to not kill the boss in 10 seconds!"},{"id":2062462,"r":15,"n":1,"b":"As of 6.0.3 this is very easy to complete.\r\nFor pet classes leave your pet on Passive otherwise it will kill the ghouls or the boss.\r\nSimply pull the boss, let the [npc=50561] get up, stay in front of [spell=93520] and they'll drop like flies, you get 6 ghouls at a time so let him kill the first 6 and then wait for the next 6, he may miss a couple depending on how long the ghouls take to get to you.\r\nSelf healing abilities may be needed, I had spirit bond with my pet so didn't need to do anything."},{"id":2254021,"r":9,"n":1,"b":"[b]L100 solo version:[/b]  Aggro the boss. Assuming you've got at least mid-600 armour on, you should suffer minimal to no significant damage from this, and the ghouls will be mowed down.\r\n\r\n(I did this using 670-something Balance Druid gear, and never saw my health bar twitch.)\r\n\r\nCounting ghouls is another matter."},{"id":2316164,"r":3,"n":0,"b":"[pre][zone=209] Achievements\r\n[u]                                                                  [/u]\r\n[u][achievement=5503]               |    https://youtu.be/W_d2WNkSM0A |[/u]\r\n[u][achievement=5504]              |    https://youtu.be/wNy8hGzvnSc |[/u]\r\n[u][achievement=5505]                 |    https://youtu.be/99Ue-rTxRcM |[/u]\r\n[/pre]"},{"id":2347148,"r":2,"n":0,"b":"6.2: run with your face in one angle, the gouls will come to you and be killed by pistol barrage. I waited until the counter ran up to 12 and then took out the boss. Nothin' to it."},{"id":2539637,"r":-5,"n":0,"b":"Bullet Time - https://goo.gl/PQBJzE"},{"id":2564749,"r":26,"n":0,"b":"Surprisingly easy compared to some of the other achievements.\n\n[ol]\n[li]Simply walk up to boss so that the boss is agro'd. [/li]\r\n[li]Do NOT nuke him down straight away. GLHF :)"}]}{"id":5744,"comments":[{"id":1354110,"r":49,"n":1,"b":"This achievement can be earned during a single visit to the instance, if your group is dedicated to it.\nHere is a map with the location of all the NPCs qualifying for the kill criteria:\n\n[map zone=1977_1][pin x=56.2 y=55.5 url=/npc=52405][div align=center]Mor'Lek the Dismantler[pad][screenshot id=217412][/screenshot][/div][/pin]\n\n[pin x=43.2 y=44.6 url=/npc=52440][div align=center]Gub[pad][screenshot id=219541][/screenshot][/div][/pin]\n\n[pin x=54.1 y=62.7 url=/npc=52422][div align=center]Kaulema the Mover[pad][screenshot id=219543][/screenshot][/div][/pin]\n\n[pin x=62.4 y=34.1 url=/npc=52438][div align=center]Mortaxx[pad][screenshot id=224129][/screenshot][/div][/pin]\n\n[pin x=57.9 y=26.9 url=/npc=52392][div align=center]Gurubashi Master Chef[pad][screenshot id=224712][/screenshot][/div][/pin]\n\n[pin x=37.6 y=40.5 url=/npc=52418][div align=center]Lost Offspring of Gahz'ranka[pad]([i]is everywhere in the lake[/i])[pad][screenshot id=219557][/screenshot][/div][/pin]\n\n[pin x=32.9 y=39.4 url=/npc=52442][div align=center]Florawing Hive Queen[pad][screenshot id=217384][/screenshot][/div][/pin]\n\n[pin x=45.8 y=55.7 url=/npc=52414][div align=center]Tor-Tun[pad][screenshot id=217417][/screenshot][/div][/pin][/map]"},{"id":1614033,"r":0,"n":0,"b":"I just soloed every single boss for this achievement (I went in solo on a fresh run) as a blood DK in ~385 iLvL DPS gear.\nArmy makes all the fights super easy, just time your cooldowns right when army dies."},{"id":1617193,"r":-5,"n":0,"b":"Easy achievemnt, no need special gruop to do it."},{"id":1649750,"r":-1,"n":1,"b":"Just tried to solo this and died because of WoG cooldown. That sucks. Though I should mention that I managed to do the Hive Queen and sneak past the first poison mage, then died as I aggroed the first Tiki-Lord. Seems you can't avoid this one. Problem with pally self-healing is that it's just too spiky, due to the [spell=85673] cooldown and no other steady sources of healing being available, [spell=20165] just not being enough.\n(iLevel 388/ GS 10478, Tank, [url=http://eu.battle.net/wow/en/character/ambossar/Hrenyo/advanced]here[/url])\n[b][u]Edit:[/u][/b] O just thought Icould run these after I didi ZG with a group so everything would be clean already (i.e. no annoying elites moping around)"},{"id":1962365,"r":71,"n":5,"b":"I fixed up Neutronimity's comment.\n\n[code]\n/way 56.2 55.5 Mor'Lek\n/way 43.2 44.6 Gub\n/way 54.1 62.7 Kaulema\n/way 62.4 34.1 Mortaxx\n/way 57.9 26.9 Master Chef\n/way 37.6 40.5 Lost Offspring\n/way 32.9 39.4 Hive Queen\n/way 45.8 55.7 Tor-Tun\n[/code]"},{"id":2334794,"r":2,"n":0,"b":"[b]Gurubashi Headhunter[/b] https://youtu.be/DmUnqqbNacM"},{"id":3270467,"r":5,"n":0,"b":"The Master Chef is actually named [url=https://www.wowhead.com/npc=52392/gurubashi-master-chef]Gurubashi Master Chef[/url] and is nonagressive (yellow) for anybody trying to /target him."}]}{"id":5750,"comments":[{"id":1348064,"r":29,"n":0,"b":"Tunnel Vision is a very serious problem with WoW players, and this achievement pretty much promotes it with it's name and objective. Focus on the boss, forget everything else."},{"id":1348234,"r":28,"n":0,"b":"Pugs are going to love this achievement."},{"id":1348401,"r":4,"n":1,"b":"My guess is this is going to be very hard to heal. If you didn't kill the totems nearly immediately in BC, they would destroy your raid.  Pugs will not get this achievement early on, I'm betting."},{"id":1349355,"r":8,"n":0,"b":"Just like playing pvp on a melee class once you see that delicious clothie!"},{"id":1349802,"r":5,"n":0,"b":"Ah the memories.  Back in the day, it seemed like our dps were always trying to get this achievement."},{"id":1351799,"r":59,"n":0,"b":"I learned to [url=http://www.wowhead.com/achievement=5518]stand in the fire.[/url]\nI also learned to [url=http://ptr.wowhead.com/achievement=5750]tunnel the boss.[/url]\nI am now officially [url=http://www.wowhead.com/achievement=5366#comments]ready for raiding![/url]"},{"id":1393614,"r":3,"n":0,"b":"I managed to do this with a mostly pugged group on the PTR, video here\r\nhttp://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GVcXzMTOQzM"},{"id":1401217,"r":12,"n":1,"b":"We killed the boss without any group member directly attacking the totems but we didn't get the achievement because the bear cubs (spawned by the buff you get whilst in ZA) killed them instead.\n\nLeaving the totems up doesn't make the fight too much harder so long as you stay spread out and the tank moves him from the healing totem as fast as possible."},{"id":1402217,"r":3,"n":0,"b":"The trick to doing this achievement (assuming you can't/don't want to just straight zerg it) is to take advantage of the six pillars around the room for LoS.  In phase one, use the pillars to break LoS between the boss and the water totems; in phase 2, the whole group needs to LoS the lightning totems behind pillars.  Totems disappear over time, so if you end up making a full circuit around the pillars, your starting point should be clear once you make it back over there."},{"id":1403300,"r":5,"n":1,"b":"You won't be able to get this achievement if you have activated the archeology quest at the beginning of the dungeon because the bear cubs will kill the lightning totems."},{"id":1403498,"r":4,"n":1,"b":"While LoS'ing seems to work, it's a bit buggy and requires a very smart tank.  We decided to simply outgear the instance a bit by keeping the tank and the totems on one side of the room (tanked the boss near the exit) and had our tank simply eat the totems.  Only two totems were kept up at a time, so only two lightning totems ticked.  We killed the lynx when it was up and then switched back to the boss.  After a lynx died, we let our healer stand in healing totem to mana back up again (totems give health and mana) and then we pushed the boss over.\n\nThe tank would rotate between moving the boss between the center area and the exit depending on whether or not a lynx is up.  If a lynx was up, he'd be at the exit to eat the totems.  The reason for this was to keep the healing totems in the center of the room and the lightning totems at the exit.  Only lightning totems come up during the lynx phase and only healing totems when a lynx isn't up.  He transitions at 30% health, or approximately around that area.\n\nOur group consisted of a Holy Priest, Fire Mage, Blood DK Tank, Aff Lock, and a Frost DK.  Granted we all had pieces of 372 gear, so this strategy is an easy mix for those who have the gear and just want the achievement.  Currently the LoS strategy just seems to be a bit buggy and we got tired of it so we developed our own.  Cheers to whoever else this works for."},{"id":1403670,"r":3,"n":2,"b":"I completed this achievement today with the following group\r\n\r\n- Blood Spec Goblin DK(Myself)\r\n- Blood Elf Holy Pally \r\n- Blood Elf Beast Mastery Hunter\r\n- Goblin Mage (Dungeon Finder Pug)\r\n- Blood Elf Rogue (Dungeon Finder Pug)\r\n\r\nAt the beginning of the fight, I pulled boss immediately to the far right side of the the room(as you entering the room and facing the boss), as the totems came I slowly kited back towards the other side. During the split phase of the boss, everyone focused on the troll to burn it down. The healer just  healed through that phase.  Once the boss split twice, it was pretty much over.\r\n\r\nWe popped Blood lust about 5-10 seconds into the fight to get the boss burnt faster. We did notice that you can outrange the lightning totems, but can't line of sight them, as I tried to kite around the pole towards the end, to avoid the last lightning totem that was spawned.\r\n\r\nOverall it was pretty easy, I'm looking forward to getting the other ZA/ZG Achievements."},{"id":1414249,"r":0,"n":0,"b":"The same thing happened to us, we had the bear cub buff and was a spur of the moment thing to try and get the achievement. The bear cubs ended up charging the lightning totems and killing them, ruining it for us."},{"id":1423065,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"Well we also had the archeology buff,but we hadn't any problem. We just moved faar away from them, in order to reduce the chance that the bears hit them,which worked well."},{"id":1426076,"r":2,"n":0,"b":"We went in here to go for ZA Timed Run, but failed as the patrol by the main entrances screwed us around after having done the first boss :( We decided to go for the rest of the bosses, and work on some achievements.\r\n\r\nWe tried LOS'ing, but that was really so unpredictable that we ended up with the initial \"plan\". I will try to outline it here:\r\n\r\n[ol]\r\n[li]Our tank started tanking the boss in the center part of the room, to have the water totems put down in that general area. \r\n[/li]\r\n[li]After the second water totem was down, he pulled the boss to the far left (directions are presuming you are standing at the entrance looking at the boss) of the room. Once the first Lightning totem was down, he would move the boss all the way to the far right side of the room. \r\n[/li]\r\n[li]Our ranged and healer would be spread out in the water totems in the center part and our melee had to \"outrange\" the lightning totems every once in a while during the Lynx phases.\r\n[/li]\r\n[li]Then, back in the non-Lynx phase, boss would be tanked in the center, and next Lynx phase we'd repeat point 2.  \r\n[/li]\r\n[li]We completely ignored the Lynx as for dps. All dps focused only on the boss through the entire encounter. [/li]\r\n[/ol]\r\n\r\nWe were a pala tank, pala healer, warlock, hunter (survival) and rogue - mainly in 359s. Oh, and we had the Bear Cubs around as well.\r\nGood luck, everyone :)"},{"id":1427460,"r":2,"n":0,"b":"Seems like Retribution Paladins specialized into Eye for an Eye will have a harder time with this achievement. The talent reflects the damage back to the totem and eventually kills it."},{"id":1432324,"r":3,"n":0,"b":"Without LOS totems etc., you'll need ~15k HPS to keep up with the damage (i.e. zerg the achievement).\n\nThis shouldn't be a problem for healers that are appropriately geared to the instance, especially given that water totems = infinite mana AND extra healing for ranged that stand in them.\n\nAs a shammy healer....\n\n- Riptide on cooldown rolling on at least 2 targets (for Tidal Waves)\n- Greater Healing Wave spam on whoever\n- Healing Rain up constantly on melee (we only had two, but it's worth it for the Earthliving procs + to counter melee being unable to stand in water totems)\n- dispel Flame Shock\n\nWe popped BL at about ~50% health....no problemooo."},{"id":1548513,"r":3,"n":0,"b":"This achievement appears to be much easier now. The lightning totems despawn after a short period, no more than 30 seconds up."},{"id":1570215,"r":-3,"n":0,"b":"Well, it's not THAT hard achievment to get... I achieved it with LFG players, being a tank, wearing PvP gear. So, good luck everyone, it's not so hard as it seems )"},{"id":1689528,"r":-3,"n":0,"b":"Class: dk"},{"id":1885901,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"Patch 5.3 / 90 BM Hunter solo / 527 iLevel\r\n\r\nMake sure to move him out of the green healing aura... Then max DPS!"},{"id":1978770,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"At iLevel 540+ this is fairly trivial, knocked it off in a minute or two by walking backwards around the room away from his healing totem as I burned him down."},{"id":2107378,"r":5,"n":0,"b":"Trivial as of Warlords of Draenor.\r\nJust burst him and that should get you your achiv"},{"id":5581734,"r":3,"n":0,"b":"Just one-shot the boss and you will get the achievement."}]}{"id":5760,"comments":[{"id":1362106,"r":26,"n":0,"b":"\"Ring Out\" - the name of this achievement, refers to a practice in various martial arts of either penalizing or disqualifying a combatant who leaves the arena of play (leaving a platform, a marked ring on the floor, etc.)  Leaving (either by being forced out or voluntarily exiting) generally shows that your opponent has an advantage over you.  In some venues (such as professional wrestling,) the ring may simply symbolize the main fighting arena, with no penalty for leaving.  The goal of a \"Cage\" match is to eliminate the possibility for ring-out, forcing the combatants to struggle for a KO, TKO, or other victory condition.\r\n\r\nMany arcade-style fighting games also made use of the Ring-Out mechanic, notably the Virtua Fighter series from Sega.  As characters often fought on high platforms, a ring-out would often mean certain death from falling.  While frustrating to some, this mechanic allowed players who were behind in a match to still win through strategic (or lucky) use of the arena edge to lure their opponents to their demise."},{"id":1400767,"r":32,"n":1,"b":"This achievement is easy for p1 human phase and p2 bear or lynx phase.\nNothing out of the ordinary like the usual boss fight, only, group up in the middle, and make sure the three people don't move out of the grid to eat [spell=42402].\n\nFor dragonhawk, ranged spread out around the rectangle to dodge your own fire column, and keep the boss in middle to avoid having half of your group eat the same [spell=43215].\n\nFor eagle, because the vortecies pick the player position after each [spell=97647] cast, but do not move over till a second later, reposition yourself (in the rectangle) as soon as the cast is done. Totems still need to die ASAP ofc.\n\nAlso, remember to [b]get in position beforehand[/b] and [b]have the tank ranged pull[/b] into the rectangle instead of running up and body pull."},{"id":1435445,"r":2,"n":0,"b":"Probably the biggest thing you need to look out for if you get Dragonhawk is the Column of Fire. It has nowhere near the visual warning of his other fire abilities (IE the line of fire) and will kill you very, very quickly, especially if you tunnel vision that last million hp. \nWith everything going on and lines of fire dividing up where you can move, it may be best for your ranged to group up to minimise the ground where you can't move, by placing the columns together."},{"id":1939015,"r":-13,"n":1,"b":"Probably the Merc Out reference?"},{"id":2362267,"r":3,"n":0,"b":"Not sure why you got the achieve AFTER he shapeshifts, but I tried it on several toons and every time I killed him after he shapeshifted it failed to give me the achieve.  The ONE time I killed him BEFORE he shapeshifted I got the achieve.  Just go in with your strongest toon and kill him fast and you will get the achieve on ALL of your toons."},{"id":5984487,"r":16,"n":0,"b":"Step 1: Nuke the Boss\r\nThat's it, just the one step."},{"id":6234342,"r":4,"n":0,"b":"Hit boss, he dies, achievement unlocked. :-) GLHF"}]}{"id":5762,"comments":[{"id":1362653,"r":17,"n":0,"b":"Nice, an achievement using an old strat!\n\nBecause [npc=52157] will kill [npc=52156] one by one eventually preventing you from being rezzed after [npc=52151]'s [spell=96684], this achievement becomes a dps race.\n\nUtilize slows, stuns and knockbacks and most importantly, group up in the middle to reduce chance to tunnel [spell=96740] and boss travel time during [spell=96684].\n\nKeep in mind that you can keep going after all the [npc=52156] are dead, and DO NOT cleave [npc=52157] down."},{"id":1366002,"r":21,"n":1,"b":"So you have the tank tank Mandokir and have a ranged DPS evade bug Ohgan...\r\n\r\n,,,Wait."},{"id":1401183,"r":8,"n":0,"b":"To get this achievement you just need to nuke [npc=52151] and avoid the spikes he does. Save reincarnation and combat resses until after all the [npc=52156] have been killed or used.\n\nI'm pretty sure [spell=31850] / [spell=47788] / [spell=86949] can save you a spirit too, but it's only a matter of time until [npc=52157] kills them all anyway."},{"id":1402402,"r":0,"n":3,"b":"Ohgan is fully CC'able, so it's not much of a DPS race if you in a decent group that communicate well."},{"id":1407592,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"Just did this and the only CC my group had was 2 Hammer of Justice. Pretty much I just told the DPS to tunnel the boss and stay out of red stuff. Worked pretty well."},{"id":1421163,"r":4,"n":0,"b":"if you have 2 heroisms this really helps\r\nuse the first at the start\r\nand the next once the other 4 have been killed once"},{"id":1446239,"r":1,"n":1,"b":"can he be knocked back?\r\n\r\ncan he be deathgripped?"},{"id":1465312,"r":0,"n":0,"b":"This achievement was easy, warriors CB, my HoJ & HW, and a Dk's Chains, Ohgan only destroyed 2 maybe 3 spirits by the time we killed the boss, easy achievement."},{"id":1555822,"r":2,"n":1,"b":"He can be stunned by Holy Wrath, so each paladin your group has allows you to keep him controlled 1/4 of the time (Thus you could just get four paladins, but it isn't really necessary)"},{"id":1852207,"r":3,"n":1,"b":"Soloed as a hunter at 90 using snake traps before he casts his one shot, the snakes keep him in combat while the spirits rezzed me, might be possible to do as an engineer with a target dummy, other than that was able to zerg him down with only 1 decapitate with ice traps on ohgans path"},{"id":1929171,"r":3,"n":1,"b":"Thought I'd do some older achievements tonight for kicks. This one frustrated me as the mechanic involves being killed. As a destruction lock I had the Void Walker tank him but still, I was jumped and one shotted, causing the VW to despawn and thus reset the encounter."},{"id":2019596,"r":7,"n":0,"b":"Solo post 6.0.2 stat squish:  Trivially easy, just make sure you[b] don't use a pet[/b].\r\n\r\nThis killed me a couple times before WoD started, but that was because I used a voidwalker.  Just get up in his face and dps him down.  The boss never got off his mount and I got it."},{"id":5906452,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"Just nuke the boss down - Easy achievement"}]}

It's a real shame to force this onto completing Glory of the Cataclysm Raider, I hope they reconsider and remove it from the meta.\n\nEDIT: Blizz took it out of the meta, thank you"},{"id":1238016,"r":165,"n":0,"b":"Sinestra is known for being a very pompuous and stuck-up character in the book \"Night of the Dragon\". Whenever she met someone she would usually brag about how she was going to torture, kill or brag about their chances against her. Even though she tries to claim that Deathwing and her are no longer allies, she does try to use the fact she's Deathwing's consort as a scare tactic as well. Only one that seemed to be on even ground with her was Krasus, considering they were both Prime Consorts.\r\n\r\nI find this achievement name very suiting to her since it makes me think she's going to retain that attitude, but considering the fact that the raid has to one shot her without dying, it would really take the wind out of her sails if you were to achieve a one-shot attempt on her. \r\n\r\nAnd i'm sure if a guild got this achievement at some point, they would love to point out to her they one shotted her without dying. What better insult to a powerful gaming character than to point out that they already humiliated her before :D\r\n\r\n\"I am Sinestra, first and greatest of the Earth-Warder's consorts . . . .\"\r\n\"Whaaaaat? I can't hear you over the sound of how Awesome i am!\""},{"id":1378470,"r":77,"n":2,"b":"Ensidia - Tarren Mill EU was world first to achiev this achievement, 28.03.2011."},{"id":1699968,"r":-1,"n":2,"b":"I very much doubt this will remain obtainable. All of the other \"kill X without any deaths/wipes\" achievements in Wrath were removed when Cataclysm hit - Undying/Immortal in Naxx, Champion/Conqueror of Ulduar and the ToTC Tributes. Herald of the Titans is a very different kind of achievement, not involving no deaths but instead requiring limited ilvl, which is probably why it remained intact (that or just an oversight). The only other achievement I know of with an ilvl restriction was the Tribute to Dedicated Insanity in ToTC, which is no longer possible because in order to remove the other Tribute achievements they simply removed the Tribute chest itself.\r\n\r\nIn short, if you want this achievement, get it now."},{"id":1719221,"r":3,"n":1,"b":"as Mists of Pandaria is released, this achievement is hotfixed recently to be [u]no longer obtainable[/u] due to its potential significant decrease in difficulty for level 90 players.\r\n\r\nSource: http://blue.mmo-champion.com/topic/235672-patch-505-hotfixes/ september 25 hotfixes"},{"id":1719677,"r":94,"n":4,"b":"Feat of strength [b]no longer obtainable[/b] as of last 5.0.5 patch hotfix update (september 25th, 2012)\r\n\r\nSource: [url=http://us.battle.net/wow/en/blog/7207170/Patch_505_Hotfixes_-9_25_2012]Wow 5.0.5 hotfixes 9.25.2012 official site[/url]"},{"id":1719783,"r":-8,"n":1,"b":"Blizzard sometimes marks an achievement as a Feat but doesn't actually make it unobtainable until later, it seems that is what happened with this achievement."},{"id":1735474,"r":10,"n":1,"b":"Achievement has been removed."}]},{"id":5539,"length":0,"total":0,"reports":[]},{"id":5372,"length":65774,"total":11,"reports":[]},{"id":5480,"length":79173,"total":19,"reports":[{"id":1706118,"r":-7,"n":1,"b":"Achievement seems to be bugged as of 5.0.4.\r\n\r\nAchievement requires Dense Embersilk Bandages that are now no longer craftable and replaced with Heavy Embersilk bandages that require one less Embersilk to make, but do NOT currently go towards the achievement."}]},{"id":5028,"length":0,"total":0,"reports":[]}]
