> {"id":5291,"comments":[{"id":1117074,"r":42,"n":2,"b":"Obvious reference to Apocalypse Now."},{"id":1117563,"r":52,"n":0,"b":"The horror..."},{"id":1208598,"r":81,"n":3,"b":"List of facts for this fight:\r\n[ul]\r\n[li]The crocolisks spawn on groups of four[/li]\r\n[li]They will have a random party member targetted with Scent of Blood, which means a lot of initial aggro towards this party member[/li]\r\n[li]They apply a stacking bleed debuff that can get nasty later on the fight[/li]\r\n[li]They [b]CAN [/b]be taunted by the tank or a bulkier DPS to hold or kite the crocolisks around[/li]\r\n[li]The safest way to do this achievement is by having a ranged DPS kiting the crocos[/li]\r\n[li]Having an offtank could work but it's risky because of the debuff[/li]\r\n[li]When the 5th group comes with the last 4 crocolisks, group them all together and AoE them down, they do not have much health so won't be a big problem[/li]\r\n[/ul]\r\n\r\nGood luck on this achievement!"},{"id":1227544,"r":32,"n":2,"b":"Our group did this achievement by having all the dps mount up, with the healer and tank taking on the boss. With luck, all the waves will attack the mounted players making kiting incredibly easy. Once the required amount was met, we aoe'd the adds down. \r\n\r\nIt also makes this easier to have a mage to cast Ring of Frost, or a hunter to use Frost Trap."},{"id":1280794,"r":42,"n":0,"b":"While you can cheese this cheevo now by standing on the croc statues, we did it early on in the xpac and made a guide video about our kiting strategy. In the event Blizz takes away the cheesemode, definitely check out the short video below outlining how to nail this:\n\n[url=http://www.youtube.com/user/bigcritsguild?feature=mhsn#p/c/E069169DDBC4CDD8/2/a-54eXAk9Js]How to: Acrocalypse Now[/url]\n\nMay all your hits be crits!"},{"id":1347761,"r":45,"n":3,"b":"We tried ALL 5 on mounts - including me as the TANK with a lightwell down, I ran into Lockmaw and then just kited him while everyone else kited till we had 20 - then TIME WARP."},{"id":1867222,"r":47,"n":2,"b":"Just did this as a blood dk in dps gear. I mounted up, agro'd him and rode around in circles until I thought there were 20 frenzied crocs. I hadn't done any damage to the boss at this point. AOE'd them down and got the achievement."},{"id":1961017,"r":2,"n":0,"b":"Did this today no problem as Windwalker Monk.\r\n1. Mount up and agro the boss, kite him around in a small circles maintaining distance as long as possible until he either dismounts you or you need to heal. Use Healing sphere's and Expel Harm to heal yourself (Roll and Use Expel Harm away from crocs due to the dmg it does). \r\n2. On occasion he may slow you so use cooldowns such as Avert Harm and Fortifying Brew to deaden some of the damage from the stacking debuff. \r\n3. Roll as much as possible to maintain distance (try and stay away from using Flying Serpent Kick as you dont always travel the full distance and when you land you do an aoe which can just about 1 shot the crocs)\r\n4. When you have enough crocs on your tail Spinning Crane Kick will 1 shot everything.\r\n\r\nI just ran round and round using the above tactic till I had a ton of crocolisks then boom!, Achi."},{"id":1981714,"r":3,"n":0,"b":"Did this in MoP 5.4.\r\n\r\nSolo ret pally. Mounted, ran around in a big circle, watched the spawn points, counted up in 4's until i had at least 20 or 24, mount down, get my 3 holy power, DS. qq, i win."},{"id":2016907,"r":12,"n":0,"b":"Did this with level 90 balance druid.\r\n\r\nFirst I mounted up, I felt like the best idea was to aggro boss and kite while mounted. However, Lockmaw didn't approve and first hit dazed me :(\r\n\r\n2 melee attacks to the boss, just for no reason.\r\n\r\nRan around in circles as cheetah, kiting the boss and waiting for 20 crocs to spawn.\r\n\r\nAfter 5 waves of crocs spawned (crocs spawn in groups of 4) popd starfall and got achievement."},{"id":2024255,"r":26,"n":0,"b":"They spawn at 4 at once, so 20/4 = 5, you need to wait 5 times for the croc to cast Scent of Blood, then nuke. :D"},{"id":2027415,"r":3,"n":0,"b":"In 6.0 \r\n\r\ni was able to solo this with my shadow priest ivl525 just by runing around him, using the speed boost from Angelic Feather, and PW:shield ever time i can, also used Flash Heal when the boss started to cast Dust\r\n\r\ni hope this tip helps someone ^^ good luck"},{"id":2099181,"r":14,"n":0,"b":"As a level 100 enhancement shaman, be careful to not accidentally kill Lockmaw while trying to spread your flame shock to everything - because then they all despawn. Guess how I found that one out..."},{"id":2155471,"r":2,"n":0,"b":"[b]100 arcane mage, 100 blood DK[/b]\r\n\r\nThe DK engaged the boss and kept aggro. I (the mage) just kept aggro on the frenzied crocodiles while I killed Augh everytime he came up there. Stacked the crocodiles 5 times (4 in each group) and oneshot' them with arcane explosion. \r\n\r\n[b]Piece of cake now :)[/b]"},{"id":2164683,"r":-5,"n":0,"b":"Easily solo'ed as level 100 rogue, nothing to worry about."},{"id":2235446,"r":3,"n":0,"b":"Soloed as level 100 prot pally in dps raid gear. Taunt the boss to start the encounter, afk for 5 minutes to spawn crocs, Consecration, win."},{"id":2236693,"r":19,"n":0,"b":"Worth noting that dropping a Magma Totem on the group will not earn you this achievement."},{"id":2315419,"r":-1,"n":0,"b":"[pre][zone=5396] Achievements\r\n[u]                                                                   [/u]\r\n[u][achievement=5291]              |    https://youtu.be/37RWYUMuNNs |[/u]\r\n[u][achievement=5290]           |    https://youtu.be/oIsYURRfHy4 |[/u]\r\n[u][achievement=5292]                 |    https://youtu.be/islaxPO-fmE |[/u]\r\n[/pre]"},{"id":2490680,"r":22,"n":0,"b":"As of legion, straightforward as a fury warrior. You need the following: (Taunt, Whirlwind, 3 minutes of your time)\r\n\r\nSteps:\r\n\r\n1- Taunt the boss\r\n2- wait for 5 Scent of Blood casts (each will summon 4 crocs)\r\n3- Whirwind\r\n\r\nGz!"},{"id":2548801,"r":3,"n":3,"b":"As a 110 BM hunter, here's how I just did this.\r\n\r\n1. Send pet in to proximity aggro the boss. No attacking, just proximity aggro.\r\n2. Move the pet to an area on the side of the field of battle, kiting the boss with him. This way, I won't mistakenly kill the boss when I AOE the crocs for this achieve.\r\n3. Stand in the middle of the field and wait for 20 crocs to come to me, 4 per spawn.\r\n4. AOE the crocs down, receive the achieve.\r\n5. Nuke the boss."},{"id":2583655,"r":3,"n":0,"b":"110 Holy Priest. I was unclear if Lockmaw needed to be alive while AEing the 20 crocs. I noticed every time Lockmaw summoned a wave of crocs (4 each wave), he'd stop for a few seconds to do so. So after the 5th wave provided all 20 crocs needed for the achievement, I kited them while waiting for Lockmaw to stop and summon the 6th wave.  Successfully AE'ed the smaller crocs and got the achievement. Then proceeded to finish off Lockmaw."},{"id":3121871,"r":3,"n":0,"b":"I earned this achievement as a 120 moonkin with a sunfire. I wasn't (and am still not) totally sure whether Lockmaw could die at the same time as the little crocolisks for this achievement - it looked like they all died at the same time, but Lockmaw could have needed one more tick? I guess that's unlikely at this point. Anyway, it's possible to earn this achievement as a solo moonkin who is not able to get far enough away from Lockmaw to not hit it with aoe."},{"id":3173478,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"As a 120 monk, I went Brewmaster, talented into [spell=115315], and used it to pull Lockmaw. Then sat off to the side a bit for a few minutes while crocs gathered, then Keg smashed them all. That way you're far enough from Lockmaw to not accidentally kill him before the crocs. Got the achievement before killing Lockmaw.\r\n\r\nHope that helps!"},{"id":3199371,"r":2,"n":0,"b":"Achievement Hunting as a 120 Druid, and I made the mistake of not having someone with me to pull Lockmaw away before hitting my AoE. If you kill him even a fraction of a second too soon, all the little ones despawn, so make sure you have a way to get him away from the group."},{"id":3202150,"r":6,"n":0,"b":"Pretty easy. Just aggro Lockmaw without killing him and run around untill 20 frenzied crocs spawn. Then wait for Lockmaw to stop and cast Dust Flail, when he does then move away from him and aoe mobs. Be sure to keep count so you know it's 20."},{"id":3220921,"r":30,"n":1,"b":"A quick macro for Counting Crocs:\r\n[code]/run local c=0;for i=1,10000 do if UnitName(\"nameplate\"..i)==\"Frenzied Crocolisk\" then c=c+1 end end print(c)[/code]"},{"id":3248561,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"As a 120 lvl druid , I waited all little crocolisks spawn, then mass rooted them, then pulled the boss away so I dont accidentally kill him, when he casts Dust Flail, I ran to the little ones and aoed them with starfall and sunfire."},{"id":5191427,"r":3,"n":0,"b":"Soloing this as a level 60 Unholy DK (as of Shadowlands) is super easy, and I assume it is similarly easy with any class that has a perma-pet.\nThe way I did it was simply to set my pet to \"Passive\" so it wouldn't attack (very important), and use the \"Move To\" command on the pet action bar to make my Geist stand on top of Lockmaw, which aggros the boss to the pet. \nI then just stood back out of AOE range of the boss and waited until there were 20 Frenzied Crocolisks attacking me, and burned them down. \nLockmaw will aggro to you only after you attack the smaller crocs, and will rush you at that point, but if you stand back far enough, you'll have plenty of time before he reaches you. \nI managed to complete this on my first attempt, so easy peasy.\n\nI did remove all of my gear just in case he aggroed to me early, but it wasn't an issue.\nI do recommend using an addon (I use Instance Achievement Tracker) to easily keep count of the crocs and tell you when it is safe to burst AOE.\n\nThis method also works for similar achievements, such as Rotten to the Core [url=https://www.wowhead.com/achievement=5287/rotten-to-the-core][/url]\n\nHope this helps some people who are out hunting old achievements!"},{"id":5233606,"r":16,"n":0,"b":"Solo'd as a 120 Guardian druid.\r\n1: Wait for 20 Frenzied Crocs\r\n2: Wait for boss to cast Dust Flail\r\n3: Run away from boss during his channel, and kill the crocs\r\n4:  Ez achievement."}]}{"id":5292,"comments":[{"id":1163902,"r":55,"n":3,"b":"Two types of adds spawning, caster mob, melee mob, when the melee mob dies, it throws the debuff you need in its melee range, stack all 3 of those, and you just need to kill boss before the buff runs out. Currently the hardest achievement of all the 5man heroic achievements."},{"id":1222947,"r":61,"n":3,"b":"Update:  Once you engage Siamat, he will throw up a shield that reduces his damage taken by 90%.  Throughout the fight, he will alternatively spawn a Servant or Minion one at a time until 3 Servants have spawned  At which point he will only spawn minions.  When Minions die, they leave behind a floating cloud that will damage anyone who walks through them.  Minions also cast chain lightning, which doesn't do much damage on its own but hurts a lot when you have 3 stacks of the debuff.  Because of this, Minions should be interrupted and pulled to the edge to minimize the chances of one of your group members accidentally taking unnecessary damage.  Ranged DPS is ideal for this as they do not have to move to damage the mob.  \n\nTake notes of which Servant spawned when, and have your tank offtank them between Siamat and the edge of the platform.  Feel free to dps them down to roughly ~33% as this will make the burn down phase considerably easier.  When there is no alternative target to dps, feel free to throw some damage onto Siamat.  Even with a 90% damage reduction, you can still easily get him to 80-85% before the third Servant spawns.  When the third Servant spawns, the entire group should damage it to roughly 33% before holding off until the next Minion spawns.  As soon as that minion is dead and there are no other targets on the platform but Siamant and his 3 Servants, finish off the 3rd Servant and engage Siamat.  \n\n[b]Only the 3rd Servant will bring down the shield on Siamat allowing normal dps to resume.[/b]\n\nAs soon as the shield falls, take note of your debuff duration.   The debuff is gained each time a Servant dies, and it increases your damage and haste while also increasing the damage that you take.  Your group should then kill one of the remaining Servants when your debuff duration reaches ~5 seconds to ensure that it continues to stack up.  It is best to use Lust/Hero/Time Warp halfway between killing the 2nd Servant and the third Servant to ensure you have the buff as long as possible to do the most damage.  After the 3rd Servant dies, you should be blowing any saves you can while doing your best to stay alive until Siamat is defeated.\n\n[b]Special notes:  This boss does not appear to have an enrage timer.  This is also an INDIVIDUAL achievement, and if your healer can not keep up it might be best to limit this to 1-2 group members at a time.  With better gear, this achievement becomes significantly easier than it is between a 329-346 average iLvl.[/b]"},{"id":1227379,"r":32,"n":0,"b":"[b]Here's a video guide of how we did it.[/b]\r\n\r\nhttp://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SsaX3EzOsYg\r\n\r\nAs of this writting, the vid is still processing, but should be done within the hour.\r\n\r\n[b]Things to know.[/b]\r\n\r\n1. [i]Chill, don't make it harder than it is.[/i]\r\n2. [i]Phase 2 starts when the third melee add dies.[/i]\r\n3. [i]Postpone phase 2 as long as your healers mana allows it. The more damage you can get in on Siamat in phase 1, the easier phase 2 will be.[/i]\r\n4. [i]Bring down one add at a time, then heal up before bringing down the second add.[/i]\r\n5. [i]When phase 2 starts, focus on surviving.[/i]\r\n\r\nHope it helps."},{"id":1232937,"r":125,"n":9,"b":"Quite an easy achievement after we realised how it was done.\r\n\r\nIf you kill the last add spawned, the boss engages. This means, you kill the last add, get a buff, the healer heals up so everything is under control, then you kill any of the two remaining adds. That means 20 sec + with 2 stack, and the ability to DPS the boss. When you have some time left on the debuff, kill the last add, and then finally kill the boss. \r\n\r\nAfter we realised this, we had 20 seconds + on the debuff when the boss went down. \r\n\r\nYou don't even need to damage the boss down at all, just place the clouds in good positions until the third add spawns."},{"id":1449956,"r":118,"n":0,"b":"Nobody explained how to GET the debuff. You stand in melee range when they die."},{"id":1931670,"r":6,"n":0,"b":"Important note: do not use spells that grant immunity (Divine Shield or Ice Block) because it will clear the debuffs and fail the achievement."},{"id":1934225,"r":40,"n":4,"b":"Why make it so complicated?\r\n*Nuke the boss to 500k\r\n*Kill 3 Servants of Siamat simultaneously, cause when you kill 1 servant you will get 1 stack of the debuff, wihch means you want to kill them at the same time, so you get a 30 second window to nuke the remaining 500k on the boss.\r\n\r\nDone!"},{"id":1940325,"r":3,"n":1,"b":"I don't think this is the hardest achievement.  I thought the one with High Priest Barim and the fire was much more difficult, because you had to kite through the fire and kill before the Burning Souls merged.  Quite a pain.\r\n\r\nFirst, you'll probably have a tank for Siamat and a heals or dps to kite the Servants.  Kill the minions.  Do not touch the Servants in any way until 3 are up.\r\n\r\nOnce there are three, and Siamat is at 75%, you may start killing Servants.  But only those in melee range appear to get the debuff you need when you kill Siamat.  (Our tank was standing about 10 yards away and didn't get the debuff.)  So when we killed Siamat, which was instantly after the three Servants went down, only those of us in range of the Servants received the achievement.  \r\n\r\nPlan on doing this once for the DPS kiting party and once for the Tanking party, swapping roles so they can get the debuff.  It's really not too bad, just you need 3 Servants to be kited, one at a time until you get all three, don't touch them, and when Siamat is at 75%, everyone stack on the kiter and aoe them down.  You must be very close, then you will kill Siamat.  Easy as pie."},{"id":1950821,"r":13,"n":0,"b":"At level 90 with a decently geared character, you can basically just kill the 3 Servants, stand in the debuff 3 times, then pop all your CDs and zerg the boss. You should have enough time to finish him off before the Lightning Charge debuff runs out."},{"id":1958293,"r":-9,"n":0,"b":"I did this as a 558 Survival Hunter by nuking boss super fast to about 1 million hp then letting just pet attack (my cape did too much damage) the boss.  I waited until there were 3 Servants alive then I dismissed my pet (he was stealing the buff stacks) aoe'd the adds down and nuked the boss."},{"id":1986950,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"Can I make a note of Im not getting any debuff from these adds being in melee range or far friggen way from them I am simply not getting a debuff and after 200g in repairs and no help from blizzard im at a complete loss with this bs achievement"},{"id":2010189,"r":8,"n":0,"b":"Ok, So after reading 25+ comments her and making a long 10 min attempt. (he takes way reduced damage for 90% of the fight) I failed because of something I did not see here. When you kill one of his larger adds. He will knock you back and bounce you around. This basically means do not kill more than one large add at a time. I worked the boss down to 300k life and then aoe'd the remaining 3 large adds. After the first one died I was knocked back and when the other two died I did not get their debuff. Make sure you single target the adds down.\n\nTLDR: Single target large adds to avoid missing debuff via knockback from boss."},{"id":2016940,"r":6,"n":0,"b":"Did this with level 90 Balance druid.\n\nStep 1: Engage Siamat, Lord of the South Wind.\n\nStep 2: Kill servant of siamat and minion of siamat.\n\nStep 3: Repeat step 2 until you have 3 stacks of Lightning charge.\n\nStep 4: Kill boss, get achi."},{"id":2018430,"r":6,"n":1,"b":"Since it is easier now.Wait for 3 of the larger mobs to come. Aoe them down and nuke the boss. Easy solo at 90"},{"id":2040614,"r":4,"n":2,"b":"I killed all 3 servants at the same time but for some reason I get only 1 stack of charge.I repeated it 5 times but on the best try I get at least 2 stacks. It seems like its bugged, but maybe I did something wrong."},{"id":2083824,"r":2,"n":0,"b":"Just a word of warning for those who are trying to solo at a high level. The bigger mobs you need for this achievement will not spawn out of phase one so just use auto attack or a taunt at the beginning of the fight till you gain all three stacks then you should be able to burn fast enough without having to worry."},{"id":2086503,"r":4,"n":0,"b":"Wife and I ran it with no gear, DK and Pally. You are safe to kill the minions as we found the spawn for the servants were a little quicker. Place a marker, stack on it, let the servants beat on you. When there are 3 kill them, get the debuff and kill the boss. GL and have fun! \r\n\r\nThanks all!"},{"id":2093649,"r":102,"n":6,"b":"I came here looking for mechanics information - so here it is because I couldnt find it: \r\n\r\n[ul]\r\n[li]Servant of Siamat is the mob you need three of[/li]\r\n[li]If you just stand and wait, they will eventually spawn (under a minute for all three to come up)[/li]\r\n[li]The bubble on the boss is super helpful at 100, reduces your damage but not to a point where it is hard to complete[/li]\r\n[li]Kill Minions of Siamat as they are just useless[/li]\r\n[li]Yes you get punted around, I just ran back under the boss while I was waiting[/li]\r\n[li]When I had three up, aoe damage to kill them all then finish boss[/li]\r\n[/ul]"},{"id":2097253,"r":3,"n":0,"b":"For some reason, the buff from the Servant of Siamat is not counting the third one for some people when trying to solo. If you're having trouble getting 3 stacks, have 2 friends help you who already have the achieve. The mobs can't hit a level 100 toon often, nor even hard enough to do much damage. Have your first friend hold the first Servant, your second friend hold the second one, wait for the third one to spawn. You kill the third one, run to one of the others and kill it, then run to the remaining one and kill it. Since you have to be within melee range (or so I've read) to get the buff, you would need to be the one killing the Servants. Kill Siamat with 3 stacks, and you're done, congrats on your achieve!"},{"id":2108746,"r":35,"n":6,"b":"At level 100 I killed each Servant of Siamat as they spawned and subsequent Servants spawn within a couple seconds of killing the last. You have to kill each Servant within melee range to get the buff.  No need to wait until all of them spawn and found doing so created a lot of knock-back which placed you out of melee range when they died."},{"id":2182536,"r":0,"n":0,"b":"Being lvl 100 I tried this achievement a couple of months ago without success. Just like others mentioned, low-level mobs hit prob is very low against 100s\r\n\r\nI just did it today in my first attempt and the first 3 mobs simply by taking out all my gear before the encounter. Hope this helps"},{"id":2188558,"r":4,"n":0,"b":"Best tip on this page I read was:\r\n\r\nKill the servant that spawns [b]last[/b], last.\r\n\r\nTruly, I did this alot, aborting 2 lightning charge attempts with Bubble Hearth.  Honestly, when I single target killed them at level 100 I managed for the first time to get 3 charges and Success.  So, yes, mark kill order, Skull, X, Square for example.  As the adds die with 1 hp left, make sure to run in there to get charged up.  Many times I was blown away from the boss or whatever.  So, to end with the best comment on the page that is relevant for level 100 players.\r\n\r\nKill the servant that spawns [b]last[/b], last."},{"id":2200705,"r":5,"n":2,"b":"At level 100, this is a piece of cake. Just wait for the three servants to spawn, AoE them down, then nuke the boss."},{"id":2270113,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"As a level 100 fury warrior, I equipped a fishing pole instead of my usual 2-handers. Then I ran back and forth through the boss, hitting him for a little hp with each pass. After a few passes, I had all 3 servants chasing me, so then I did a whirlwind and took 'em out. After they dropped, I had 3 stacks of the debuff and killed Siamat. Done."},{"id":2304140,"r":11,"n":0,"b":"As a level 100 shaman I took down each servant one by one, standing as close to them I could to get the debuff. Check the debuff countdown to make sure you dont kill the servants to slow, its about 30sec and it gets refreshed when you kill another servant.\r\n\r\n[b]Do not use Blood Lust, Heroism, Time warp or anything like it. It removes the Lightning Charge debuff.[/b]"},{"id":2304954,"r":-9,"n":0,"b":"A quick guide in how to Solo this achievement can be found at:\r\n\r\n[url=https://youtu.be/xEmh8Cj4rn4]LilyBase.net - Headed South Achievement (solo)[/url]\r\n\r\nGood luck! =D"},{"id":2315417,"r":-5,"n":0,"b":"[pre][zone=5396] Achievements\r\n[u]                                                                   [/u]\r\n[u][achievement=5291]              |    https://youtu.be/37RWYUMuNNs |[/u]\r\n[u][achievement=5290]           |    https://youtu.be/oIsYURRfHy4 |[/u]\r\n[u][achievement=5292]                 |    https://youtu.be/islaxPO-fmE |[/u]\r\n[/pre]"},{"id":2319996,"r":-11,"n":0,"b":"Travel south crossland\r\nPut out the fire\r\nDon't look past my shoulder\r\nThe exodus is here\r\nThe happy ones are near\r\nLet's get together\r\nBefore we get much older"},{"id":2327930,"r":0,"n":0,"b":"Stand CLOSE to the servants to recieve the debuff. If you kill just one a little too far away, you will not get debuff and have to wait till they kill you to try again. (On WoD it takes LONG time to wipe here)"},{"id":2351679,"r":23,"n":2,"b":"Easily soloable at 100. Aggro the boss and wait for the adds to spawn. There are two types of adds, you want the melee ones. As the ranged adds spawn you can take them out to keep track of things easier. Once you get 3 melee adds whaling away on you, take them out and stand in the clouds to get the debuff. Make sure you get 3 of them, then take out the boss."},{"id":2352559,"r":-4,"n":1,"b":"What devilry is this?This achievement only works for one person at a time? At level 100, 700+ gear, my son and I were killing time completing mount achievements.  For Headed South, I aggroed three servants while my son killed minions, then we stood next together and I blew everything up in 6 seconds flat. I got the achievement but my son did not. Man, was I bummed! My son's silence on the other end of the mic was heart crushing. Some comments say that this is a one person per time achievement. Is that correct? (Disappointed Dad)"},{"id":2472339,"r":-7,"n":1,"b":"This might be bugged currently, as no servants would spawn during the encounter."},{"id":2586384,"r":31,"n":0,"b":"Obtained this achievement in patch 8.0.1 on my 110 shadow priest.  I left the Servants of Siamat alive and killed the minions.  Once I had three Servants, I moved them under the grey cloud (into the green swirly stuff on the floor) and killed them.  Each Servant provides 1 stack of Lightening Charge when it dies.  So if you kill three at the same time you get the 3 stacks required for the achievement. Once I had the 3 stacks, I immediately killed the boss, which was one-shot at this level. Pretty easy.  \r\n\r\nIf you accidentally kill one of the Servants I recommend that you reset the boss by jumping off the platform and running out a short distance.  I accidentally killed the first one and only two more spawned after that so I think that the boss will only spawn 3 Servants per fight, irrespective of how long the fight goes on for.  I waited a good 10 minutes and only minions spawned after the third Servant. \r\n\r\nN.B the Servants are melee, the minions are casters. \r\n\r\nHope this helps."},{"id":3205003,"r":30,"n":1,"b":"Quite a easy achievement now in BFA:\r\nTake off all your gear, move near boss [b]without attacking[/b] him to take aggro and start the combat (you might one-shot him with normal hit, even naked, it happened to me once), wait for him to summon all 3 [npc=45268] , in the meantime you can kill the [npc=44704], don't stay near the edge, you might get thrown away from the platform. Once all 3 [npc=45268] are summoned, go a bit far from boss, pull them near you and kill them with a aoe ([b]make sure they all die in meele range, to get the buff[/b]). Once you got the buff you can see how many stacks you got, if you got all 3, kill the boss."},{"id":3216601,"r":8,"n":0,"b":"I recommend spacing out the kills on the Servants a bit. I got hit by some knockback while they were dying, ended up getting only 2 stacks and couldn't even reset the fight at this point."},{"id":3232148,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"Are you a hunter? Did you (like me) screw something up and need to reset the boss and try again? Feign Death is your friend."},{"id":3236251,"r":42,"n":3,"b":"Pull the boss without hitting him. Wait until the boss summons 3 servants (not the minions, you can kill those). Then, kill all 3 servants at meele range then kill the boss. Easy."},{"id":3249485,"r":4,"n":1,"b":"You can reset this boss on any class.\r\n\r\nRun off the plateform in the direction of the 1st or 3rd boss. Sometimes (but not always), you will hit the ground and take fall damage. Repeat until you die.\r\n\r\nP.S. You can go back on the plateform with the tornado at the 1st boss."},{"id":6256364,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"Only seem to get 2 stacks of lighting charge when killing all 3 adds. Have tried to kill them all at once and also one at a time.  -- EDIT --  Killed them one at a time and spaced apart and it worked."}]}{"id":5293,"comments":[{"id":1217452,"r":30,"n":1,"b":"A ranged DPS can hit the snakes from the platform, with say Blizzard, that way the snakes come running for him and the lever puller (for that side) is safe. That was our method for getting this."},{"id":1218673,"r":83,"n":2,"b":"The fight consists of two phases.  In the first phase, its a simple tank and spank of Anhuur while avoiding the randomly laser/flame channels on the platform.  The second phase occurs every 33% and Anhuur will become completely invulnerable to all damage until his shield is brought down.  While his shield is up, he will slowly chant (I hate that song, remember?) and apply a stacking dot onto all group members, eventually resulting in an unhealable amount of damage.  [b]In order to complete the achievement, you have to interrupt his casting within 20 seconds (this was a hotfix).[/b]\n\nWhen his shield is up he is completely invulnerable to all spells and abilities.  The only way to interrupt his channel is to bring his shield down.  This can be accomplished by pulling the two levers in the pit below for 10 seconds each.  There is only one problem: snakes (Why did it have to be snakes?).  The snakes will attack anyone who jumps into the pit, preventing them from channeling the levers and preventing you from bringing the shield down to stop the cast.  There are two strategies for dealing with this.\n\n[ul]\n[li][b]1.  Have your tank pick up all of the snakes in the pit BEFORE engaging the boss.  The snakes DO NOT RESPAWN unless they are killed, so your tank can simply of tank Anhuur while your dps burns the boss down and channels the levers below.\n2.  Have your tank jump down into the pit at ~75% and ~35% to pick up all of the snakes.  Then when the boss is pushed over, two group members can pull the levers and then kill the snakes.[/b][/li]\n[/ul]\n\n[b]Option 1 is by far the easiest way to complete this achievement.[/b]  However, if your tank or healer is under-geared, option 2 might be best as it will minimize the damage the group takes over the course of the entire fight.  The choice is up to you!"},{"id":1947769,"r":3,"n":0,"b":"This and [achievement=5284] were the last two I had remaining leftover from the Cataclysm days. Myself and two others went to HoO and were able to get this finished. The comp was shadow priest, ret paladin, and myself as an Arms warrior (535 ilevel).\r\n\r\nThe first time the DoT ticks from the snake poison interrupted our shadow priest, so we had to wipe and do it again.  I stayed up on the top platform, but before we pulled the boss I ran down and picked up all of the snakes and brought them up to the boss platform. I was the only DPS on the boss and the other two pulled levers. I ensured not to use any AoE abilities, and we got it in one attempt without a problem.\r\n\r\nIf you have the legendary strength cloak/meta, make sure to unequip those items or the accidental AoE will cause new snakes to spawn. You need to make sure they stay alive the whole fight, and it can be done easily with three people."},{"id":1951876,"r":1,"n":2,"b":"Just soloed as a BM Hunter 571 ilvl nuked him down.\r\n\r\nhttp://i.imgur.com/BdDjbuz.jpg"},{"id":1952017,"r":-4,"n":0,"b":"Sadly this can't be soloed. It seems you would need at least 3 people to do it."},{"id":1952449,"r":4,"n":4,"b":"Soloed as 551 combat-rogue...definately do-able!\n\njust made a macro to use [url=http://www.wowhead.com/item=76089]Virmen's Bite[/url], [url=http://www.wowhead.com/item=102351]Drums of Rage[/url], [url=http://www.wowhead.com/spell=126731]Synapse Springs[/url](Engineer Glove Enchant), [url=http://www.wowhead.com/spell=121471]Shadow Blades[/url] and [url=http://www.wowhead.com/spell=13750]Adrenaline Rush[/url] at the same time.\n\nAt start of fight i stacked [url=http://www.wowhead.com/spell=8647]Expose Armor[/url] 3times, used [url=http://www.wowhead.com/spell=84617]Revealing Strike[/url] and [url=http://www.wowhead.com/spell=1943]Rupture[/url].\n\nTo finish him off, i used [url=http://www.wowhead.com/spell=51690]Killing Spree[/url].\n\nThe whole fight lasted 9 seconds, so..jeah, basically: use everything you have and dps hi down as fast as possible.\n\nScreenshot as proof is following"},{"id":1977703,"r":5,"n":1,"b":"Soloable. DPS him slowly until like 75%, then use some powerful spell, to get him around 50% with one shot, then use another powerful spell to get him around 20% and then finish the boss. No need to use levers. Downed with 577 ele shammy, used Heroism with Ascendance + potion."},{"id":1985534,"r":7,"n":3,"b":"I can can confirm this is soloable, as I just did it.  570 destro warlock with 1 mil chaos bolts.  I reduced the bosses health to around 70-73% fired off a chaos bolt and he dropped to 32%, and then he shielded and started singing. \r\n\r\nI stood there waiting for the achievement to go red and fail (have it on tracking) but it never did, so I just walked down stairs killed all the snakes, pulled both levers, walked back up stairs and finished the boss of for achievement....obviously there is a bug/exploit that if you drop him so low so fast it doesn't ruin the achieve as he was singing for minutes :)"},{"id":1986353,"r":8,"n":1,"b":"Yo, Whatshername-TarrenMill here.\r\nAfter around 10 attempts I finally managed to get lucky with timing the burst, hunter 541 solo.\r\nSome useful info to spare you couple unnecessary wipes. \r\nThis guide is for nabs with less than 560ilvl+ ^^\r\n\r\n1)His shield procs at 66%, BUT luckily for us there is a bug in the encounter. If you manage to bring the boss down from ~68% to 32% or less in around 0.5sec(while boss \"realizes\" it's time for his bubble+hymn), you still most likely need to go down and pull the levers to break the shield....but you will get the achievement after killing him ;)\r\nIn a nutshell, if you proc 2nd hymn with your burst while he is casting the first one, achievement will not break even after those 15sec.\r\n\r\n2)So as a hunter you precast petBL/hero/potion/all cds/procs you got, start very slowly on the boss, until he reaches around 71%(the lower the better, its a timing fight, practice a bit). Then you smash him with Powershot+KillCommand(I was BM) and pray for both to crit. \r\n\r\n3)Simple rule to make sure you will get the achievement:\r\nIf he starts singing with less than 32%, you've spanked the devTeam! :) Grats!"},{"id":1992245,"r":5,"n":0,"b":"I soloed this as a 567 fury warrior. If you want to do this, a few notes:\r\n\r\n1. You should probably have at least 560 ilvl. You need to be able to burst about 75% of his health in 2 gcds, so about 560 ilvl~ with normal mode weapons. You also probably have to be fury, I doubt arms could do it except maybe with a higher ivl/better weapon.\r\n\r\n2. Don't spec into second wind. If you mess up and don't do it properly, you'll be basically impossible to kill with second wind and will have to either kill him and try the next day or hearth out and come back. Dying is faster.\r\n\r\nTo solo it, start with a shattering throw, then bloodthirst and apply deep wounds. You need to do roughly 800k damage to phase him, so be careful. One or two light attacks is enough. If you bloodthirst him and auto attack for about two seconds, it's enough. At this point pop all of your CDs, a potion of mogu power and colossus smash, then storm bolt and heroic strike. That plus maybe one more attack should be enough to kill him before he shields himself, netting you the achievment. It does rely on some RNG here, you  basically have to do about 2.5 million damage in 2~ GCDs which isn't that hard, but if you're undergeared it will make it either much harder or impossible."},{"id":2008311,"r":3,"n":0,"b":"If the achievement bugs out on you and you do not get credit I recommend bursting the boss down to 30% as quick as possible this will make it so he only hymn's one time. The achievement should pop. \r\n\r\nThis has been tested and worked after failing a few times (While doing it the right way). I would recommend hitting escape > help > submit a bug report if it doesn't work for you or if you did not get credit doing it the way it was intended."},{"id":2013093,"r":11,"n":1,"b":"Anyone trying to do this post 6.0 should have an easier time. > [{"id":5589215,"b":"[b]I've submitted screenshots that follow along with the instructions in [url=https://www.wowhead.com/achievement=5289/extra-credit-bonus-stage#comments:id=2585159]the comment left by Zerias describing the location of each orb[/url].[/b]\n\nAlso, the newer feature to interact with objects by using a keybind makes this an absolute breeze - I definitely recommend using it for this achievement. To turn it on, go to the Game Menu (ESC) > Options > type \"Interact\" in the Options menu search bar > Check the box for \"Enable Interact Key\" and [u]make sure that there is a keybind for \"Interact with Target\", since this is the keybind that you will use to interact with the orb as soon as you are close[/u].\n\n[b]Lastly, when you are sent back to the entrance, there will be slipstreams that appear on either side of the dungeon entrance portal after killing the bosses. > {"id":5759,"comments":[{"id":1354793,"r":64,"n":0,"b":"If it does any comfort to you, the achievement does not require you to kill Jin'do himself after killing the spirits. That way you can attempt to kill all the spirits without the fear of a wipe."},{"id":1406573,"r":31,"n":1,"b":"We all ran to the back of the platform, and our Paladin jumped down to the stairs and bubbled once he got close to the ghosts.  He grouped them up, then ran back up the stairs.  We proceeded to jump down and AOE stun/AOE damage all of them.  We wiped afterwards."},{"id":1424850,"r":29,"n":0,"b":"I'd just like to say, that the \"crazy jumping off the platform\" strat and AOEing our brains out was by far the easist thing we tried, and should have done that from the very beginning.   Its far easier than any other kiting strat listed on this page.\r\n\r\nIts too bad we read the \"kiting\" strats first and wasted all that time and repair money."},{"id":1941443,"r":17,"n":2,"b":"Extremely easy to solo at level 90.  Best way I found to do this is to clear the lower level then head up top to engage the boss.  Once you get to phase 2, just run around the outer edges where the boss is.  The twisted spirits move pretty slow and typically wont catch up to you.  Since you are going around the outer edge and are moving faster then them, they typically try to go straight at you which has them going around the inner part of the alter.  Just keep running laps around the outer edge.   After about 10 or so laps you will have a couple of dozen spirits chasing you.  A speed buff or potion helps here but is not necessary.   One you are ready to engage them, run to one of the corners furthest away from the mobs to group them all up nicely.  Then just aoe them to get the achieve.\n\nOn a side note, if you are a melee class, make sure you do your aoe as soon as they get in your melee range. One aoe hit typically will kill all of them as they only have around 15k hp. If they attack you first, it is very likely you will die as they hit hard and with 20 plus of them they can do a lot of damage."},{"id":1988872,"r":3,"n":0,"b":"Hunter with Barrage = cake. Just start the boss, jump off one side and then jump down again, head to the stairs that lead up to the boss. Then you can Barrage with ease"},{"id":2104652,"r":-3,"n":0,"b":"As an enhancement shaman, I wasn't sure how to do this, as you have to get kill credit on the spirits, meaning Magma Totem won't do you any good... \r\nI tried popping Heroism and just flailing + CL'ing my day away, but I missed it by about 3 kills, so I figured I'd just scrap it for now and respec elemental or something and come back and do it.\r\nHowever, when I starting breaking the shields on the chains, I noticed they have enough HP to sustain a Flame Shock (about 134k hp), meaning I could just stack up a bunch of spirits on top one of the Chains, FS it and immediately hit Escape so as not to auto attack it, and then use FN once - bam, twenty kills from the FN. So that's the trick for enhancement shamans soloing this!"},{"id":2246817,"r":12,"n":0,"b":"if the boss-fight got bugged, incase you do not want to hearthstone just suffocate yourself by running under-water."},{"id":2281255,"r":23,"n":3,"b":"1. Kill Venoxis so you get access to Jin'do\r\n2. Get Jin'do to 70%\r\n3. Wait like 2 minutes until you have 20 Twisted Spirits around you, it should look like that http://i.imgur.com/DStUCna.jpg (okay, that's maybe a bit too much xD)\r\n4. Do some kind of AoE."},{"id":2295798,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"[b]\r\nSpirit Twister[/b] https://youtu.be/RJAqmwencW0"},{"id":2304955,"r":-8,"n":0,"b":"A quick guide in how to Solo this achievement can be found at:\r\n\r\n[url=https://youtu.be/vOi74DXRgZw]LilyBase.net - Spirit Twister Achievement (solo)[/url]\r\n\r\nGood luck! =D"},{"id":2538084,"r":14,"n":4,"b":"To complete at 100+, you must remove all your gear except your weapon.  Hit Jin'Do with your weakest move (as a hunter, I used concussive shot).  You want him to be at least below 70% without killing him.  This will spawn the spirits.  Run around until you've collected 20+ spirits (you don't need to count, just make sure it looks like more than 20).  Hit your AOE and achievement done.\r\n\r\nNow, maybe I'm stupid, but I couldn't figure out the next part (breaking the chains) so I figured I would add that just in case anyone else is in the same position.  You have to run down the stairs and aggro one of the big Gurabashi spirits, bring them back up to the chains and they will do a smash move that breaks each of the chains when you pull them over it (a purple arrow will show up to let you know you're doing it right)."},{"id":2561794,"r":16,"n":3,"b":"You can use this macro to check the number of Twisted Spirits around: \r\n\r\n[i]/run local t,c=\"Twisted Spirit\",0 for i=1,10000 do local p=C_NamePlate.GetNamePlateForUnit(\"nameplate\"..i) if p and p:IsVisible() and p:GetChildren():GetRegions():GetText()==t then c=c+1 end end print(t,\":\",c)[/i]"},{"id":3209134,"r":24,"n":1,"b":"I was reading all the be careful, take off your gear, don't kill him and I honestly didn't have all the patience for that being a 120 warlock.  I hit him and it put him to 1 hit point and started the spirit phase.  I just put my back to a corner and counted all the spirits that came toward me. 1 Cataclysm and all the spirits died giving me the [s]cheese[/s] chieve."},{"id":5945704,"r":5,"n":0,"b":"I just completed it today. Easy as pie. Dps him down 60-70%, wait for the shadows to appear. It will take like 2-3 mins, stay, don't move, wait for them to gather and then kill them all. That's it!"}]}{"id":5761,"comments":[{"id":1360626,"r":29,"n":0,"b":"Or it could be referencing [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chex_Mix]Chex Mix[/url]."},{"id":1362098,"r":99,"n":1,"b":"In [zone=3805]'s level 70 raid instance, trash mobs would drop [item=33865].  These were green quality items which are not shared loot.  When you use the [item=33865] on one of the [npc=24396]s in the central area of the zone, a few things could happen:\n[ul][li]You could rescue a humanoid (also under: [npc=24396]) that leaves either a chest or money.[/li]\n[li]You could rescue a humanoid (also under: [npc=24396]) that is a vendor and sells various items.[/li]\n[li]You could get [item=33993] as a non-combat pet.[/li][/ul]\n\nThe vendors eventually make their way back to the entrance area, if you're looking for them later.\n\nMost people farmed these for [item=33993], but there was benefit to farming for the NPC's as well.  You could land [item=33928] (which contained various flasks) or [item=33926] (which could contain a rare recipe.)  As some people are still recipe-hunting, some of them may sell well on the auction house (particularly weapon patterns, enchant recipes, or other epic patterns.)\n\nIt looks like they have brought back the spirit of the hexing system again, and this achievement rewards your compassion for these poor souls. (ribbit!)"},{"id":1401267,"r":60,"n":0,"b":"You dont have to use the [item=33865] on all the [npc=24396]'s yourself. As long as someone in your party uses it then it will count towards the achievement for you."},{"id":1403973,"r":33,"n":0,"b":"You can buy [item=33865]s from auction house. Kill trash up to next boss, do not kill boss.\r\n\r\nRun out and reset, repeat.  Get 10 or so sticks per run and no need to wait a day for next try."},{"id":1991209,"r":12,"n":1,"b":"How many times did I run this looking for Tyllan?\r\n\r\n...toooooooooooooooooooooooooooooo many...\r\n\r\nThe good thing is - I made about 3K gold and have 7 Hex Sticks left to sell off.\r\nThe bad thing is...\r\n\r\nI think I have carpal tunnel now :p\r\n\r\nBe prepared to run this over and over looking for that ONE guy or girl.\r\nDON'T KILL ANY BOSSES on your runs.\r\n\r\nI went left/right - killed everything but the bosses.\r\nI went straight ahead - killing EVERYTHING I could find - except the bosses.\r\n\r\nNot finding Tyllan AGAIN - I went outside and reset the instance (if you kill a boss you're screwed until it resets automatically so don't kill any).\r\n\r\nSome things to note:\r\n\r\n#1:  DO NOT unhex and leave.  Wait for their little speech - and then look carefully at the ground.  There will either be a sack or a box left behind containing various items or gold.\r\n#2:  Make sure to hover over them - some of them might turn out to be vendors...\r\n#3:  YES - there are duplicates of people you have already unhexed so be prepared to waste your hex sticks...\r\n#4:  It's good to be a skinner here - as even the alligators and cats drop hex sticks - so kill EVERYTHING.\r\n\r\nGood luck with this one.\r\nMaybe you'll get lucky and get them all in one run..."},{"id":2037530,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"FYI the frogs respawn pretty quickly, so as long as you don't run out of hex sticks you can just keep circling around the water until you get the one you need."},{"id":2102546,"r":-2,"n":1,"b":"Completed this in 2 runs, easy soloable now with WoD! Weird :P"},{"id":2283548,"r":4,"n":0,"b":"initial thought: BUT MY HUNTER CAN'T CAST HEX...!"},{"id":2372764,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"For me on my RNG adventures on what else I needed:\r\n\r\nTyllan \r\n/way 49.1 58.3\r\n\r\nRelissa\r\n/way 48.2 47.5\r\n\r\nMelissa\r\n/way 49.3 50.6"},{"id":2496154,"r":3,"n":5,"b":"An interesting observation: if you reset and collect the sticks as [url=http://www.wowhead.com/achievement=5761/hex-mix#comments:id=1981870]this comment[/url] suggests, don't use them until you have 12 or more.
