I even spawned Mojo three times in a row after the NPCs for the achievement.\n\nCan anyone else confirm is this is true or are the NPCs truly random?"},{"id":2574366,"r":0,"n":0,"b":"so its [b]2018[/b] and this is still ridicules! \r\ni'm on my [b]6th [/b]trash clear and still missing [b]2[/b]"},{"id":2574580,"r":3,"n":0,"b":"Did it on first run, got 15 sticks, 12 NPC released out of 15 and got 1 pet so RNGesus helps us all!"},{"id":2576310,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"I ran this and reset it 3 times, giving me enough sticks to do all the frogs and achievement at one time. Warning: The treasure chests and other items the NPC's sometimes drop do not appear until they start to move out of the area, so wait or look around afterward."},{"id":2610746,"r":14,"n":0,"b":"I can confirm - got the achievement today\r\n\r\nRun the instance without killing any bosses to collect the Hex Sticks. \r\nReset and run again and again if needed untiil you have 12 Hex Sticks.\r\nMade the following macrco\r\n/target Forest Frog\r\n/use Amani Hex Stick\r\nGot all 12 - easy peasy"},{"id":2871434,"r":3,"n":0,"b":"Hunter can use \"Humanoid\" tracking ability to see all the \"Forest Frog\" on his mini-map."},{"id":3205971,"r":2,"n":0,"b":"I entered the dungeon, killed trash (without killing bosses), exit, reset, back again killing trash and after i cleared all trash i had around 13-14 [item=33865]. Went on the frog area near entrance and got all 12 NPC from the first try except Micah, who appeared twice, before the last npc. Hope this helps."},{"id":3229253,"r":3,"n":0,"b":"Tried this and now, make sure you have more than 12 Hex Sticks\r\n\r\nHad 12 exactly in my inventory and there were duplicates, so had to farm more than once."},{"id":3245945,"r":9,"n":0,"b":"This achievement hasn't changed in 2020 (or in SL pre-patch):\r\n\r\nBefore you go, check the AH.  Amani Hex Sticks were only 4 gold when I looked (AFTER I spent an hour farming them).  For 100 gold I could have saved myself the time.\r\n\r\n1) Kill trash (not bosses) for Amani Hex Sticks. They are tradeable green items that don't stack.\r\n2) Go to the middle of the map and find Forest Frogs.  There are plenty of them.\r\n3) Use hex sticks on frogs.  Each will either turn into people in the form of a vendor, a pet (check your inventory) or drop gold/ a buff you don't need.\r\n\r\nFew things to note:\r\n\r\n1) Don't forget you can use your mount to run around.  \r\n2) Virtually everything in the zone can drop a hex stick.\r\n3) You WILL likely get repeats when you use the stick.  It took me 18 hex sticks to spawn \"Rosa.\"\r\n4) If you farm all of the trash and don't get enough, zone out and reset.  It took me 3 resets.\r\n\r\nGodspeed."},{"id":3302264,"r":8,"n":1,"b":"The frogs are around the middle water area, 44,53.\r\n1. Press \"v\" to turn on nameplates.\r\n2. Type \"/tar for\" to target Forrest Frogs.\r\nDon't skip mobs because you'll need as many Amani Hex Sticks as you can get.  And if you don't want to come back, you may want to bring some extra from the AH, because I cleared the whole instance, and the ones I had weren't enough to get them all."},{"id":5372511,"r":4,"n":0,"b":"I got like 7-8 Mojo pets before Micah ever showed up and I don't seem to be alone in having that brat take forever to appear."},{"id":5760474,"r":8,"n":0,"b":"In 2024 If you are having trouble getting the NPC you need, you might benefit from what I learned:\r\n\r\nMost of the hex sticks drop on the very bottom of the map. Run past the first boss you encounter there without engaging and eventually you will end up in a little \"village\" of npcs. Clear them all the way up to the next boss. You should loot anywhere from 10 to 14 hex sticks. You can from there, risk it and use them all now for a chance at the ones you are missing... or you can exit and reset and do again for another 10+ and with your 20 hex sticks clear all the frogs on the map. \r\n\r\nHope that helps!"},{"id":6068798,"r":2,"n":0,"b":"It appears that the droprate has been dramatically reduced.  I've cleared all trash up to the bosses 8 times and only 2 Amani Hex Sticks have dropped.  I've resorted to buying them off the Auction House, but there's rarely any on there."},{"id":6099287,"r":-1,"n":0,"b":"[b]Hex Mix [/b]\r\n\r\nYour first run-through will not give you enough hex sticks to finish this.  My first priority to try was for the achievements, so I did not deal with trash mobs at all.  Who knows, maybe I would have had enough sticks, but my focus was 100% on rushing to get the mount.\r\n\r\nThen I did a run-through and used those hex sticks to get un-hex five of the kids, including several duplicates. As using the hex sticks does not guarantee a different kid (see spawn points below) from each stick, I had to do additional runs just to pick up more sticks.  Thinking ahead (for once) I did several runs collecting sticks.  First run snagged eight sticks, second run snagged five, and third run snagged another eight.  \r\n\r\nSeveral sticks were used up unexpectedly collecting Mojo, the Battle Pet, after I had purchased him from Eulinda.  Several no longer frog kids also dropped hex sticks in their reward drops for me.\r\n\r\nMade the little macro cheat sheet below in the hopes I could pass by the Frogs already un-hexed. You can see what happened.\r\nI used up all my hex sticks and left many, many frogs  still  hopping around.\r\n\r\nGood luck to all of you.\r\n\r\n\r\n/way 24.39 73.96 Melasong /way 37.21 50.57\r\n/way 50.22 49.64 Relissa /way 49.36 55.16  /way 48.68 51.72\r\n/way 37.00 73.46 Mawago /way 37.69 50.07\r\n/way 35.00 39.17 Lenzo /way 10.04 61.76\r\n/way 37.21 53.08 Harald /way 37.11 55.09\r\n/way 38.16 55.81 Micah /way 38.07 53.73 /way 48.88 49.86 /way 47.63 48.06\r\n     /way 48.88 46.27 /way 48.59 55.81 /way 38.07 51.72\r\n/way 49.06 37.37 Arinoth\r\n/way 49.26 54.45 Eulinda (Mojo) (Ivory Bone Bag) /way 50.12 53.66\r\n/way 48.49 50.51Tyllan /way 50.22 51.65\r\n/way 49.45 50.36 Melissa /way 38.26 51.36\r\n/way 49.07 50.50 Kaldrick\r\n/way 49.55 55.95 Mojo /way 49.26 56.60 /way 49.93 54.81\r\n/way 48.88 57.17 Rosa /way 50.22 52.30 /way 49.55 50.00"},{"id":6256078,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"In one run (took out the trash, no boss) got 16 sticks, decursed 11/12 NPCs.\r\nReset.\r\n10 sticks. 12/12\r\nNo Mojo, though."}]}{"id":5765,"comments":[{"id":1401026,"r":32,"n":0,"b":"The temple rats are critters you can find in the temple you enter. They are unique so you need four people in the group to pick up one each. Simply right click them to loot them and they should appear in your bag. \r\n\r\nWhat we did was to have 1 person using their rat per pack that we pulled (we pulled 4 panthers per go) and then the next person use his/her rat (you need to place the rat on the ground). Do this 4 times and simply kill the boss."},{"id":1401171,"r":50,"n":3,"b":"We just did this achievement and it seemed to be party wide (in the way that if a party member feeds a rat to a panther, it still counts towards your achievement).\n\nThings to know:\n- The [item=69724] is unique, so each player can only carry one. You obtain them by picking them up around the inside of the temple.\n- When using it, you must choose an area where you want the rat to spawn. I think the rat is attackable in the time between spawning and being eaten, so don't cleave or aoe.\n- The panther gains a frenzy buff shortly after eating it.\n\nTo get this achievement we just pulled 1 panther at a time, fed a rat to it and killed it after it had enraged. Repeat this until you have fed 4 panthers and then kill the boss as you normally would."},{"id":1402395,"r":47,"n":4,"b":"When you pick up a rat you can see it wriggling in your hand! Easy to check if people have their rodents!\r\nAlso worth noting that the achievement is reset if you only do a partial amount of rats so it is not cumulative like the deadmines achievement."},{"id":1423926,"r":24,"n":0,"b":"Note for trigger happy aoe dpsers:\r\nYou can not kill the rats after you have thrown them during the fight. The rats would go down to 1 hp but would still be alive and if there are any cats still active, would get eaten and gain you credit for the achievement.\r\nHave fun cleaving."},{"id":1814558,"r":28,"n":5,"b":"If you're not a Monk, you'll probably need another person to complete this, but most any combination of classes will do, as long as one of them can tank the boss and cats for a while.\n\nOne person stays outside the door, the other person pulls. We used a Warlock to stay outside (or in this case, port outside), and a Holy Paladin to tank the boss and be in charge of waking up the cats. The inside person wakes up one cat at a time and brings it to the door, positioning the cat so that it's outside the barrier, and is in line of sight of the outside person. The outside person throws a rat. Kill cat once it has eaten rat, get another rat, repeat another 3 times, finish boss."},{"id":1942933,"r":4,"n":3,"b":"Soloable - completed as hunter, probably soloable as any other pet class.\r\n\r\nSend the pet in and aggro the boss but keep it from dealing any further damage (you don't want to kill by mistake as this could take a while).\r\n At this point you're outside the boss room and the impassible wall appeared. have your pet aggro 4 panthers one by one (you can do it by looking inside the room through the door or you can move up the first set of stairs and see the health bars for all the panthers).\r\n\r\nWait, preferably with one rat in your bag and you positioned near 3 others. The panthers will do the job on your pet, or you can try calling your pet back (that actually works). Once the pet is dead or back by your side the boss and the 4 panthers will come out of the boss room (through the impassible wall). \r\n\r\nFrom here on follow the usual proceduce, feed panthers one by one, killing them as they enrage, kill the boss, get your achievement. \r\n\r\nNote: personally I think this is an exploit and should be avoided."},{"id":1948781,"r":3,"n":0,"b":"Soloed as an Enhance Shaman, 3/5/14. Put a magma totem in the center of a pack of cats. Went out of door and aggroed boss with unleash elements. Ran up to next level where 3 rats spawn. Boss follows and 4 cats will follow after they kill totem. Start feeding the cats, while watching health. Its a little tricky. Took 3 attempts but got it. Call of the elements talent helps with healing totems. Once up got all 4 cats, achievement should pop as long as you killed boss before. If you haven't killed boss before this. Obviously kill now. Be careful once you drop bosses health because the rest of the cats will come running."},{"id":1952958,"r":6,"n":0,"b":"Trying this achievement solely seems to have become impossible during the last few weeks. The boss - and the adds as well - despawns when she is pulled just a few meters out of the main room. \r\nEven if you use a class, that has a pet to taunt the boss and the adds, the boss is going to despawn when one of the adds is targeting you and jumping on you while you try to get a new rat.\r\n\r\nI had a very frustrating evening trying to get this achievement. Trying every tactic I could find. Despawns. Despawns! And more despawns!"},{"id":1964957,"r":44,"n":1,"b":"I just soloed this achievement as a Holy Paladin. Definitely possible to solo even with no pets, if you are (very) patient.\r\n\r\nHere's how I did it.\r\n\r\n1. Pick up a rat somewhere upstairs.\r\n2. Head down to the level the boss is on. Just outside the doorway where the barrier spawns, you should see a rat running around. Just leave it alone for now.\r\n3. Go in, pull the boss, and immediately use an aoe ability to get 4 cats (I used holy prism). Then run just barely outside the barrier before it spawns.\r\n4. Use your rat on top of the cats, and as soon as one eats it (and you see your achievement counter tick up) kill it.\r\n5. Facing towards the barrier, very slowly back up until you can grab the rat that is running around in the corner, that you noted earlier. You may have to wait for it to run closer to you; if you back up to far the boss will reset. I found I could get about to the far corner of the Diamond in the floor. If you move too fast, a cat will pounce on you, and the boss will reset.\r\n6. Now you have a rat again, run back up next to the barrier. Repeat step 4. You will then have to wait for the rat to spawn again (1 min maybe?) then repeat step 5, and continue until you get your achievement.\r\n\r\nImportant note: If at any point the boss creates a big purple wave in front of her, run up next to the barrier. If you don't you will get knocked back and likely reset the boss.\r\n\r\nIf you fail to get out of the room fast enough, you'll have to let her kill you. Otherwise failure involves her resetting, and you can try again as soon as you go upstairs and get another rat, and wait for the one in the corner to respawn.\r\n\r\nHaving some heals (or being a tank) is recommended, I was taking quite a bit of damage (you won't be attacking anything the whole time except to kill cats after they eat rats). The achievement does not require killing the boss, so don't worry about having the dps to kill her.\r\n\r\nWhole thing took me maybe 30-40 minutes including many failed attempts where I figured out my strat. Good luck."},{"id":1982947,"r":4,"n":0,"b":"FYI, there are four panthers patrolling outside the building.  I aggroed them and tried everything I could think of to get them to eat a rat, but they weren't going for it.  They are the same \"Pride of Bethekk\" cats that are inside the room but apparently the achieve only works for her *special* cats."},{"id":1982961,"r":1,"n":1,"b":"CHEESED IT!\n\nI'm going to make this nice and easy for you.  \n\nBefore you start, put your achievement on \"Track\" so you can get this thing done.\n\n(1) kill all the trash inside the building.\n(2) grab a rat and put it on your action bar for quick dropping.  Don't grab any of the three rats on the second floor above the boss though!\n\nYour goal and some tips:\n\n(a) you need to pull the boss up to the second floor, along with the four cats that are sleeping across the room in front of the door\n(b) you need to do this without being locked in the room by the barrier that pops up\n(c) the barrier pops after about 2 or 3 seconds AFTER you agro the boss\n(d) anybody who has a pet, put it on passive or dismiss it or the boss despawns.  if you have it on passive, for Spirit Bond perhaps, never ever never misdirect on your pet or the boss despawns.\n\n(3.a) if you are melee you need to lay down consecration/death and decay or something on those four sleeping cats.  they won't wake up until you agro the boss.  after you lay down something to agro the cats, agro the boss and run like hell through the door.  if you have no way to agro the cats like this, just hit the boss, then hit the four cats (they turn red and become active immediately after the fight starts), and then run like hell through the door.  if you don't make it in time, then you must reset the fight by dying.  simply agro all of the cats and they keel you quickly.\n(3.b) if you are ranged, you need to lay down something like a hunter trap in the middle of those four sleeping cats.  then, standing OUTSIDE the door, hit the boss\n\nAt this point the fight for everybody becomes the same.  \n\n(4) you are right by the door and the barrier pops up don't run away from that barrier until you DOT THE BOSS or she despawns.\n(5) ignoring the cats (they do little damage), you are basically slowly walking backwards and attacking the boss every few seconds, but then take your focus off of the boss so you don't passive damage her too much.  The reason you are slowly going backwards is her agro table is annoyingly quick to reset and she despawns: I repeat, you MUST attack her every few seconds for this to work.\n(6) you have pulled her and her four cats up the stairs.  now drop the rat you had on your action bar.  you can drop it near the cats and they will ignore it, so drop that sucker right in the middle of the floor where you know you are going to run, then forget the rat!  grab the second one under the stairs, drop it in the very same place (don't get fancy), and then pull the cats over that place.  trust me: they will eat the rat.  once a cat is fed, it gets large and red.  I call this \"fed and red\".  forget about that cat and run like hell over to the far wall, grab the 3rd rat and drop it towards the middle of the floor, grab the 4th rat and drop it in the same place. \n(7.a) all this time you are occasionally dotting the boss.  don't use anything that will kill those tender kitties, they die way too quickly from light damage.  once you have dropped all four rats, look: do you see any yellow bars that belong to the rats in the room?  No?  Do all four cats look huge angry and red?  Yes?  PWN THE KITTIES.\n(7.b) myself, I killed each cat one by one after it ate the rat, because they do more damage after they eat it.  I single-targeted this cat only after it become huge and red, which takes a couple seconds after it eats the rat (there is no mistaking the transition).  this way the fight was completely controlled and became increasingly easier.  just remember to dot the boss every now and then.\n(8) Now, look at your achievement tracker.  It will have ticked down the four cats that ate rats.  If the tracker says to kill the boss, then kill her quickly but if you do light dps then consider saving your burst-deeps for phase 2.  At this phase she turns into the cat-lady and summons all remaining cats from the room below.  If you are a boomer, then boom-pop everything right away and geterdone.  As soon as she becomes cat-lady, burst her down before those cats get to you because they do a lot of damage.  Don't try and range her from afar, get pretty much right in her FACE so she has no excuse to ignore you and despawn.\n\nBe patient: she might despawn a few times before you get it.  Remember, this is a bug you are exploiting - the boss isn't designed to pass through that barrier.  But if you do it right, trust me, you will solo the unsoloable achieve.  \n\nCHEERS!"},{"id":2003190,"r":4,"n":0,"b":"soloed it with my 90 hunter, after several tries... \r\nRequirements: Spirit Bond talent (so u get heals from pet)\r\n\r\nLoot 1 rat from the rooms before the boss, not the one just outside her room.\r\nSet ur pet to passive\r\nPress Move to and place it a bit outside of the entrance of the room\r\nMisdirect to your pet and pull boss and 4 adds and get out of the room. \r\nOnce they are just outside of the room throw 1 rat on them.\r\nKill the one who ate it.\r\nLoot the rat outside of the room\r\nThrow it to throw it to the cats.\r\nKill the one who ate it.\r\nWait for the rat to respawn and repeat the progress 2 more times\r\n\r\nWarnings:\r\nThe boss-adds may reset if the cats jump to you and you are far away from the entrance.\r\nThe boss uses a wave ability that throws u back. Be sure to evade it.\r\nIf some adds are in the room. Heal your pet to get aggro and make them come out."},{"id":2017198,"r":2,"n":0,"b":"This is a relatively 'easy' achievement to get on a Hunter (can't say I've tried with other classes).\nI say 'easy' cause just the very little things can make this a hassle.\nFirstly, put your pet on passive. Turn off any of your pets AoE abilities just in case. \nUse the Move To button to position your pet just outside the door.\nLay down an Ice Trap on top of one of the packs of Panthers.\nMisdirect the boss to your pet. \nDO NOT GET AGGRO FROM ANYTHING. If you get aggro from the panthers than they will pounce you when you go to pick up the next rat that is located just outside the door and them pouncing will reset the fight.\nIt's also very important to look out for her 'tidal wave' ability. Use the Move To button to position your pet away from it, because it will still knock your pet back even at level 90 and it will reset the fight.\n\nIt's also worth noting to not have your legendary cloak equipped and don't forget Chimera Shot is a cleave now!"},{"id":2018402,"r":224,"n":20,"b":"This is easiest way to solo if you can stand the damage for 5min.\r\n\r\nFirst bind Interact With Target to a key you like.\r\n\r\nThere are four rats so get one from upper floors. When you enter boss room turn right. Now you should be in corner next to brazier and temple rat is other side of the wall.\r\n\r\nPull boss and aggro 4 cats and use temple rat on the ground. You can kill the cat which ate it. Now you can get more rats every 1 minute by doing [i]/tar temple rat[/i] and spamming interact with target key. Don't forget that you might target upper floor rats if rat on your floor has not spawned yet."},{"id":2027162,"r":3,"n":1,"b":"so i looked through all the comments and did a ctrl f to search and i didnt see anything about my question...would [item=43004] work on the rats and get enough in the room to use?"},{"id":2049540,"r":4,"n":0,"b":"just soloed this as a lvl 100 feral druid. How to without despawning her :\r\n\r\nI picked up a rat before the last one before her room.  I then pulled her with faerie fire which does no dmg and then typhooned a group of the cats to pull them.  Once outside the room where the barrier will spawn I threw down the rat and killed the cat who got the buff.  Then while facing the barrier I back peddled until I was halfway from the barrier to the wall behind me and waited until the rat got close enough to loot.  Anytime she spoke I would walk to the barrier as to not be pushed back by her cast as this would despawn her if you are too far from the barrier.  You then have to back peddle again to the middle of the room to continue trying to collect the rat.  The only hard part is knowing how far away from the barrier you can get, and waiting for that darn rat to get close enough.  Imo I would just get a friend to loot them and throw them down, but if you are impatient like myself I hope this strat helps since this is how I soloed it. GL!"},{"id":2052979,"r":6,"n":2,"b":"Tried it today solo, the edging towards the rat to pick up wasn't working for me. Any time I went for the rat the boss would reset, oddly only if the cats were present.\r\n\r\nAs a Druid i was able to pull the boss, use Typhoon on 4 cats by the door and run back upstairs to where the 3 rats are (2 in the far side, 1 under the steps), the boss didn't reset and the achievement was very easy.\r\n\r\n1. Pickup a rat from upstairs\r\n2. Pull the boss and aggro the cats\r\n3. Run back upstairs to where the 2 rats near the wall are\r\n4. Throw your rat, pick up another and throw, pick up the third and throw.\r\n5. Run to the rat under the stairs, pick up and throw, the achievement will be awarded if the 4 cats devoured the rats."},{"id":2074873,"r":3,"n":0,"b":"I did this as a frost mage using elemental.\r\n\r\n[ol]\r\n[li]Pick up a rat on your way downstairs.[/li]\r\n[li]Position elemental to stand next to boss, make it attack to start fight.[/li]\r\n[li]As soon as boss is active, agro the 4 cats next to the door and run upstairs as fast as you can, hug the right side of the walls and stairs, until you get up there.[/li]\r\n[li]From this point, you should be alright to feed the cats and pick up the other 3 rats without resetting the boss.[/li]\r\n[/ol]\r\n\r\nThe mechanics involved with this is pretty fickle and it will probably take you a few times before you get upstairs without resetting. Good luck."},{"id":2084898,"r":4,"n":0,"b":"Pretty straight forward now at 100 following [url=http://www.wowhead.com/user=tyuiop]tyuiop[/url]'s suggested method. I was on a hunter, but I'd imagine any class could do it no problem because they do virtually no damage now.\r\n\t\t\r\n[quote]This is easiest way to solo if you can stand the damage for 5min.\r\n\r\nFirst bind Interact With Target to a key you like.\r\n\r\nThere are four rats so get one from upper floors. When you enter boss room turn right. Now you should be in corner next to brazier and temple rat is other side of the wall.\r\n\r\nPull boss and aggro 4 cats and use temple rat on the ground. You can kill the cat which ate it. Now you can get more rats every 1 minute by doing /tar temple rat and spamming interact with target key. Don't forget that you might target upper floor rats if rat on your floor has not spawned yet.[/quote]\r\n\r\nMy only issue was doing too much damage to pull the cats with just auto-attack, so I used my hunter's [url=http://www.wowhead.com/spell=13809/ice-trap]Ice Trap[/url], which woke them up easily without doing any damage. After that it was just a matter of waiting for the rats to appear and then spamming interact until it pathed close enough to the wall for me to pick up.\r\n\r\nOnce you've fed four the achievement pops immediately, and you can go ahead and kill the last cat and the boss."},{"id":2088646,"r":2,"n":3,"b":"I tried most of the tactics for soloing this one but none of them really worked, not easily at least. So I took the tactic of the user [url=http://www.wowhead.com/user=5minutesofgaming]5minutesofgaming[/url] and changed it a bit. Or at least further improved it since it wasn't fully clear on all points in my opinion.\r\n\r\nHere's how I did as a level 90 hunter in patch 6.0.3. This was by far the easiest strategy I could find. There is a video below the list that you can use to easily follow the text points together with.\r\n\r\n[ol]\r\n[li]Pick up one of the Temple Rats on the top-most floor (you are going to need the three on the middle floor).[/li]\r\n[li]Move JUST inside the boss room, put your Tenacity pet on Passive, disable all damage abilities and send it to the boss but make sure you use Move To immediately after it has established aggro on the boss to position them closely to the entrance but NOT outside of the impassable wall that will spawn in a few seconds.[/li]\r\n[li]While still standing JUST inside the boss room throw an Ice Trap to the panthers so as to pull them but not risking killing them.[/li]\r\n[li]Now quickly move RIGHT outside the boss room. The impassable wall is about to spawn. Position yourself immediately to the left wall of the entrance, hugging the wall.[/li]\r\n[li]Now throw down the rat you picked up, watch the Achievement counter and kill off the panther that ate it. [i]Move on to Number 6.[/i][/li]\r\n[li]Start running upstairs while keep on hugging the wall.[/li]\r\n[li]Up the stairs, make a 180 while hugging the stair fence and keep running into the room on the middle floor where there are three rats (one under the stair leading up to the top-most floor and two at the back of the room).[/li]\r\n[li]In this room it doesn't seem that you have to hug any walls so you can freely roam around without the risk of the fight resetting [i](I guess this is due to that room being right on top of the actual boss room)[/i]. Use the three rats in this room to finish the achievement then head back down exactly the same way you came up, by hugging the same walls.[/li]\r\n[li]Position yourself so you are out of line of sight of the boss as to take as minimal damage as possible. Now turn on all your pet damaging abilities again and let your pet take care of her.[/li]\r\n[li]At 50 or so percent she will call all the panthers in the room and they will most likely go for you. Here is the 'gambler' of this tactic. Be sure to kill them real quick so they don't have time to pounce you (which will probably reset the fight). Use Explosive Trap, Barrage or whatever to quickly get them down.[/li]\r\n[li]The boss will be getting lower now and depending on your pet it might kill her, otherwise she will vanish, and your pet will come outside the wall, but don't worry, she will turn up right at you and you can finish her off quickly.[/li]\r\n[li]Achievement done![/li]\r\n[/ol]\r\n\r\nVideo showing how I did it: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KZJE1jExwsA"},{"id":2093612,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"Tried to do this solo unsuccesfully for about 20 minutes, as she kept resetting every time I took her out of the barrier.\r\n\r\nAfer trying a couple different techniques, this is how me and a friend managed it together:\r\n\r\nI stayed outside the barrier while he aggroed both the priestess and all the cats, dragging them as close to the barrier as possible.\r\nI threw the rats as close to the barrier as I get could them, on my side of the barrier. Throwing them through the barrier just makes them disappear.\r\nIt's a bit hit or miss, probably took around 10-15 rats total, but it was easier than finding 2 more people to do such an old achievement :)"},{"id":2095362,"r":10,"n":2,"b":"Found an [b]EXTREMELY[/b] easy way to duo this achievement, no weird pulling required. \n\nSimply leave player 1 outside the boss room. Player 2 can then aggro the boss and stay inside no problem. \n\nPlayer 2 can use 1 rat he picked up before getting to the boss for an easy one. \n\n[b]Now here's the trick[/b]: Both players can stand close to the barrier, player 1 can then [b]TRADE[/b] rats to player 2. Weird, but it works! Nice thing about this one, too, is that player 1 can run as far back to get rats as needed, without worrying about resetting the boss. Player 2 just keeps throwing the rats at the panthers until you have all 4. Happy Achievement Grinding!"},{"id":2135804,"r":-2,"n":0,"b":"Seems blizz has \"fixed\" this so no one can do it solo (at lvl100).  Using any class with a pet is useless since you can't actually control your pet through the barrier and for pets with growl, all it does is kill the panthers instead of drawing agro, which is odd because growl is not a DPS ability, guess it is now.  I turned off all my pet's abilities and hit growl, it draws agro of the panther and as soon as it's in range, my pet swipes and one-shots it.  Guess I'll just have to wait longer to find someone to try this with."},{"id":2139374,"r":2,"n":1,"b":"This is soloable, but you must have a class with a pet. I used a method similar to 5minutesofgaming. As a hunter, I put my pet on passive and stationed it right under the boss so that it aggroed her. I then used my freezing trap on the four cats to aggro them and ran upstairs, and the boss did not reset. I used a rat that I had picked up earlier, then collected three more rats that were on the floor above the boss. After all four cats became red, I got the achievement, didn't even have to kill the boss."},{"id":2141709,"r":16,"n":6,"b":"6.1  I have just soloed this as a priest very easily with no pets or any fancy tricks or  anything. The boss did not despawn outside the room. Nor did I need a pet to pull the kitties.\r\n\r\nHere's what I did:\r\n\r\nPre-prepare one rat in your bag (not strictly necessary but makes the process faster)\r\n\r\nStand just outside the doorway to High Priestess Kildare's room. The exact  coordinates are 47.1 18.7\r\n\r\nPull the Priestess with whatever ability you choose.  She then will run outside of the room and be on the 'wrong' side of the green wall of impenetrability.  The fight then commences on the  outside of the barrier, with the Pride of Bethekk cats still inside sleeping at this stage.\r\n\r\nHead back up the stairs to where all of the rats are. \r\n\r\nAs the fight progresses and you DPS the priestess down \"gently\",  the Pride Kitties will come out of their room and run up the stairs to try and eat you alive. This is all cool at level 100 because they don't eat much. Feed them a rat and pick up another. Rinse. repeat."},{"id":2172742,"r":8,"n":4,"b":"Tried to respond to Kimpira's comment, but couldn't :(\r\n\r\nManaged to get this after a while - using the comments from Kimpira and Wynadorn (Thanks both!).\r\n\r\nI Aggro'd the boss, then went up the stairs but stood in just in front of the end of the 'fence' there (Favouring being slightly to the left of it looking down towards where the boss came from - hug the wall on the way up).\r\n\r\nGot her to 40% then the cats ran up (Mostly in single file - this seems to be important - if you stand at the bottom and try to walk them up, they spread out and one is too far away it seems (Or at least that was my experience) then everything de-spawns).  It's not a massive issue if this happens, just rinse & repeat \r\n\r\nOnce they're all up top, just walk round to the left where the 3 rats are and you're golden (Bring 1 with you as Kimpira noted)!"},{"id":2183570,"r":0,"n":0,"b":"Worked perfectly. I wonder how long it took you/and or the person who came up with this to actually figure this out. XD\r\n\r\nAnd yes I just stood by the entrance, targeted the rat, and then ran to the side of the wall to interact with target, instead of using /tar just to be sure that it was targeting the right one every time."},{"id":2189899,"r":8,"n":2,"b":"As a level 100 Balance Druid, it took me 5 tries because by some odd reason, the rats have a \"grabbing\" cooldown and if you collect them too fast when one panther is eating, the rat will not get into your inventory and disappear and they are very few, and took me a while to understand where to fight the boss and the timing to avoid resets. Fortunately the rats respawn after a while so you can try again and again if you miss one. Here is what I did:\n\n[ol]\n[li]Grab the rat that is at the corner just before the entrance that seals itself when the fight starts.[/li]\n[li]Use [spell=2908 domain=www] on the boss and lure her upstairs.[/li]\n[li]Hug the fence and start to wear down her HP by using [spell=173571 domain=www] on her, or just hit her with the staff. If she bumps you away with her abilities, reposition again against the fence of those stairs and get her below 50%[/li]\n[li]She will transform and summon her cats. Wait for the cats to go upstairs in a single file, and when they start to maul you and spread around you, run towards the room where the 3 remaining rats are waiting. This part of the floor is just above the boss room so unless you stray yourself one floor above or one floor below, the boss will not reset.[/li]\n[li]Toss the rat you had in your inventory before the battle, wait for it to be eaten. Go the next rat and pick it up before the cats and the boss surround you or you will have a hard time clicking the rat.[/li]\n[li]After 3 more times, just nuke the boss with your [spell=78674 domain=www]/ and you are peach :)[/li]\n[/ol]\n\nIf by accident the rat disappears, just run downstairs towards the boss' entrance and the fight will reset. Wait a few minutes and the rat from the corner and the 3 rats from the floor above will respawn. Wish you luck for the [item=68824 domain=www] she drops at 1% of chance."},{"id":2245208,"r":2,"n":0,"b":"Hey, the tactic where you just interact with the rat through the wall (inside the boss room) worked fine for me, just wanted to point out that a targeting macro is not needed, and you might end up spam targeting the wrong rat, just look at the rat through the boss door when it's spawned and click it, then the interact button through the wall, easy preasy :)"},{"id":2283796,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"Had to add this as a new comment due to the \"outdated\" marker.\r\n\r\nUsed Kimpira's method (from older comment) and it worked very well, so this is still soloable with some manipulation.\r\n\r\ni564, fresh 100 rogue. Shuriken to get her out of the room (giving myself a nice headstart), used Burst of Speed to drag her up into the room above her regular room, and to minimize the time she's in areas where she might reset. I used leeching poison to help survive the cat damage and popped Evasion to help mitigate a bit.  Kept her largely in the center of the room and ran back and forth to get the remaining three rats."},{"id":2291845,"r":2,"n":0,"b":"I'm not sure if the solo stuff still works but I tried the suggested methods for doing this alone and found it to be an irritating experience because it seemed to me like she reset easily. I couldn't get her up the stairs let alone get back and forth to rats without her resetting. If it's still working for others then it's probably my own impatience. \r\n\r\nI ended up getting a friend to go aggro her and hold on to her and the cats. I went back and forth grabbing the rats. We were able to trade them, even when I was upstairs, and he was able to feed the rats to the cats. It counted even while I was still upstairs. I had to make sure I didn't walk into the areas where she had reset when I was trying to do it myself on my way to go get the rats. The tempting rat right next to the door to the entrance was one of the most notable places where she did. \r\n\r\nGood luck!"},{"id":2292008,"r":7,"n":0,"b":"If you came here for the Dungeon name , it is [zone=1977]\n\nCareful when you do it with shadow priest. I managed to kill [npc=52059] 2 times in a row after trying to kill off the fed cat with [spell=154477]."},{"id":2303136,"r":3,"n":0,"b":"Did this with one of my friends using the \"grab the rat trough the wall\"-technique. It worked fine, just needed a bit of patience. Feeding the cats one by one and then killing them off. Since we were 2 people, we only needed to grab to rats trough the wall. \r\n\r\nWIth another friend I used another approach. He ran in and engaged the boss and I stood outside the room. When he had used his rat I traded mine trough the doorway to him. Then I just ran and got new rats to trade him until he got all four. \r\nVery smooth and faster than the other approach. But I don´t know if it would count for me aswell, since I already had the achievement."},{"id":2304971,"r":20,"n":2,"b":"A quick guide in how to Solo this achievement can be found at:\r\n\r\n[url=https://youtu.be/Zk32rsj0-ZY]LilyBase.net - Solo: 'Here, Kitty Kitty...' Achievement [Zul'Gurub][/url]\r\n\r\nGood luck! =D"},{"id":2310965,"r":19,"n":4,"b":"Easy as 680+ ilvl 100 destro warlock with Grimoire of Sacrifice for auto self-heal.\r\n\r\nGrab a rat (I put the rat on the action bar so I could drop it with a keybinding).\r\n\r\nAggro boss from boss room door, run out and up stairs (stay close to wall closest to boss) and hang at floor at top of stairs above the boss room, wait for boss to join you - this is the trick to not cause the boss to reset as you're above the spawn room and still in the non-reset area (some of the other posts were unclear on where exactly to position).\r\n\r\nI melee'd with my staff to get boss to 50% (with full gear, it's too easy to one shot the boss, but warlock melee dps in feeble enough :)\r\n\r\nAll the cats will now run up and join the fight... wait for them to come up.\r\n\r\nDrop a rat (achievement tracking will show if you successfully fed one).\r\n\r\nRun through door on that level (one up from boss room) to the next set of stairs... there's another rat under the stairs.  Grab it and drop it (2nd cat fed).\r\n\r\nRun to other end of the room - 2 more rats there.  Repeat... if you mess up, there's one more rat up the next level.\r\n\r\nThe self heal from Grimoire of Sacrifice kept me at near full health... took about 90 secs total - much faster than the \"wait for rats to respawn\" technique.\r\n\r\nA tank class can probably do this easily too (or anyone with damage mitigation at least).... trick is to wear full gear (for health/armor) but not one shot the boss (no weapon equipped for example)."},{"id":2456958,"r":8,"n":0,"b":"So, here is my version of a guide for this achievement:\r\n\r\n[b]Overview:[/b]\r\nIt's pretty simple. You don't have to damage or kill the boss to get this achievement, nor do you have to damage or kill any of the adds. It takes about 5 minutes to get this achievement.\r\n\r\n[b]Step 1:[/b]\r\nEnter the Zul'Gurub dungeon (Cataclysm dungeon, Heroic mode), and go to the Temple of Bethekk. On the top floor, pick up a [url=http://www.wowhead.com/item=69724/temple-rat]Temple Rat[/url] from the Temple Rats that walk around. You can only pick up one at a time, so don't bother about the rest of the Temple Rats.\r\n\r\n[b]Step 2:[/b]\r\nGo to the boss [url=http://www.wowhead.com/npc=52059/high-priestess-kilnara]High Priestess Kilnara[/url] on the bottom floor and aggro her.\r\n\r\n[b]Step 3:[/b]\r\nGo to the most north-west corner of the room (look at [url=http://i.imgur.com/Sg9MCvN.jpg]this screenshot[/url]) and target the Temple Rat behind the wall.\r\n\r\n[b]Step 4:[/b]\r\nSpam the [i]Interact With Target[/i] button untill the Rat is close enough to pick it up. (You can set the key binding by going to menu > key bindings > targeting).\r\n\r\n[b]Step 5:[/b]\r\nOnce you have the Rat, aggro a [url=http://www.wowhead.com/npc=52061/pride-of-bethekk]Pride of Bethekk[/url], and use the Temple Rat item and place it on the ground. The Pride of Bethekk will eat it and recieve a buff. You can kill it after he (or she) ate the Rat, or keep it alive. Repeat step 3 to 5, untill 4 of the Pride of Bethekks ate a Temple Rat. You will recieve the achievement right after the fourth Pride of Bethekk ate the Rat."},{"id":2457063,"r":61,"n":6,"b":"This is a clarification of the process presented by tyuiop.  That process worked well, but I found it a little confusing.  This specifically applies to level 110 characters soloing this achievement (or any level that can survive indefinitely for this fight).\n\n[ol]\n[li]Bind a key to \"Interact with Target\" (Found in the \"Targeting\" section most of the way toward the bottom.  I used the comma key.)[/li]\n[li]Track the achievement [achievement=5765][/li]\n[li]On the way down to the boss, grab a [item=69724] from anywhere upstairs from the boss, not the one right next to the boss room.  (They don't stack, I'm not sure why they show that they stack to 20 on the item page, don't bother collecting more than one.)[/li]\n[li]Pull the boss without doing damage.  (Walk into her for example.)[/li]\n[li]Damage the boss [b]VERY CAREFULLY[/b] using whatever wimpy attack you have.  (Remove armor if you have to so you don't kill her.)[/li]\n[li]Your goal is for her to wake up all her cats.  (I found I couldn't pull the cats without them dying, so I needed the boss to do it for me.  You can skip this if you can pull the cats yourself.) [/li]\n[li]Now, with all the cats active, use your [item=69724] from upstairs.  (You should now have 1/4 fed.)[/li]\n[li]Walk over to the green barrier and click the [item=69724] (or wait for it to spawn in 30-60 seconds, and then click it).[/li]\n[li]Walk around the wall to the left of the green barrier toward the corner where the brazier is.[/li]\n[li]Spam your bound \"Interact with Target\" key until it says \"You receive item: [item=69724]\"[/li]\n[li]Feed the cats again by using your [item=69724].  (Repeat steps 8 through 11 until your achievement tracker shows 4/4 fed.)[/li]\n[/ol]\n\nIf all goes well you never needed to /target anything and you should now be able to kill the boss and get the achievement."},{"id":2590224,"r":44,"n":8,"b":"Patch 8.0\r\n\r\nI did this solo as 110 warrior. I didn't need to do any damage to the boss to get the achievement. Make sure to set [i]Interact with Target[/i] button. (Game menu > Key Bindings > Targeting > Interact With Target (Set key binding), and also track the achievement [achievement=5765]\r\n\r\n\r\n1. Go to [zone=1977] on Heroic mode and enter. \r\n2. Run across the bridge to the Temple of Bethekk, go up the stairs, go inside and clear trash down to the bottom floor. \r\n3. Pick up [item=69724] on your way down (you can only carry one at a time).\r\n4. Agro boss, you will be sealed in the room.\r\n5. Go to any of the pens and Taunt a Pride of Bethekk (OR get agro without killing it). \r\n6. Use the [item=69724] on it. Wait a few secs for it to get a buff, then kill it. \r\n7. Run to the door and target [item=69724]. (These respawn after about 2 mins).\r\n8. Run next to the wall close to where you saw and targeted the [item=69724] and Spam the [i]Interact with Target[/i] button. \r\n9. The [item=69724] will appear in your bag. \r\n10. Repeat from step 5 until you have fed and killed four Pride of Bethekk, then you will have the achievement."},{"id":2855289,"r":19,"n":2,"b":"Today I solo'd it using one of the comments on there, but instead of going to the portal and spamming a key (the mouse never came close enough to the door to grab), I went on the other side of the wall where the rat was and was able to pick it up THROUGH the wall. Been trying this cheevo for years, and figuring out this method turned a pain the butt into cake."},{"id":3191006,"r":7,"n":1,"b":"Tried doing this as a pretty geared 120 rogue. Hope this helps!"},{"id":3192049,"r":11,"n":1,"b":"I did this today on my Demonhunter, which made the achievement kinda trivial, without waiting for new rats to spawn. Here is how to do it as DH:\n\n1. As others suggested before, bind the action \"Interact with Target\" to a key.\n2. Create yourself a macro which just targets the rats, so as simple as \"/target Temple Rat\" as command, thats it.\n3. Take one rat with you on the way down into the boss room, just because .. why not? they are everywhere ^^\n4. Trigger boss by running into her or taunt her.\n5. Taunt a cat, throw the rat at the cat and wait until she eats and grows big, kill the cat. now the easy part:\n6. hit your target macro and you will see, that you can target rats through the cealing, that are wandering the floor above the boss room.\n7. double jump right unter the rats and then at the highest point midair press your \"interact with target\" bind. u can grab them through the ceiling, lol. ^^\n8. repeat step 5-7 until you got 4 kitties grown up and killed. \n9. enjoy the achievement without having to wait for new rats to spawn\n\nAs others also suggested before, and i cant stress how important this is: TAKE OFF all your gear, especially Azerite Armor and Corrupted Items, since they can trigger effects on getting hit and oneshot the boss. we dont want that to happen, do we?"},{"id":3308294,"r":2,"n":0,"b":"For hunters, Tar Trap will aggro the cats"},{"id":5203021,"r":3,"n":0,"b":"If you don't have a non-damaging spell to easily pull the cats, [item=46725] works well"},{"id":5331584,"r":19,"n":7,"b":"Whenever I throw the rat at the add he wont eat it. Any suggestions what I am doing wrong?\n\nEDIT 03-06-2022: it is fixed :)"},{"id":5380485,"r":7,"n":2,"b":"As per 9,2,5 this achievement is now working again. This was previously bugged in 9.2 where the cats would not interact with the rats."},{"id":5449060,"r":0,"n":1,"b":"[b]This achievement appears to no longer be bugged![/b] :)\r\n[i]- After years of needing this achievement, finally it's over[/i].\r\n\r\nUnfortunately, this achievement requires 4-5 people to complete as you can only hold 1x rat at a time and you need 4x for the achievement. The Tempest Rats are found in the room above the boss' room, there's a few sets of Bethekk Pride (cats) in this room, these are NOT the cats you feed for the achievement.\r\nThe cats you feed for the achievement are in Priestess Kilnara's room, they are all sleeping in groups of 4 around the room. You will need to /taunt each cat 1 by 1 and feed it 1x rat for this achievement, totaling 4x rats to 4x cats.\r\n\r\nA few notes we found when testing the boss: \r\n- If you throw the rats at a cat that is still sleeping (not engaged by /taunt) the rat will run around and then disappear. \r\n- If you need to reset this boss, it's not easily resettable. Most instances will reset the boss after being offline for 5-10 minutes. We had alt+f4 and remained offline for 5 mins and then 10 mins, the boss was still active when we came back both times. We were lvl 45-60, resetting the boss might be easier with lower level characters as it's easier to die and reset the boss."},{"id":5464695,"r":10,"n":5,"b":"I used a similar strategy as Marwenpala as a hunter, although this method will work for all classes as long as you can aggro the cats in some way.\r\n\r\n1. Create yourself a macro which just targets the rats, so as simple as \"/target Temple Rat\" as command, thats it.\r\n3. Take one rat with you on the way down into the boss room\r\n4. Trigger boss by running into her\r\n5. Scare beast a cat which will aggro it, throw the rat at the cat and wait until she eats and grows big,you don't have to kill the cat but feel free if you want.\r\n6. Leave one character outside of the boss room, and start the boss fight as usual on the character you want to get the achievement on.\r\n\r\n2) Wait for the wall to go up at the entrance, then move the combat character to the wall.\r\n\r\n3) Use your non-combat character to go collect a rat, then go back to the boss' room entrance.\r\n\r\n4) Trade the rat to your combat toon.\r\n\r\n5) Use the rat on an aggro'ed cat as usual\r\n\r\n6) Rinse steps 3-5 until the achievement pops."},{"id":6236145,"r":6,"n":0,"b":"TWW 12/1/25 - Quite easier than you'd think...\r\n\r\n1. Pick up a rat by right clicking and looting it from the floor above you. You can only hold one rat at a time. Pull the boss with a non-damage ability (taunt, etc). Pull a kitty and right click the rat in your bag to feed the kitty. 1/4 down. Can kill the kitty you fed.\r\n\r\n2. Create a macro - /tar Temple Rat.\r\n\r\n3. Enable Interact key in options and keybind interact with target key to whatever key you want. Go to the wall and wait for that rat to get close and have it targeted and spam the interact keybind you just made. Aggro 2/4 kitty and feed it.\r\n\r\n4. Repeat it two more times and boom, achievement done. The rat takes a minute to respawn so another ~2 minutes and gg. GLHF :)"}]}{"id":5858,"comments":[{"id":1418572,"r":66,"n":0,"b":"Surely im-paws-ible!"},{"id":1418792,"r":56,"n":0,"b":"Earning this one could get grizzly..."},{"id":1418890,"r":89,"n":5,"b":"Let's not start making bad puns.\r\n\r\n[small]They're un[i]bear[/i]able[/small]"},{"id":1427408,"r":26,"n":0,"b":"[u]Recommendation:[/u] Continue moving forward after each boss. [b]Ignore releasing the prisoners until after you have made the timer in order to minimize the amount of time wasted.[/b] Certain mobs can be avoided / skipped, but be sure to communicate ahead of time which route you are taking so that group members do not lose their [i]BEAR-ings.[/i]"},{"id":1429764,"r":77,"n":2,"b":"[quote]Save all four prisoners before they are sacrified in Zul'Aman [b]on Heroic Difficulty[/b]. [/quote] \r\n\r\nGlad they tagged that on, because I was thinking of attempting it on Normal."},{"id":1482289,"r":35,"n":1,"b":"Showed up for a random ZA, and as I was buffing before starting, the tank announced that we were making a \"bear run\".  The instructions were \"Stay close to me, don't aggro other mobs, don't loot anythng until the end.\"  Believe it or not...it worked.\r\n\r\nTank ran the shortest path to each boss, marked what needed to be killed first or cc'd, and we sliced and diced.  There were several occasions where the tank had to keep moving with mobs in tow, and we hacked at them en route to the next boss.  No one died, there was little typed in Party Chat...everyone just knew what do do and did it.  Pretty amazing I think, for a PUG."},{"id":1932226,"r":-3,"n":0,"b":"Just two manned this with a 540 BM hunter, and myself, a 529 frost mage with ease. We killed the final boss with 11 minutes to spare before we realized we forgot Halazzi. We ran past all the trash and killed the boss with 8 minutes to spare."},{"id":1955147,"r":34,"n":3,"b":"Soloed [achievement=5858], and got the [item=69747] today.\r\n\r\nOthers have talked about the specific fights, routes through the instance, and tactics, but I haven’t seen much on whether the achievement is soloable at level 90.  For shamans anyway it is.  \r\n\r\nMy main is an Alliance elemental shaman, ilevel 544.  Before the gate opened, I used [item=49633] to get [spell=69378], and also [item=76085].  Took a handful of [item=76093] along for use immediately before fights.  Prepot before each boss fight, and maybe for some of the trash fights also if the mobs are too numerous.\r\n\r\nThere is nothing really remarkable about the fights themselves, except for [npc=23576], although a few details are helpful for a solo attempt.\r\n\r\nFirst, I killed [npc=23574], the eagle boss.  Ignore the brown eagles.  Burn him down.  Killing this boss adds 5 minutes to the timer.\r\n\r\nSecond, killed [npc=23576], the bear boss.  This is the boss who gave me the biggest headache.  You need to kill the mobs on the way to him, or else he won’t spawn at the top of the platform and become killable.  Others have covered his brutal mechanics in detail.  This is how I killed him solo.  I cast [spell=2894],[spell=32182], popped a potion, [spell=108281], [spell=8050], [spell=77451], [spell=114049], and [spell=108280], in that order.  Then spammed lava burst and burned him down.  Didn’t need [spell=30823] for damage mitigation, or [spell=59547] for extra healing, although they would certainly have been beneficial.  [spell=30884] kicked in during his first [spell=42402], but he died shortly thereafter.  Final DPS was about 240k.  Killing this boss adds an additional 5 minutes to the timer.\r\n\r\nThird, was [npc=23578], the dragonhawk boss.  I ignored most of the tactics for this fight and just burned the boss down.  Once he dies, all of the dragonhawk hatchlings despawn as well.\r\n\r\nLastly was [npc=23577], the lynx boss.  I got to him with around 6 minutes remaining, but both heroism and my fire elemental needed about a minute before the cd reset.  I drank to replenish mana, then started the fight using heroism and the fire elemental totem.  The key is to keep kiting him around the room and away from his healing totems.  Once, I foolishly kited him back into his own healing totem.  He instantly jumped from almost dead to full health.  Yeah, I’m a noob.  After 60 seconds, I managed to finally kill him, got the achievement and began to collect the prisoners.\r\n\r\nFor the run as a whole:  \r\n\t- Leave the prisoners till after all 4 of the bosses are dead, and you have the achievement.  Then go back, release the prisoners and collect the loot from their trunks.\r\n\t- The mount is in [object=186672], which drops from Halazzi’s prisoner.  The bag is in a corner of the room, and is not immediately obvious.  You have to loot the bag.  I thought maybe the mount would come in the mail, or become automatically known.  Not so.  Loot the bag.\r\n\t- Don’t forget to turn in [quest=29217] before hearthing.  Otherwise, like me, you’ll have to go back to Ghostlands to turn it in."},{"id":2044665,"r":2,"n":0,"b":"Did this on 11/22/14 and got the bear from Kasha's Bag."},{"id":2100280,"r":-5,"n":1,"b":"For anyone new to Zul'Aman or having trouble getting your mount, here is a simple and short guide to the whole process.\r\n\r\n[b]Simple WoW Guide - Bear-ly Made It and the Amani Battle Bear Solo[/b] \r\nhttps://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_0R0OxIWVOc"},{"id":6234340,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"TWW 11/27/25 - You have plenty of time to kill all four bosses before the sacrifice timer runs out. Before he going down the portal the achievement popped."},{"id":2304953,"r":-9,"n":0,"b":"A quick guide in how to Solo this achievement can be found at:\r\n\r\n[url=https://youtu.be/zalg_H2xwas]LilyBase.net - That's Not Canon! Achievement (solo)[/url]\r\n\r\nGood luck! =D"},{"id":2573219,"r":7,"n":3,"b":"If you get this achievement while on [quest=30104], you will not be able to complete the quest.  If Mannaroth sacrifices Varo'then to heal himself, he gets credit for the kill, not you.  You'll have to wait to archive Varo'then till the next day (dungeon only has heroic mode)."},{"id":5244178,"r":11,"n":0,"b":"[url=https://www.wowhead.com/item=97919/whole-body-shrinka]Whole-Body Shrinka'[/url]\r\n\r\nI had to use that.  Sometimes [url=https://www.wowhead.com/item=137663/soft-foam-sword]Soft Foam Sword[/url] isn't the option.  It doesn't always work in instances, but Whole Body Shrinka' seems to work everywhere."},{"id":5313956,"r":0,"n":0,"b":"No longer bugged.  You don't need to use any toys, all you have to do is get naked, punch him till he's 90%(took me 4 punches), wait for him to sacrifice Varo'then, then kill him."},{"id":5586513,"r":49,"n":7,"b":"If you are in Dragonflight and level 70 then just bypass Varo'then and hit Mannoroth. I one shot Mannorot but still got the achievement. You won't finish the dungeon quest though as Varo'then remains undefeated."}]}{"id":6127,"comments":[{"id":1583543,"r":97,"n":4,"b":"We tried this several times.  The best way we found was to have one person with a mark over their head.  Everyone follow that person, and just rotate around the room.  We made a full circle, and completed the achievement that way.  Stay near the fire wall.\n\nYou only have to endure the eye dodging phase one time.  Also, you can wipe and come back in if someone in the party fails at dodging the eyes."},{"id":1585235,"r":171,"n":6,"b":"Got this today after trying out a couple of different strategies. Spreading out and stacking up can both work, but they get hairy after about 30 seconds or so when the eyes start getting really close to people.\r\n\r\nThis is going to sound silly, but we had the easiest time by simply sacrificing 2 of our DPS at around 80% HP on the boss and we left up our tank, healer, and 1 DPS for the eye phase. The 3 of the remaining people split into a triangle formation on the edges of the room and simply dodged eyes in their own area, moving as needed, and we one shot it like this with no problems at all. We happened to have two druids, so we brez'd the dead DPS after the phase was over and cleaned him up, though I wouldn't be surprised if 3 people could finish him off just as well.\r\n\r\nGood luck!"},{"id":1599900,"r":163,"n":0,"b":"The [item=6797] might come in handy while doing this achievement.\nDon't forget to get your upgrade in Warlords of Draenor: [item=118024]."},{"id":1931574,"r":6,"n":1,"b":"Easy to solo as a 'drop agro class' like a Hunter. Just burned his HP as fast as I could, then when the eye phase started i ran till the fire wall, dismissed pet, and feigned death, there are some spawned eyes that won't go for you and just stand there in the middle (these are the real ones that would follow you). The others, 4-5 i think, just roam around and may never get to you, one did eve 'touch' me while feigned and didn't screwed the achievement. Patch 5.4.2"},{"id":1935212,"r":6,"n":1,"b":"Just did this at 90 on my fury warrior, really easy, just poped Bloodbath/dragons roar at the start, when eye phase came up at 50% i ran to the fire wall and walked in a circle around the entire room, by the time i was at my starting point again the phase was over, the last 5-10 seconds or so i had to dodge an eye or two but it wasnt hard at all, then he pops back up and I just poped CD's again and burned him."},{"id":1967847,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"I thought I might share this for any groups out there having trouble.\r\n\r\nIf your capable of taking this guy down solo (any level 90) but your having trouble with people in your 'achievement' group being seen, simply have one member who feels confident they can avoid the eyes do it while the rest of the group get themselves locked out of the fight... not the instance obviously.\r\n\r\nI was in a two person group, we were having some issues so we thought we would give it a try and as I'm sure you would have worked out by now, we both got the achievement. The last one on the list for both of us.\r\n\r\nI hope this helps any 'groups' out there having trouble with it.  Solo is a breeze."},{"id":2017687,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"With ok gear you can just kill him before he goes into his second (roaming eye) phase. You still get the achievement and don't have to dodge eyes."},{"id":2017689,"r":6,"n":1,"b":"Very easy achievement for a pally in current gear. He will still shield if you burn quickly, forcing the eye phase.\r\n\r\nPallys can use Divine Shield to drop the stun, and continue to finish him off before he disappears."},{"id":2027058,"r":2,"n":0,"b":"If you happen to be farming achievements and you can't seem to get enough DPS to kill Peroth'arn in time, I suggest you just keep walking along the edge during the Eye phase, waiting for it to end. That's what worked for me on my Death Knight."},{"id":2072139,"r":1,"n":1,"b":"You do not actually need to go through an eye phase in order to get this achievement. However, he will go to the eye phase and dispel all debuffs on himself almost immediately upon reaching 60%. You have just enough time for a single on-GCD and a single off-GCD ability to take him from 100% to dead."},{"id":2126550,"r":-1,"n":0,"b":"As MM hunter in 652 ilvl gear I used one [spell=60954], immediately followed by one [spell=5116] to make sure his dead and got the achievement without going into the eyes phase."},{"id":2132903,"r":16,"n":1,"b":"At level 100, the cheev is trivialized completely. Hit him with a DoT and he'll pretty much die on his own. If you need to dodge the eyes at all, it won't be for very long."},{"id":2349209,"r":9,"n":2,"b":"As a level 100 with 720ilvl you can 1 shot the boss and get the achievement :)."},{"id":2624006,"r":2,"n":0,"b":"Before the boss fight, you have to shut down 3 portals. It might say that the portal is locked after you've done this (that would be the reason why you are looking for this comment).\r\n\r\n-Run out of the instance.\r\n-Reset all instances (Top left of your screen, click on your portrait, there it says reset all instances).\r\n-Go back inside.\r\n\r\n-Make Illidan follow you, run up to the npc's guarding the portal.\r\n-Let them attack you first, so that Illidan gets in combat.\r\n-Kill the NPC's while Illidan is in combat.\r\n-Close the portal.\r\n-Repeat the previous 4 steps 2 more times."}]}{"id":6130,"comments":[{"id":1542090,"r":69,"n":0,"b":"Bonus points if you use [item=52253] during this."},{"id":1585662,"r":47,"n":0,"b":"Hint: rather than try and mark a specific pair of ghouls (which costs dps time), put a ground marker in advance with instructions that players kill the nearest two ghouls to it."},{"id":1585771,"r":42,"n":0,"b":"As Vaugn said use a ground marker to pick which ghouls, I placed 2, and since I was doing a fair bit more dps than my friend and the pug dps, I went on one and those 2 and the tank on the other, burned mine down and got a kill shot on the other. \r\n\r\nTo clarify if anyone else was unsure, you only have to kill 2 ghouls on one phase, I'm not sure if you always get 2 ghoul phases, that may depend on your dps if they're timed or it might be a % health trigger, we burned down 2 on 1st phase then only got 1 on the second and got the achievement. \r\n\r\nIt's not a major dps check, we had a tank in 359's and blues, rogue in around 370, spriest slightly better and myself at 381. Bloodlust of course helps!"},{"id":1603414,"r":58,"n":0,"b":"Earning the Achievement:\r\n\r\nAlthough it's not clear from the wording on the achievement, [i]you must kill two ghouls in a [b]single[/b] Highborne phase to earn this achievement[/i]. Simply killing one ghoul in each Highborne phase - two total - in insufficient.\r\n\r\nYou can kill two ghouls in [b]any[/b] single Highborne phase, though, and earn the achievement. And it only has to be done in [b]one[/b] of the Highborne phases, [b]not[/b] each phase. If you kill two ghouls in one phase and only one ghoul in another phase, you'll still earn the achievement when the boss dies.\r\n\r\nBest practice is to mark an area on the ground, and plan to kill the two nearest ghouls that spawn to that point, unless you're very fast with putting up raid markers (a raid marker on the group may help, especially since some group members may get turned around and disoriented when she pulls the group in). The boss doesn't hit hard, so some groups may even use a hybrid to tank (e.g., a dps kitty in bear form) to have extra dps to burn the two ghouls for the achievement. A reasonably well geared group can do it with the standard 1 tank, 1 healer, and 3 dps. Save personal and group dps cooldowns for the ghoul phase."},{"id":2077802,"r":47,"n":0,"b":"Very straightforward at level 100, just a matter of pulling Sylvanas and then not DPSing until she finally summons the Risen Ghouls. Kill two or more, then defeat her, and your achievement will pop."},{"id":2098614,"r":46,"n":0,"b":"As a quick reference:\r\n\r\nAzure = Echo of Jaina\r\nObsidian = Echo of Baine\r\nEmerald = Echo of Tyrande for [achievement=5995]\r\nRuby = Echo of Sylvanas  for [achievement=6130]"},{"id":2136317,"r":-5,"n":0,"b":"This video show how to Severed Ties (Solo).\r\n\r\nhttps://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CvF-OGBJFGc"},{"id":2192491,"r":14,"n":1,"b":"This is super easy at lvl 100.  I just started the encounter and then waited for her to spawn the ghouls and killed all of them (only need to kill 2, but I wanted to be thorough). Then finish her off and cha-ching!"},{"id":2270415,"r":0,"n":0,"b":"[url=https://youtu.be/7l1eWaUrExM]Video[/url] of this achievement"},{"id":5394060,"r":15,"n":2,"b":"If you fall against Baine as first boss (Obsidian Dragonshrine), get out of the dungeon, reset and get in until the first encouter is against Sylvanas (Ruby Dragonshrine)."},{"id":5617966,"r":4,"n":0,"b":"If you're doing this on a hunter and cannot pull the boss without killing her, use the following macro:\r\n\r\n/cast Tranquilizing Shot\r\n/stopattack\r\n\r\nThis will pull the boss and stop you attacking her. Just stand there and do nothing nothing until the ring of risen ghouls forms.  Kill two of those and then kill the boss. Done"},{"id":6023098,"r":7,"n":0,"b":"Can confirm that in TWW this is still super easy. Just pull the boss(or just walk into her) without attacking, wait for around a minute until she spawns the ring of ghouls, kill 2+ of them and then oneshot her once she gets back down."},{"id":6032511,"r":9,"n":0,"b":"Extremely easy indeed. Wait for two ghouls to spawn, kill them, then kill Sylvanas."},{"id":6235994,"r":7,"n":0,"b":"TWW 12/1/25 - Still easy as pie. Aggro the boss, let her spawn ghouls, kill them, kill her. Profit :-)"}]}{"id":6132,"comments":[{"id":1584948,"r":37,"n":0,"b":"Very easy achievement, perhaps the easiest of the new 5, imo.\r\n\r\nOnce Benedictus enters his Twilight phase, about halfway through the fight, Twilight Sparks will spawn around the room, some can be melee'd from the inner platform, others you have to use ranged abilities or walk down to hit, just make sure not to stand in the bad stuff on the ground for too long at once, as the damage from it stacks up.\r\n\r\nWe got it on our first try without much extra effort, just requires a little bit of running around before you kill him off.\r\n\r\nGL!"},{"id":1975328,"r":-5,"n":3,"b":"In soloing this boss, you can kill the 10 Twilight Sparks, wipe, res, then kill boss AND then get the chieve.\r\n\r\nGood thing too, because after wiping, the Twilight Sparks already slain do not respawn."},{"id":2155446,"r":38,"n":0,"b":"Don't let everyone's comments about how easy this is make you overconfident.  Even as a level 100, you'll take a serious amount of damage that can be potentially fatal if you aren't keeping an eye on your health and using whatever dmg mitigation and self heals that you have.\n\n[ul]\n[li]Whack Benedictus down to 50% or so in health to make him cast this irritating shadow spell that turns everything purple.  [/li]\n[li]At this point, you must run OFF the center platform and run all around it targeting the various sparks that spawn.  [/li]\n[li]Kill ten of the sparks.[/li]\n[li]You may now safely down Benedictus for the achievement.[/li]\n[/ul]"},{"id":2328604,"r":5,"n":0,"b":"Easy achievement, but a possible bug currently in 6.2. I had to reset the boss twice before the Sparks actually spawned when he transitioned to phase 2."},{"id":2349212,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"As of 6.2, I had to reset the boss in order to get the phase to activate, it could be a bug."},{"id":2361734,"r":31,"n":0,"b":"If anyone is trying to do this achieve in Legion still here are a few things to keep in mind from my own experience.\r\n1. You have to get the boss to second phase. So you can't 1 shot him\r\n2. You cannot use the soft foam sword toy here.\r\n3. You have to kill 10 adds in phase 2 and then kill the boss to get achieve.\r\n\r\nI did the following as a BM hunter:\r\nStripped naked, equipped weapon and one piece of clothing because I found I needed the stamina. The second phase has a constant damaging effect. If you are naked, you are going to get hit really hard. So, I found that I need a little more stamina and with my Exhilaration heal, healing potion, and pet's spirit mend ability I was able to survive the second phase. With more or less healing your mileage will vary. Remember though that the more gear you have the harder you'll hit and the more chance you have of killing the boss in the first hit. So, start small.\r\n\r\ngood luck!"},{"id":2533389,"r":9,"n":0,"b":"I'll give my advice for any casters trying this, made it remarkably easy for me (Destro Warlock myself):\r\n\r\n1. Equip a fishing pole prior to the fight, used that to melee boss down to 50% (you'll be surprised how slow you dps with a fishing pole on)\r\n2. Once he goes into shadow mode, just run to the edge of the center platform and kill 10 sparks around the room, don't go into shadow area if you can help it.\r\n3. After you have 10 dead, just turn and burn.\r\n\r\nHope that helps, enjoy your 10 points!"},{"id":2873339,"r":-7,"n":3,"b":"Evidently Blizzard has put in something that prevents one-shotting multiphase bosses so you can hit each individual phase.\r\nI hit the boss once and it put him exactly at 49% so i could get into Phase 2.  I did this with my pet (MM hunter, turtle pet)... I had my pet on passive... growl off... Tapped growl on so my pet would taunt and attack once, and instantly put the pet back to passive.\r\n\r\nInstantly at 49%... able to kill the sparks... done."},{"id":3202480,"r":2,"n":0,"b":"This probably isn't the most efficient method, but since the last useful comment was from patch 7.3.2 I thought I would throw in my advice.\n\nEven with no gear on, I one-shot the boss and, unfortunately, Soft Foam Sword doesn't work in the instance. What I suggest is for you to go in, start the fight, then afk for a bit. Thrall does a small amount of damage to Benedictus without taking any himself. Just wait for Thrall to push the boss to phase 2, kill the sparks, then finish the fight with one hit to the boss.\n\nLike I said, this likely isn't the most efficient way to get the achievement, but at least you don't have to wait til the next TW Cata event to give it a try."},{"id":3204346,"r":4,"n":0,"b":"Easily done using the Whole-Body Shrinka' toy."},{"id":3213331,"r":7,"n":1,"b":"very straight forward at 120 DH.\r\n\r\nStripped all my clothes off. punched the boss, took a few hits to get him to about 50%. \r\n\r\nHe will cast a spell which will turn the area purple. you will see the enemies around the room you need to kill, equip a weapon and get your 10 and then kill the boss."},{"id":3241811,"r":8,"n":0,"b":"Level 50 DH (pre-patch). Unequip all gear, no buffs. 3 hits to Benedictus to 49%. \r\n\r\nPurple spawned on outside of the center ring. Equip MH weapon, ran around the room and killed the 10 purple orbs. \r\n\r\nKill Benedictus. Profit."},{"id":5266576,"r":10,"n":1,"b":"Okay, it's still possible in 9.1 on lvl60\r\n\r\nDone like most of the other commenter before me:\r\n\r\n[ol]\r\n[li]Remove all equipment and if you want to be 100% sure, kill yourself and ress at the spirit healer[/li]\r\n[li]bring [npc=54938] below 50% (2, max. 3 hits)[/li]\r\n[li]as he begins to cast and the outer ring turns purple, go to said outer ring and kill 10 [npc=55466][/li]\r\n[li]finish him[/li]\r\n[/ol]"},{"id":5387491,"r":19,"n":0,"b":"Extremely simple with the right tools:\r\n\r\n1. Leave all your gear on, no res sickness, no pre-planning needed\r\n2. Use [item=97919], causing your damage output to be ridiculously small\r\n3. DPS the boss until he is below 50% health, it took me around 12 hits\r\n4. The adds will spawn on the outside ring of the platform, I ran around and killed every single one after removing the Shrink buff from the toy\r\n5. Kill boss\r\n\r\nDone."},{"id":5550811,"r":25,"n":2,"b":"This can still be done with absolutely zero prep, wearing full gear, no rez sickness, and without owning a [item=97919].  (Although, make sure you aren't wearing any gear that procs or reflects damage.)  I didn't know what I was in for, so I just watched at first and noticed Thrall was whittling down the HP on Benedictus.  Thanks, Thrall!\n\nNext step, waste some time: I looked up how to get the achievement on Wowhead, found some quick options, but I was committed to taking the easy way out.  I got some food and watched an episode of something or other.  \n\nEventually Thrall stops helping because he's in agony or something.  That's fine, because the Sparks have appeared!  There's purple stuff all around and the Twilight Sparks are on the outer ring of the room.  Kill ten (or more to be safe) then kill Benedictus.  \n\nI don't recommend doing it this way unless you're dead set on being lazy."},{"id":5760977,"r":5,"n":1,"b":"Just did this achievement at lvl 70. I just let thrall slowly get him down to 60% health, as i took the beating from him. killed the 10 sparks, then shot him. its a slow process, but works."},{"id":5762945,"r":4,"n":0,"b":"@ lvl 70 the only way to do this is the World Shrinka toy w/ no armor and weapon on. Beat up boss till he goes to phase 2. Take off toy effect by right clicking the icon and run around killing 10 of the sprites."},{"id":6028482,"r":5,"n":3,"b":"I used the toy because i didn't want to wait 18 minutes. Drop his health below 65%, wait a bit, disable the effects of the toy, go around and kill the spirits, then the bishop and you're done."},{"id":6062902,"r":5,"n":0,"b":"Just waited 18 minutes for thrall to lower him to 60 just to felblade into one of the mobs, break out of the map and now I cannot login cos it keeps disconnecting, i broke the game"},{"id":6463045,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"As of today,\r\nI punched Archbishop, unarmed, no armor, and each punch took him down about 12%. > Am adăugat primele 16 ghiduri detaliate în modulul Cataclysm, cu dificultate și puncte de hartă numerotate. Cercetarea confirmă și trei achievementuri blocate de refacerea dungeonurilor — „Old Faithful”, „Prince of Tides” și „Umbrage for Umbriss” — care trebuie eliminate. „Stood in the Fire” rămâne: comentariile indică o cale prin Dragon Soul.

> {"id":6236145,"rating":6,"nreplies":0,"date":"2025-12-01T22:38:25-06:00","body":"TWW 12/1/25 - Quite easier than you'd think...\r\n\r\n1. Pick up a rat by right clicking and looting it from the floor above you. You can only hold one rat at a time. Pull the boss with a non-damage ability (taunt, etc). Pull a kitty and right click the rat in your bag to feed the kitty. 1/4 down. Can kill the kitty you fed.\r\n\r\n2. Create a macro - /tar Temple Rat.\r\n\r\n3. Enable Interact key in options and keybind interact with target key to whatever key you want. Go to the wall and wait for that rat to get close and have it targeted and spam the interact keybind you just made. Aggro 2/4 kitty and feed it.\r\n\r\n4. Repeat it two more times and boom, achievement done. The rat takes a minute to respawn so another ~2 minutes and gg. GLHF :)","replies":[]}[]

Oh gosh please save us, someone, murlocs are going to take over the world","replies":[]},{"id":1125307,"rating":-3,"nreplies":1,"date":"2010-09-22T03:05:13-05:00","body":"not only are the murlocs taking over deadmines, they are invading loch modan! (with the help of kobolds and gnolls)","replies":[{"body":"Add gnomes to that list .","creationdate":"2010-12-14T23:34:17-06:00","id":467471,"rating":0,"commentid":1125307,"dataTree":1,"roles":0,"username":"xemega","markupDisabledEnvironments":{"ptr":true,"ptr2":true,"beta":false,"d4ptr":false,"d4beta":false,"classicptr":false},"downvotedByUser":false,"reportedByUser":false,"votedByUser":false}]}],"id":5083,"length":45486}{"comments":[{"id":1152565,"rating":1,"nreplies":0,"date":"2010-10-25T03:27:47-05:00","body":"is this the guy in that worgen cinematic from  blizzcon?","replies":[]}],"id":5093,"length":43821}{"comments":[{"id":1615610,"rating":1,"nreplies":0,"date":"2012-01-23T09:59:27-06:00","body":"This boss has de voodoo man.\r\n\r\n I was DPS and the finder didn't put me in this instance after 1 month straight, so I never saw it before. Since nobody had any thoughts about this fight, here is mine.\r\n\r\nNow serious:\r\n\r\nThe fight begins with a green bubble on the ground. I don't know if it was the healer or the spirit in the back. You have 5 seconds to be inside it. Be in it in more than 3 and get one pissed healer at you. DPS boss down. He will get melee-personal and start lashing 5k hits on each people. It appears to be unavoidable.\r\n\r\nPhase 2, the boss will go back to the stairs where you came (but he won't go down) and spawn 3 chains. 4 people should focus on the chains while one DPS should be let loose to kill the adds. (That was me.) Pop-up spirit of the fox (if you are hunter), and DON'T STAND STILL.\r\nMove and blow, you will take out the adds, and draw aggro like an unfortunate ... player. Keep your pet on assist for this, but don't make him draw more aggro, he needs to get rid of your targets, not draw more.\r\n The rest of the party will be busy wearing the chains down and picking up adds you didn't get in time. By all means, leave those already engaged on tanker, but keep the heat off him, keep wiping. If you please the healer enough by wiping the adds, he may have mana left for you. If you get enough spare time, (2 seconds is plenty) you can also land 1-2 shots on the chains, so save some focus to do it with Dots. Serpent sting, anyone?\r\nThe boss lets go one big purple blob from time to time that takes some 70k health, and that's why you should not stay still . Get hit by two in a row and die.  Avoid the spot where he throws the purple thing, it is pre-warned, and usually he will do it on you. Yes, you have now a big red circle painted on your chest, so you want to draw as least aggro as possible, to leave your pet free to hunt adds. The adds are not elite, and you can almost one-shot them with Arcane, if you are geared enough.\r\n\r\nAfter all 3 chains are damaged or destroyed, the battle ends. You don't actually kill the boss. Like battling Mannoroth. Enjoy.","replies":[]},{"id":5268713,"rating":8,"nreplies":0,"date":"2021-10-21T07:27:44-05:00","body":"I know why you are here. The chains. Why are the chains immune.\r\n\r\nThe first thing you need to do it kill the Gurubashi Spirit Warrior on the lower platform before the boss.\r\nOnce you enter the spirit realm now they will be alive. Taunt one of them and stand on the chain.\r\nThe Spirit warrior will use body slam and remove the immune buff from the chains. Do this 3 times and finish of the boss ^^","replies":[]},{"id":5623616,"rating":3,"nreplies":1,"date":"2023-06-06T08:43:35-05:00","body":"When entering Zul'Gurub, a Bonus Objective pops up that says \"0/4 All Guardians of Jindo defeated.\"\r\n\r\nI couldn't complete the objective and I couldn't understand why, and I was unclear whether it included mini-bosses or some other entities.\r\n\r\nThen I realized, I was working on the dungeon in separate sittings, and leaving the dungeon or logging out resets the progress on the objective. Kill and profit"}]},{"id":4850,"total":2,"profit":[]},{"id":4851,"total":6,"profit":[]},{"id":4852,"total":41,"profit":[]},{"id":5094,"total":3,"profit":[]},{"id":5107,"total":1,"profit":[]},{"id":5108,"total":3,"profit":[]}]
