Oh, it seems I am not smart enough to make a working macro so I used the Tab button to help target the Fiends and then used a simple Moonfire to blast each one. I [i]think [/i]there is a counter on the right side that shows how many you have killed, as it hit 6 and then I shifted into Twilight after that. I could be wrong on that part. I killed one more Fiend just to be sure my count was high enough though."},{"id":3229934,"r":33,"n":3,"b":"120 assassination rogue. I made a macro that just has this in it:\r\n\r\n[code]/target Twilight Fiend\r\n/cast Poisoned Knife\r\n[/code]\r\n\r\nAfter initiating the encounter (by literally just standing under Valiona), I waited until Dazzling destruction so that I could get sent into the twilight nightmare. Once there I ran around clicking this button. Each time I killed a twilight fiend I hit F1 so that I would target myself, and wouldn't auto target the boss (which happened on my 120 fire mage). I kept running around and clicking until I got 6 (and I checked the achievements tracker to make sure I had it). Then just DPS the boss down and you got the achievement!"},{"id":5678300,"r":2,"n":1,"b":"I had absolutely abysmal luck finding these little fiends on my Paladin. Took me almost ten minutes to kill five of them -- not because I was missing them, but because I simply could not find them. Accidentally killed the boss one fiend short.\r\n\r\nI tried again on my level 60 Hunter and the fiends seemed to spawn super fast. They were everywhere! Killed all 6 using tab-target & Arcane Shot (pet dismissed) within 60 seconds. \r\n\r\nNo idea what I was doing wrong the first time. My best advice is using ranged single-target attacks and make sure you have nameplates turned on."},{"id":5779079,"r":7,"n":0,"b":"Two tips: Turn off mouseover cast so you don't accidentally kill the boss.\n\nTry this macro to find them :)\n[code]/tar Twilight Fiend\n/ping [@target] Attack[/code]"},{"id":6016379,"r":4,"n":0,"b":"So I just got this 5 min ago.  Lvl 80 Troll Arcane mage. I just hit the dragon on the right as you enter with my staff. Hit her a few times and they started to spawn. I made a macro to make it easy to find them. Just be careful as it sometime seems to target boss. just keep running back and forth as they spawn from both sides and they do despawn as well. It will ding before the boss is dead. \r\n\r\nHere is the macro I used\r\n/target twilight fiend\r\n/script SetRaidTarget(\"target\",8);\r\n\r\nHappy Hunting\r\nPerrên \r\nFOR THE HORDE"},{"id":6032307,"r":5,"n":0,"b":"Not difficult in any way, but rather annoying. I recommend like some previous users to do a marco, because these guys are rather quick and you might not see them.\r\nThe bosses will be on your tail the whole times so be careful not to accidentally hit them. Otherwise the achievement is easy."},{"id":6032358,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"Not difficult in any way, but rather annoying. I recommend like some previous users to do a marco, because these guys are rather quick and you might not see them.\r\nThe bosses will be on your tail the whole times so be careful not to accidentally hit them. Otherwise the achievement is easy."}]}{"id":5304,"comments":[{"id":1456157,"r":54,"n":6,"b":"Now with the 4.2 normal mode nerfs, this achv is very easy on 10man.\n\nWe just put tank and healer on frost, while the rest of the raid nuked down Rohash/Anshal, and then jumped to Nezir's platform asap. With the extended Gaining Strength time from the nerfs, everyone from anshal/rohash platform reached 7 stacks when there was ~25 seconds left on Gaining Strength, and Nezir was almost dead anyways from people nuking him while gaining stacks."},{"id":2028316,"r":225,"n":13,"b":"Just solo-ed the achievement on a 582ilvl Fury Belf warrior lvl 90. (specced into Impending Victory for more heals)\r\n\r\n7 easy steps to get 7stacks:\r\n\r\n1) kill Anshal\r\n2) Jump and stay at Nezir till you gain 3stacks of the debuff\r\n3) Jump and kill Rohash asap\r\n4) Jump back to Nezir and stay there gathering stacks.\r\n5) Wait till Anshal is active again and let him finish Zephyr cast, then jump and kill him.\r\n6) Jump back to Nezir and gather stacks if you are still short and kill as soon as you hit 7 stacks of Wind Chill\r\n7) Enjoy the achievement.\r\n*PS: I lost the 3 stacks during the Rohash encounter, so just continued and gained the remaining stacks at step 4-6.\r\nStill reached 7stacks and downed the Nezir as the last boss*"},{"id":2076210,"r":71,"n":9,"b":"After reading several tips here I found them overly complicated so I'll explain how I managed to do it, as  638 Beastmaster\r\n\r\n1) used [spell=120360] to quicly kill Rohash (the boss on the right as you enter, not Anshal like everyone is saying);\r\n2) Jumped to Nezir' plataform, and just auto-atacked him once or twice while I crossed his plataform;\r\n3) Jumped to Anshal and again used all my Barrage\r\n4) jumped again to Nezir plataform, at this time I had 2 stacks, and just waited till I had 7 then I used Barrage again.\r\n\r\nAt 638 I managed to do this while Rohash and Anshal were still recovering :)"},{"id":2427092,"r":100,"n":12,"b":"Easily soloable on whatever difficulty (10, 25, normal, heroic) you want in Legion.\r\n\r\n1) Go left, kill Anshal.\r\n2) Go to the middle, stand around and wait for Nezir to give you 3 stacks.\r\n3) Go to the right and kill Rohash.\r\n4) Come back to the middle and get another 3 stacks. You'll probably start to take a little damage here.\r\n5) Go kill Anshal again.\r\n6) Come back to the middle, kill Nezir after he gives you your final stack.\r\n7) Go kill Rohash again.\r\n\r\nez pz"},{"id":2570108,"r":8,"n":0,"b":"This is super easy at 110 with a Warlock\r\n\r\n1. Use Affliction - select \"Absolute Corruption\"\r\n2. Go left - put Corruption on Ashal. He'll probably die by the time you move right to 2nd platform.\r\n3. Ignore Nezir, move to right and teleport over to Rohash\r\n4. Put Corruption on Rohash. He'll take a little while to die because of shield, but he will die.\r\n5. Portal back to Nezir.\r\n6. Wait for 7 stacks of Wind Chill. (Do not worry about other 2 bosses. When they gain strength, corruption is still ticking, and will take them back to 1 HP in seconds)\r\n7. Kill Rohash, collect achievement"},{"id":2578196,"r":20,"n":3,"b":"as a guardian druid in Legion, I just went to Nazir's platform, got 7 stacks and then hopped to 1 of the other bosses, \"killed\" him, hopped back to Nazir then over to the other bossed \"killed\" that one then finished off Nazir. :)"},{"id":2853731,"r":19,"n":1,"b":"Given that the game has moved on and the DoTs are now mostly inconsequential at top level, I had more trouble dealing with time more than anything (namely the time to stack Wind Chill, the short time for it to wear off and the shortened time of Gather Strength to 1min rather than the original 2min).  \r\n\r\nHere's an amended approach to Glitterangel's method that I took as a BFA Outlaw Rogue:\r\n[ol]\r\n[li]Skip Anshal/Rohash, go straight to Nezir.[/li]\r\n[li]Pull (but don't kill) Nezir, stop attacking.  Start stacking Wind Chill while moving Nezir close to the wind bridge towards either Anshal or Rohash.[/li]\r\n[li]Once you've got 6x Wind Chill, you've got 30 secs max between now & receiving your 7th (due to WC wearing off). Take the nearby wind bridge to your choice of wind lord.  Rush over, kill them - At this point, you've got another timer (60 seconds) to kill the other lords before Gather Strength brings them back.[/li]\r\n[li]The moment Anshal/Rohash is dead, rush back to Nezir's platform. Stick near him to refresh Wind Chill and get your 7th stack.[/li]\r\n[li]At this point, it's the point of no return.  Kill Nezir, rush over to the remaining lord's platform.[/li]\r\n[li]While flying over to the remaining lord's platform, check you still have Wind Chill x7 and kill them. If you managed to beat both timers, the achievement should pop.[/li]\r\n[/ol]\r\n\r\n[ul]\r\n[li]The lords are not quite one-shot during the BFA era, so don't worry about a ranged pull one-shotting them.[/li]\r\n[li]Any abilities to move quickly (e.g. [url=https://www.wowhead.com/spell=2983/sprint]Sprint[/url], [url=https://www.wowhead.com/spell=195457/grappling-hook]Grappling Hook[/url]) will help a lot.  [/li]\r\n[li]If either timer expires (Wind Chill stacks wear off or a previously-killed wind lord comes back), disengage and all three lords will pop back.[/li]\r\n[/ul]"},{"id":2871106,"r":24,"n":0,"b":"All these comments seem to now (L120+) be just making a simple thing complicated. Kill Nezir last. That's it. \r\n\r\nKeep knocking down Rohash and Anshal to 1%, get 7+ stacks of wind chill from Nezir and once both Rohash and Anshal are at 1% (watch all 3 boss' health bars on your UI), make sure you have the stacks and finish Nezir."},{"id":3229933,"r":2,"n":0,"b":"Did this on 120 prot warrior. From where you start, head to Nezir, don't agro the other bosses. Aggro Nezir (I used taunt). Move yourself towards Anshal's platform as if you're about to fly to it but don't. Wait for 3 stacks of windchill. As soon as 3 stacks hit, fly to Anshal's platform and drop him (I used crucible to one-shot). Hurry back to Nezir. As you're getting stacks 3-6, walk yourself to Rohash's platform as if you were going to fly to it. Wait for stack 6 of wind chill. Fly immediately over to Rohash and down him (I used crucible again to one-shot). Quickly come back to Nezir's platform after downing Rohash. Get the 7th stack of windchill, immediately drop Nezir as quickly as you can.\n\nIf you did it fast enough, the others won't gather enough energy to reform themselves. Easy achievement."},{"id":3235876,"r":6,"n":0,"b":"Go to Nezir, pull the boss and get 6 stacks of Wind Chill. Once that is done, jump to any other boss and nuke that one. Go back to Nezir, get the 7th stack, jump to the other boss, kill that one. go back to Nezir and nuke that one last."},{"id":3256540,"r":10,"n":1,"b":"I have some friends trying to do glory of the cataclysm raider but as of Shadowlands it seems to be impossible to do \"Stay Chill\" (getting 7 stacks of Wind Chill before killing Nezir).\n\nFirst of all the wind carrying you from platform to platform seems to be bugged as it disappears and takes a while to reappear.\n\nThe second problem I noticed is the rate at which the debuff (Wind chill) is cast. It seems to be very low in comparison to pre-Shadowlands. Adding to this is the fact that the bosses seem to stay in the middle of the platform spamming a AOE damage skill.\n\nLastly they get a debuff (Withering winds) that reduces healing received and increases damage taken. I can't seem to recall that this was a problem when I did the achievement but now it is absolutly decimating them. This makes me think that maybe the debuffs in this raid hasen't been scaled correctly to the new max level and is doing more damage then intented.\n\nAnyone else having problems or are we making a mistake ?"},{"id":3256672,"r":5,"n":0,"b":"hey so trying to do this after shadowlands launch at lvl 50 but i can't ever seem to get with more than 4 stacks of wind chill, am i doing something wrong here or just very unlucky with rng. i am literally just sitting in front of nezmir waiting to get hit by debuff and nothing."},{"id":3257203,"r":33,"n":2,"b":"As of patch 9.0.2 this encounter is definitely bugged.\n\nThe three bosses are supposed to accumulate energy slowly (1 energy per second) and when their energy bar is full (90) they cast their 'ultimate' which in Nezir's case is [spell=86367]. Casting their ultimate then drains their energy back to 0 and the cycle continues.\n\nThe issue in 9.0.2 is that their energy bars fill to full almost immediately and even [u]during[/u] casting their ultimate their energy immediately fills back up.\n\nNow this is an issue because if Nezir's energy is at full he's continually casting the channeled (15 seconds) spell [spell=86367]...and therefore he's not casting [spell=84645], which is the debuff you need to stack. \n\nNow there's a second or two after he finishes channeling [spell=86367] before he realizes his energy is still full and begins casting [spell=86367] again, in that time he may cast [spell=84645] and you might be able to get a stack or two but it's very hit and miss...getting to 7 stacks is an impossibility.\n\nAm going to log an in-game bug report myself, I'd recommend to anyone else trying for this achievement to do the same!"},{"id":3285514,"r":3,"n":0,"b":"[b]Completely BUGGED[/b]\r\n\r\nIf you are here [b]04/01/2021[/b] there's no point trying, you need the Energy Bar to go down but it staggers at a constant 9 - 10 meaning you can't get the Stay Chill debuffs.\r\nHopefully there will be a fix soon..."},{"id":3285766,"r":2,"n":0,"b":"After the hotfix today, this is once again possible to get. I did this on a level 60 Demon Hunter, but it seems like any class with high mobility will do.\r\n\r\nI started on the Nezir platform, pulled him toward one of the jumps, and waited for the debuffs to stack. As soon as I got the 7th stack, I killed him and jumped to the nearest other boss. I don't think it mattered which boss I hit next since I was just trying to outrun the debuff timer. Keep in mind that currently Nezir will probably reach 90 energy right after you get the 7th debuff stack, so you have to be quick about killing him as soon as you get it. From there I just raced between the two other boss platforms and managed to get it with about 1 or 2 seconds left on the timer."},{"id":3286766,"r":5,"n":0,"b":"After hotfix I tryed this achivement, I could last long enough to see 7 stacks with my lvl 60 rogue. I just wanted to be sure and waited for 9 stacks and killed all of the 3 bosses but I could not get the achivement for some reason.... \r\n\r\nAfter that I gave it a shot with my lvl 51 monk. Raid is still extremely buggy after 7 stacks I died a couple times while trying to kill other bosses. \r\n\r\nSo my final strategy was going to Nezir and wait for 3 stacks. ASAP I got the 3 stacks of wind chill went for other boss killed it and came back.\r\nand I waited 2 more stacks so as soon as I got 5 stacks I went for other boss killed it came back to Nezir.\r\n\r\nAnd finally at 7th stack I have killed Nezir and got the achievement."},{"id":3288003,"r":7,"n":3,"b":"Definitely doable, just got it after 5 wipes. As of 9.0.1, the boss is bugged and once a boss reaches 90 energy, it will spam cast its ultimate ability as it keeps regenerating energy at the same rate it loses it.\n\n• I started on Nezir's platform\n• Pull Nezir, but do not kill him, just stand there.\n• Wind Chill will stack on your character every 6ish seconds or so. At 5 stacks, jump from Anshal's platform (doesn't really matter which one you jump to)\n• Kill Anshal and jump back to Nezir's platform. Gain 1 stack (6 total) of wind chill\n• Nezir will reach 90 energy at this time and cast his ultimate. [i]Pop a cooldown if you are taking a lot of damage on a lower level character[/i]\n• At the end the ultimate, Nezir will fight for about 10 seconds before casting his ultimate again. This is enough time to add 1 stack of Wind Chill (7 total)\n• Kill Nezir and then jump to Rohash (the last living boss) and kill him.\n\nIf you are quick enough, you can kill Nezir and Rohash before Anshal regenerates. If not, there is probably enough time to go and kill Anshal again (not tested)."},{"id":3289058,"r":31,"n":6,"b":"I just did it very easily!\r\n\r\nWhat you wanna do is:\r\n\r\n- Go to nezir (10 man normal)\r\n- Get 5 Stacks of wind chill (boss will be close to 90 energy)\r\n- Go to Anshal and kill him, then go back to nezir\r\n- After nezir finishes his special, wait for 7 stacks then kill him\r\n- Swap to rohash and kill him asap\r\n\r\nResult: Achievement earned!\r\n\r\nGood luck"},{"id":3290282,"r":0,"n":0,"b":"Due to the scaling issues with lvl 60 characters, I decided to do this on my lvl 52 mage in the 10 man normal version.\r\nFinished first try with 100% hp."},{"id":3300078,"r":3,"n":1,"b":"It seems bugged, but this worked for me (in 10 Normal):\r\n\r\n- Kill Anshall\r\n- Jump to Nezir, takes his HP down, but don't kill him\r\n- move close to airbridge Rohash and wait till you have 7 stacks\r\n- At 7 stacks, throw some dot on Nezir while taking airbridge\r\n- Kill Rohash asap\r\n\r\nFor me Anshall wasn't back up and I had enough time to get the achievement"},{"id":5248230,"r":43,"n":5,"b":"Can confirm that in current patch (9.1.0) this works as intended, I just did it in 25 man HC.\r\n\r\nGonna copy a comment from Furyisop, cause it's nice and simple.\r\n\r\n[quote]What you wanna do is:\r\n\r\n- Go to nezir\r\n- Get 5 Stacks of wind chill (boss will be close to 90 energy)\r\n- Go to Anshal and kill him, then go back to nezir\r\n- After nezir finishes his special, wait for 7 stacks then kill him\r\n- Swap to rohash and kill him asap [/quote]"},{"id":5529902,"r":-5,"n":0,"b":"Just completed this in 10 man N with a L60 frost mage. The below works, just needs some patience:\r\n\r\n- Go to nezir\r\n- Get 5 Stacks of wind chill (boss will be close to 90 energy)\r\n- Go to Anshal and kill him, then go back to nezir\r\n- After nezir finishes his special, wait for 7 stacks then kill him\r\n- Swap to rohash and kill him asap"},{"id":5602545,"r":29,"n":7,"b":"Easiest method yet, no back and forth between bosses:\r\n\r\n1) Go left, kill Anshal.\r\n2) Go to the middle (Nezir), stand near slipstream to Rohash.\r\n3) Wait for Nezir to give you all 7 stacks of Chill.\r\n4) Kill Nezir \r\n5) Go to Rohash and kill him before stacks wear off\r\n6) Achieved!\r\n\r\nThis method probably works in reverse, moving counter clockwise through the bosses"},{"id":5711693,"r":26,"n":5,"b":"My approach to this was a little different to what others had done:\r\n\r\n-Get naked.  I always do this to avoid having my equipment proc a damage-causing response to incoming damage.\r\n-Go to Nezir, stand near the slipstream to Rohash\r\n-Target Rohash from Nezir's platform, wait until you have at least 5 stacks of Wind Chill\r\n-Watch for Rohash to cast Wind Blast, and as soon as it's done, go over to Rohash and kill him\r\n-Go back to Nezir, stand near the slipstream to Anshal\r\n-Wait until you have 7 stacks of Wind Chill (Rohash will probably be about 75% of the way to going active again by this point)\r\n-Kill Nezir\r\n-Go to Anshal, kill him\r\n\r\nI did it this way because when I would try killing Anshal first, after 6 failed attempts due to Rohash always hitting me with Wind Blast when I got to his platform, I decided that it was important to be able to choose when I want to go to Rohash's platform rather than being in a rush to get there before Wind Chill drops."},{"id":6040044,"r":5,"n":0,"b":"Just did this following someone else's post, had 8 stacks actually, killed all 3 within the time frame and...no achievement. Any ideas what I might have missed or is this somehow bugged? \r\n\r\nI one shot Anshal, then went to Nezir and stood there doing nothing til I had 8 stacks, one shot him then went over to Rohash and one shot him. By that time Anshal had popped back up, but I had time to get back to him and killed him again. \r\n\r\nAm I dumb?"},{"id":6134533,"r":21,"n":2,"b":"Dungeon set to normal, fully geared lvl 80 Druid: Killed Anshal, then stay on Nezir till 6 stacks hit, quickly jumped and kill Rohash back to Nezir and kill him on 7 stacks and got the achievement."}]}{"id":5306,"comments":[]}{"id":5307,"comments":[{"id":1169601,"r":116,"n":0,"b":"[url=http://cata.wowhead.com/spell=79710]Arcane Annihilator[/url] is a fast casting, interruptable spell.\n\nStatic Shock occurs only as a result of Electron being struck while [url=http://cata.wowhead.com/spell=91448]Unstable Shield[/url] is active.\n\n[url=http://cata.wowhead.com/spell=80086]Poison Bomb[/url] requires that those who are fixated by the bombs kite them away from other raid members so they can be safely killed by ranged DPS.\n\nFlamethrower requires that a raid member turns Magmatron away from the rest of the group when they're marked with [url=http://cata.wowhead.com/spell=91532]Acquiring Target[/url].\n\nEDIT: Why must people needlessly downrate things?"},{"id":1234495,"r":55,"n":0,"b":"This achievment can be completed over multiple victories against the Omnitron Defense!"},{"id":1280625,"r":69,"n":7,"b":"[b]Remember: You will not have to complete all 4 parts of this achievement at the same time! It's possible to complete this achievement over several lockouts[/b]\nThe fight starts out with 1 construct active. The second one will then activated as the first constructs' energy bar, depletes to 50.\nSo remember that the fight requires you to be aware of several parts of this post at once, even though they are described as separate encounters. I'd recommend doing only 1 part of the achievement per kill, even though all 4 parts are manageable to pull off in 1 kill, It might just take some extra time.\n\nIt's split up into 4 different (read : separate) parts.\n[b]No player hit by Static Shock[/b] - Static Shock is a spell cast by [url=http://www.wowhead.com/npc=42179]Electron[/url]'s[url=http://www.wowhead.com/spell=91447]Unstable shield[/url]. He will cast his own variation of the shield ability ([url=http://www.wowhead.com/spell=91447]Unstable shield[/url]) just like the other 3 constructs, when he reaches 50 energy (he'll start at 100, and then slowly drain). The part of this achievement, is completed by making sure that [url=http://www.wowhead.com/npc=42179]Electron[/url] won't get hit, while his shield remains active. \n[i][b]Protip[/b]: If you're going for this part of the achievement, please make sure that dots are 100% off Electron, as they'll trigger the shield, and cause him to cast the Static Shock. The tank should stop attacking the second he starts casting the shield.[/i]\n\n[b]No player hit by Poison Bomb[/b] - \"[url=http://www.wowhead.com/npc=42897]Poison Bombs[/url]\" is a part of [url=http://www.wowhead.com/npc=42180]Toxitron[/url]' spell rotation. \nThe key to completing this part is very simple however! [url=http://www.wowhead.com/npc=42180]Toxitron[/url] will cast a spell from time to time, called [url=http://www.wowhead.com/spell=91513]Poison Protocol[/url].\nWhen he casts this spell [url=http://www.wowhead.com/spell=91513]Poison Protocol[/url], simply move away from him! Tanks, Melees and Ranged have to stay at distance, as he will spawn 3 [url=http://www.wowhead.com/npc=42897]Poison Bombs[/url], that'll explode if they hit their designated target. The target is set by a random function ([url=http://www.wowhead.com/spell=80094]Fixate[/url]) as they spawn, so having a ranged DPS at distance, assigned to call out the targets of the poison adds, is a very helpful thing to do.\nThe healthpool of the adds happens to be really low, so a few direct damage spells will do the job.\nYou will get this part of the achievement, as long as none of the adds actually makes it all the way to their designated target. \n[b]Protip[/b]: The Poison Bombs are stun/slowable.\n\n\n[b]No player hit by Arcane Annihilator[/b] - [url=http://www.wowhead.com/spell=91540]Arcane Annihilator[/url] is a spell casted by our best friend [url=http://www.wowhead.com/npc=42166]Arcanotron[/url]. This part is easily the hardest. [url=http://www.wowhead.com/spell=91540]Arcane Annihilator[/url] is an interuptable-cast, that will deal direct magic damage, to [url=http://www.wowhead.com/npc=42166]Arcanotron[/url]'s current target. The key to this part is to have [b]2 interrupters[/b] interupt him from the exact second he [url=http://www.wowhead.com/spell=95016]activates[/url], till the second he [url=http://www.wowhead.com/spell=78746]shuts down[/url].\nYou want 2 interrupters on him, because he'll cast the spell way more often than every 10 seconds (Making it impossible for a single guy to interrupt, as most interrupts have around 10 seconds cooldown).\n[b]Protip[/b]: Having a tank as one of the interupters, will be a massive benfit, as he's able to cast [url=http://www.wowhead.com/spell=91540]Arcane Annihilator[/url], right after he [url=http://www.wowhead.com/spell=95016]activates[/url], making a DPS very likely to grab aggro when taking interrupting the first cast if you're in a group with a slow tank. You will have to be very good at interupting him, as 1 fail-interupt will make you fail the achievement.  [u]He will still cast his [url=http://www.wowhead.com/spell=91540]Arcane Annihilator[/url] while his shield is active, so the interrupters will have to sit at him all the time[/u].\n[i]I got a quick tip from the poster beneath me. An elemental Shaman is able to solo interrupt it, as Wind shear with the[url=http://www.wowhead.com/spell=16113]Reverberation[/url] talent, can solo interrupt it! Thanks to [url=http://www.wowhead.com/user=WarlockLover]WarlockLover for the tip![/url][/i]\n\n[b]No more than one player hit by each Flamethrower[/b] - [url=http://www.wowhead.com/npc=42178]Magmatron[/url]'s Flamethrower is triggered by the [url=http://www.wowhead.com/spell=92036]Acquiring Target[/url] ability. [url=http://www.wowhead.com/spell=92036]Acquiring Target[/url] is cast on a random raid member (from personal experience, we haven't seen any melees or tanks getting targeted).\nThe key to this part is to make sure that everyone's spread out, as the Flamethrower ability is a line of fire, going from the boss to the raid member that's been [url=http://www.wowhead.com/spell=92036]Acquired[/url] as [url=http://www.wowhead.com/npc=42178]Magmatron[/url]'s target. The achievement fails if there are more people than the [url=http://www.wowhead.com/spell=92036]Acquired[/url] target getting hit by the line of fire.\n[b]Protip[/b]: Use your brain! If you see a guy next to you with a big cross over the head, move the hell away from him!\n\nIf you need more [b]Protips[/b], feel free to ask me - [b]Horseofdeath[/b] - [i]Darksorrow - Alliance - EU[/i]"},{"id":1289844,"r":52,"n":1,"b":"This achieve is essentially \"Do the fight correctly.\""},{"id":6234325,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"11/27/25 TWW - Just one shot the boss and achievement unlocked. GLHF :)"}]}{"id":5308,"comments":[]}{"id":5309,"comments":[{"id":1121803,"r":45,"n":0,"b":"...signifying nothing!"}]}{"id":5310,"comments":[{"id":2017835,"r":146,"n":10,"b":"The old comments here makes it look trickier than it actually is. Nuke boss down to 25%, AoE down all the aberrations that spawn and then kill the boss. No bugs, it works. :-)"},{"id":2091886,"r":67,"n":3,"b":"If you're going for Glory of the Cataclysm Raider, attempting to do this encounter in heroic and getting this achievement simultaneously, you might have a hard time. Here's a tip me and my friend discovered. \n\nSince the two parts of this achievement are counted separate, killing the 12 aberrations and killing the boss, you can start the encounter in normal, nuke the boss to 25%, kill all the aberrations, run out, change the encounter to heroic, run back in and kill the boss, and you'll get both achievements.\n\nMake sure to track the achievement so you can make sure you got credit for killing all 12 aberrations, and make sure the difficulty actually changes to heroic. You might get a message saying the party was recently in combat and you have to wait a bit."},{"id":2496353,"r":7,"n":2,"b":"Although the achievement itself states otherwise \"...and then defeat Maloriak\" you will get this achievement once you have killed the 12 mobs within 10 seconds.\r\nIf you didn't get it, just run out and reset.\r\n\r\nSoloable as a Discipline Priest using Halo on Heroic 25, wait for Halo's cooldown and cast it three times."},{"id":2566227,"r":17,"n":0,"b":"Super easy.\r\n\r\nWalk in, right click punch him a couple of times to get him to 25% or just under. One hit kill the adds, one hit kill him with a skill.\r\n\r\nOne of the easiest achievements in game"},{"id":2866486,"r":4,"n":1,"b":"As a geared 120 I was having trouble killing the aberrations without taking out Maloriak in one hit first.  Switched to a 110 toon and problem was solved."},{"id":2868969,"r":11,"n":1,"b":"Just did this as a lvl 120 MM Hunter. I unequipped my weapon, aggroed the boss and punched him down to below 25%. he spawned all the aberritions. I equiped my weapon. Muti-shoted all adds then downed the boss. entire encounter took less then 25 seconds"},{"id":3203887,"r":3,"n":0,"b":"May 3rd 2020\r\n\r\nI am hunter, but this will work with any class. Had no pet out.\r\n\r\n[ul]\r\n[li]Took off the bow and put it in my bag.[/li]\r\n[li]Dragged icon of the bow to action bar[/li]\r\n[li]Walked in and aggroed the boss[/li]\r\n[li]Right clicked for auto-attack until he was 35%[/li]\r\n[li]Turned around with my back to him as spawns come from the corner of the front of the room[/li]\r\n[li]Clicked bow icon on action bar for fast equipping[/li]\r\n[li]Smacked all mobs including boss to heck.[/li]\r\n[/ul]\r\nAchievement done.\r\n\r\nNote:\r\nGot a surprise title from it:\r\n\r\n[Name], Slayer of the Stupid, Incompetent and Disappointing Minions"},{"id":3229918,"r":2,"n":0,"b":"120 fire mage, ilvl 446. I kept all of my equipment on and just waited until 12 aberrations came and then proceeded to annihilate them. I attacked Maloriak purely with right click (which uses the wand). It does relatively minimal damage to him but he will continue to spawn aberrations. As soon as I reached 12 aberrations or more, I began to use dragon's breath, meteor and other spells to try to down the aberrations as quickly as possible. Managed the achievement without too much difficulty."},{"id":5296658,"r":2,"n":0,"b":"Done on 12/11/2021 on 25 normal during Shadowlands as a level 60 fury warrior.\n\nI removed all gear, and put my MH weapon on my action bar. Punched him down to <25%, then he summoned the aberrations. They spawn on the side of the room close to the door. I leaped over there, equipped my weapon, used WW/BS to AOE them, down, then killed the boss. EZPZ."},{"id":5299063,"r":86,"n":4,"b":"Updated comment as of Shadowlands 9.1.5\r\n\r\nJust did this achievement no probs, don't have to take gear off or touch the boss.  Simply aggro him, then twiddle your thumbs.  It took him about 2 to 3 minutes, but he eventually started spawning the aberrations. \r\n\r\nI just waited until there was just over 12 in the area, kited them away from the boss while he was doing a long cast, burnt them then burnt him. \r\n\r\nEasy peesy :)"},{"id":5558695,"r":10,"n":3,"b":"Updated Macro for checking number of Aberrant's that are spawned:\r\n\r\n/run local t,c=\"Aberration\",0 for i=1,10000 do local p=C_NamePlate.GetNamePlateForUnit(\"nameplate\"..i) if p and p:IsVisible() and p:GetChildren():GetRegions():GetText()==t then c=c+1 end end print(t,\":\",c)"},{"id":6234328,"r":4,"n":0,"b":"TWW 11/27/25 - Aggro boss, wait a couple of minutes for 12 adds to spawn. Aoe nuke them down away from the boss, kill boss, profit! :-) GLHF.\r\n\r\nSide note - I recommend Instance Achievement Tracker for this and many other achievements. It'll track how many adds spawn and when it's safe to nuke the boss for credit. I love it."},{"id":6328647,"r":8,"n":0,"b":"Adding an updated comment for Midnight as I've just completed this achievement. \r\n\r\nIt's still pretty straightforward by using the toy [url=https://www.wowhead.com/mop-classic/item=97919/whole-body-shrinka]Whole-Body Shrinka'[/url].\r\nYou will want to agro the boss and do 50% damage using a low damage ability. You may also want to remove some weapons/armour just to be extra safe. (I completed this on a Windwalker monk and almost one-shot with Crackling Jade Lightning + toy effect).\r\n\r\nThe boss will then spawn the Aberrations from each side of the room, nuke them down with an AoE ability before the boss finishes the cast and then instantly kill the boss.\r\n\r\nCongrats on your achievement"}]}{"id":5311,"comments":[{"id":1117215,"r":73,"n":0,"b":"-my dear Watson."},{"id":1688121,"r":69,"n":5,"b":"The only hard part now is the pulling in P3: the tank needs to be in the middle [b]before[/b] the phase starts. Note also that if the tank is exactly [i]on[/i] the monstruosity, it will move back and pop 2 pools, so you want to be in front of the boss, like 2-3 yards away.\r\n\r\nThen don't move and just nuke it down."},{"id":2086268,"r":179,"n":9,"b":"I never ran this raid during Cataclysm, so I had to search around a bit to find the information for how to complete this achievement first time. Once I got it figured, though, it was extremely simple.\r\n\r\nFor anyone else like me who isn't familiar with the fight, it is made up of three mandatory phases and 5 individual bosses.\r\n\r\nWhen you first enter the room and clear it of the elementals wandering around, you may enter the first phase with [url=http://www.wowhead.com/npc=43686]Ignacious[/url] and [url=http://www.wowhead.com/npc=43687]Feludius[/url]. Before you pull, position yourself near the centre of the room, preferably around the edge of the purple area on the floor. This is the area you should aim to remain in throughout the fight, as the achievement relies on the final boss spawning in the centre and not moving.\r\n\r\nAttack both bosses, distributing the damage as much as possible, as when one of them is defeated both will vanish and the leftover health of both will carry over to the final boss. When you have taken them out, the next two will spawn - [url=http://www.wowhead.com/npc=43688]Arion[/url] and [url=http://www.wowhead.com/npc=43689]Terrestra[/url] - and you can repeat the same process. Once they are both down they will disappear and then all four will reappear and coalesce into the final phase of the encounter, the [url=http://www.wowhead.com/npc=43735#comments]Elementium Monstrosity[/url]. You will be stunned for the few seconds it takes for this to happen, so you need to be in position beforehand.\r\n\r\nWhen the final boss spawns it will create one of the ice pools underneath it. To complete this achievement, do not move it at all! If you were careful to defeat both pairs of bosses as close to simultaneously as possible, this final boss will not have much health, so you should be able to burn it down very swiftly.\r\n\r\nCongratulations, the achievement is yours!"},{"id":2477241,"r":13,"n":0,"b":"Let the final form of the bosses cast at least one ice patch before you one-shot him... otherwise you'll be stuck in his room with both the entrance and exit doors closed.\n\nNote that if you hearth and come back, the doors will be open so you can get to Cho'Gall."},{"id":2514189,"r":8,"n":0,"b":"110: Just one shot everything for the achievement. However, like Pentarion said, the doors will bug out if you don't let the final form cast one ice patch, requiring you to leave and re-enter the raid to continue to the last boss."},{"id":3233228,"r":7,"n":0,"b":"Burn 'em down.  No door bug anymore."},{"id":3251943,"r":5,"n":0,"b":"Done on BfA level. \r\nWhen boss appear and you see icy circle under him just nuke and you are good."}]}{"id":5312,"comments":[{"id":1119078,"r":65,"n":3,"b":"Whatever you do, do NOT use portals or unsummon pets with this debuff on. We don't need a repeat performance."},{"id":1130297,"r":94,"n":3,"b":"\"He who fights monsters should see to it that he himself does not become a monster. And when you gaze long into an abyss, the abyss will gaze back into you.\""},{"id":1169615,"r":42,"n":1,"b":"This achievement requires that everyone in the raid avoid [url=http://cata.wowhead.com/spell=93177]the[/url] [url=http://cata.wowhead.com/spell=82919]multitude[/url] [url=http://cata.wowhead.com/spell=81689]of[/url] [url=http://cata.wowhead.com/spell=81757]abilities[/url] from the adds that spawn in the first phase plus strong DPS in the second phase in order to down Cho'Gall before his unavoidable [url=http://cata.wowhead.com/spell=94145]AoE[/url] or the tentacles he summons cause anyone's corruption level to rise past 30%.\n\nAssuming nobody made a mistake in the first phase, and the darkened creations never manage to get their spell off, you have a little over a minute to burn down the last 25% of his health."},{"id":6392167,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"When doing this achieve it will bug out if you kill him too fast on 25 heroic. After multiple times of him bugging on heroic before I could get achieve I did it on 25 man normal, let first set of ads spawn, and then just 1 shot the boss. Could likely just pull boss and 1 shot em on 25 normal without doing anything else and get it too but I wanted to be safe."}]}

> {"id":5799,"comments":[{"id":1410688,"r":95,"n":3,"b":"Obviously another reference to Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade.  WOW must be a subsidiary of Geoge Lucas and Steven Spielberg,  either that or Blizzard really loves those movies."},{"id":1462383,"r":133,"n":4,"b":"Actually, Fandral's trash pack is just a set of 3 Druids of the Flame, two in cat form and one in humanoid form chain-casting [url=http://www.wowhead.com/spell=99705]Kneel to the Flame[/url]. They have nothing to do with the achievement at all besides the humanoid mob chain-casting, since people should be looking at him to know when the cast is finishing.\n\nInstead, Fandral's Flames are actually two objects that look like flame orbs on pedestals. Their model is identical to the orbs summoned during his encounter. Each Flame has 3 swirling circles next to it, indicating that each Flame requires at least 3 people in range to click it, requiring a total of 6 people to make their way to each respective Flame and get close enough to click ([s]on 10-man; 25-man probably requires more[/s] 6 for both 10 and 25). Once all 6 people are in position, you give the order to right-click the Flames [b][i]once[/i][/b] after the next Kneel to the Flames cast finishes, and you should have the achievement.\n\nIt is highly worth noting that feral-type shapeshift forms including Bear Form, Cat Form, and Ghost Wolf will cause channeling Fandral's Flames to fail or bug out. We just lost credit on this last night because our shaman was still in Ghost Wolf form after he'd made his way up there and it wouldn't let him channel at all. So, make sure all of your players at the Flames are out of forms before you make the call to channel, as if you don't notice an error fast enough on channeling you will end up losing your chance because of Kneel to the Flame going off and hitting someone.\n\nLastly, Fandral's Flames despawn if someone is hit. [s]Haven't attempted to soft reset the instance to see if they'll respawn or not, since we killed Staghelm afterwards both times, but until a possible soft reset you've lost your chance at the achievement if someone got hit.[/s] Based on subsequent posts, it's apparent that Fandral's Flames will respawn on a soft reset of the instance, assuming Fandral is still alive. The orbs will also despawn if the trash pack is pulled.\n\nThis is probably one of the more interesting raid achievements they've implemented in awhile, although you can imagine how aggravated we all were when Ghost Wolf form messed us up."},{"id":1627754,"r":635,"n":20,"b":"Everything you need to know about this achievement.\n\n[ol]\n[li]You need 2 people (1 on each side)[/li]\n[li]You can use /sit /kneel /lie /sleep or just press your sit button (Default is X)[/li]\n[li]You must not be shapeshifted[/li]\n[li]You must not be in bear/cat/wolf form[/li]\n[li]You must not have any companions/pets/minions/elementals out[/li]\n[li]You must not have any gear equipped that causes anything to spawn (eg. [item=77191])[/li]\n[li]It takes a few seconds to activate the flames so I suggest you call out on voice comms when to do it,[b] wait until a cast is finished[/b] then click the orbs [b]at the same time[/b].[/li]\n[li]If one person gets hit it fails the achieve.[/li]\n[li]It is required for [achievement=5828][/li]\n[li]Failing this achievement awards -50 dkp.[/li]\n[/ol]\n\nGood luck."},{"id":1694883,"r":108,"n":2,"b":"This achievement is really, really simple but incredibly easy to screw up.  On top of being very finicky, it also seems to be buggy and some things will prevent credit from being granted.  I've outlined the known things that can prevent credit below as have some other posts.  In theory if people mess up you can reset it but the last couple times I've been in raids in that circumstances, we've had trouble getting the orbs to reset, so I don't know if it's been changed so you can't make them respawn, or if that is just more of that aforementioned finickiness.\n\nSo, start-to-finish instructions:\n\n[b][url=http://www.muffinsguild.com/screenshots/domo.gif]Introducing Majordomo Fandral Staghelm & Friends[/url][/b]\n\nDruid chain casts something called [b]Kneel To The Flame[/b].  When the cast time finishes (it is several seconds long), he does an AoE explosion that hurts everyone in his room who is standing.  The way to avoid damage -- and earn the achievement -- is either be sitting or kneeling when the cast finishes.\n\nSplit the most reliable of your raid into two teams of three (it is [u]six people regardless of raid size[/u]), one group going for the left orb the other group going for the right.  The remaining people will wait by the portal where it is \"safe.\"  Make sure you have sit keybound (default is \"X\") or a /sit macro prepared in advance.\n[quote]\n[u]Things That Can Bug The Achievement[/u]\n•  Combat pets, included ones summoned by items - dismiss them.  Vanity pets are okay.\n•  Shapeshifts and forms - Druids be in their race's form.  Shaman do not use ghost wolf.  Take off the Murloc suit.  No Furbolgs invited.  \n•  Do not be mounted.\n•  Do not use invulnerability abilities through the casts.  Just sit down.[/quote]\n\nRun while he is casting, then when his cast is about half to 3/4 finished, sit down and wait until the AoE goes out, then repeat.  [b]Play it safe and sit early[/b].  I cannot stress this  enough.  There is no rush to get there.  BTW, there may be a graphical delay on sitting, but if you've hit \"X\" and visually your character is in the process of sitting, it should still count.  \n\nYou can use a /sit or /kneel macro, or you can just hit 'X' (which is the default keybind if you haven't rebound it).  If you take damage, you've failed.  Any individual fail the whole raid.\n\nIn front of each orb are three swirlie orange things.  When each person arrives in front of the orb, they should sit on one while they wait for the others.  Strictly speaking, you do not HAVE to be sitting on these, but they are a good indicator that everyone is in place and close enough to get that magical golden cog without having to adjust positioning when the time comes.  \n\nOnce everyone is sitting on the little orange swirlie seats in front of the orb, have everyone hover their cursor over the orb while someone counts down a pre-determined number of casts, preferably on voice chat.  I recommend setting a number (\"Click in three more casts... 3... 2... 1\") rather than just calling for it, due to voice chat delays.  As soon as the agreed number of casts FINISH, all six people will all [b]single click[/b] the orb simultaneously.  If anyone accidentally starts early or misses the click, you can't cancel your channels and try again.  That's it.  You're done.\n[quote]\n[u]More Things That Can Bug The Achievement[/u]\n•  Do not click the orb more than once.  Break your double-click habit.\n•  Clicking too much earlier or later than everyone else.\n•  Do not waste time standing, then clicking.  Just click from sitting and auto-stand.\n•  Do not cancel the channel\n•  JUST STAND STILL DONT MOVE OKAY\n[/quote]\nYour click will start a channeled spell to the orb.  At this point, if everyone did it right, achievement credit will be given and the orbs will despawn.  If you messed up, the orbs will despawn without credit and you can all leave the instance and reset it and try again, but no promises the orbs will be back.  Even if the orbs are back, remember you're still bound by the instance limitation."},{"id":2014715,"r":89,"n":0,"b":"You still need 6 people as of the most recent patch (7.0.1).\n\nAre you getting forced to kneel after clicking the orb? Make sure you are standing in one of the swirls in front of the orb. Our group kept messing up because people would click but it wouldn't continuously cast. [b]Make sure EVERYONE is in a swirl. [/b]There are three swirls on each side in front of both orbs."},{"id":2102120,"r":104,"n":2,"b":"[Only the [u][i]Patient...[/i][/u]]"},{"id":3162817,"r":343,"n":6,"b":"As of patch 8.2.5 this no longer requires 6 people. I did today with a friend of mine and i got the achievment."},{"id":3180835,"r":152,"n":0,"b":"Just did this with a friend!\r\n\r\nYOU CAN DO IT WITH 2 PEOPLE!\r\nSame tactic, it dropped the meta achievement with only 1 person on each orb!\r\nDon't know when this was changed, but please push this comment on top so others don't lose hope :)\r\n\r\nCheers and birb on!"},{"id":5712089,"r":2,"n":0,"b":"[b][u]Up here in 10.x land - gotchas to look out for[/u][/b]\r\n\r\nTake off [b]trinkets[/b] that proc little friends.  They might make you stand up.  Dragonflight is a trinket rich environment.  \r\n\r\nDelink any talents that proc stuff that makes you stand up.  [i]I have no idea which might do it, just test that /sit works for a minute straight in a combat you can otherwise ignore.[/i]\r\n\r\nThe reason [b]Pets need to despawn[/b] is that pets kneel to noone and do not sit on command. [b]ANY raid member[/b] including pets, getting [b]tagged even without damage getting through[/b] fails. \r\n\r\nDon't take any risks, because raid IDs got smooshed into [b]two types only[/b] (I think this happened when flex raiding - how many raiders - was made).\r\n(I'll come back in a little while to mention if resets work for this these days.  Been slogging the Terecgosa questlines.)\r\nTricks with borrowing into another person's raid lock and raid ID, as long as they haven't fried Staghelm, should work fine.\r\nDoing this with pals, resetting to match someone's raid lock, it matters who is Party Leader and/or who enters the doorwell first.\r\n\r\n[quote]make a [b][u]/sit[/u] macro[/b] [/quote]\r\n\r\n[b][i]do not paste flat any trash mobs near Majordomo Staghelm[/i][/b] it's the chain of mobs casting the trigger for his AOE.\r\nUse Focus on them so you can see the cast."},{"id":5751269,"r":17,"n":3,"b":"Druid Solo Strategy: (How I did it)\n\n[b]General description of the achievement:[/b]\nStanding at the start of the [npc=52571] courtyard you should see two large fire orbs either side of the stairs ([url=https://www.wowhead.com/npc=53696/fandrals-flame]Fandral's Flame[/url]).\nThese fire orbs are interaction targets, to win the achievement you need to activate both in quick succession.\nIf you get hit by [spell=99705] the orbs will despawn. This spell is a blast wave going across the courtyard and has a 5s cast time, it's being chain cast by the center [npc=53619] on the steps\nTo avoid being hit by the spell you need to be kneeling when it goes off.\n\nThis achievement is actually something you do before fighting the Druid's on the steps, and as such if you fail you can exit the instance wait 30 mins and try again (since the achievement is doable on both normal and heroic, you can try twice every 30 mins).\n\nAlso note, the achievement used to require 6 players as each orb required three players to activate it, but Blizzard changed this so that an orb can be activated with just one player, and using certain abilities players can get to the other orb in time to also activate it\n\nAlso also, this is a [url=https://www.wowhead.com/achievement=5799/only-the-penitent#comments:id=3295626]good comment[/url] a little further down and has a video demo with several classes\n\n[b]General steps: (skip if you already know the basics of the achievement)[/b]\n[ol]\n[li]create a macro for /kneel and put it on a keybind for easy activation[/li]\n[li]Target the [npc=53619] casting [spell=99705] to see the cast bar for when it goes off[/li]\n[li]Head to the one of the orbs kneeling each time the spell triggers[/li]\n[li]There are three flame spots on the ground next to the orb, position yourself on the one closest to the stairs to reduce run distance to the other flame[sup]*[/sup][/li]\n[li]Point yourself to the other orb and stay kneeling on the spot till you are ready to execute the move - you will only have about 4s to perform the activations[/li]\n[/ol]\n[b]Druid specific steps:[/b]\n[ol]\n[li]Spec for [url=https://www.wowhead.com/spell=131768]Feline Swiftness[/url] and [spell=252216] for max burst speed (I tried [url=https://www.wowhead.com/spell=783]Travel Form[/url] with [url=https://www.wowhead.com/spell=102417]Wild Charge[/url] but wasn't successful)[/li]\n[li]switch to [url=https://www.wowhead.com/spell=768]Cat Form[/url] and use your kneel macro to make sure you're still kneeling on the spot[/li]\n[li]Just after a [spell=99705] cast, click the first orb to activate it[sup]** ***[/sup][/li]\n[li]Immediately [spell=252216] to the other orb and it's closest mark on the ground[/li]\n[li]Activate the orb and wait [sup]****[/sup][/li]\n[li]You got the achieve, Congratulations[/li]\n[li]or you didn't get the achieve, exit the instance and stay out of it for 30 mins and try again... when entering the instance if you waited long enough after about 10seconds the boss will yell across the raid zone indicating the soft reset[/li]\n[/ol]\n\n* I think you need to be on one of the marked spots next to the orb to [b]correctly[/b] activate it\n** After clicking the orb you don't have to channel the activation, you can immediately move to the other orb, but it may be prudent to see the flame channel briefly to confirm it activated\n*** It's suggested you briefly press forward before activating so you aren't kneeling, I don't know if this is required, but play around with it if you aren't having success\n**** Suggested to kneel here in case the next [spell=99705] cast messes with the orb activation and achievement\n\nWhen I did it, it was about 4seconds to get the second activation; I don't know what the max timeframe is, it may be longer and you simply need to avoid despawning the orbs from Kneel to the Flame!\n\nThis is going to be easier with two players, though personally I enjoy soloing the old achieves where possible, and it seems most (maybe all) classes have a way of doing this"},{"id":5756218,"r":3,"n":1,"b":"Just got this in Dragonflight. Tried about 20 times to do it solo on my Beast Master Hunter, and failed every time. I finally got it while attempting it with a friend. The orb clicking must be bugged, because we got to both orbs successfully 3 times and each time we clicked it, it didn't trigger. What eventually worked was we just spam clicked the orb over and over again and then the achievement finally triggered! I hope blizz looks into this and fixes whatever the issue is on their end. I should note, you have to not only be in a group, but you also need to Convert to Raid because the achievements are dependant on a raid group."},{"id":5912576,"r":10,"n":1,"b":"Just got this as a feral druid with 175% cat form speed + dash. Used a /kneel macro to sit in the little lava pool by the right orb. Took a small step forward, clicked orb 3 times and saw it start to open, dashed over to left orb, clicked a few times and did another /kneel before the cast finished. Had to reset and try maybe 20 times. You can use the portal back to the raid start, leave the raid, create a new group in the group finder and then right click on your portrait to convert that new group to a raid. You do NOT need to wait 30 minutes for the orbs to respawn if you mess it up."},{"id":5924448,"r":5,"n":0,"b":"Managed to solo today, first attempt, as warrior. Kneel next to one of the orbs, wait for the cast to finish, then leap to the other orb as soon as the cast finishes."},{"id":5951883,"r":3,"n":0,"b":"Soloed with a Goblin Hunter, clicked the orb > Aspect of the Cheetah > rocket jump > clicked the second and kneel, kneeling after clicking the second orb is needed.\nI followed the recommendation on this thread to reset and retry:\n[quote]You can use the portal back to the raid start, leave the raid, create a new group in the group finder and then right click on your portrait to convert that new group to a raid. You do NOT need to wait 30 minutes for the orbs to respawn if you mess it up.[/quote]"},{"id":5963249,"r":3,"n":0,"b":"I did this today after failing it a few times with my DH and a few other classes. Not a difficult achievement, but a rather annoying one.\r\nI recommend using a mage, dh, and a warrior. IMO the easiest classes to do this with. With a warrior you just heroic leap to the other orb and that's it.\r\nI completed this with my DH today after watching a guy on YT. Reach the first orb, watch the druid's casting, once he's finished the casting that fiery spell, use metamorphosis and fel rush to get to the other orb and wait a bit. That's what i did and got it. Like i said, rather annoying achievement, but not one of those that drives you insane. And i also got the Glory of the Firelands raider achievement :)"},{"id":6003681,"r":12,"n":0,"b":"\"kneeling after clicking the second orb is needed\". This sentence made me get out of my anguish after watching tons of guides to see what I was doing wrong try after try, without managing to spot a flaw in the execution.\r\n\r\nOne try of kneeling after clicking the seccond orb, and [i]voilà[/i]!"},{"id":6046843,"r":5,"n":0,"b":"I can confirm the clicking Orbs is STILL bugged. I tried solo with Warrior and Mage but kept failing. Even tried doing it on both at the same time with two accounts and after few fail tries, duo option worked.\r\n\r\nBottom line is, even if you are trying with a team of duo and it still fails, just do the soft reset and keep trying. It will eventually work."},{"id":6077467,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"Some people consider getting Exalted with Uldum Accord. to be hell on earth Honestly, I consider this achieve to be that. \r\n\r\nBut I know my limits and simply won't put myself hell trying - unless I weaken and join a guild one day, that can carry me. I will happily grind rep and assuage my OCD and leave this sort of achieve well alone.\r\n\r\nIf you've got this achieve - congratulations to you !"},{"id":6096347,"r":9,"n":1,"b":"As a mage.. you stand on the swirly stuff on the ground at the orb to the right.. than when your ready you  press alter time. blink over to the other one. kneel, than you press the orb, right after that, you will be teleport back to the first one. press it. and kneel again.   worked just fine for me.  just make sure your standing in the right spot."},{"id":6148406,"r":6,"n":0,"b":"Just did this on a mistweaver monk after like 20 attempts, some helpful notes no matter the class:\r\n\r\n1. Set a keybind macro for /kneel.\r\n2. Make sure you kneel enough in advance that you aren't too slow to do so causing you to fail.\r\n3. Make sure you're on one of the three fire sphere symbols on the ground on both orbs when you /kneel and click on them, if you aren't you can't complete the achievement. Also you have to /kneel before you click the second one or the achievement will not count (that took me the longest to figure out).\r\n\r\nHope that's helpful!"},{"id":6150568,"r":6,"n":0,"b":"7/29/2025 in TWW\r\n\r\nI tried soloing it a million times on my warrior. I followed the steps perfectly. Kneeling to dodge the flame casts, stood in the flame aura, stood up before clicking first orb, etc. YOU NEED TO BE IN A RAID GROUP EVEN WHEN SOLOING IT OR IT WILL NOT POP. As soon as I invited a second person and converted to a raid group, I went in and did it on the first attempt. The second person doesn't even need to be inside the raid!\r\n\r\nCheers :)"},{"id":6242057,"r":3,"n":0,"b":"Just in case anyone is running this in 2025 and is as incompetent as I am, a couple things. \r\n- The egg orb things won't appear unless you've killed most of the trash mobs. \r\n- If you step in the boss arena at any time and you aren't kneeling when his cast goes off, the eggs will disappear and you can't reset the boss to get them back, don't walk forward until you're ready to begin the interaction and make sure to kneel each time before he gets his cast off."},{"id":6268772,"r":9,"n":3,"b":"Adding a comment for 2026 achievement hunters. I tried this on several classes (DM, Warrior, monk) and could not get this. Switched to my Mage and used the alter time method and got it first try. I even fumbled the second alter time click and still got it. Some tips that worked for me as I’ve seen some contradicting info in these comments;\r\n1. When you get to the orbs kneel in the fire on the inner circle.\r\n2. Immediately after a fire spell, cast alter time then simmer x2 to the other orb and kneel in the fire again. \r\n3. After the fire spell goes off again click the orb. Give a second or two to activate. \r\n4. Hit alter time again and click first orb. May take a second to activate and then boom you got it. \r\n5. I was in a raid group alone. Not sure if that helped or not. \r\n6. I knelt again after I clicked the second orb but I think the achievement popped before I knelt so can’t confirm if this is required. \r\n\r\nGood luck everyone. This one was really frustrating until I tried this method. Highly recommend trying it."},{"id":6288490,"r":4,"n":1,"b":"[b]2026 - SOLO[/b]\r\nHow to quickly retry this and get the achievement:\r\nI picked Demon Hunter for this. But I have seen people doing it with a class without any dash/blink.\r\n\r\n[ol]\r\n[li]First, create a macro for /kneel and put it in an easily accessible keybind.\r\nWe do this because in the red area, if you are hit by the AoE flame, the orbs will disappear.[/li]\r\n\r\n[li]Reach one orb, it does not matter which. Kneel near it.[/li]\r\n\r\n[li][b]IMPORTANT: You must be very close to the orb. Otherwise, you will see the channeling animation, but nothing happens.[/b][/li]\r\n\r\n[li]After the druid completes his cast, move a bit so you are no longer kneeling. We do this because channeling can bug out while kneeling.[/li]\r\n\r\n[li]Activate that orb.[/li]\r\n\r\n[li]Now we need to reach the other orb quickly. I used Metamorphosis + Fel Rush for this. I have seen people do it using only movement speed boosts.[/li]\r\n\r\n[li]After making sure you are near it, click on it as well.[/li]\r\n\r\n[li][b]IMPORTANT: After activating the second orb, kneel again. Some people noted that this is required.[/b][/li]\r\n[/ol]\r\n\r\n[b]IF YOU FAIL[/b]\r\n[ul]\r\n[li]There is a portal after you cross the bridge. Just return to it. It will teleport you to the entrance. The opposite also applies, do not walk every time. Use the portal near the entrance, down the stairs.[/li]\r\n[li]Leave the raid. Then reset all instances. Go to Premade Groups and start a group (it does not matter which raid you choose) and convert it to raid. Enter the raid again. It is reset. Enter the portal and try again.[/li]\r\n[/ul]"},{"id":6307334,"r":-1,"n":2,"b":"2026\n\nI don't think its possible with druid in cat form.\n\nI've clicked on the first orb (saw a line attach to my toon) dash to the second orb and click it successfully and kneel afterwards before a cast goes off. What happens is that the second orb disappears but the first one remains.\n\nWill try other options.\n\nEDIT (a few days later):\n\nGot this to work fully while in druid cat form.\n\nThings I did:\n\n1. Start from the middle swirly of the right orb and run to the middle swirly of the left orb.\n2. Click the first orb many many times, like 3 times because it doesn't register that well.\n3. When you reach the second orb, also click it many times, spam click.\n4. You don't need to be in a raid group or anything like that. \n5. I kneeled after I clicked the second orb, don't know if that helps or not."},{"id":6309220,"r":3,"n":0,"b":"I just think this achievement bugs out a lot.\r\nI've tried this on many a class, though it's usually my warrior I try it with the most.\r\nI did finally get it to pop today on a flameshaper devastation evoker while farming eternal embers.\r\n\r\nI started on the left orb instead of the right like I usually do. Because I'm a creature of habit but decided to do something different.\r\nStood as far away from the orb as possible while still being able to click it to make the travel distance shorter, clicked as soon as the latest kneel to the flame cast went off, zoomed to the other orb, clicked, and pressed my kneel macro.\r\nThen the achievement popped.\r\n\r\nAdmittedly, I was surprised, because I didn't exactly do anything remarkably different from every other time I tried besides going to the left orb instead of the right, so I guess if you're still trying, don't give up and you'll get it eventually?\r\nOr do what I was planning to do since I assumed I was just never going to make it happen and bring a buddy in with you."}]}{"id":5810,"comments":[{"id":2022457,"r":449,"n":4,"b":"Just dps his right leg. Easy-cheesy."}]}{"id":5813,"comments":[{"id":1409715,"r":175,"n":3,"b":"Actually you just have to press Z or R twice to get this achievement."},{"id":1410577,"r":107,"n":1,"b":"This is one of the popular quotes said by Peppy in Star Fox 64. It's pretty nice for Blizzard to put in a bunny icon as a tribute to this quote."},{"id":1484957,"r":136,"n":2,"b":"[i][small]Since Wowhead is only showing \"Alysrazor slain\" 4 times...[/small][/i]\n\n\nHere is the ingame criteria aka stuff you should not get hit by (as of patch 4.2):\n[ul]\n[li][url=http://www.wowhead.com/spell=98868][b]Brushfire[/b][/url][small] (Flying Phase)[/small]: The [url=http://www.wowhead.com/npc=53896]Blazing Talon Initiate[/url] conjures a fiery ball that moves across the arena.[/li]\n[li][url=http://www.wowhead.com/spell=99427][b]Incendiary Cloud[/b][/url][small] (Flying Phase)[/small]: Alysrazor periodically creates an increasing number of Incendiary Clouds lasting for 3 seconds.[/li]\n[li][url=http://www.wowhead.com/spell=99335][b]Lava Spew[/b][/url][small] (Flying Phase)[/small]: [url=http://www.wowhead.com/npc=53520]Plump Lava Worms[/url] spew a molten cone of fire, dealing damage to all enemies within a 35 degree cone.[/li]\n[li][url=http://www.wowhead.com/spell=99816][b]Fiery Tornado[/b][/url][small] (Transition after Flying Phase)[/small]: Fiery Tornadoes erupt from the Fiery Vortex and begin moving rapidly around Alysrazor's arena in circles.[/li]\n[/ul]\n\n[i]Remember: The achievement says, every raidmember has to avoid everything.[/i]\n\nThis achievement looks like it's based on the [url=http://www.wowhead.com/npc=33350]Mimiron[/url] achievement [url=http://www.wowhead.com/achievement=3237]Set Up Us the Bomb[/url], which could be done in multiple parts, meaning that one week your raiders could focus on not getting hit by Brushfires, Clouds and Lava Spews, and the next week you strictly avoid the Vortexes.\nAlso the achievement criteria counts for each raidmember. So following the example above, if someone is not able to raid the second week, where you avoid the Vortexes, he still has completed the 3 other criteria and so it is possible for him to get another raid in which every raidmember avoids the Vortexes and so he still gets his achievement.\n\n[b]Long story short[/b]: [b][u]Every[/u][/b] raidmember has to [b][u]avoid things[/u][/b], but [b][u]each[/u][/b] raidmember gets [b][u]personal credit[/u][/b].\n\nEdit: [url=http://www.ascendance-guild.eu/eqdkp/viewnews.php]Ascendance[/url] on EU-Alonsus was the first guild to complete this achievement, so they also were the first ones who completed [url=http://www.wowhead.com/achievement=5828]Glory of the Firelands Raider[/url].\n[small][i]Other Edits: Typos ;)[/i][/small]"},{"id":1523672,"r":102,"n":4,"b":"Just wanted to verify that even if you avoid everything, if you die before she's dead you will not receive credit for the achievement. We had 8 in our raid receive it but everyone else did not, anyone who didn't get credit happened to be dead."}]}{"id":5821,"comments":[]}{"id":5829,"comments":[{"id":1425046,"r":278,"n":1,"b":"Kiting a hunter?"},{"id":1487169,"r":99,"n":2,"b":"To the two posters above me: the term \"Bucket List\" has been around FAR longer than 2007 when that film was released, or even 2006.\r\n\r\nI remember people talking about having a bucket list (same usage - a list of things to do before you died) back in the 90s...\r\n\r\nI love how popular media tends to define where folks give attribution. \"The most popular place I found it must be first if I'd never encountered it before then!\""},{"id":1499549,"r":107,"n":1,"b":"Not really a hard achievment, just time consuming.\r\nSome quick notes:\r\nKilling Rageface at the start will helps alot (If you don't already do that for your Regular strat)\r\nDon't let Shannox get too far away from Riplimb, use Riplimb's run back with the spear to get some distance with a fast kite\r\nYou do not have to actually go up to Beth'tilac's room or even any of the trash to her room, Along the side of the cliff to her room you can get credit for being in \"Beth'tilac's lair\"\r\nEnrage really shouldn't pose an issue unless you kite him too slowly.\r\nThat's about it, same stuff as the actual fight just a lot of movement and don't get hit by traps, ect"},{"id":1625485,"r":555,"n":1,"b":"I'm surprised, noone have linked the map, where you need to go, but here is it..\r\nhttp://www.wowhead.com/maps?data=5723:340308291623341751616559612454"},{"id":1854340,"r":86,"n":3,"b":"[ul]\n[li][b]Easily solo'd by anyone with the following tips:[/b][/li]\n[/ul]\n\n[i][b][u]Before spawning Shannox:[/u][/b][/i] ([i]Highly Recommended[/i])\n[ul][li][b][Optional][/b]: [i]Set your Achievement to \"Tracking\"[/i] so you can see the exact moment when you've succesfully covered a zone.[/li]\n - [li][b][Optional][/b]: If you have not cleared Firelands trash yet, I [i]strongly recommend[/i] clearing the mobs along the entire northern edge of the zone (Mobs between The Ridge of Ancient Flame to the Path of Corruption), as well as the dogs who quickly run and patrol the paths throughout Firelands. \nThis will not only make the achievement significantly easier, but typically it's exactly enough mobs to spawn Shannox; saving you time.  \nIf you have already cleared trash, it's OK, just be careful of the insane aggro range of mobs before the Path of Corruption (even at level 90).[/li][/ul]\n\n[i][b][u]Bucket List; Kiting Shannox the easy way!:[/u][/b][/i]\n [ol][li]After clearing trash, mount up and wait near the ramp taking you to Rhyolith and wait for Shannox to come around to you.[/li] \n - [li]When he's near, stay mounted, get close to pull him, but run up the ramp towards Rhyolith until the achievement tracker turns from red to white.[/li]\n - [li]From there jump off the side, landing in the Shatterstone, kite him deep into the shatters tone (still mounted) so you can run a wide circle around him and get out with minimal to no damage.[/li] \n - [li]Run to path of corruption, up the hill, and hide in the little nook until he's near (Don't worry, if you were fast, he will take awhile to catch up, but he wont reset if you get too far away)[/li]\n - [li]Pop out of the nook as soon as the achievement tracker turns from red to white, then head towards Bethtilac (this would be the only point where Shannox may hit and dismount you, but you're almost done)[/li] \n - [li][b][i]Important!:[/i][/b] When going towards Bethtilac, you [i]can skip[/i] actually going to Bethtilac's Lair by looking for the last little \"lump / mound of dirt\" or mini hill hugging the wall [i]before[/i] the captured/webbed Molten Giant. Kite Shannox [i][u]over[/u][/i] the tiny mound and you'll receive credit without ever going near Beth's actual area![/li] \n - [li]Finally... head straight up the ramp where you entered the raid at (Flame Breach) and kill boss there![/li]\n - [li]From there, follow any of the hundreds of standard solo methods to down him; most notably... (see below if you need help killing the boss).[/li][/ol]\n\n- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - [b][i]CONGRATULATIONS ON YOUR ACHIEVEMENT![/i][/b] - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - \n\n - [i][b]If you messed up; Don't worry![/b][/i] - if you messed up, got dismounted, or missed a zone, just go back and get it!  No need to reset the entire encounter. The boss's enrage/berserk timer is rediculously long; enough time for you to backpedal on foot around Firelands twice again.   \n - The only way to mess this up is to kill him without ensuring the achievement trackers all changed from \"red\" to \"white\".\n[br]\n[small]v v v v v v v v v v v v v v v v v v v v v v v v v v v v v v v v v [/small][b]! - [i]OPTIONAL[/i] - ! - [u]Boss-Specific Tips for Beginners Only[/u] - ! - [i]OPTIONAL[/i] - ![/b][small] v v v v v v v v v v v v v v v v v v v v v v v v v v v v v v v v v v [/small]\n[small] \n- If you're dying to Shannox, make sure to clear your stacks JUST BEFORE finishing off Rage Face and Rip Limb by slowing/snaring Rip Limb when you hear \"Fetch your Supper!\", and then out-running them until stacks clear.  \n - If you're inexperienced, do this when Rage Face and Rip Limb reach 25% HP or so, because if Shannox catches up to you before your debuff falls off, you have to do it again.  If you know what you're doing, it's safe to clear stacks literally at 1% HP then finish them off.\n - Once Rip Limb dies, the only way to clear your debuffs is through extreme measures (Darkwater Potion + Nitro Boots + Warrior-charge x 2 the critters + Heroic Leap) etc; and Rage Face dying just adds to the damage. \n - If you're in an actual group and level 90, but used this guide to essentially earn the achievement for everyone, just remind everyone of Rage Face's \"Face Rage\" ability, or else you [i]will[/i] get pinned down and [i]can not[/i] attack until you're broken out; then nuke the crap out of him! [/small]"},{"id":2016976,"r":189,"n":9,"b":"If you're looking for information on how to solo this easily in the glorious post-6.0 era of utterly wrecking old content to get achievement mounts :\n\nJust in case you were wondering why you are getting stunned to death while some posts on here never mention it... No need to kill the bosses.\r\nIf you're max level, take off your gear in case anything procs because you can't prematurely kill Shannox before dragging him to all five points.\r\n\r\nUnder the Objectives, all five points will be in red text. I went clockwise to the other four points. At the end, once at The Ridge of Ancient Flame (which was my last point), then I killed Shannox, which completed this for me.\r\n\r\nI recommend going in this direction because you're free of adds leading up to the bosses on the other four points outside of Flamebreach. What is the meaning of this?"},{"id":1456281,"r":264,"n":2,"b":"We got this achievement in our Ragnaros kill... by accident.\n\nBut I'll describe exactly how you get it.\n\nLiving Meteors are spawned in Phase 3 (40% - 10%), they will spawn one every so often and fixate on a random raid members. If they are attacked, they get knocked back the opposite direction, and then fixate a new target and go after it. They can only be knocked back every 5 seconds or so, and they go faster and faster as they fixate the target. In addition, they have a huge amount of health, so killing them is out of the question. You just have to kite it.\n\nAnyways, Lava wave comes from the Sulfuras hammer, which Rag uses in all phases. When his hammer hits the ground, it spawns three lava waves, one which travels directly in front of it, and two that go left and right of it. You need to have the meteors hit by this lava to get the \"Lavalogged\" debuff. The debuff doesn't seem to serve any purpose other than to track for the achievement, and the debuff does not go away (EDIT - Possibly goes away after one minute? Need more info)\n\nOnce you have three \"Lavalogged\" Meteors, kill the boss, and the achievement is yours.\n\nThe reason we got it accidentally is because we killed the boss just barely with only a few people alive, so the meteors were going all over the place to aggro new people, including through the lava waves, so I guess we got lucky.\n\nI would imagine though that the best way to go about this achievement is to wait for Lava waves to happen, and then position yourself so that when you hit the meteor, it will get knocked back into the lava being formed by the hammer. Do that for all three meteors and there you go..."},{"id":1480460,"r":127,"n":0,"b":"Posted this almost 2 years ago on the page for the MC version of Rag, but it seems to be a better fit here:\r\n\r\nBrought to you by Tarren Mill... Ragnar-Os!\r\nThe only cereal with the Molten Core!\r\nBY FIBER BE PURGED!\r\nTASTE THE FLAVORS OF SULFURON!\r\nTWO SCOOPS, EXECUTUS! TWO SCOOPS!"},{"id":2082155,"r":141,"n":6,"b":"Completed this today with my 640 frost mage, on 10 man normal. \n\nAs already stated, bring Raggy down to below 30% (but above 10%) as quick as possible. \nIf you have a pet, place that in melee range of Raggy, and put it on passive. \nWait for the Living Meteors to spawn. These will fixate on you, and roll after you. They can be knocked back by a single attack (they have plenty of HP). You wan't to keep these knocked back and away from you. \nWhen you have three fixated on you, you need to get all three of them hit by a lava wave. These are caused by Ragnoros' smash. \n\n[b]If you have the achievement tracked, it will start out red, and turn white when the criteria has been done and you can kill Raggy.[/b]\n\nTip for frost mages: I left a Magma Trap up on purpose, so when I had my three meteors, I waited until just before the timer for the smash, jump in the trap and got hurled up. All the meteors gathered directly below me on a nice neat pile and got hit by the lava wave. I used slow fall and ice lanced spam Raggy. Just before I hit the ground, I used blink to get away from the meteors, and finished Raggy off. Win!"},{"id":5527972,"r":4,"n":0,"b":"If you're having trouble with Living Meteors not spawning - try switching your tank spec to a dps spec, that fixed the issue for me."},{"id":5707565,"r":3,"n":0,"b":"On Heroic mode at 10.1.7, when the IAT says criteria met, boss can be killed. Be careful not to stand too much on the side because the meteors threw me in the air and I ended up in the lava below and died, so try to stay in the middle of the platform.\nThen when I ran into the lava wave, the achievement tracker told me I can kill the boss. It didn't seem like drone1 ran out of energy before smoldering devastation1, so you'll probably have to have a guy tanking during the fiery rain aoe.\n\nThen whenever a drone runs out of energy it goes upstairs, and whichever dps you have up there kill it quickly. Not a difficult achievement, assuming everyone knows the fight."},{"id":1536634,"r":26,"n":1,"b":"We did this on 10HC tonight, we was a bit confused as you end up with a couple of drones left over in Phase 2 but just keep them alive when she dies and you will get this achievement."},{"id":1550886,"r":14,"n":0,"b":"Be careful when doing this achievement, be sure to kill the drone when it is up top asap.  When it is a done draining enough energy from Beth'tilac the drone will be immune to death for a few seconds and begin to drop down at which point it no longer counts for the achievement.\r\n\r\nA GM also said \"If all drones were killed up top and none reached the floor a second time and the achievement was not earned, then something may have gone wrong.\" which makes it seem that if a drone actually makes it to the top it MUST be killed and not allowed to hit the floor again.\r\n\r\nThe in-game achievement tracker showed a pass the entire fight even when we killed the drone as it started to drop again but we did not get the achievement; we figured it would still count so it was easy.\r\n\r\nNormal or heroic you will end up with 2 drones left on the bottom during the burn phase."},{"id":1637551,"r":37,"n":0,"b":"I noticed it hasn't been said specifically here so i thought i'd clarify.\n\nIf you're trying this achievement with a group of decently geared people, you can COMPLETELY ignore the drones.
