When she landed for us after the 3rd devastation, she was at 30% hp, then we just popped hero and burnt her for our achievement."},{"id":1638019,"r":14,"n":1,"b":"We attempted (and succeeded) with the following:\r\n\r\n(Majority of raid is DS normal/lfr geared)\r\n\r\n2 tanks,  3 heals, 5 DPS.\r\n\r\nDruid tanked ALL drones, picked them up as they came out of the caves and as they came back down from top of web after they ascended when their energy ran dry.\r\n\r\nWarrior (with Vengeance on druid) taunted on all Spinners down. \r\n\r\nDPS kill Spinners and Spiderlings.\r\n\r\nNO ONE goes up, NO ONE touches the Drones.\r\n\r\nWhen Beth comes down, the Warrior picks up and all burn down Beth while keeping both tanks topped as best you can.\r\n\r\nRead the achievement and believe it. We did. As long as the DRONES do not die on the lower level you will achieve."},{"id":1778250,"r":14,"n":0,"b":"If you look at the icon, you can see the number 7.\r\nWhat has been seen..."},{"id":1854201,"r":5,"n":0,"b":"Easy solo for Warriors with at least LFR ToT gear.\r\nGo Prot spec, wearing heavy DPS gear and at least 1 stamina trinket, emphasis on Crit and crit gems.\r\nStr flask, food, drums of kings, runescroll of fortitude.\r\n2nd wind will heal you through the entire encounter so no worries on survivability.\r\n\r\nStrategy:\r\nAt the start, taunt a cinder spider down, immediately take the web to the top where Beth is, ignoring all adds below.\r\nAt the top, DPS all out, no need for rotating defensive cooldowns, spam Heroic Strike, whatever gets the most DPS in for you, leaving at least a little rage for each Smoldering Devastation. \r\nFirst Smoldering Devastation: Demo Shout, Rally cry, and Shield Barrier (you'll live easy)\r\n2nd Smoldering Devastation: Demo Shout, Last Stand, Shield Barrier.\r\n3rd (and if your DPS was good enough you won't have a 3rd) Shield Wall with Demo shout and Shield Barrier. Ideally you will have taken her down enough to where there won't be a 3rd.\r\nFinal phase follow her down, Rally Cry (and Shield Wall if you didn't reach a 3rd Smoldering Dev), Burn her fast, pop Health Potion if needed, and due to Vengeance she should be dead within seconds.\r\n\r\nMy exact setup was simply Crit everything, Bloodbath, Dragon roar, 1 Stan trinket, and Brutal Talisman Trinket. \r\nTough fight, but thrilling and not overwhelming.\r\n\r\nIf you followed above, no Cinder web Spinners will have died, ever, and instant achievement."},{"id":1928713,"r":4,"n":0,"b":"Did it with a Destruction Warlock (567).\r\n\r\nKill 1 Cinderweb Spinner\r\nNuke boss\r\n\r\nEasy solo achievement :):):)\r\n\r\n*Using GoSac\r\n*Only casting Incinerate. Embers are for self heal (Ember tap)\r\n\r\nMake sure to use CD's for Smoldering Devastation ^-^"},{"id":2056527,"r":64,"n":2,"b":"For those who never went to Firelands and want this achievement!\nThis achievement is really easy.\n\n- Engage the boss\n- She or He [!] goes up. Some [b]Cinder Web Spiders[/b] dangling from roof to the mid ground.\n- Kill ONE of them, After that u can jump on its web and go up\n- Nuke boss until she/he comes down \n-- If during this phase u fell down again and boss is up, again kill one of the dangling spiders and go up and nuke boss\n- At final phase when boss goes to the ground [u]try to only damage her and not the adds [[DRONES]][/u]  [b]avoid splash or AoE damages[/b], \n\nBang, you've got yourself the achievement."},{"id":2057849,"r":0,"n":0,"b":"[quote][b]Soloing at 100. [/b][/quote]\r\n\r\nRunning through Firelands as a Blood [class=6] at level 100 - This for me was the most annoying boss to solo, but [u]it is[/u] do-able.\r\n\r\nI killed it on 25man Heoric, the trick was to save any movement impairing breakers until I was stunned (as a DK, only [spell=48792] did the job.) Once released from the stun, the trick is to kill as many of the hanging spiders as you can, if like me you've spent all your time above the web; there may be a few. \r\n\r\nAfter AoEing the ones I could, I then had to single target and became stunned again. I waited until the 24 second stun had worn off and in the second I was unstunned, I would spam an instant damage cast to kill the remaining adds - One per every 24 seconds, so if you cannot survive the stun you [i]will not [/i]be able to do this. \r\n\r\nA [u]good note[/u] is to remember is that as well as using instant casts to kill the ones stunning you, you can also use that brief second you have to pop any CDs that may be useful as well as any [i]health pots.[/i]"},{"id":2078111,"r":-1,"n":0,"b":"This is really easy to do on any 90+ character now. The achievement can be done on 10 man normal so if you just want this achievement it makes sense to run it on this difficulty so that the fight is at its easiest. I have a video of me doing it with a level 92 fury warrior (558 ilevel) [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jdzO8Qs5zoI&list=UUas7lMpcp73cLLhOJDEix_Q]here [/url] any level 100 should have no trouble with this."},{"id":2147651,"r":-1,"n":0,"b":"I soloed this easy after i saw this guide https://youtu.be/fCICLW6KojY !"},{"id":2398711,"r":6,"n":0,"b":"ok.I got this Achievement on my druid.When you enter Beth'tilac's Lair, You see a lot Spiders with birds.I didn't kill them all , just in stealth mode I passed them all ( without killing any NPCs) then reached Boss.\nnow You Attack boss then Boss will go up.Wait for Cinderweb Spinner ( on 10 man , It does have 20K HP) , kill only one (there are 3 or 4) and Then Click Red Rope.Rope will bring you to boss to face it and then Nuke boss.\n\nI don't know If you kill all NPCs at entrance ( before reaching boss) , You still can get achievement or not."},{"id":2614607,"r":5,"n":1,"b":"It case it wasn't clear to everyone, the achievement is only in regards to Cinderweb [b]Drones [/b]-- [u]not [/u]Cinderweb [b]Spinners[/b]!  The spiders that hang from the ceiling that you need to kill in order to get lines up to the top of the canopy are Spinners, so feel free to kill them as much as you want.  The Cinderweb Drones are the bigger spiders that hang out on the ground, not dangling from webs.\r\n\r\nAlso, I just got this achievement without killing any Cinderweb Drones at all... I just killed a Cinderweb Spinner to get up top, then burned down the boss, and then the boss dropped back down to the floor when she had virtually no health left, then she died almost immediately after we got back to the ground -- I didn't even attack her on the ground, I think she may have just died from the DoT she had on her.  I confirmed from my combat log that I never attacked any Cinderweb Drones, but I still got the achievement.\r\n\r\nVery easy to solo."}]}{"id":5830,"comments":[{"id":1411029,"r":44,"n":0,"b":"First we [url=http://www.wowhead.com/achievement=2152]Shared the Love[/url] and now we will [achievement=5830]."},{"id":1456163,"r":21,"n":0,"b":"DPS race achievement. The better your dps is, the less crystals will spawn and the easier it'll become. With 370+ geared raid in 25man, this was relatively easy to do (accidentally, I might add). We used 6 healers, and looking at the logs we had 2 ranged group DPSers not taking even 1 tick, and we still got the achievement. I can imagine 10man being harder with just 5 dpsers, but it should still be doable.\n\nMy biggest advice would be to have good communication. We separated our ranged crystal group (10), melee crystal group (7) and healers/tanks to different vent channels. You don't really need to know who's healing who when you're organizing the rotations for crystal tanking. Use dispersion and other similar cooldowns to prolong stacking so that you only need 2 people for a crystal every now and then. Shadow priests might want to switch SWD glyph to dispersion glyph, you don't want to use SWD with the +250% shadow damage taken debuff.\n\nEDIT: Like Silhac pointed out, this achievement is about how many times you have the debuff that you get when you leave the crystal. Not about how many stacks you get before moving out from the crystal."},{"id":1465672,"r":29,"n":0,"b":"The thing that people don't understand is due to the wording. It's not based on how many stacks you have, but how many times you have received the Torment debuff in any way. Basically, if you go to the crystal to receive torment more than three times, you won't receive the achievement. If you DON'T, regardless of how many stacks you took each time, you get it."},{"id":1475258,"r":8,"n":1,"b":"Also got this by accident last night. All you need to do is to kill him fast enough (took me 13 seconds on Normal difficulty)."},{"id":2398760,"r":3,"n":0,"b":"I solo It with Feral Druid ilvl 609.\nI First killed 4 [npc=54161] then 2 [npc=54143] and then used all CD to nuke it very fast.\nAccording to Combat log \n17:32:12 [npc=53494] Melee hit You 2863 Physical\n17:32:12 [spell=99259] [spell=99256] hit You 126 Shadow\n17:32:13 [npc=53494] Melee hit You 1215 Physical\n17:32:13 [spell=99259] [spell=99256] hit You 126 Shadow\n17:32:14 [npc=53494] Melee hit You 2215 Physical\n17:32:14 [spell=99259] [spell=99256] hit You 126 Shadow\n17:32:15 You Killed [npc=53494]\n\nSo yes you must Nuke it Very fast."}]}[{"id":6268772,"n":3,"b":"Adding a comment for 2026 achievement hunters. I tried this on several classes (DM, Warrior, monk) and could not get this. Switched to my Mage and used the alter time method and got it first try. I even fumbled the second alter time click and still got it. Some tips that worked for me as I’ve seen some contradicting info in these comments;\r\n1. When you get to the orbs kneel in the fire on the inner circle.\r\n2. Immediately after a fire spell, cast alter time then simmer x2 to the other orb and kneel in the fire again. \r\n3. After the fire spell goes off again click the orb. Give a second or two to activate. \r\n4. Hit alter time again and click first orb. May take a second to activate and then boom you got it. \r\n5. I was in a raid group alone. Not sure if that helped or not. \r\n6. I knelt again after I clicked the second orb but I think the achievement popped before I knelt so can’t confirm if this is required. \r\n\r\nGood luck everyone. This one was really frustrating until I tried this method. Highly recommend trying it."},{"id":6288490,"n":1,"b":"[b]2026 - SOLO[/b]\r\nHow to quickly retry this and get the achievement:\r\nI picked Demon Hunter for this. But I have seen people doing it with a class without any dash/blink.\r\n\r\n[ol]\r\n[li]First, create a macro for /kneel and put it in an easily accessible keybind.\r\nWe do this because in the red area, if you are hit by the AoE flame, the orbs will disappear.[/li]\r\n\r\n[li]Reach one orb, it does not matter which. Kneel near it.[/li]\r\n\r\n[li][b]IMPORTANT: You must be very close to the orb. Otherwise, you will see the channeling animation, but nothing happens.[/b][/li]\r\n\r\n[li]After the druid completes his cast, move a bit so you are no longer kneeling. We do this because channeling can bug out while kneeling.[/li]\r\n\r\n[li]Activate that orb.[/li]\r\n\r\n[li]Now we need to reach the other orb quickly. I used Metamorphosis + Fel Rush for this. I have seen people do it using only movement speed boosts.[/li]\r\n\r\n[li]After making sure you are near it, click on it as well.[/li]\r\n\r\n[li][b]IMPORTANT: After activating the second orb, kneel again. Some people noted that this is required.[/b][/li]\r\n[/ol]\r\n\r\n[b]IF YOU FAIL[/b]\r\n[ul]\r\n[li]There is a portal after you cross the bridge. Just return to it. It will teleport you to the entrance. The opposite also applies, do not walk every time. Use the portal near the entrance, down the stairs.[/li]\r\n[li]Leave the raid. Then reset all instances. Go to Premade Groups and start a group (it does not matter which raid you choose) and convert it to raid. Enter the raid again. It is reset. Enter the portal and try again.[/li]\r\n[/ul]"},{"id":6307334,"n":2,"b":"2026\n\nI don't think its possible with druid in cat form.\n\nI've clicked on the first orb (saw a line attach to my toon) dash to the second orb and click it successfully and kneel afterwards before a cast goes off. What happens is that the second orb disappears but the first one remains.\n\nWill try other options.\n\nEDIT (a few days later):\n\nGot this to work fully while in druid cat form.\n\nThings I did:\n\n1. Start from the middle swirly of the right orb and run to the middle swirly of the left orb.\n2. Click the first orb many many times, like 3 times because it doesn't register that well.\n3. When you reach the second orb, also click it many times, spam click.\n4. You don't need to be in a raid group or anything like that. \n5. I kneeled after I clicked the second orb, don't know if that helps or not."},{"id":6309220,"n":0,"b":"I just think this achievement bugs out a lot.\r\nI've tried this on many a class, though it's usually my warrior I try it with the most.\r\nI did finally get it to pop today on a flameshaper devastation evoker while farming eternal embers.\r\n\r\nI started on the left orb instead of the right like I usually do. Because I'm a creature of habit but decided to do something different.\r\nStood as far away from the orb as possible while still being able to click it to make the travel distance shorter, clicked as soon as the latest kneel to the flame cast went off, zoomed to the other orb, clicked, and pressed my kneel macro.\r\nThen the achievement popped.\r\n\r\nAdmittedly, I was surprised, because I didn't exactly do anything remarkably different from every other time I tried besides going to the left orb instead of the right, so I guess if you're still trying, don't give up and you'll get it eventually?\r\nOr do what I was planning to do since I assumed I was just never going to make it happen and bring a buddy in with you."}]

He might even be easier than Alysrazor, I'm not sure about that. We never downed a Cata HM boss or even end boss like Ragna as fast as this one. I think. No boasting here, that's how it worked out for us. And we're nowhere near the top!\nBut really, he's downright easy if you get a few basic things right:\n\nscorp:\n- start with scorp phase, leave 3 DDs out (ours were MM hunter, BM hunter, rogue) in first, 1 (rogue) in the following, and 0 when he's got 6 fury stacks and more.\n- in the 1st scorp phase, wait for up to 12 cleaves (or more if you handle it), stack raid CDs. in the following scorp phases, take 6 or 7 cleaves. use raid CDs everytime they're ready (should be in the 3rd scorp phase) to delay the transition.\n- everyone who can should be using defensive CDs to mitigate high damage bursts at the end of the scorp phase.\ncat:\n- hero/lust as soon as everyone has maxed out concentration\n- always do 7 stacks in cat, spread well, positioning is key to avoid healrange and concentration issues\n- assign the orbs well; we used tank/melee and hpally/spriest for max damage. mind that the ranged orb soakers should keep distance between each other to prevent charge damage.\n- make sure that a melee has maxed out concentration for most of the fight to cleave down the adds.\n\nthis is for 10m. i neither know nor care about 25m :P"},{"id":1515346,"r":4,"n":0,"b":"An update on rilgania's method to maximise dps for lower dps groups.\r\n[url=http://www.wowhead.com/spell=97235]Fury[/url], the buff that the boss gains each time he shapeshifts, which increases scythe and leap damage. Note that, it doesnt increase melee and other spell damage of boss.\r\nThe idea is to skip scrop and avoid getting damaged by leap.\r\n\r\nFor scrop, tank should blow [url=http://www.wowhead.com/item=68713]cooldown[/url] and eat the first scythe away from the raid. Spread out to cat phase immediately after first scythe. (or just spread out 2 sec before the cooldown for the 1st scythe ends) \r\n\r\nFor cat, have melee deal with the spirits and keep range in clusters. Range should keep an eye on boss's energy, when energy reaches 100, start moving to avoid getting hit by leap. \r\n\r\nYou can repeat this indefiantely untill the boss enrages."},{"id":2489598,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"If you're trying to do this on heroic for the achievements, and not sure why you're not getting them. Like he knows you kicked his ass, but he just doesn't care. Morchok doesn't afraid of anything!"},{"id":1598768,"r":7,"n":0,"b":"Short guide for 10 mans (how our raid did the 1st kill):\n\n[b]Setup[/b]\n- 2 Tanks (druid, warrior)\n- 4 Healers (druid, shaman, 2 priests)\n- 4 DDs (2 hunter, mage, rogue)\n\n[b]Normal Phase[/b]\nThis boss is fairly simple. Split in two even groups and tank the bosses ~60-80y apart. Assign a DD or healer to soak the Stomp along the tank; we did it with hunter and rogue and their -20% damage buffs. There are several other possibilities like shadow priest, holy pally, plate DD, whatnot. You could do it with less than 4 healers, but really, that's not necessary. The bosses have little HP and a very forgiving enrage timer (do they have any at all?).\nThe remaining three people should take the resonating crystal. Move closely until the debuff is blue. The tank can follow, making sure the crystal group is 10-15y away.\n\n[b]Black Blood Phase[/b]\nThe groups can meet in the middle, usually on the path that leads to the tower. Ranged DDs should keep DPSing the boss by finding a good spot while healers can exchange buffs like innervate. Towards the end, try to retake the initial position you had at the beginning of the fight.\n\nEnjoy the easy loot! :)"},{"id":1645072,"r":3,"n":0,"b":"My group did it with \r\n2 tanks warrior/dk\r\n3 healers shammy/pally/priest\r\n5 dps druid/warrior/hunter/rogue/mage\r\n its a super simple fight and all you have to do is make sure you stack for stomp before heading out to the crystal"}]}{"id":6110,"comments":[{"id":1600542,"r":3,"n":0,"b":"I wouldn't want to give an overview of the whole fight, but i can say something which wasn't obvious to us untill the end of our learning process:\ndon't try to lengthen the time between the bounces of the void of the  unmaking.\nshorter bounces will overall increase your DPS, and most importantly for non-dk tanks: it will give you a good chance of reaching phase two with one less Psychic Drain.\n\nin short: try to make the shortest possible bounces, without risking the ball passing through the melee group still inactive. (either premature P2 or dead tank)"}]}{"id":6111,"comments":[]}{"id":6112,"comments":[{"id":1591739,"r":-13,"n":0,"b":"World first by Blood Legion - US - Illidan on December 7 2011"},{"id":1673247,"r":3,"n":0,"b":"For Druids on the Ice Phase, you can shift forms to drop Frostflake, though make sure to dip into the bubble to do so as it still drops the ice patch on the ground."},{"id":2106017,"r":3,"n":0,"b":"If you are having trouble with the achievement Holding Hands I put together a simple guide to doing it solo with a pet or with a friend.\r\n\r\n[b]Simple WoW Guide - Holding Hands Solo lvl 100[/b] \r\nhttps://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gt-kyR7gxrY"},{"id":3175247,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"For the Achievement Holding Hands, it needs to be in 10 man.  The distance between the conductors is too great in 25 man for just you and your pet."}]}{"id":6113,"comments":[{"id":1600735,"r":3,"n":0,"b":"Short guide for 10 mans (how our raid did the 1st kill):\r\n\r\n[b]Setup[/b]\r\n- 2 Tanks (death knight, druid)\r\n- 2 Healers (druid, priest)\r\n- 6 DDs (2 hunter, mage, rogue, warlock, priest)\r\n\r\n[b]General[/b]\r\nThis fight is hardly any different from normal mode and has only a few changes:\r\n[ul]\r\n[li]You'll need to rotate up to 6 people per Hour of Twilight, 2 each.[/li]\r\n[li]The group will most likely not survive the last 30 secs before enrage for long. We used Ancient Hysteria after the 6th hour of twilight because of that.[/li]\r\n[li]This is a [i]massive [/i]DPS race and HPS check.[/li]\r\n[/ul]\r\n\r\n[b]Assignements[/b]\r\nHealers: druid took red, priest green. The druid would switch to blue once he couldn't sustain the raid with hots any longer (most likely after the 5th hour of twilight).\r\nHour of twilight:\r\n[ol]\r\n[li]hunter, hunter[/li]\r\n[li]feral druid, shadow priest[/li]\r\n[li]rogue, death knight[/li]\r\n[/ol]\r\nThe mage was backup.\r\n\r\nEnjoy! :)"},{"id":1629230,"r":2,"n":0,"b":"Hi.\r\nWe did this last night with 1 healer - holy paladin.\r\nRest same. 2 ppl stay on HoT, we`ve used, DK and Feral tank, rogue, priest, Dk dps, holy paladin.\r\nIn some of trys, we also use shaman in last HoT, he ofcourse died, but then can stand back."},{"id":2505097,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"what a bug just killed ultraxion HC 10 man and i cant loot the chest. dunno why but i think i killed her too fast?"},{"id":6141689,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"Just killed them what I can only assume was too fast so the chest didn't open. The nerfs haven't impacted it as much as Madness, due to the mechanics of the Spine fight, meaning that this fight is still very hard."},{"id":1709304,"r":11,"n":0,"b":"As of Patch 5.04 [b]Heroic: Spine of Deathwing[/b] is no longer a requirement for [url=http://www.wowhead.com/achievement=6169]Glory of the Dragon Soul Raider[/url]."},{"id":2017697,"r":-2,"n":0,"b":"This does not appear duo-able in patch 6.0. We are getting unexplained instakill flips, but it is not showing the animation. I've successfully duo-ed normal though."},{"id":2020039,"r":6,"n":0,"b":"This boss is the reason why soloers with no dispel ability can't have nice things.\n\nDid you somehow think that bringing a healer friend along to dispel the instakill debuff would make things easier ? Joke's on you : having 2 players alive makes Deathwing roll faster (5 seconds VS 10 seconds solo), so you will die very quickly if either of you loses the tiniest bit of concentration when things get hectic. Did I mention that the tentacles can stun you too ? Yeah this never happens in solo. It requires the other player to hit the Corruption to break the stun, but you know, with our ilvl those tentacles are pretty fragile, and killing it spawns yet another Amalgamation. Which you seriously didn't need. Oh look, it's eating up the few blood pools you had carefully started to pile up ! Oops. And now you've got the Corrupted blood debuff. Hope your healer didn't just get stunned at an unfortunate moment.\n\nIf you expected this to be just as faceroll as the other DS heroic bosses, I'm sorry to say this probably requires some actual raid-level Vent coordination.\n\nBasically, it was late at night, and after the 10th try (admittedly, we were [i]also[/i] trying to get [achievement=6133] for my friend, so we weren't making things easy on ourselves), we ended up saying $%^& it and plowed through it in Normal mode.\n\nEDIT 6.0.3 : Blood of Deathwing was nerfed and is now survivable solo. REJOICE."},{"id":2020680,"r":4,"n":1,"b":"Strat after 6.0:\r\n\r\nDisc priest and Sub Rogue.\r\n\r\nAt the start of the fight we cleared 3 tentacles, forced a roll and then stood 1 on each side that way Deathwing never rolled. I faded and all bloods went to the Rogue and once we had enough we killed the last tentacle. Stacked up bloods, killed, ran along our designated sides, killed tentacles and forced a roll, then went back to 1 side each.\r\n\r\nThis actually ended up being very, very easy. Hope this helps."},{"id":2020789,"r":1,"n":1,"b":"With the changes in 6.0.3 I've managed to solo this as Restoration Druid (Item Level 570).\r\n\r\nI've specced into Ysera's Gift, Force of Nature and Dream of Cenarius and barely had any health problems, which I did have before this patch (maybe it was just bad play back then). And glyphed the Lifebloom which you usually use for PvP (Glyph of Blooming)\r\n\r\nKeep moving from side to side and keep Moonfiring the Hideous Amalgamation, with the extra time before it rolls you can squeeze in a few Wraths as well but I used this time mostly to Hurricane the Corrupted Bloods. I timed the Hurricanes usually with the Nuclear Blast so I had free DPS time for the Burning Tendons. After three tries I had the right routine and managed."},{"id":2022452,"r":11,"n":1,"b":"With the Stat squish of 6.0.2 this is soloable but extremely difficult to do.\r\n\r\nProblems with the fight as stands\r\n1. Deathwing wants to continually roll. This can be countered simply by running back and forth the entire fight.\r\n2. Damage of the bloods. There really is no counter for this other than being a hybrid healing dps class such as a disc priest ect. Non healing classes may want to only kill one corruption per each plate as to slow the rate of bloods coming out, also recommended for hybrid classes.\r\n3. Healing absorb debuff. Again easily dealt with by a healing hybrid class such as disc priest.\r\n\r\nI play primarily shadow and for this fight I had no choice but to switch to disc. It took me several attempts to finally get it but I did get it. \r\n\r\nDoing the counters I mentioned above helped make the fight more manageable. Once you get past the first plate as a disc priest you can simply holy nova the rest of the fight and be fine along with shielding. Make sure you always kill a corruption closest to the plate. Holy nova right at the plate running back and forth once the amalgamation gets 9 stacks, stand in the area to be secured during the killing of the burning tendrel and holy nova when needed. Simple to explain how I managed it hard to actually pull off the first time. Just like doing it as a normal raid the fight gets easier after the first plate is up."},{"id":2023555,"r":-6,"n":0,"b":"Finally did it as an Enh Shaman last night on Heroic 25.  Definitely a very annoying fight needing to run around a lot just trying to survive. The healing from Spirit Bond kept me up above 80% health during the whole fight and I didn't notice any change in the difficulty compared to Normal mode (which I used to do before WoD).\r\n\r\nThe Life-BInder's Handmaiden grind has started."},{"id":2094134,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"Ilvl 645 destro warlock. On 10H there's still enough damage going out to kill if one isn't careful.\r\n\r\nOn 10N, stand in the fire gripped by a tendril, swamped by adds, it doesn't matter. Just execute the mechanics properly and that's it.\r\n\r\nVoidlord didn't take any noticeable damage on normal or heroic.\r\n\r\nOn 10H, used Glyph of Eternal Resolve, did a lot more moving around to avoid damage, used the Voidlord to handle the bloods a lot more, popped Dark Regeneration once or twice. That was plenty, and multiple different combinations of heals/CDs/talents/glyphs would work. Managing the amalgamation to pick up the debuff, position, go nuclear and blow off plates was a bit more involved as a consequence.\r\n\r\nNot a big deal at all, but 10H required some attention. On 10N one can afk."},{"id":2271564,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"Soloed- 677 Blood DK. \r\n\r\n DeathWing will roll a lot! \r\n\r\nRun from front to back while maintaining a zig zag motion. Kill the corruption while kiting the Amalgamation over the pools the corrupted leve behind. Once you have dragged the Amalgamation through to 9 stacks, kill him near the plate, BUT Maintain your running. I just dropped plague and hit him a few times and ran away in my zig zag motion. ( Didn't want to take a chance). The tentacles you can't just burn down.  \r\n\r\nRinse and repeat. Good luck!"},{"id":2319239,"r":1,"n":1,"b":"This [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_zXyqKAkDxM]video[/url] shows how you can close the Spine of Deathwing 25HC Solo"},{"id":2407110,"r":4,"n":0,"b":"Confirm still soloable in Legion. \n\nAsmongold's WoD video is actually faster, easier, and less intensive than my original comment. See it here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XBGMj6eGYa8\n\n[s]Did it as an 833 Fury Warrior, just for the Bloodthirst self healing, since it can take a while.\n\nBasically, kill however many Corruptions you're comfortable with, then keep only one Amalgamation alive and run constantly back and forth across the spine on the edge closest to Deathwing's death. If you have DBM, the \"Beware!\" sound cue means you're good to turn around the other way and rinse and repeat to prevent Deathwing from rolling.\n\nAs you're doing this, kill Corrupted Bloods so that the Amalgamation you've left alive can pick them up as he follows you back and forth across the spine.\n\nOnce he's reached 9 stacks, kill him so he explodes and takes off a back plate, then kill the tendon. You will need to keep running back and forth across the spine during this as well.\n\nDo this for all three plates and you're good. It's easily the most consuming fight in the raid now because of this, but it isn't exactly hard.[/s]"},{"id":2474766,"r":8,"n":1,"b":"Had to watch a bunch of vids and stuff to understand, here is a tldr;\n\n\nYou have to get amalgamation to get 9 stacks of the stuff that bloods leave. amalgamation spawn after you kill a tentacle, so just leave 1 tentacle up.\n\nTo what to do; Kill 3 tentacles and then stand in the one of the 3 fire puddles (tentacle you just killed) to avoid running left/right and get 9 blood adds to spawn (they spawn inplace of the tentacle, so only need to leave 1 tentacle up to get more adds quickly). Kill 9 blood adds and then kill tentacle to spawn amalgamation. Run amalgamation over the dead body of the 9 bloods to get him 9 stacks. Get amalgamation near the head/north-most of deathwing and kill him, plate will come slightly off, kill the thing below the plate to completely remove it and move to the next phae. Repeat."},{"id":2479679,"r":58,"n":3,"b":"I just wanted to add this stratagem to a few places to make life easier for anyone who plans to do this raid solo (Specifically, the Spine of Deathwing fight). This is a paraphrase from another comment from lapdragon who got it from kulisek.\n\n1) Kill 3 tentacles\n2) camp in one of the tentacles holes (and make sure you have the tendrils buff) until you have at least 9 bloods attacking you - make sure to turn off your autoattack so you don't unnecessarily kill any of the bloods. Although, if you tend to have trouble it may be necessary to kill 1 blood to get the buff to resist fire damage.\n3) Once you have 9 bloods, kill the final tentacle and start running left and right across his spine to keep resetting the Roll countdown, the bloods will follow you and the Amalgamation will eventually hone in on your position. Use an area of effect ability to kill all the bloods without killing the amalgam, and have the amalgam follow you over the fiery blood orbs until his counter says 9 next to the amalgam's target character icon. Then kill the amalg as quickly as you can making sure to run between the left and right side so the amalgam doesn't get rolled off prior to knocking the plate up.\n4) Finally, kill the Tendon thing that is keeping the next spine plate on his back so the plate will fly off, and then repeat till you get the last plate and you win the fight!\n\nThis works best if you are at least lvl 100 with hopefully ilvl 720 or higher. I did this following these steps and was able to complete the [achievement=6133] chieve at the same time. If you have trouble try taking out less of the tentacles at first or gear up. Supposedly, this fight gets much harder if you have more than 1 person doing it which from my experience is very true. I tried this Raid with a small group of new guildies and the person who took us knew what he was doing but it was horrible because no one else knew what to do and it is very difficult with a non-cohesive team. Probably the worst boss mechanic of the entire game.\n\nThis works as of 7.1.5 Legion"},{"id":2871135,"r":18,"n":1,"b":"Easy version:\r\n1) kill 3 tentacles, 3 amalgamations will spawn\r\n2)kill 2 amal's and wait until 9 or more corrupted blood spawn\r\n3) kill all corrupted bloods\r\n4) pull amal through the puddles the bloods leave behind\r\n5) at 9 stacks, kill amal next to the plate, it will explode and rip the plate off\r\n6) rinse and repeat. always keep 1 tentacle and 1 amal up each round\r\n\r\ngood luck"},{"id":3287668,"r":5,"n":1,"b":"\"I didnt realize you fools were still there\"\r\n\"your tenacity is admirable but pointless. you ride into the jaws of the apocalypse\"\r\n\"you are less than dust, only to be brushed from my back\""},{"id":6138689,"r":11,"n":1,"b":"I'm just gonna add my strategy since I had trouble with the other strategies, either accidently killing the \"bomb\" type minions or having them get thrown off when Deathwing rolled. Pretty much followed the other strategies below. I took off all my gear and weapons because as a warrior, the enemies were just randomly dying and even with no gear and weapons I still one shot everything and took no damage at level 80.\n\nAdd auto attack to your bar. What I did was kill 3 tentacles like the other guides said but instead of waiting in a tentacle spot until 9 slimes spawned, I constantly walked back and forth between both sides so that Deathwing would never actually commit to a roll. Literally just walk back and forth between both sides so that it spams your screen saying he feels something on his left or right. \n\nThen I would tab target until I got to a slime and use the auto attack to kill it. Just keep one \"bomb\" enemy up, kill slimes, and walk the bomb enemy over the little spot the slimes leave behind, All while walking back and forth between both sides. \n\nOnce the bomb enemy gets 9 stacks, which you'll know because his model changes to a different looking model, bring him to the plate that is towards the direction of Deathwing's head. Attack the bomb enemy when he right up against the plate and it will loosen the plate, then all you have to do is tab target the plate and attack it to kick it off. Rinse of repeat 3 times and it's over.\n\nNot sure if this will be helpful for anyone but after many deaths, this was the only way that actually worked for me."},{"id":6142127,"r":5,"n":1,"b":"I don't know if something was just changed, but I did Spine on a character the other day and had to follow the previous comments advice of constantly moving left and right to prevent a spin while gathering fodder for the bomb mob. But I just did the encounter again now and a single blood was enough to power up an amalgamation to blow the plates."},{"id":6151155,"r":4,"n":0,"b":"It's so much easier with only one blood stack required by the Amalgam on Heroic. it finally enabled me to solo this as 'doing all the things between rolls' was a bit challenging for my ageing concentration and dexterity, even while cosily snuggled into a pool of fire. I finally have my long-wished-for dragon mounts from this encounter.\r\n\r\nOne 'doh' thing that has hilariously caught me out a few times though and seems almost too obviously stupid to mention but still ...\r\n\r\nWhen you land and get to work, in all the excitement and flaming motion after the parachute drop, do make sure you are facing his head ... and not his butt !\r\n\r\nOn occasion, even now, I have somehow forgotten to check and found myself getting frustrated, yelling at the screen, \"Why won't the damn plates come off?\" and suddenly realised they were the WRONG plates ... which look quite similar really though, in the heat of the moment !\r\n\r\n*Facepalm* :D"}]}{"id":6116,"comments":[{"id":1537118,"r":49,"n":0,"b":"This is it, the final battle against Deathwing on it's heroic difficulty."},{"id":1546600,"r":6,"n":2,"b":"Surely \"Avenger of Azeroth\" would be a more appropriate title ?"},{"id":1553836,"r":28,"n":0,"b":"Title awarded changed to \"Savior of Azeroth\" [url=http://db.mmo-champion.com/a/6116/heroic-madness-of-deathwing/#14849/14890]Source[/url]"},{"id":1599238,"r":-5,"n":2,"b":"Korean alliance guild <즐거운공격대> (Kin Raiders)  has killed heroic deathwing on 12/20/2011 getting world first.\r\n\r\nI feel as if he was downed too quick, IMO."},{"id":1599514,"r":12,"n":0,"b":"for nick - Deathwing, Savior of Azeroth"},{"id":1603069,"r":32,"n":0,"b":"Heroic Tier-11 had a whole new boss.\r\nHeroic Tier-12 had a whole new phase.\r\nHeroic Tier-13 had a whole new...add?\r\nI'm seeing your trend here, Blizzard. You'll die and then have a ringside seat for the end of the world."},{"id":1613215,"r":4,"n":0,"b":"This is currently the last raid boss we will see in Cataclysm, because [url=http://www.wowheadnews.com/blog=199727/patch-4-3-2-will-be-cataclysms-last-according-to-dave-kosak]4.3.2 is going to be the last patch in Cata[/url] and there isnt any raid or dungeon in that one unfortunately."},{"id":1630245,"r":-8,"n":0,"b":"Challenge accepted.\r\nNo life mode:on"},{"id":1631330,"r":6,"n":0,"b":"For those who landed here searching for the boss encounter, this is probably what you are looking for: [npc=56173]\n\nEdit: This comment was written when searches for \"Madness of Deathwing\" only turned up this achievement page. The search result has since been fixed."},{"id":1678530,"r":3,"n":0,"b":"Don't know if it has been mentioned earlier but this is possible with one tank, as long as you have a shadow priest in the raid he can soak the impales, it's a bit tricky and might take a few tries (since the tentacle targets the nearest with the biggest aggro) but it's doable."},{"id":1681356,"r":3,"n":0,"b":"If you play with only one tank (very smooth because everything dies quicker) not only a Shadowpriest can soak the Impale.\r\nWe also played it with a Hunter soaking it or a Rogue and it worked as well."},{"id":1709303,"r":3,"n":0,"b":"As of Patch 5.04 [b]Heroic: Madness of Deathwing[/b] is no longer a requirement for [url=http://www.wowhead.com/achievement=6169]Glory of the Dragon Soul Raider[/url]."},{"id":2178730,"r":5,"n":1,"b":"In order to do Deathwing on heroic, [b]you have to do all the previous encounters on heroic[/b]. Sucks but true. No easy farm of heroic Deathwing by having a 7/8 normal save on an alt and switching it to heroic every week."},{"id":6139622,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"I avoided this fight but I needed the Blazing Drake for the achievement.  To do this fight during TWW:\r\n\r\nThere are 4 corruption tendrils as soon as you drop.  Kill 3 and leave 1 up.  Park yourself in the right front one.  Always leave one tendril up.\r\nLet the blood oozes come to you.\r\nLook at your buffs and make sure you are tethered (looks like a worm).  Don't move!  If a tendril spawns, kill it immediately!   Tendril means you're not tethered and you'll be blown off during ROLL.\r\nKeep killing bloods (maybe 10 or so, more is better).\r\nOnce you have a nice looking pool of blood, kill that one Corruption tendril and it should spawn a Hideous Amalgamation.  (Time this right after roll.)\r\nHideous Amalgamation should go right to you and within seconds should immediately have 9 stacks.  Kill it immediately!  You don't have to leave where you're tethered. You don't have to move to the middle as some videos say.   Just be close to the armor.\r\nHideous Amalgamation will cast Nuclear Blast and will remove 1 piece of armor.\r\nWait for Roll, then kill another Corruption at the next section, same spot.\r\n\r\nRinse, repeat.\r\n\r\nAfter I got this, I swear I ran all alts and did DS in 15 minutes (could be shorter if not the RP at the top with the Aspects).\r\n\r\nGood luck!"}]}{"id":6177,"comments":[{"id":1578038,"r":20,"n":0,"b":"For killing Deathwing on HC you will get the title \"[url=http://ptr.wowhead.com/achievement=6116]Savior of Azeroth[/url]\""},{"id":1592560,"r":7,"n":0,"b":"Neat title, I had been hoping we'd see a return of something like Kingslayer."},{"id":1597836,"r":5,"n":2,"b":"TBH - herding cats is way harder than LFR.."},{"id":1610772,"r":34,"n":0,"b":"LFR title should be \"The Extremely Patient\""},{"id":1642436,"r":-6,"n":0,"b":"I like this title. > {"id":6084,"comments":[]}{"id":6105,"comments":[{"id":5594854,"r":2,"n":0,"b":"Occasionally 2 drakes come from the back, the right one (when facing back toward the cabin) dies first but they don't die until the riders get off so any DoT is fine.\nAnd the boss will occasonally put down a huge purple swirly that you stand in.\nKill the saboteurs that drop in on another fast drake (this drake is inconsequential)\n\nand should have it once the boss drops down."},{"id":5853532,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"Ironically the class I had least problem doing this achievemnt with wasn't any caster, but a Demon Hunter. Glaive toss bounces to another target, has two charges and fairly low cooldown, just gotta keep rage building up with Vengeful Retreat (if speced into Tactical Retreat) and Immolation Aura, Fel Rush also gives a nice mobility."},{"id":6112733,"r":1,"n":1,"b":"As noone has pointed it out yet this has to be done on normal, on heroic you will get the broadside from the dragon."},{"id":6149464,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"Super easy on 7/26/25. Just make the /tar Twilight Assault Drake macro, spam it and kill both drakes each wave with any ranged ability. I had 3-4 waves and that's it."}]}{"id":6128,"comments":[{"id":5579303,"r":13,"n":0,"b":"For anyone struggling with this and getting tired of the tentacle disco, most videos lack this valid point of information. When you bounce the ball it becomes immune for a few seconds. To solo this the ball seems to always go the opposite direction it was going, so simply walk over the orb, let the boss walk over the orb and turn around while the orb is immune. Then it should become active again once you have moved the boss over it. Rinse and repeat 9 more times and you get the achievement. Did it with a naked lvl 60 Evoker no problems once I figured this mechanic."},{"id":5669704,"r":2,"n":0,"b":"Ok so, for anyone wondering how to Solo this on a Shaman or any other class really, but are still having trouble following the top comments, this is what I learned: \r\n\r\n[ul]\r\n[li]Once the orb spawns, it will start moving away from the boss. [/li]\r\n[li]After you hit it the first time, make the boss take a couple of steps  OPPOSITE the orbs direction. Not much, just 2 steps or so otherwise you wont be able to catch up to the ball. [/li]\r\n[li]immediately run toward the ball again. CC breaks and things like Deaths advance (DK) or Spirit Wolf (shaman) are helpful for the stun. I also took Spirit Walk on Shaman. [/li]\r\n[li]Hit the ball, take a couple steps forward, then run through the boss and repeat. [/li]\r\n[/ul]\r\n\r\ntry to do this on the first try if possible, since the orb is usually in the middle. If you fail though, you can kill the adds and try again. Hope this helps!"},{"id":5688329,"r":17,"n":0,"b":"I don't mean to sound dramatic, but this achievement can go suck a fart through a garden hose."},{"id":5706019,"r":26,"n":6,"b":"If you have a tank spec of your class... switch to it. This achievement is easy if you cannot get dazed\r\n\r\n1.Clear Mobs\r\n2.Agro boss\r\n3.Boss summons ball\r\n4.Hit ball\r\n5.Wait 3 seconds chase after ball\r\n6.Repeat steps 3-5 9 more times."},{"id":5761309,"r":10,"n":3,"b":"So I've been pumpin with more than 20 alts in a single day, and that stupid ball keeps on despawning on my 6:th, or 9:th, and so on.\nI have even used 2 alts at thesame time, and there is always a reason I somehow ONE-SHOT the boss. \n\nI used rouges, mages, druids, but this time I tried with my hunter instead.\n\nYou can reset the boss with the classes I mentioned easily, except for druids.\n\nDon't know if this is the reason I finally cleared the achievement, so here it goes.\n\nHow I finally CLEARED it:\n\nOn Heroic-10-man.\n\nBeing right under the ball seems to make it despawn, so make sure to be INFRONT of it instead.\nSecond reason it might keep despawning is because the boss touches it, so I made sure the ball was far away from boss.\n\nI used a HUNTER with SURVIVAL-spec, and without GEAR, and had my pet tanking the boss.\nSPEC-code : \"B8PA5ZKiUcehijAKxoiI1CP3gCoEkEhSQQERaJJkQCRkIAAAAAAEE4ASSSIJSkGAAAAgA\"\n\nBefore you start;\n\nMake sure your pet is on passive, and in the middle of the room. Use MISDIRECTION on your pet, and hit the boss once, and the boss will go straight to your pet. You have free will now!\nAfter the ball spawns, make sure you move your pet further away from the middle of the room so that the boss won't be near the ball.\nOnce the ball spawns it will always bounces back to boss at first, that is why I moved boss further away.\n\nI had macro made also just in case;\n \n/target void of the unmaking\n/use auto attack\n\nSo right before the ball hits you I used the macro, but once the ball was further away from boss I began right-clicking the mouse instead.\n\nI just kept on doing this and it worked on my first try. Maybe I was lucky this time, I don't know. Hope this gives some insight."},{"id":6045249,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"for anyone doing this in 2025. i leveled a warlock up to level 41. i used my voidwalker to tank him. i had him moved closer to the edge facing the middle. let him summon orb and wait till its closer to edge. then hit it back to him and hit it to wall and then back to him. it doesn't go that fast i used burning rush sometimes. it worked pretty easily. hope this helps a solo player.( as long as you statr hitting it back from afar you should be good.)"},{"id":6068433,"r":2,"n":0,"b":"I just messaged a friend in my list and asked him if he has this achiev and he said no, he came on a druid, he kept the boss taunted and I have bounced the ball 10 times, easy peasy on a paladin :) Don't be anti-social, just ask a friend or even a stranger for help :)"},{"id":6081458,"r":4,"n":1,"b":"Tried several times not getting the idea but then it became completely clear. The bad guy is stuck to you all the time. The orb is always running in the opposite direction when you touch it, hence it will always hit the bad guy head-to-head. No exceptions. BUT for about five seconds the orb is immune to everything. That's the point! So...\r\n1. Switch to tank spec as there's no movement impairing effects in that case.\r\n2. Run into the orb. It changes direction 180 degree and gets immune.\r\n3. Continue to run in the direction it was running before for about a second so that the specter orb runs through you AND THE BAD GUY. In other case the immunity ends before the orb passes the boss.\r\n4. Do a U-turn once the orb passes the boss.\r\n5. Run for the orb. Repeat.\r\n\r\nGood luck!"},{"id":6097272,"r":6,"n":1,"b":"This was a pain. failed so many times. on my levl 80 tank druid the orbs disappeared after max 2 hits. and same on my mage...\r\n today i tried on my levl 46 warlock.  easy street. . void tanks the boss. and when the orb spawnes, you tell the void to move abit to the side,  taking the boss with him, so you can focus on the orbs. \r\ndo this on Normal so you dont have to kill the adds. but you have to be quick. two times i got 9 orbs before \"add phase\" started. so run inside the orb following it."},{"id":6111959,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"This is doable on a Brewmaster Monk. Put the ox statue close to the boss and wait until the orb spawns. The orb seems to despawn when it comes too close to the boss, so you want to bounce it close to the edge of the arena. After you hit it and it changed directions it will take 2-3 sec until the orb glows, signaling that you can hit it again. Repeat until you hit it 10 times then kill the boss."},{"id":6137986,"r":2,"n":0,"b":"Shortly after pull the boss will summon a glowing ball that you can kick to increase its stacks. \r\n\r\nThe ball will become transparent for a short while after kicking and fly away. When it starts glowing again it can be kicked once more.\r\n\r\nOnce it reaches 10 stacks/10 kicks, kill the boss and you are good.\r\n\r\n[b]However[/b], if the ball collides whith the boss [b]while glowing[/b] it will be consumed to trigger the intermission. Always keep the boss on your back while chasing the ball so he doesn't accidentaly touch it."},{"id":6148482,"r":1,"n":1,"b":"Ok so I tried this so many times on so many toons until I read to just count to 2-3 before chasing the ball and it worked! Basically once you touch the ball it reverses direction, becomes transparent and can safely pass through the boss. Just remember to remove any gear or talents you have which cause damage to attackers, and this includes gear that has Leech on it!\n\n1. Clear all trash\n2. Taunt the boss\n3. Allow him to attack you until he spawns the orb\n4. Just run into the orb, it is immune to damage\n5. Every time you touch it count to 2-3 (2 for slower characters) and run into it again until you've touched it 10 times (the Instance Achievement Tracker addon will help keep track and let you know once it is sage to kill the boss)\n6. Kill boss for achievement\n\nI did this on my level 80 DH in Vengeance spec. The first time I did it the orb despawned because counting to 3 let it get too far away. I kept kiting the boss until he summoned another orb and this time counted to 2 instead and got the achievement :) Good luck to you!"},{"id":6148924,"r":1,"n":1,"b":"Tried on many toons, the misdirect strategy was useless for me - the pet never gains nor holds aggro and every time it did, it just killed the boss.\n\nUsing [b]Monk (Brewmaster) with black ox statue is SO much easier.[/b]  I took off all my gear, used the statue to start the fight by placing it directly on the boss. When he spawns the orb [b]it is utterly crucial to not start hitting it until a few seconds have elapsed or it will just try to get back to the boss and mess up everything[/b]\n\nWorth noting that instance achievement tracker is REALLY great but it does NOT give confirmation that you can kill the boss; it just says you have 10/10 stacks. He spawned another ball with the other one rolling around and I just killed the boss (panicked) and it worked.\n\nEDIT: the statue lasts 15 minutes so you can screw it up several times and still get it!"},{"id":6149443,"r":-1,"n":0,"b":"Insanely easy in TWW on 7/26/25. I did this on a level 80 Rogue. Pull the boss, touch the orb, it'll change direction, you'll get dazed here and there, but just touch it again after 2-3 seconds or so up to 10 times for the achievement. If you get too far away, just use shadowstep to the orb. Easy :)"},{"id":6151142,"r":0,"n":0,"b":"This was causing me a lot of frustration and headaches with dazing or accidentally killing the boss. \n\nFinally managed it on my 80 Draenei huntress on Heroic 25 (as I was doing a Spine run later)\n\nBrought along George the crab. Tenacity specced, thinking his 'pin' might come in handy but don't think I needed it. \n\nSet pet with Growl and Pin on Auto, all other abilities off, and set pet mode to Passive !\n\nStripped naked to reduce damage and any effects from trinkets, procs or Cyrce's Circlet jewels, which HAD caught me out the week before, removed weapon too, and had melee autoattack on action bar for simple punch.\n\nRespecced out of any talent tree abilities that were likely to proc any damage or apply Leech\n\n( Had Aspect of the Cheetah and Disengage handy in case of chasing, and Feign Death for aggro drop, all in case things went wrong, but didn't need them as it happened. )\n\nMoved George to sit by the boss and cast Misdirection on him\n\nImmediately hit the boss with 1 shot from the Red Rider Air Rifle\n\nFrom this point on, George and the Boss were inseparable !\n\nUsed 'move to' again,  to shift them out of the centre a bit.\n\nMessed up a couple of times as I accidentally booted the spawned ball back at the boss so had to deal with a double helping of Tentacle Disco, but no need to panic, things were still OK. George and the Boss were still wrestling away while I beat away the tentacles with my bare fists to clear the decks so I could see clearly again.\n\nStill no pressure from the Boss so,  more relaxed, I picked my angles more carefully, waited for the ball to light up each time before running into it and scored ten bounces at my leisure, keeping it clear of the Boss this time.\n\nWent over and thumped the Boss a few times and thanked George for his help. Job done :)\n\nUsed Instance Achievement tracker which let me know where I was at, and when it was time to clobber the Boss."},{"id":6217448,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"did this today on a level 70 paladin! I struggled on my first attempt cuz I kept getting dazed over and over and couldnt move fast enough to get caught up to the orb before it got absorbed into the wall \r\n\r\nthen I read a comment on here that said you switch to tank spec you wont get dazed! so on my second try I just switched to protection, aggroed the boss, waited for the orb to spawn, then just started to run into it until I got all 10 (used the instance achievement tracker to know)\r\n\r\nit was easy enough that I got it on my first try like that. I didnt have any issues with it despawning or hitting the boss (cuz it can go through the boss when its not glowing)"},{"id":6257328,"r":4,"n":2,"b":"Hasn't worked for me. And it's the only achievement I have left for Dragon Soul."},{"id":6355915,"r":2,"n":1,"b":"Normal, 10 ppl\n[b]Hunter with Trailblazer passive, pet with Taunt[/b]\n\n1. Set pet to Passive, turn off every abilitie's autouse (right click on it). Using 'Move to' command, position your pet 20-25m off the boss.\n2. Use pet's Taunt once and [b]IMMIDIATELY[/b] press Passive stance. I taunted with a hotkey and clicked on Passive. You can try this trick on any other mobs to make sure it works for you.\n3. Run in front of the boss and wait for the orb to spawn.\n4. Once it is spawned, wait 2 seconds while the orb floats to the wall, then use Aspect of the Cheetah and run to the orb. Once touched it will change direction back to boss.\n5. Take over the orb and run along it until it becomes touchable again. Touch it and it will start floating to the wall again.\n6. Run along the orb and touch it 8 more times."},{"id":6399548,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"Not sure if I just did not notice before, but:\r\n\r\nAs of version 12.1.0.69299 (8/11/2026) the boss is casting the orb as you are dropping into the room. I was able to get my 10 bumps before even engaging the boss.\r\nThe counter will not go over 10, so bump 11, 12, etc. will continue to show 10."}]}{"id":6129,"comments":[{"id":5524015,"r":9,"n":0,"b":"The addon Instance Achievement Tracker will track the color combos for you.  You can download it from CurseForge.  I just did this on heroic and it took less than 4 minutes."},{"id":5900829,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"2024 update: You can do the achievment in 1 run! \r\nStart combat, wait to ozzie phase kill 1 (another 3 should be 1 color variant).\r\nAfter then you should wait an another ozzie phase and kill an another combination.\r\nYou should write witch combination is done because the achievment progress is still bugged."},{"id":6004017,"r":4,"n":0,"b":"Was able to do this today on my mage. strongly rec Instance Achievement Tracker addon it makes it easy for all achiv"},{"id":6137982,"r":9,"n":0,"b":"You can do this on heroic mode.\nThe criteria requires combinations between 5 colors and the boss will spawn 4 of them at a time on heroic which makes it faster to complete.\nYou don't need to kill any of the globs, but do pay attention to which colors are on the field.\n\nFor example if the spawns are: Blue Black Purple Yellow, you'd get progress for Black+Yellow, Black+Blue and Purple+Yellow all in one intermission.\n\nThen just wait for another wave until you have seen all 4."},{"id":6238131,"r":3,"n":0,"b":"[u]Pull and don't kill him[/u], [u]stay AFK until all combinations reach him[/u]. Yes 4 colors per turn, just make sure you see the pairs you want. [u]Stay like that until you see all the pairs of the achievement in a single run[/u], then kill him! Might take you few rounds until you get all 4 pairs. \n\nIf you having trouble initiate the fight and don't have a taunt ability or you keep one-shot him, take out all gear and use \"Whole-Body Shrinka\" to initiate the fight, then do the rest. (Used that method on a marksman hunter 80lv)\n\nTrash mobs don't affect this process at all, you can carefully clean if you like or let them be. (careful not to kill the boss until you finish)\n\n[b]Achievement's tracker STILL don't work[/b], so even if you track the achievement and get a wanted pair you won't get live credit on any of the 4 pairs... Just follow the instructions and after the kill you will get it."},{"id":6385617,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"I went in on a 282 hunter, used Intimidation to pull, it doesn't do any damage.  Made some popcorn and when I was done eating all combos had shown up."}]}{"id":6174,"comments":[]}{"id":6175,"comments":[{"id":5599389,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"BM hunter here. I was worried this wouldn't be possible solo at level 70, but I was able to do this on 10man normal completely naked. Two punches took her to 19% health. If you crit you're probably outta luck and have to wait until the next week."},{"id":5761333,"r":3,"n":0,"b":"I've cleared this so many times on Heroic 25, and 10-man, and still no achieve popped up.\r\n\r\nSo I thought maybe it only works on Normal-10-man.... \r\n\r\nJust did it and worked like a charm. Have the achieve now.\r\n\r\nPets might work too... and you probably need at least 3 to make it happen.\r\n\r\nEven if you have no gear at all, you will one-shot the boss.\r\n\r\nTaunt or use shrinka for aggro..... GOOD LUCK!"},{"id":6025059,"r":26,"n":6,"b":"This is still soloable in TWW if you have a class with a pet. Here is a small step-by-step for anyone wanting to still finish it:\r\n\r\n1. Set the raid to 10-man normal.\r\n2. Remove all your gear, make sure that you don't have any damaging abilities active and set your pet to passive.\r\n3. Kill the trash to make the boss spawn.\r\n4. Use the Whole-Body-Shrinka toy and punch the boss a few times until she is below 85% (around 700k HP).\r\n5. She will first do her ice phase. If you get trapped by Ice Tomb, target it and have your pet attack it to free you. Make sure to still have your pet on passive while doing so, otherwise it might accidentally oneshot the boss.\r\n6. Once the lightning phase starts, kill the elemental that spawns close to one of the conduits to charge it.\r\n7.  Use \"move pet\" to place your pet next to the charged conduit, as far away to it as possible while it's still getting hit by the lightning.\r\n8. Move your character between your pet and the second conduit, creating a \"chain\" to charge the next conduit. With some adjusting you should have no problem reaching it.\r\n9. Repeat Step 7 & 8 twice to charge the third and fourth conduit. The achievement will pop once the last conduit has been charged.\r\n\r\nNote: You do NOT need to kill the boss at all, the achievement unlocks once all conduits are charged.\r\n\r\nHope it helps!"},{"id":6103322,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"As of today 11.1.5, we were unable to proc the achievement in normal mode (compared to previous comments).\n\nSo we decided to do it in heroic and we were successful.\n\nWe were 2 and it was more than enough to energize the pillars but i guess it can work for a hunt with the pet too.\n\nNo need to kill the boss to have this achiev so you'll know when you've succeeded.\n\nIf you have the ice phase and get stuck in the ice block, just wait until it breaks (Can be a minute or two) and wait for the thunder phase.\n\nGood Luck ! ✨"},{"id":6358551,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"Midnight\r\nMage, Water elemental\r\nNormal, 10 ppl (not 25!)\r\n\r\n1. Summon Water Elemental, set on passive\r\n2. Pull boss, bareknuckle her to ~65%\r\n3.  Wait for Lightning Elemental to spawn.\r\n4. Stand near one of the transmitter, CS to pull elemental, kill in melee range.\r\n5. Position yourself and your elemental in a straight line (not along the circle!) between active transmitter and the next one.\r\n\r\nIt is possible, check screenshot."},{"id":6383588,"r":0,"n":0,"b":"I did this with my DK and pet, with my pet doing the conduit running. Hagara got stunned, but no achive popped."}]}{"id":6180,"comments":[{"id":5609573,"r":21,"n":2,"b":"Alexstrasza = far left (get speed buff from swapping platforms before starting)\r\nNozdormu = 1 left\r\nYsera = starting platform\r\nKalecgos = 1 right\r\n\r\nStart fight then hop over to their platform by running off the edges."},{"id":5805725,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"Someghow I need Nozdormu (the one to the left of Thrall) and cant get even after starting there after starting the event... anyone else?"},{"id":6065736,"r":6,"n":2,"b":"Note that even after the addition of Warbands, this is a [b]character-specific[/b] achievement, so you cannot just run through on 4 different alts in the same week."},{"id":6129619,"r":6,"n":0,"b":"hi! finally got this achievement and only needed Alexstrasza left.\r\ntwo important things to note:\r\n-the assault aspects  spell 11.0.5 (Tue Oct 22 2024) meaning it casts faster now. any comments before then might have been easier because it was a longer cast before!\r\n - i am using All The Things, an achievement tracker which showed Nozdormu being assaulted as credit even after Alexstrasza was successfully assaulted first. \r\ndon't panic, if you kill the boss it will still count as Alexstrasza first.\r\ntl;dr: jump platforms twice then talk to thrall, rush to alex's platform and make sure the speed buff lasts. after that just do the rest of the encounter and enjoy! <3"}]}

> [{"id":1586187,"b":"the majority of the raid has to port out of the twilight realm in order to avoid taking damage from [spell=103327].  in order to get this achievement, you have to plan a rotation order for only keeping people in the twilight realm once.  if too few people stay, the aspect NPCs die.\r\n\r\non 10 normal, you must have one player stay in the twilight realm.\r\non 25 normal, you must have three players stay in the twilight realm.\r\non 10 heroic, you must have two players stay in the twilight realm.\r\non 25 heroic, you must have five players stay in the twilight realm.\r\n\r\nthis achievement is a dps race in that the faster you kill the boss, the fewer raid members/cooldowns you will have to cycle through."},{"id":1594603,"b":"[spell=106371] is cast every 46 secs in the fight so you will get at most 7 if you hit the hard enrage time of 6 mins. On 10 man this means you need 5 dps or healers to eat the attack since your tanks can take the other 2."},{"id":1595080,"b":"Tanks can use their standard cooldowns that they use to survive [spell=109415], however you will need others using cooldowns for up to 5 more Hours of Twilight. Here's a list of what non-tanks can use to survive the damage:\n\n[ul][li]Death Knights using [spell=48707] and [spell=48792] (or [spell=51052] for Unholy); [/li]\n[li]Feral Druids using [spell=61336] and [spell=22812]; [/li]\n[li]Paladins using [spell=498] (glyphed with [item=41096]) or [spell=642];[/li]\n[li]Warriors using [spell=871] ([spell=63329] if needed);[/li]\n[li]Shadow Priests using [spell=47585];[/li]\n[li]Mages using [spell=45438] and Fire Mages, thanks to [spell=86949];[/li]\n[li]Hunters using [spell=19263];[/li]\n[li]Rogues using [spell=1966] or [spell=31224];[/li]\n[li]Holy Priests using [spell=47788] on any player.[/li]\n[/ul]"},{"id":1598815,"b":"[url=http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uyiu10998_o]Here's a fraps of us doing this achievement. [/url]Fairly straight forwards. \n\nSeeing as we were doing the achievement, we made use of the following personal cooldowns for staying in the Twilight Realm alone:\n[ul]\n[li]2 x Feral tanking druids each stayed out once (Survival Instincts / Barkskin / Trinkets)[/li]\n[li]Holy Pala (Divine Shield)[/li]\n[li]Death Knight (Anti-Magic Shell)[/li]\n[li]Hunter (Deterrence)[/li]\n[li]Rogue (Feint)[/li]\n[/ul]\n\nOn a sidenote, we usually also have a ret pala and a mage with us, who can also both do their Hour of Twilight on their own in the Twilight Realm. When we do, we leave the tanks out of the rotation, so they can focus fully on their tank swapping in sync with applications of Fading Light and such\n\nGood luck!"},{"id":1625673,"b":"Almost certainly a reference to the Doomsday Clock (which represents the threat of global disaster), since the goal of Ultraxion is to bring about the end of the world, rather than a reference to Iron Maiden's album \"2 Minutes to Midnight\" or Linkin Park's album \"Minutes to Midnight\"."},{"id":1628293,"b":"Right now with currently available gear, the 5% debuff, and the current fastest kill times in either format as recorded on WoL...this achievement is nigh-impossible to accomplish in Heroic mode without some serious raid stacking.\n\nTo do it in either format would require the raid to kill him before the 6th Hour of Twilight [b][i]and[/i][/b] have 10/25 raiders capable of soaking one Hour each. Not all classes have abilities to allow them to soak Hour, nor are there enough raid single-target cooldowns available to aid them (except possibly in 25-man, but the DPS check there is far more severe than 10). Sacrificing people is an option, but due to the combat resurrection limit in both formats, this means only a handful (or single person) can be \"sacrificed\" and brought back. However, the lost DPS harms the capability of that particular option.\n\nIf the debuff ends up increasing, then it will make this achievement more doable on Heroic (assuming guilds are doing the DPS they should be for this kind of fight). For the vast majority of guilds, however, they will have to accomplish this on normal.\n\n[i]It's worth noting that there is a legit 10-man Heroic kill that occurs before the 5th Hour of Twilight cast, which lowers their requirement to achieve this down to 8 unique players. That still doesn't make it easy, however.\nEDIT: Wow, typo'd noting to nothing. That was bad.[/i]"},{"id":1634004,"b":"For the purpose of 10 man groups.  You need at least 6 people if your group is capable of downing Ultraxion in under 5 min. and 15 sec.  @5:15 a 7th Hour of Twilight will occur; Twilight Eruption / Engage timer @ 6:00\r\n\r\nSo play for soaking 6 to 7 Hour of Twilights.\r\n\r\nThere are also trinkets capable of soaking the damage such as [item=68996] This will not soak enough alone to keep you alive, however it can be combined with things like [spell=498] to increase over all survivability.  Stay of Exc. is particularly nice because it is a purchase-able item, provided you are Revered with Avengers of Hyjal [faction=1204].\r\n\r\nWith Normal 25m and Heroic modes, the added advantage of multiples standing in one Anti-Magic Zone (75%) (Unholy DK) and Power Word: Barrier(25%) (please confirm, my guild uses a Holy Priest).  Also Tanks with 4pc T13 sets should be able to provide Divine Guardian (20%) more often (1 min CD ) and Warriors (20% on party members) [skill=105911]  Plan to have classes with weak or no death avoidance abilities to soak with a tank, unholy DK or PW:B."},{"id":1690314,"b":"When we did it, we used:\r\n\r\n1x DK (Main Tank) with Anti-Magic Shell\r\n1x Shadow Priest with Dispersion\r\n2x Hunter with Deterrence\r\n1x Discipline Priest with Pain Suppression\r\n1x Protection Paladin with Divine Guardian\r\n\r\nWe had a mage and used Ice Block, but it doesn't count as him taking it. Since nobody took it other than the immune person, Ultraxion cast Twilight Eruption and wiped the group."},{"id":1983955,"b":"Linkin Park's fans hands up!"},{"id":2027221,"b":"We did this today with 1 hunter il 490 and disc priest il550. Simply put, ultraxion only got to cast hour of twilight once before we killed him. achievement done.\n\nedit. hunter was 36k dps, and priest was 19k dps. Reason i commented is for people who are concerned they could not get this achieve via solo or small group as lvl 90."}][{"id":1583015,"b":"p1 - 4yd - p2 - 4yd - p3 -> is this a fail? or between p1 and p3 must be <5 yd too to fail it?"},{"id":1587515,"b":"-obligatory comment stating the reference-\nReference to the classic Sting/Police [sub](hinthint, Sting was in The Police!)[/sub] song of the same name.\nThe chorus is basically \"Don't stand, Don't stand so, Don't stand so close to meeeee\"\nI love it when blizzard references something and I don't need a comment like this to go \"OOOOOOHHHH I GET IT NOW\" ^_^"},{"id":1587935,"b":"This achievement could also possibly be a reference to a song from \"The Police\": \"Don't Stand So Close To Me\", released in the early 80's."},{"id":1600629,"b":"We did this achievement in our run last night, on 10m normal mode - though it might even be more suitable on heroic mode, at least on 25man as you'll have your raid more split up that way. We put up 2 flares on each side of the pathway, and loosely preassigned which side and flare each raider would move to. The whole point is to make sure no one is within 5 yards (get those range radars up and running, guys) of each other while Morchok is channeling [url=http://www.wowhead.com/spell=103851]Black Blood of the Earth[/url].\n\nThe whole trick lies in making sure everyone is on the ball and rotate their cameras (preparing to move out IMMEDIATELY when they aren't immobilized anymore) while being \"stunned\" after he pulls everyone in while he is casting [url=http://www.wowhead.com/spell=103176]Falling Fragments[/url]. Assign people so that you have those with any kind of speed increases/enhancements spread out evenly and sharing a \"side\" with those who don't. Have your raiders focus more on positioning than anything else, as this boss is pretty much the one all should be walking all over for loots.\n\nAlso, just tell people that it's better if they take some damage from the Dark Blood of the Earth than stack too close to a fellow raider, messing up the achievement. The bloods shouldn't kill you from standing in it a brief while anyways.\n\nHere's the setup we used, and the splitup:\n\n[b]Left side of the path[/b]\n[ul]\n[li]Feral tank druid[/li]\n[li]Retribution pala[/li]\n[li]Enhancement shaman[/li]\n[li]Destruction warlock[/li]\n[li]Survival hunter[/li]\n[/ul]\n\n[b]Right side of the path:[/b]\n[ul]\n[li]Blood death knight[/li]\n[li]Holy pala[/li]\n[li]Disc priest[/li]\n[li]Assassination rogue[/li]\n[li]Elemental shaman[/li]\n[/ul]\n\nBest of luck to you all :)\n\nAlso, [url=http://www.wowhead.com/npc=55265#comments:id=1598696]here is a link to some info on the normal mode encounter [/url]as well as a link to a video of one of our early kills on him, for those interested."},{"id":1616544,"b":"Don't bother using a raid achievement tracking addon for this as they report it failed when it's not (and they admit it's not accurate for this achievement) - just shift click the achievement and it will go red if you fail it at any point during the encounter."},{"id":1656514,"b":"We did this on heroic which probably is easier since the raid splits up."},{"id":1659189,"b":"My guild decided to finish our Meta recently, being a 25man guild i thought i would share our Strat since all of the comments are about 10man.  Since Euphemia explained the basic mechanics pretty well, i'll just cover the 25man way to do it.\r\n\r\nOn 25man, you can not have any more then 2 people ever within 5 yards of each other (achievement says 3 players within 5yds of each other, so 2 is the maximum since 3 is failure).\r\n\r\nWe set up 5 Raid Markers on the ground in a Star shape (Top of the star is on the path we come down).  Then assigned each group to a marker\r\n\r\nOnce Earten Vortex happend, each group were suppose to target themselves towards their marker, once we all popped up all groups ran out, you can use a druid with [url=http://www.wowhead.com/spell=77764]Stamping Roar[/url], also a Hunter using [url=http://www.wowhead.com/spell=13159]Aspect of the Pack[/url] to help.  \r\n\r\nMelee in the groups stayed just behind the nearest Fragments while the ranged kept running another 10ish yards passed that person, it was a bit excessive but we took safe over sorry just in case.  Once the channel was complete everyone ran back in, melee being closest got in right away while the range ran back too.\r\n\r\nWe did this is only one Black Blood phase, but 2-3 is acceptable as well depending on the dps output of the raid.  just stay calm and give it a go, it is not that difficult.\r\n\r\nUse blizzard's in game achievement tracker for this one, addons can't track it properly.  Good luck!"},{"id":1704639,"b":"This Achiv is easy mode on 10-heroic, with 2 groups split into 5 all ready. \r\n\r\nTank Heads North\r\nSoaker North East or West\r\nHealer East or West\r\nDPS East or West (The way the healer didn't go)\r\nDPS South"},{"id":1708622,"b":"So I raid lead a META run last night. I came in thinking this would be the hardest achievement other than deck defender. I thought about it, and thought of a good plan. So heres how we did it in [b][u]one shot[/u][/b].\r\n\r\nWe elected to clear the trash as if it was heroic, to avoid any issues with our spread.\r\n\r\nWith all our DPS above 20k, we only had 1 black phase actually, but you just repeat if you have more.\r\n\r\n[b][u]I set up the 5 color markers[/u][/b], around the boss, in a semi circle formation. They were pretty evenly spread out, and they were farther back then I needed, just to be safe. I assignedone tank to go behind the boss (towards the temple), and one to the closest marker on the right. Then,[b] [u]I assigned a person to every single marker[/u][/b]. Then, [b][u]I assigned a person to be in between each marker[/u][/b]. So for example, I said [i]Fauxton, Red. Nayel, Red/yellow. Darwaf, Yellow.[/i] I had one healer on the tank side, 2nd mark, and one on the other side, 3rd mark (basically center). Then, when black phase hit, we all ran to our spots, and no1 ran in before black phase ended. Achieve complete. Hope this helped! :)"},{"id":1761639,"b":"If you kill him fast enough before he even does his [spell=103851] phase, you will get the achievement. Therefore, hero and just burn him fast for an easy win."},{"id":2009513,"b":"As of [b]MoP[/b], this achievement is as easy as 1 2 3 ..\r\n\r\n[ol]\r\n[li]pop [b]hero[/b]! [/li]\r\n[li][b]NUKE [/b]fast & kill him before he cast  [spell=103851] [/li]\r\n[li]achievement accomplished!  [/li]\r\n[/ol]\r\n\r\nkinda works like [achievement=4579] for [achievement=4602]\r\nwhere you can get the achievement before any portal is even spawned, if your party heals the dragon fast enough!\r\n\r\n\r\n\r\n[i]good luck[/i] :)"}][{"id":1832557,"b":"FYI dont die while doing this achievement. you wont get it but everyone else will. had a ticket in and they just confirmed that."},{"id":1854291,"b":"This achievement is soloabe... I did it as a feral druid."},{"id":1878973,"b":"Not sure why comments about soloing have been downvoted, solo is indeed the easiest way to get this achievement at level 90, as long as you have a decently geared dps spec, since you need to kill her before the second phase. About 214k dps is needed, which should not be too hard to achieve since you'll be taking advantage of [spell=99461] (stacking to 25) and [spell=100029].\n\nPick up 3 feathers, go in the air and start nuking the boss, fly through the rings to maintain your buff. When the boss goes down fly down after her but don't land, just fly slightly above her and keep dps-ing. Repeat until boss dies. If you do this, you will not be hit by any of the attacks in the achievement, or indeed take any damage at all. Getting past the trash solo is probably harder than this achievement."},{"id":1879496,"b":"You can now stand on a rock all the way to the west to avoid everything. You just need to have enough ranged dps."},{"id":1884491,"b":"I just soloed this with 150K dps as an elemental shaman.  I assume this method would also work for any dps class with healing capabilities.  First pick up the 3 feathers and immediately get right on Alyrazors tail. I had problems with her getting too far away and resetting so stay close. Try to hit every ring you can for the haste buff and continue riding her tail and dpsing until she begins to fly in a rapid circle. Land to the east on the rocks circling the fight area and wait out the hellish fiery vortex phase keeping yourself healed throughout. As soon as she enters her burn out phase, where she takes 50% more damage, run in and finish her off."},{"id":1904116,"b":"In order to complete this achievement, aside from meeting the criteria mentioned, you must stay alive. If you perish at all during the instance, it takes the achievement."},{"id":1913601,"b":"Ok, so after weeks of trying to do this achi. I actually got it by chance. So i was doing FL with a few friends who needed to do the legendary quest. So mid Aly fight my ISP goes whack and i disconnect, my friends being not very nice people kick me from the raid, thinking i was afk/DC. So 4 mins later i log back in get ported out and within a minute after I get the achi. Show my friends and low and behold witness them cry over skype. So if youre having trouble, I guess you can engage, plug out your internet, log in again leave grp, tele out and wait for your raid to kill the thing without you and get the achievement:)\r\n\r\nDon't believe me? Just check Mamon lvl 90 dk on ravencrest EU"},{"id":1924989,"b":"Soloed as a Ret Paladin. Easy fight! Just grab 3 feathers and dps as hard as you can. Try not miss any rings and avoid the explosions. I finish the boss with 195k final dps and before phase 2. ilvl 558 btw."},{"id":1937608,"b":"I did it with 3 friends yesterday. I decided to stay in the air to damage the boss, while others were just... Well, hanging around and dying.\r\n\r\nThey all died, taking a lot of aoes, and pretty much ruining the achievement. I finished the boss by myself, and got the achievement. Of course, they didn't.\r\n\r\nSo what I can tell is that when people die during the fight, even if they got hit by the listed aoes, the achievement will sort of reset for you. As I finished it alone, it only considered the aoes I had taken, which means zero.\r\n\r\n\r\nI guess this achievement, if you want it done in one run, is better done in solo. Just stick to the boss (flying) and dps him down, it's a lot of efforts not to reset him, but once you got how to do it it's just a matter of time. Not too hard with the current gear, did that with some SoO's LFR gear. Good luck !"},{"id":1939714,"b":"Just easily solo'ed it with my 562 destro warlock.
