You can tell by the map that this boss is located in a first wing, and you can see another wing with no colour or \"skull\", so Blizzard will add more wings in later patches. As you can see, this second wing has a \"Closed door\" mark where the entrance to this room is. Also, you can see another \"closed door\" just north from the two wings to a hall that probably will lead to next area where the next -boss branches- can grow out."},{"id":1228468,"r":0,"n":0,"b":"Just killed him today in 10 man, he dropped two epic ilvl 359 items - PvP Deathknight Gauntlets, and PvE Priest leggings. Looks to be the same type of loot table as VoA, where pvp and pve items drop, and it can be either gloves or legs for any class. Also awards valor points when killed, I believe 70."},{"id":1232827,"r":16,"n":2,"b":"The strategy that we used to successfully PUG(10) him last evening (12/11) was such:\n\n[ul]\n[li]2 Tanks, 3 Heals, 5 DPS(9-15k)\nOriginally had 2 Heals, 6 DPS but when the Shadowpriest pulling 6.7k said he was usually Holy, he was promptly role-changed.[/li]\n[/ul]\n[ul]\n[li]Positioning: [/li]\n[/ul]\nOne group on each of the 2 front corners of the square dias on the floor of his room, about 40% ajacent to each other\n\n.......................|..******..|\n.......................|.BOSS.|\n.......................|..******..|\n.................G1..------------..G2\n\n[ul]\n[li]Mechanics:[/li]\n[/ul]\n\n[ol]\n[li][b]Most Critical element[/b]: Dispelling [url=http://www.wowhead.com/spell=88954]Consuming Darkness[/url] immediately.[/li]\n[li]Each time he casts [url=http://www.wowhead.com/spell=88942]Meteor Slash[/url], the damage will be spread out betweenthe 5 group members in front of him, reducing it to a very manageable level.  He does not do a Physical cleave, so it is thoroughly acceptable to remain grouped at all times.[/li]\n[li][url=http://www.wowhead.com/spell=88972]Fire Phases[/url]: Stay out of it : Nuff said.  \nFireballs will only land where someone WAS, so a \"stand, shift, stand, shift\" strategy works well here.\nBe sure to return to original positions as his cast ends.[/li]\n\n[/ol]\n[ul]\n[li]Our \"limiting factor\" was healer mana.  Having a shadowpriest for an extra [url=http://www.wowhead.com/spell=64901]Hymn of Hope[/url], and a Balance Druid for an [url=http://www.wowhead.com/spell=29166]Innervate[/url] will help tremendously, although they are not required if fire phases are managed well[/li]\n[/ul]"},{"id":1308606,"r":-1,"n":0,"b":"Boss enrages after 5 minutes, so a minimum DPS of 10K  is needed from all DPS''rs."},{"id":1385715,"r":2,"n":0,"b":"A DK tank can solo tank this boss with anti-magic shell and by switching sides to the other group.\r\n\r\nThere will come a time when the DK has 2 stacks of the meteor slash but shortly after the boss does his felfire storm and the debuffs will fall off."},{"id":1633180,"r":7,"n":3,"b":"How is this a PVP achievement, If its in a raid instance ?\r\nOK someone else has to have won TB for it to be available, but surely this is a Raid not PVP.\r\nI'm angry that I wont be able to complete a PVP achievement because I don't Raid"}]},{"id":6045,"total":6,"comments":[{"id":1508865,"r":15,"n":0,"b":"This was added as a part of [url=http://us.battle.net/wow/en/blog/3401239#blog]Patch 4.2.2[/url] on August 30, 2011.\r\n\r\nIt is not in the offical patch notes, but, well, there it is."},{"id":1512756,"r":11,"n":1,"b":"It should be noted that this achievement is not retroactive, meaning that even if you did kill Occu'thar before, you will have to kill him again to earn this achievement, unless you already have it."},{"id":1515868,"r":4,"n":0,"b":"The achievement PuG leaders have been waiting for since 4.2.."},{"id":1541244,"r":3,"n":0,"b":"This achievement seems to currently not be tracked on Armoury.\n\n[b]Edit:[/b] Forgot to update this post. It is now being tracked on Armoury."},{"id":2142485,"r":12,"n":3,"b":"for some reason when I logged in today, I immediately got this achievement. 0.o"},{"id":2142591,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"it seems with 6.1 they must have retro-activated this achievement I logged in my druid today and got this"}]},{"id":6108,"total":1,"comments":[{"id":1557224,"r":10,"n":0,"b":"The third raid boss in Baradin Hold. between enemy MMR (eMMR) and your personal rating (CR). I looked at this closely during patch 9.0 and found it to be a simple linear correlation which held true regardless of absolute rating level (data below comes from games with CR 1700-2450). Here are the key conclusions to help predict your CR change -\r\n\r\nIf eMMR vs CR = -200, then a win changes CR by +6, a loss changes CR by -18\r\nIf eMMR vs CR = -100, then a win changes CR by +8, a loss changes CR by -16\r\nIf eMMR vs CR = -50, then a win changes CR by +10, a loss changes CR by -13\r\nIf eMMR vs CR = +0, then a win changes CR by +12, a loss changes CR by -12\r\nIf eMMR vs CR = +50, then a win changes CR by +14, a loss changes CR by -11\r\nIf eMMR vs CR = +100, then a win changes CR by +15, a loss changes CR by -8\r\nIf eMMR vs CR = +200, then a win changes CR by +18, a loss Will it be based on K/D, defends, captures, wins/losses as a whole, or some combination of all of these?  It would suck, IMO, to base them purely off a win/loss ratio, as so much random team-assignment screwage will inevitably happen.  Anybody know anything more?"},{"id":1197982,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"I'm not positive, but it would make sense that this will be based off of win/loss ratio from rated battle grounds. I beleive rated BGs are the ones that have 15 players per side or less (no AV or other mass BGs)."},{"id":1333962,"r":29,"n":0,"b":"This can only be obtained by 10v10 games (Warsong Gulch, Battle for Gilneas, and Twin Peaks) as 15v15 games (Arathi Basin, Eye of the Storm, Strand of the Ancients) was removed as of 4.0.6 because of the lack of interest and games played compared to the aforementioned. Along with that change another noticeable one was the removal of Aura Mastery affecting Crusader Aura so that teams can no longer stack Paladins to chain it to reach say for example the Waterworks faster in the Battle for Gilneas.\r\n\r\nFurthermore this takes some time and dedication but not to the extremes the previous way this title was earned. It is far more like arenas in the nature of it's point system but even at very high ratings you will find yourself versus low rated teams and vice versa. If you lose a battle, your Rated Battleground rating will only be reduced if that rating is currently higher than your Match Making Value (MMV). For the most part, a rating only goes up. I have only seen people lose points above a 1800+ rating typically but it does depend on the MMV. On top of that, lower rated teams will give you as little as one point earned if anything at all when winning to slow inflation of teams. The first of the titles isn't even earned until 1100 but once you get to that point, the drive becomes more satisfactory as you gain a title and achievement ever hundred points thereafter.\r\n\r\nThe grind does not require you to be in a guild as isn't a set team either but you cannot queue alone requiring premades only. There is no magic number of healers but most strong groups tend to run with three or possibly more depending on the group make up. It is a very good idea to set up a person designated to run the flag in a specific carrying spec making sure the individual joins the game last to know if they should be in it for Twin Peaks or Warsong Gulch or to be in a more desirable dps or healing spec for Battle for Gilneas. Some sort of commincation system will also likely be required and the more veteran teams will be very vocal and communicative through it. \r\n\r\nAlong with that most teams will have minimum resilience rating required to even participate with the groups typically around 2.5k but some may start even earlier with a lower team rating but the higher the team rating is usually the higher cap will go. Some groups will also not let in certain underpowered specs compared to other classes with control. Some of the best things to have are frost mages for ring of frost, rogues for spamming fan of knives to keep people of the flags or poisons to slow runners, frost death knights for hungering cold, hunters for traps, priests and warlocks of any type for fear bombs in terms of control.\r\n\r\nMost of all it is important to listen to directions and to be very mobile as well as adaptive to whatever the team you are facing strategy is.\r\n\r\n\r\nAll in all this is still a lengthy grind but with good groups it still very achievable with some patience and good play. Remember, don't fight off flags! Best of luck and Lok'tar Ogar!"},{"id":1506141,"r":5,"n":1,"b":"seen a level 70 twink with this today was sweet. cool you can do RBGs with twinks at that level going to so get a team from a win or loss is a direct function of the DIFFERENCE between enemy MMR (eMMR) and your personal rating (CR). I looked at this closely during patch 9.0 and found it to be a simple linear correlation which held true regardless of absolute rating level (data below comes from games with CR 1700-2450). Here are the key conclusions to help predict your CR change -\r\n\r\nIf eMMR vs CR = -200, then a win changes CR by +6, a loss changes CR by -18\r\nIf eMMR vs CR = -100, then a win changes CR by +8, a loss changes CR by -16\r\nIf eMMR vs CR = -50, then a win changes CR by +10, a loss changes CR by -13\r\nIf eMMR vs CR = +0, then a win changes CR by +12, a loss changes CR by -12\r\nIf eMMR vs CR = +50, then a win changes CR by +14, a loss changes CR by -11\r\nIf eMMR vs CR = +100, then a win changes CR by +15, a loss changes CR by -8\r\nIf eMMR vs CR = +200, then a win changes CR by +18, a loss changes CR by -5"}]},{"id":5326,"total":18,"comments":[{"id":1117330,"r":25,"n":1,"b":"Surprising it doesn't have \"and get some fresh air every now and then\" like the Bloodsail Admiral achievement."},{"id":1117445,"r":5,"n":2,"b":"I personally thought this would be granted to the [b]VETERANS[/b] of the Horde..the people that served the Horde 6-7 years ago that earned theyr titles then..but heck winning 500 rated battles should take a blasted long time aswell so youve done some work to earn it least."},{"id":1117554,"r":1,"n":0,"b":"[quote]I personally thought this would be granted to the VETERANS of the Horde..the people that served the Horde 6-7 years ago that earned theyr titles then..but heck winning 500 rated battles should take a blasted long time aswell so youve done some work to earn it least.[/quote]\n\nFor Christ sake, enough whining about the titles already. My calculations say that if you solo a dungeon, 100% of the people in the group are in the same guild which meets the requirement of at least 80%.","also":[]},{"a":5037,"id":1211944,"r":1,"n":0,"body":"Cannot be done solo.","also":[]},{"a":5037,"id":1226460,"r":6,"n":0,"body":"The dungeon/raid guild achievements are only given if 75% of the group is people from your guild. Empty spots in the group/raid are considered as non guild members. This means if you go in solo you are 1 person from your guild and 4 who are not. This means the group is only 20% of your guild. In a 5 man instance you must have at least 4 people who are in your guild. In a 10 man instance you must have at least 8 people who are in your guild. In a 25 man instance you must have at least 19 people who are in your guild. I don't know if \"classic\" raids will count the raid as a 40 person raid for purposes of the achievement, but if they do then they will require at least 30 people who are in your guild. Also, only members who are actually in the instance will be counted. Otherwise, their spot in the group/raid is considered occupied by a non guild member. The level of the members present does NOT matter. If they can enter the instance then they are counted.","also":[]},{"a":5037,"id":1334275,"r":8,"n":1,"body":"You need 3 guild members in your group (including you) while killing the final boss to get this achievement.","also":[]},{"a":5037,"id":1978013,"r":1,"n":0,"body":"You need a minimum of 3 guild members for guild dungeon run, 8 people for a 10 man raid, and 20 people for a 25 man raid.","also":[]},{"a":5038,"id":1160426,"r":-6,"n":0,"body":"Hardest guild achievement ever.","also":[]},{"a":5038,"id":1219779,"r":-5,"n":0,"body":"Doesn't work if you solo the instance.","also":[]},{"a":5038,"id":1221448,"r":-2,"n":1,"body":"Everything I have read so far says group must be 80% guild members. Made full party of guild members(all questing elsewhere) and tried soloing again but nothing. Still believe they're my favorites.","also":[]},{"a":5058,"id":1312217,"r":9,"n":0,"body":"My original comment up top was about RAQ, not TAQ, so it got down-voted. Here's the corrected info: Our guild achieved this on 1/16/11. This is the raid formerly known as AQ40. It's still a 40-person instance as of Cataclysm. To earn the guild achievement, you must have 10 people in the raid be members of the guild. (You can bring up to 30 non-guilded raiders, as long as you have 10 guild members.) You do not have to kill every boss. You can skip any of the optional bosses. The non-optional bosses are: * The Prophet Skeram * Battleguard Sartura * Fankriss the Unyielding * Princess Huhuran * The Twin Emperors : Emperor Vek'lor & Emperor Vek'nilash * C'Thun You'll get some amount of guild XP for each boss kill, but only killing C'Thun grants this achievement. The optional bosses are: * Vem, Yauj, and Kri * Viscidus -- very difficult if you don't have a lot of frost damage to freeze it, and then a lot of melee attacks to destroy it when frozen * Ouro the Sandworm For 85s, the place is mostly easy, but you can still die to falling damage from the mobs with knockback, and the Twin Emperors fight can be difficult if you don't know how the mechanic works (keep them separate, no AOE or dots, need 2 melee tanks and 2 spell casting tanks). You can do this with about a half-dozen 85s. BUT to get the achievement, you still need to have 10 in the instance, even if only a few are actually there to engage C'thun (the rest can be parked by the door).","also":[]},{"a":5059,"id":1263652,"r":-10,"n":0,"body":"We did this with 4 lvl 85 guildies (only this 4 guildies - nobody else in the raid group) but didn't get this achievement...","also":[]},{"a":5059,"id":1264109,"r":29,"n":0,"body":"Credit goes to commenters on the similar achievements: 40 man classic raids require 10 people to get the achievement. 20 man classic raids require 8 people to get the achievement.","also":[]},{"a":5059,"id":1276942,"r":7,"n":0,"body":"Our guild achieved this in the first week of Cata's launch. This is the raid formerly known as AQ20. It's now a 10-person instance as of Cataclysm. To earn the guild achievement, you must have 8 people in the raid be members of the guild. (You can bring up to 2 non-guilded raiders, as long as you have 8 guild members.) You do not have to kill every boss. The first two bosses are required, but then you can skip 3 optional bosses and head straight for Ossirian after the first two are dead. For 80s-85s, the place is ridiculously easy, and it can be done with 2-3. But you still need to have 8 in the instance, even if only a couple are actually there engage Ossirian -- the rest can be parked by the door.","also":[]},{"a":5067,"id":1875108,"r":1,"n":0,"body":"You require a minimum 3/5 people from your guild to get this achievement.","also":[]},{"a":5073,"id":1684883,"r":1,"n":0,"body":"If anyone loses Thrall during this, try looking for him at 52,41. at some point in the road, after you cross a bridge (there should be a rare turtle to your left, friendly), Thrall will step off the road and go along the river up to Tarren Mill, and stop behind the hill that's next to the farm, so that he can infiltrate the city without being found out. You'll have to speak to him again there before you proceed. Hope this helps and solves the problem of \" where did Thrall go? Here's some Information for guild leaders concerning guild achievements based on single and meta-achievement guild runs. If you partially complete a meta-achievement and then faction transfer your guild, there is a very real chance as of the current patch that you will render your guild meta-achievement \"inactive\". What will happen? You will be shown as having received credit for x achievement as part of the meta-achievement progress with a completion date in the tooltip but no assigned character. It will also appear greyed out even though the tooltip will show a completion day in the meta-achievement. The single achievement will show up normally. The only fix available currently is to put in a GM ticket and make sure you explain it carefully and provide screenshots. Personal dealings: It took 10 tickets to get this issued resolved after 3 escalations on february 27, 2012. Why so many? My description of the issue actually. Every GM thought I was speaking of my personal achievements. So guild leaders, if this happened or happens to you, it can be fixed. Be patient with your GM's try to be very clear on the issue and add screenshots","also":[]},{"a":5096,"id":2191939,"r":1,"n":0,"body":"The entrance to this dungeon can be found at the following Here's some Information for guild leaders concerning guild achievements based on single and meta-achievement guild runs. If you partially complete a meta-achievement and then faction transfer your guild, there is a very real chance as of the current patch that you will render your guild meta-achievement \"inactive\". What will happen? You will be shown as having received credit for x achievement as part of the meta-achievement progress with a completion date in the tooltip but no assigned character. It will also appear greyed out even though the tooltip will show a completion day in the meta-achievement. The single achievement will show up normally. The only fix available currently is to put in a GM ticket and make sure you explain it carefully and provide screenshots. Personal dealings: It took 10 tickets to get this issued resolved after 3 escalations on february 27, 2012. Why so many? My description of the issue actually. Every GM thought I was speaking of my personal achievements. So guild leaders, if this happened or happens to you, it can be fixed. Be patient with your GM's try to be very clear on the issue and add screenshots"},{"id":1709949,"r":3,"n":1,"b":"My guild is having a problem with Scarlet Monastery since 5.0 dropped. Were gonna try MC tonite see if we can get thru the Core hounds (Ret Pally, Holy Pally, Rouge)"},{"id":1303842,"r":69,"n":4,"b":"Hey guys, here a little guide how to obtain all of them in Cata: [item=17182] Well, this one shouldn't be hard these days, every class that is capable of soloing in your guild should just farm MC solo until one of them gains the [item=17204], and then everyone who farmed MC should give the [item=17203] they have to the blacksmith who is going to make the [item=17193]. The other maths should already be farmed or buyed of the AH. After that, enjoy your first legendary! (If your guild didn't have one already) 1 down, 5 to go. [item=19019] Yep, this one hurts. Again, everyone who is capable of soloing MC should still do so, until 1 of them was lucky enough to find both of the Bindings (Drop off Baron Geddon and Garr). After that, a lot of people should help getting the mats for the [item=17771], as you need 10 of them, the more people who help here, the better. After that, just bring 1 or 2 people to fight Thunderaan (I'm not sure if this guy i soloable, guess so, but just in case) and this shiny sword is yours! 2 down, 4 to go. [item=49623] Ah, now it's starting to get better. First of all, get some money rollin to get the 25 primordial saronite. This isn't as expensive as it used to be, and you can also use justice points to get them. Again, the more people who help here the faster it goes. The other parts of the first quest is just about killing Festergut and Rotface on 25-player ICC wich shouldn't be much of a problem at lvl 85. Just don't try to solo it. Oh, and you should get Light's Vengeance, wich is basically just go into some cavern in Dragonblight, kill some ghouls and a elite, and loot the hammer. After you turn in this quest, you should go into ICC and kill... 50 scourge. Yes, 50. It was 1000 before Cata but they nerfed it. Hurray. Should be easy. After this, you need it to get infused by Professor Putricide (By eating his slimes as the abomination), Queen Latha'nel (By being the Blood Mirror (stand near main tank)) and Sindragosa (Eat 4 frost breaths without dying and kill her). Beware, this are 3 different quests, so dont do them at once. Lastly, you should obtain 50 [item=50274], wich means kill bosses. Takes some time but after that you have a very nice axe! Most text here but one of the easiest once to obtain due to almost guaranteed drops. 3 down, 3 to go. [item=46017] Ah, Val'anyr. Another pretty easy one at level 85. You first should get 30 [item=45038], wich has a chance to drop from nearly every boss in Ulduar in 25 player mode, wich means farm, farm, farm(Yogg-Saron has a 100% though). When u have 30 u can smelt them together to form [item=45039], wich starts a quest wich leads you to Archivum Console in Ulduar. After that, you obtain a quest to throw the fragments in the mouth of Yogg-Saron when he casts Deafening Roar, while at least 1 keeper isnt assisting you (Kind of a semi-hardmode, think Sartharion 1D). Don't worry, if you fail, you can throw the item again, it isn't destroyed in the progress, it only has a 20-second cooldown. After this, kill Yogg-Saron and loot the quest item, return to the Console and there you have a shiny mace! 4 down, 2 to go. [item=34334] Now it's starting to get annoying. This shiny bow drops from Kil'Jaeden in Sunwell Plateau, at a drop rate of ~5%. Just farming. Now, DONT try to solo this one. You will die pretty horribly. 3 man should be possible, but takes just as few as you feel comfortable with. I'll take 5 or something. This is just farming, so, Good Luck! Oh, and don't forget to take someone with you who can actually EQUIP the bow. :P 5 down, 1 to go. [item=32837] & [item=32838] Ah, best for last. Some people say. The Twin Blades of Azzinoth. Okay, first of all, the off-hand doesn't have a higher droprate than the main-hand. They both drop at a rate of ~4% of Illidan Stormrage, the last boss of Black Temple. Again, take somewere between 3 and 10 people, just as few as you feel comfortable with. This is basically just farming, again. As of patch 4.0.3 (or 4.0.1 ?) Death Knights can obtain these awesome one-handed swords too, so take a DK, Rogue or Warrior with you. After this, your guild has [achievement=5010]! Good Luck Everyone! :D"},{"id":1316429,"r":11,"n":3,"b":"Hey just letting you all know that as long as the person who have the legendary in their inventory is honored with the guild the guild achievement count, you DO NOT need to equip it. Here's some Information for guild leaders concerning guild achievements based on single and meta-achievement guild runs. If you partially complete a meta-achievement and then faction transfer your guild, there is a very real chance as of the current patch that you will render your guild meta-achievement \"inactive\". What will happen? You will be shown as having received credit for x achievement as part of the meta-achievement progress with a completion date in the tooltip but no assigned character. It will also appear greyed out even though the tooltip will show a completion day in the meta-achievement. The single achievement will show up normally. The only fix available currently is to put in a GM ticket and make sure you explain it carefully and provide screenshots. Personal dealings: It took 10 tickets to get this issued resolved after 3 escalations on february 27, 2012. Why so many? My description of the issue actually. Every GM thought I was speaking of my personal achievements. So guild leaders, if this happened or happens to you, it can be fixed. Be patient with your GM's try to be very clear on the issue and add screenshots Updated for the current patch. What will happen? You will be shown as having received credit for x achievement as part of the meta-achievement progress with a completion date in the tooltip but no assigned character. Healer should only focus on healing the tanks at this point."},{"id":1353786,"r":5,"n":0,"b":"We went in to do this guild achievement last weekend - after having tried unsuccessfully shortly after most had dinged 85. You are all right, that the fight becomes incredibly much harder at level 85 because of our largely increased health pools in combination with the Leeching Swarm that Anub does in the third phase. What we ended up doing was go in with only a few level 85s: MT, 2 healers and 2 dps - rest were level 80-81. We went and nuked him in the first phase, killing only the first wave of big adds, then forcing him to skip second phase - going straight into the last phase. In the last phase we all ignored the adds, kept the raiders around 10% health (popped damage mitigation abilities rather than health increasing stuff) - healed the tanks and down he went. I belive we wiped a couple of times figuring out how to do it - but once we sorted the skipping second phase, blowing Heroism in the beginning, and then popping mitigation abilities and damage increase stuff in the last phase, he had to crawl it up - and we could walk out of there with another pretty Guild Achievement off the checklist. Good luck!"}]},{"a":5022,"len":43879,"c":[{"id":1517072,"r":17,"n":0,"b":"Here are the criterias for making it a guildrun; 3/5 - dungeons 8/10 - 10 player raid, 10 player BG 20/25 - 25 player raid, 25 player BG 10/40 - 40 player raid 12/15 - 15 player BG 2/2, 3/3, 5/5 - Arenas"},{"id":1570001,"r":0,"n":0,"b":"any tips for clearing this content nowadays with cata gear and lvl?"}]}]

Our guild got the achievement from a Paladin getting honored with the guild."}]},{"a":5187,"len":51158,"c":[{"id":1211059,"r":8,"n":0,"b":"In the achievement tab it states Requires Guild Reputation: Honored I believe this to mean that for the Legendary you own to count you will need to get honored with your guild. This will be to stop people just swapping around to get the achievement for other guilds but should they actually swap and stay in a guild it will eventually count towards their new home."},{"id":1798961,"r":8,"n":0,"b":"The forming of Val'anyr is very simple, compared to the other legendaries with quest lines attached. In order to collect the 30 fragments of Val'anyr required you simply must run 25 man ulduar. I got an average of 3-4 fragments a week, with a lowest of 2 and a highest of 6 in the one run. The chances of fragments dropping are increased when doing hard mode versions of bosses: Flame Leviathan with the four towers up, XT Heartbreaker, Mimiron Firefighter (push the red button.. No don't push the red button!) Freya with the three elders up, Thorim while Sif is still alive, Hodir speed kill, Yogg-Saron with no keepers. After collecting the 30 fragments, right click to use them, turning them into Shattered Fragments of Val'anyr. This item begins the two part quest chain which rewards val'anyr. After creating the Shattered Fragments of Val'anyr, you must take them to the Archivum Console located near (south of) the Iron Council's room. The Archivum System will than begin a small event, telling you that the only way to create (or rebind, as it says) the weapon is to use the acid inside of Yogg-Saron. You will than be given a quest to throw the Unbound Fragments of Val'anyr (provided) into Yogg-Saron, while he is casting Deafening Roar. He uses this ability during the third phase, after your group has sufficiently damaged his brain and the Shadowy Barrier has been removed. If you miss the roar, the Unbound Fragments of Val'anyr will remain in your bags. You do not consume them in the attempt. They are usable multiple times, with a twenty second cooldown. Once you have successfully thrown the fragments in, and defeated Yogg-Saron, loot the boss. He will have Reforged Hammer of Ancient Kings in the loot. You will be the only person able to loot this, as it is a quest item. Once looted, return to the Archivum Console, hand in the quest and enjoy the roleplay. After the roleplay ends, congratulations on your mace. > {"id":1303842,"rating":69,"nreplies":4,"date":"2011-01-22T04:41:58-06:00","body":"Hey guys, here a little guide how to obtain all of them in Cata:\n\n[item=17182]\nWell, this one shouldn't be hard these days, every class that is capable of soloing in your guild should just farm MC solo until one of them gains the [item=17204], and then everyone who farmed MC should give the [item=17203] they have to the blacksmith who is going to make the [item=17193]. Again, everyone who is capable of soloing MC should still do so, until 1 of them was lucky enough to find both of the Bindings (Drop off Baron Geddon and Garr). After that, a lot of people should help getting the mats for the [item=17771], as you need 10 of them, the more people who help here, the better. After that, just bring 1 or 2 people to fight Thunderaan (I'm not sure if this guy i soloable, guess so, but just in case) and this shiny sword is yours!\n\n2 down, 4 to go.\n\n[item=49623]\nAh, now it's starting to get better. Just don't try to solo it. Oh, and you should get Light's Vengeance, wich is basically just go into some cavern in Dragonblight, kill some ghouls and a elite, and loot the hammer. After you turn in this quest, you should go into ICC and kill... 50 scourge. Yes, 50. It was 1000 before Cata but they nerfed it. Hurray. Should be easy. After this, you need it to get infused by Professor Putricide (By eating his slimes as the abomination), Queen Latha'nel (By being the Blood Mirror (stand near main tank)) and Sindragosa (Eat 4 frost breaths without dying and kill her). Beware, this are 3 different quests, so dont do them at once. Lastly, you should obtain 50 [item=50274], wich means kill bosses. Takes some time but after that you have a very nice axe! Most text here but one of the easiest once to obtain due to almost guaranteed drops.\n\n3 down, 3 to go.\n\n[item=46017]\nAh, Val'anyr. Another pretty easy one at level 85. Don't worry, if you fail, you can throw the item again, it isn't destroyed in the progress, it only has a 20-second cooldown. After this, kill Yogg-Saron and loot the quest item, return to the Console and there you have a shiny mace!\n\n4 down, 2 to go.\n\n[item=34334]\nNow it's starting to get annoying. Oh, and don't forget to take someone with you who can actually EQUIP the bow. :P\n\n5 down, 1 to go.\n\n[item=32837] & [item=32838]\nAh, best for last. Some people say. The Twin Blades of Azzinoth. [code]/run print(\"== Tabards you haven't worn:\") for i=1,99999 do local s,_,d,_,_,_,_,l=GetAchievementCriteriaInfoByID(621,i) if s then if l then _,l=GetItemInfo(l) end if not d then print(l and \"- \"..l or \"- \"..s) end end end print(\"== end\")[/code] Also useful if you're a completionist. Well I died after using the shadow step on claw... ok Im not a subt player. Assassination around 70k-80k I noticed the combat spec stack very slow, and when it start to proc, you want to use Evis all the times, I mean just spam that skill, but I start to thinking, its a dps lose, because you want to use RvS then Evs, so basicly in 6sec proc time you need to spam: RvS then Evs, Rvs then Evs, you would only click around 2-3 times of that rotation during the proc... if you only spam Evs, you could do around the 4-5 Evs... So in end of the test I realize combat is not very good using that daggers. Then we have 2 options, subt and assassination. Subt relaying on Backstab, ambush, Hemo, that could make the daggers stack faster because the Hemo dots, + Poison dots + attack speed. so subt is the ultimate specc for that daggers, however the downside of this specc is the backstab, you cant use backstab in every raid tactic, so the boss like ultraxion you need to replace the backstab to Hemo, and Madness you cant use shadow step. Then I fell in love with assassination... Assassination spec make the daggers stack faster than combat but abit lower than subt, and when you get proc, you just spam the venom like hell. And the result is 80k dps. So rogues its time to return to assassination like the good old time. Btw, I know some ppls will still think the combat is good, well... they say the proc of the daggers will lower then CDs of the AR, and KS, yes I agree! But it took too long time to get the stack over 30+, I didnt test exactly how long time tho. The thing is to let the dagger proc more than ever to increase the dps and combat failed to do that. However! combat still is top1 aoe dps, so this means rogues need to switch to combat during the aoe situations before the encount, you need to know exactly what will happen during the next fight or you will stack with your current talent. Blizz made this daggers is a great news but they set a stupid spec trap to control our dps... [quote]-- Fangs of the Father ---- Assassination: 23.139% chance on white/yellow melee landing, no ICD. ---- Combat: 9.438% chance on white/yellow melee landing, no ICD. ---- Subtlety: 28.223% chance on white/yellow melee landing, no ICD. ---- These chances are multiplied by 0.9 for lvl 89 targets, 0.8 for lvl 90 targets, 0.7 for lvl 91 targets, 0.6 for lvl 92 targets, and 0.5 for lvl 93+ targets. ---- After adding a stack, if you have >30 stacks, you have a [1/(51-stacks)] chance to proc the Fury buff. [quote]-- Fangs of the Father ---- Assassination: 23.139% chance on white/yellow melee landing, no ICD. ---- Combat: 9.438% chance on white/yellow melee landing, no ICD. ---- Subtlety: 28.223% chance on white/yellow melee landing, no ICD. ---- These chances are multiplied by 0.9 for lvl 89 targets, 0.8 for lvl 90 targets, 0.7 for lvl 91 targets, 0.6 for lvl 92 targets, and 0.5 for lvl 93+ targets. ---- After adding a stack, if you have >30 stacks, you have a [1/(51-stacks)] chance to proc the Fury buff. > [{"id":1415566,"n":3,"b":"The most important part: [b]How to get yours![/b] [i]Contains spoilers btw[/i]\n[s]As a pre-requisite, you must have cleared the first tier of raiding (nefa/al akir/cho gall). Probably normal mode will do.[/s] [i]This has been removed as a requirement.[/i] Instead, you must kill a [url=http://ptr.wowhead.com/npc=53115]Molten Lord[/url] inside Firelands (trash mob) to pick up the quest.\n\n1. [url=http://ptr.wowhead.com/quest=29129]A Legendary Engagement[/url] - Pick up the quest from a capital.\n2. [url=http://ptr.wowhead.com/quest=29134]A Wrinkle in Time[/url] - Talk to Anachronos\n3. [url=http://ptr.wowhead.com/quest=29135]All-Seeing Eye[/url] - Collect 25x[url=http://www.wowhead.com/item=71141]Eternal Ember[/url] (drops from bosses) and 3x [url=http://ptr.wowhead.com/item=65893]Sands of Time[/url] (vendor)\n4. [url=http://ptr.wowhead.com/quest=29193]On a Wing and a Prayer[/url] - Go to Coldarra\n5. [url=http://ptr.wowhead.com/quest=29194]Through a Glass, Darkly[/url] - RP inside Nexus\n6. [url=http://ptr.wowhead.com/quest=29225]Actionable Intelligence[/url] - Go talk to Kalecgos\n7. [url=http://ptr.wowhead.com/quest=29234]Delegation[/url] - Go to Firelands and pick up [url=http://ptr.wowhead.com/item=69646]Branch of Nordrassil[/url]. This drops of a named \"boss\" named Volcanus the Firelord, youll need a full raid to do the encounter. To get to him, kill bosses in FL and collect stuff from them while doing it.\n8. [url=http://ptr.wowhead.com/quest=29239]Nordrassil's Bough[/url] - Give the bough to Kalecgos in Coldarra now. At this point, you probably receive the first stage of this staff, [url=http://ptr.wowhead.com/item=71084]Branch of Nordrassil[/url]. Or maybe in the previous quest, w/e.\n9. [url=http://ptr.wowhead.com/quest=29240]Emergency Extraction[/url] - Go to Coldarra with Kalec, RP ensues, probably a cutscene\n10. [url=http://ptr.wowhead.com/quest=29269]At One[/url] - Tarecgosa wipes and Kalecgos does some [i]inserting action[/i] (HoN Empath anyone?)\n11. [url=http://ptr.wowhead.com/quest=29270]Time Grows Short[/url] - Collect 1000x[url=http://ptr.wowhead.com/item=69815]Seething Cinder[/url] from Firelands (aka Shadowfrost shards). You get around 50 from 25man bosses and around 20 from 10man.\n12. [url=http://ptr.wowhead.com/quest=29285]Alignment[/url] - Some more blue dwagon RP in coldarra - cutscenes galore again probably. Kalecgos becomes the new aspect.At this point, you receive the second stage of this staff, [url=http://ptr.wowhead.com/item=71085]Runestaff of Nordrassil[/url] \n13. [url=http://ptr.wowhead.com/quest=29307]Heart of Flame[/url] - Go kill Ragnaros (normal/heroic, both work. You get extra debuff in the fight) and loot [url=http://ptr.wowhead.com/item=69848]Heart of Flame[/url]. [i]In addition[/i], you must [b]FIRST[/b] leech 250 Smouldering Essences from bosses in Firelands. On 25man, heroic bosses drop ~17-18 of them. Half of that on normal. Assuming less on 10man.\n14. [url=http://ptr.wowhead.com/quest=29312]The Stuff of Legends[/url] - Dwagon RP in capital + you receive your staff! Huzzah! Also, whole guild receives the minipet available for purchase.\n\nThe iLvl is the same as heroic ragnaros, 397, after patch.\n\nEdit: Fixed to correct ember thanks to Teenkas note on the change from PTR."},{"id":1528349,"n":0,"b":"Completed this today, some helpful tips:\r\n\r\n[ul]\r\n[li]After the nerf, Ragnaros does not pose much of a threat (in normal, that is). You can easily survive all through P2 staying outside the group, with no healer CD's needed. I hugged for the Sulfuras Smash during Molten Seed, though. You should be able to as well.\r\n[/li]\r\n[li]There is no timer on the debuff you receive, but before you explode, a hellfire-like effect will start about 5 seconds prior to the explosion. This should warn you to move away.[/li]\r\n[li]After Ragnaros died, I did not receive the fire resistance buff. However, looting the Heart was no problem. Ask your healers to spam heal you. There is no cast bar - looting the item is instant.[/li]\r\n[li]Once you are done, report back in Orgrimmar/Stormwind. Save yourself the flight to Coldarra... which I sadly didn't.\r\n\r\n\r\nA fun little fact about the staff is that the mount works even in areas which don't allow the use of flying mounts. Battlegrounds, dungeons... Pretty fun to see a big, shiny drake in those places.\r\nGood luck on your staff quest, everyone - it's definitely worth the wait."},{"id":2551106,"n":0,"b":"If anyone is looking to get this and wondering how long will this take here is the answer [u][b]9-12 weeks[/b][/u] because of the farming and can only run once per week and assuming your running 25 Heroic solo (or only one rolling on mat items). Idealist 9 weeks with 2 weeks for 25 Embers, doing charged shards without killing the bosses reset then starting 3 weeks of 1000 Seething Embers, overlapping into 4 additional weeks for 250 Smouldering Essences. \nBreak down of of farming (assuming you complete outside Firelands quests at the same week of the pre/post farm week):\n[b][i]25 Embers[/i][/b] - Stage 3 ( [quest=29135 domain=www] ) [b]2-3 weeks[/b], drops rates 10-14 per week 25 Heroic\n[b][i]4 Charged Embers[/i][/b] ( [quest=29234 domain=www] ) Stage 7 - [b]1-2 weeks[/b], [b][u]can be done in 0 week[/u][/b] as long you perform each of the 4 bosses without killing the 4 bosses and perform each mechanic to get a charged shard\n[b][i]1000 Seething Embers[/i][/b] Stage 11 ( [quest=29270 domain=www]) - [b]3 Weeks[/b] Drop rates approx 60 per boss on 25 Heroic giving about 400 per week. On week 3 don't finish instance once you have 1000 exit so you overlap into next\n[b][i]250 Smouldering Essences[/i][/b] Stage 13 ([quest=29307 domain=www]) - [b]4 Weeks[/b] Drop rates 10 per Boss on 25 Heroic (only first 6 bosses, doesn't drop off Ragnaros). Given that from previous you completed the 1000 embers you left and still had 3 bosses still up and started the farm that week (30 + 60 per week for 4 weeks after)"},{"id":5617963,"n":2,"b":"For those like myself who aren't sure if they have started the questline yet, you can paste this script in-game to find out.\r\n\r\nAlliance:\r\n/script print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(29453))\r\n/run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(29132))\r\n\r\nHorde\r\n/script print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(29452))\r\n/run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(29129))\r\n\r\nCheck both! I hadn't  completed Your Time Has Come, but have completed A Legendary Engagement.\r\n'True' you have completed this part of the quest chain\r\n'False' you have not. \r\n\r\nYou can continue checking your progress by changing the  last number in the script (quest ID) by opening the corresponding quest in wowhead. You will find the number in the URL in the address line  eg.  https://www.wowhead.com/quest=[b]29134[/b]/a-wrinkle-in-time."},{"id":5866271,"n":0,"b":"[b]Soloing this as an Arcane Mage, Level 70, iLv 487[/b] (no Arcane Familiar) was a bit tricky, but here is the run down.  I would also like to mention that I originally received this staff on my Main with the help of the guild I was briefly a part of back in 2009 when Cataclysm was live. It was a long haul for all of us to gather the mats but we all shared in the achievement and obviously the pet and Guild Feat of Strength.\n\n[b]** NOTE: If you wish to do the next part of the questline in the Firelands quicker, DO NOT kill any of the bosses, just go invisible to lose aggro. **\n[/b]\n[i]Try not to use any attacks that proc secondary attacks, i.e.: if you have any arcane charges left, using arcane barrage can shoot at multiple targets that are not actually targeted, but close to the selected target, bad idea. If you have your talents set up for Orb cleave (if you cast arcane barrage, you may also initiate an Orb Barrage being launched, again, bad idea. [b]I just used arcane blast, spellsteal to aggro Beth'tilac, mirror image to encourage Riplimb to use it as a chew toy, and arcane missiles when I needed to hit an add that was no where near the boss[/b] - wearing the [b]Wayward Chronomancer's set gear[/b] can proc multiple arcane missile targets. [/i]\n\n[b]Shannox:[/b]\nWhile mounted, run through the boss to aggro him. You can use arcane missiles to kill of [b]Rageface[/b] as this mutt is a pain to deal with and you only need one hound to do this task. Cast [b]Mirror Image[/b] to have [b]Shannox[/b] start tossing crystal traps, if you try this without either a friend grouped with you in the raid or a class that has constant pets like hunters or warlocks have, then [b]Shannox[/b] will not toss traps down to try and catch you. Once he does throw some traps about, you need to maneuver [b]Riplimb[/b] to cross into the trap, become encased in the red crystal and wait for him to break out. If you cannot collect the single fragment that does drop when the hound breaks out, wait until you cast your [b]Mirror Image[/b] again to trap [b]Riplimb[/b] a second time, then collect the first piece. I didn't really move far from the boss as I took no damage and did not walk into a trap myself. Once you have done this to get 3 of these pieces, use them, to combine them into the [b]Dull Emberstone Focus[/b], If you are using DBM, wait until you see [b]Shannox[/b] about to cast his spear and place the focus on the ground (use) there will be a nice big target pattern on the ground where the spear is intended to hit, you do not have to be in the center of it, just by this will do.  Once the spear hits, the focus is changed into the \"[b]Charged Emberstone Focus[/b]\". Pick it up, then you can go invisible to lose aggro from the boss.\n\n[b]Beth'tilac:[/b]\nThis boss I ran through, jumped up into her, but nothing aggro'd it until I cast [b]Spellsteal[/b] (does no damage). Then she went up to the top web and shortly after, [b]Cinderweb Spinners[/b] begin to dangle from the web above, kill a few and wait until the [b]Cinderweb Drones[/b] begin to spawn at the cave areas around the fight arena you're in. You need to kill 3 Drones to get your 3 [b]Obsidian-Flecked Chitin Fragments[/b]. Combine them into the [b]Dull Chitinous Focus[/b] and then use one of the web ropes left over from killing a [b]Cinderweb Spinner[/b] to climb up to where the boss is. You are going to put down (use) this focus near [b]Beth'tilac[/b] just before she does [b]Smoldering Devastation[/b]. This charges the focus and it becomes the [b]Charged Chitinous Focus[/b]. Pick it up, cast [b]Slow Fall[/b] and go invisible to leave the fight. You'll float down to the ground and can run out of the boss area. \n\nAdded Note: I would like to point out that this fight/looting of Foci pieces, has been a bit more frustrating in that once a drone comes out, you kill it and get your 3 pieces from it, then going up to [b]Beth'tilac[/b], I always was knocked down after dropping the focus, and could not go back up. What I did was get the 3 shards, made the focus and then went invisible, left raid, reset it and went back in, [b]Beth'tilac[/b] was  there again, no 30 minute wait as I read somewhere else, and once the [b]Cinderweb Spinners[/b] came down, I killed on, went up, wait until about 10 seconds before the [b]Smoldering Devastation[/b], which dropped me off the web each time, went back up killing another [b]Cinderweb Spinner[/b] and retrieved my now [b]charged focus[/b]. \n\n[b]Lord Rhyolith:[/b]\nThis was the easiest procedure, run up to the boss and he begins the fight. Skirt the outer edge of the rock platform looking for your [b]Rhyolite Fragments[/b]. They seemed to be slow to appear, one at a time. After you combine the 3 into the [b]Dull Rhyolite Focus[/b], then use arcane explosion under the Rhyolith's legs, this kills both legs and begins phase 2 of the fight. After he has changed into the molten giant, he is going to do a [b]Concussive Stomp[/b] to you at one point, put the Dull Focus (use) down on the ground (typically right in front of him, close to under his toes, lol) and wait for the stomp. The [b]Dull Rhyolite Focus[/b] becomes the [b]Charged Rhyolite Focus[/b]. Pick it up and go invisible.\n\n[b]Alysrazor:[/b]\nThis is a longer procedure and kind of gets 'hazy' as in the screen become cluttered with bright yellow white fire pillars making it hard to see the ground. Once [b]Alysrazor[/b] begins phase 1, you wait until the two molten eggs hatch. Each of the [b]Voracious Hatchings[/b] can be killed. Pick up the two [b]Pyreshell Fragments[/b] and basically run about killing the priests with arcane missiles until the next 2 eggs spawn and hatch. Kill the second set of Hatchlings and collect your third [b]Pyreshell fragment[/b]. I say to kill these adds because they are bright yellow white, and it makes seeing the ground quite difficult in order to collect your fragments. You have the fire grubs belching jets of continuous flame around, fiery balls of flame moving around and then priests shooting fire at you, the adds just make a difficult situation more difficult to see. Combine them into the [b]Dull Pyreshell Focus[/b] and hang onto this as you will need to use it when phase 3 finally starts. While waiting, I ended up picking up 3 feathers and flew about behind [b]Alysrazor[/b] going through the fire rings until phase 2 began, the storm of fire pillars/tornadoes and that was where it was hard to see anything. Just run about and kill off adds, but use arcane missiles and make sure you never accidently target the boss.\n[i]Once phase 3 starts, [b]Alysrazor[/b] is on the ground, go to her head and place the [b]Dull Pyreshell Focus[/b] (use) under her head.[/i] The clerics will be throwing beams of fiery energy at her to recharge her. At one point she stands up, and pulses of fire keep flowing off of her, but your Dull Focus is still 'dull.' You basically have to wait until phase 1 starts again as she takes off from the ground and has finally charged your dull focus into the [b]Charged Pyreshell Focus[/b]. Pick it up an go invisible.\n\nThe four Charged Foci are now ready to use for the next part, opening the portal killing some more mobs and getting the branch back, unfortunately I killed my bosses so I'll update this next week with the finish to the Delegation quest! So, once you have your 4 charged foci, head to the north west on your map, to the \"[b]Path of Corruption[/b]\". Follow it to a pair of fiery branches \"[b]Circle of Thorns[/b]\" and right click on any of your charged foci in your bags. This opens a portal to the next part of the quest, getting the [b]Branch of Nordrassil[/b]. I used Arcane Barrage on all the priests and then went to the center of the area, touched the interactable there, one-shotted the tree, it became friendly then you become the tree, but you have the chance to one-shot the next boss before you change and so I did. I had to wait about 10 seconds to change back to myself, then waited to pick up the [b]Branch of Nordrassil[/b] on the ground. All very easy. Teleport right from this finished fight area in the raid to [b]Northrend - Dalaran[/b], then take the taxi to the \"[b]Amber Ledge[/b]\" flight point to meet with [b]Kalecgos[/b] to turn in the quest. \n\nPS: There are some very nice videos out there by dedicated players, thank you for your efforts. But I have found that sometimes there is just too much activity going on to see what they are trying to explain to you in the video, thus my readable process to get these four charged foci for opening the portal. You should also know that you can collect these focus fragments in either Normal or Heroic modes and use them on either mode to open the portal.\n\n[i]The reason I mentioned the [b]Arcane Missiles[/b] and [b]Arcane Barrage[/b] attacks in the beginning is because the gear from DF for Mages can proc multiple targets to hit when using Arcane Missiles and if you have any Arcane Charges built up from casting say [b]Arcane Explosion[/b] for example, you can inadvertently proc a multi target when you use Arcane Barrage. That is what happened and I killed Beth'tilac accidently while trying to charge my focus.[/i]"},{"id":6414659,"n":0,"b":"Hello,\r\n\r\nI want to share to everyone that the criteria to unlock [quest=72900 domain=www] has been updated as of recently, likely when Mana-Forge Omega was released. This questchain is the prelude and a requirement to unlock the Kalecgos questchain which primarily rewards [item=206162 domain=www] giving us Tarecgosa as a mount without having to use [item=71086 domain=www] .\r\n\r\nI’ve had a giant headache the last couple of days retracing my quest steps as to why [quest=72900 domain=www] didn’t show up from Kalecgos in Valdrakken. I finished the base Dragonflight questing zones fully despite that I have done it previously many times on my account, researched Wowhead quest comments to solutions but no luck there.\r\n\r\nMy final chance was to complete the small questchain [quest=70437 domain=www] and after completing it with [quest=72380 domain=www] as well as a simple relog, the [quest=72900 domain=www] did indeed show up!\r\n\r\nThink that the problem is that the Vault of the Incarnates quest to kill Raszageth has been reworked as a Story Mode with followers, similar to Mana-Forge Omega where you kill Dimensius with followers in a Story Mode. Not sure why this should be connected to the “Keeper of the Ossuary” quest though.\r\n\r\nBut yes this is the solution in The War Within, if “Keeper of the Ossuary” won’t show up. Hope this helped!"}]

> [{"a":30116,"len":104373,"n":17,"profit":[]},{"a":30118,"len":147902,"n":28,"profit":[]},{"a":29234,"len":815165,"n":217,"profit":[{"id":3186613,"r":130,"n":7,"b":"As of BfA (perhaps even Shadowlands)...\n\nThe only [b]annoying[/b] part of this quest is getting [b]Shannox Charged item[/b], solo. All other 3 are very easy: \n[ul]\n[li][b]Beth'ilac[/b] (auto-attack her to begin) kill all adds, but the 'nerubian-like' one [b]Cinderweb Drone[/b], is the one you need, 1 drops all 3 fragments, create [b]Dull item[/b], click a web string to get on top near the boss, and as soon she begins casting the 8s Devastation (happens right after her energy drops to 0%), drop the Dull Item and grab the [b]Charged Item[/b]. Drop on hole, and reset fight (if you can't, use some kind of 'teleport' (I got engineers with 2-3s teleports)).[/li]\n[/ul][ul]\n[li][b]Rhyolith[/b] is the easiest one, just max-out zoom, walk near him to start fight and keep walking near the edges of the island, looking for the 'purplish' rocks near the edges (you can spot it from afar, if you dropped Graphics down). Grab 3 while single targetting down the 2 adds that ocasionally spawn. With 3 fragments, create the [b]Dull Item[/b], get beneath the boss, and as soon you seem him casting the 'Stomp', drop it, then grab the [b]Charged Item[/b]. Reset, or just jump into the lava to get killed. [/li]\n[/ul][ul]\n[li][b]Alysrazor[/b] too, is pretty much easy now. The 2 eggs are dropped in the middle of the room after a while, and some seconds after, and then a 3rd time. You only need 3. Begin fight normally, let her fly low then take off, Single target only the casters while waiting for the eggs, kill the hatchlings that come out of them, and grab the shards beneath the area they were dropped. Wait for second wave of eggs, rinse. Create [b]Dull item[/b]. Now, wait for the Boss to drop in the middle of the room (you'll notice her energy is depleted), let the casters channel into her, and be ready to drop the Dull item anywhere (preferably on clear floor) when you see the boss with 80+ energy. She will get up but still a bit low untill 100% and when she takes off again, grab the [b]Charged Item[/b] from where you dropped it. Reset, teleport, or try to take a feather and fly away (didn't try this last trick).[/li]\n[/ul][ul]\n[li][b]Shannox[/b], the annoying one, here you'll want to Single target [npc=53695] down asap. His raging face stun ability has a 30s duration, but he can reapply it almost undefinitely, maybe only classes that can put instant DoTs might kill him between these annoying stuns:\n[ul]\n\n[li]For [b]Classes that can use a pet undefinitelly[/b] (mages can go frost and use the water elemental), just put them in passive, turn off any autocasting ability, especially damaging ones (warlocks' voidwalker has one), and use command to move them, and put them on their path. Stay a bit far from them while they all target your pet. Send it to single target Rageface, and once he's dead, send him a bit away again or move yourself out. Step into the [b]crystal prison traps[/b] and send your pet to hit it, single target. Once out, grab the fragment, and rinse 2 more times, untill you got 3 and can create the [b]Dull item[/b]. Once you got it, stand near your pet, but this time, avoid the traps, and keep watching where Shannox drops his spear, you'll notice a fiery rune appear on the spot 2-3 seconds before that (usually a bit to his right side, if he's targetting the pet). Get into it and drop the dull item FAST. The spear hits it and then get the final [b]Charged Item[/b]. Profit.[/li]\n[/ul]\n[ul]\n[li]For [b]Classes without a permanent pet[/b] it is a bit harder to do (Shamans, Priests and Druids). I'd recommend doing the pull the closest to the entrance possible, and move them to the bottom of the path to exit if you can.: \n\nFor [b]Shamans[/b], I'd recommend going as elemental. As soon as they are passing near the spot the closest to the exit, Single target down [npc=53695], if you can't kill it fast enough (due to low dps from few equipment), call the earth elemental, put it in passive and send it to attack and kill rageface, then [b]move it[/b] closer to the path to exit. It lasts 60s, so make good use of it. While moving it, try stepping in the [b]crystal traps[/b], target it and send your pet to hit it, move it away so you can see the fragment on the ground and grab it. If you can manage a second trap-break with the pet, good, if not, rush to exit, get back in and rinse; \n\nFor [b]Priests[/b] (I recommend as Shadow), it's almost the same as with the Shammy, position near their path, the closest to exit, target Rageface and call your [b]Shadowfien/Mindbender[/b] to attack it, ONLY. After that, send it to attack Shannox if possible, but ONLY attack rageface, yourself, do nothing on the 2 others (only your pet, and only on Shannox). For priest, if you don't manage to kill rageface fast, try targetting it and spam the instant DoT, sometimes after he finishes casting its stun, you got time to do that, and it will kill it sometime. Since your pet lasts so fewer time, you'll have to [b]CAREFULLY[/b] make [npc=53694] walk into them, it'll get stunned, you can target the prison and insta-kill it (it will drop in time, but time is of the essence), move them away and spam click the [b]fragment[/b] untill you grabbed it. For next fragment you can send your pet again, this time to Shannox or, for safety, rush to exit then rinse; \n\nFor [b]Druids[/b], talent to [spell=205636] and do the same as for the 2 previous cases. Wait for them at the spot, keep kiting them to the path to exit, while killing RageFace in SINGLE TARGET. The talent is placed in a targeted area, try, at first, to hit Rageface alone, and after it is dead, Shannox. Meanwhile Shannox, as with previous cases, will be dropping the traps, they last a bit, so make sure to come back to the reddish [b]crystal prison[/b] ones if you must use riplimb on them. A good time to make it walk into them is after Shannox throws his spear at a fiery rune, Riplimb walks to it to grab it and give to Shannox. Position yourself in a way that when Riplimb walks back to you, he is hit by trap[/li]\n[/ul][/li]\n[/ul]\n\nMy best advice is that you take almost all your gear, if you have to leave anything, leave non-damaging-proc trinkets or rings. This way your pets wont kill shannox accidentally. \nOnce you got all 3 fragments and the [b]Dull item[/b] next, Do the same as with classes with permanent pets. After killing Rageface, stand near your pet, dodge the traps but keep an eye on his spear cast and spot to drop the Dull item. Grab your [b]Charged Item[/b] and you're done.;\n\nFor the last part, use all 4 items at the circle, port to the next area, kill the casters normally, and once you click the branch in the middle, run to the portal, and wait for the tree to come to you, [b]auto-attack it[/b]. Once he gets [b]friendly[/b] he turns you into a tree, you can't move for some seconds, and once you can, kill [b]Vulcanus[/b] and a bit after grab the Branch. Gratz on the hardest part of this questline. \n\nPS: It is for the best, as high leveled character, to unequip most (if not all) your equipment, so you don't accidentally kill the bosses during this quest (specially on the druid), as you'll need them alive to speed one of the next quests in the line. Also, since these old raids were turned into a [b]flex mode[/b], you are able to [b]kill the bosses twice per week, once in heroic, once in normal[/b]. So after you finish this quest, remember to kill them twice, before next week reset. This works for the previous collecting part of the questline."},{"id":5795086,"r":7,"n":2,"b":"As of 10.2.5. here is how to solo Shannox as a shaman at max lvl in normal, didn't tried in heroic: \n\n1 Start fight with Earthbind Totem on top of them: they will be aggroed to the totem and he will throw the trap at you\n\n2 Wait until totem vanishes and stand right behind the trap facing Shannox. Probably Rageface will stun you, while Ripclimb gets trapped.\n\n3 The trap will break itself and as soon as you get unstunned, kill Rageface. \n\n4 The crystal should be on the floor, spam click it until you get it.\n\n5 Reset the fight by joining a follower dungeon (this is the easiest and fastest way to reset)\n\nRepeat steps 1-5 times until you have 3 crystals and you combine them. Then next all you have to do is drop the crystal on the spear center. And profit."},{"id":5898413,"r":16,"n":3,"b":"Did this on mage solo season 4 of dragonflight. This is how I did it without even taking off gear.\n\nAll are easy but Shannox.  A lot of old guides use the old water elemental but that doesn't work anymore. I killed shannox on heroic and normaly trying to use the icy veins summoned elemental. [spell=12472] WILL 1 shot shannox even with gear taken off. Follow this one for the new mage.\n[ul]\n[li]Fire blast rageface to begin encounter.[/li]\n[li]Cast Mirror Image to spawn a trap[/li]\n[li]Wait for trap to despawn and crystal to appear[/li]\n[li]Cast invisibility to reset the fight[/li]\n[li]Pick up your crystal.[/li]\n[li]Repeat 3 times[/li]\n[li]Engage shannox 1 last time, drop on ground before spear[/li]\n[li]Profit[/li]\n[/ul]"}]}]

For the rogues who already did the quest, how many pickpockets did it take for you to get the ring?"},{"id":1556383,"r":5,"n":0,"b":"I've gone and done the fight several times, and believe a sub spec rogue has an advantage over assassin and combat. Most of the fight is kiting the boss out of the purple aoe he places from Consuming Darkness. So a sub rogue's Shadowstep would make it trivial to get back on the boss to kick, and much less damage taken from the Consuming Darkness. - Consuming Darkness - 1 second cast that spawns an AOE underneath the player that does roughly 9k per tick. This move is uninterruptible and you would run out of it to kite the boss a little. - Blackhowl's Will - 1.5 second cast that hits the target for roughly 20k shadow damage (this also saps you off all your energy down to 0). You need to kick this, I don't believe that [spell=51679] is much help b/c of the travel time of the throw. But you can also coat mind numbing on your thrown weapons and [spell=51723] spam with [item=45766] for kiting, or throw at him. - Shadow Breath - 1 second cast warm up, 3 second channeled duration that deals shadow damage in front of him. Just don't stand in front of him, very easy to get out of this and able to keep dps on him from behind/on the side while he's channeling. When he berserks at exactly 2 minutes (grows big and red), use [spell=2094] paired with [item=64493]Glyph of Blind on him to get your"},{"id":1556907,"r":8,"n":0,"b":"[quote]ADD: He also has an Enrage at 10%. Yes, keep evasion for this part, his melee attacks hit a lot harder, and use [url=http://www.wowhead.com/item=45769]Glyph of Cloak of Shadows[/url] so you can stand in the voids as well as taking less damage. Edit: tested the proc of the setbonus to get the suffering buff. It took my combat speced rogue about 5 mins to get 50 stacks (22% haste unbuffed, 90% haste with trinket and SnD up), and my assassin spec rogue 1 min 40 seconds (15.3% haste unbuffed, 80% haste with trinket procs and SnD up) to get to 50 stacks. It seems to be working off a percentage per hit like [item=2892], not a PPM mechanism like [item=6947] to be around 20% with just pure white hits and specials. Dots themselves do not make it proc, in fact, it seems that dots lowers the chance to proc. I tested this by using the updated version of recount and counting up to 49 stacks of the buff in full bg gear, except the 2 piece t12 test on a standard assassin speced rogue. So in answer to the above: 1) Dunno about the 15mins/reset rule, I have heard it's 12 hours but I don't know if that is true, but WIPING ON HAGARA (getting her to despawn is probably the key thing here) definitely resets it. Dont bother wasting time going to wyrmrest temple."},{"id":2050032,"r":33,"n":1,"b":"As of 6.0.x, it is really easy to solo Dragon Soul at level 100 and probably at lower levels too. On my 100 rogue, I went into Dragon Soul to kill the first four bosses. After taking down the first boss, I could talk to [url=http://www.wowhead.com/npc=55476]Lord Afrasastrasz[/url] on the first floor of the Wyrmrest Temple. Once the next three bosses were down, I was able to go to Eye of Eternity to spawn [url=http://www.wowhead.com/npc=55689]Hagara the Stormbinder[/url]. Here's the important part: She spawns a few trash packs. Just kill them. After [url=http://www.wowhead.com/npc=57821]the last trash mob[/url], the boss will jump down to the center of the room and become attackable. [u]She does not engage you automatically[/u]. Make sure to keep a distance when she jumps down to not accidentally body-pull her. Being in stealth may help here. At level 100, you can simply walk up to her - in [url=http://www.wowhead.com/spell=1784]Stealth[/url], of course - and use [url=http://www.wowhead.com/spell=921]Pick Pocket[/url]. Your rogue can be logged out while the ring is charging. Corastrasza is located at 29.0, 25.0 in the middle/under the big tree. BTW, exalted faction rep with Ravenhordt will be of no help in the next quest. All the guards will still be very hostile."},{"id":1570111,"r":210,"n":9,"b":"To complete this quest as Alliance you must first visit [url=http://ptr.wowhead.com/npc=57800]Thaumaturge Rafir[/url] who is in Stormwind located at 50.6, 61.3 and pay him 10.000 gold. As Horde you go to [url=http://ptr.wowhead.com/npc=57801]Thaumaturge Altha[/url] located at 57.6, 65.5 in Orgrimmar and also pay 10.000 gold. The first week, you will pick pocket Hag. The followup quests will take a minimum of 13 hours. 12 to charge the ring, 1 to do the rest. Next, you'll need the 333 gems. If the average is 6 gems per cluster, you will need 56 clusters in order to do the turn in. That means that at 8 clusters a week, it will take you 7 weeks to collect all of the shadowy gems you need for the second phase of the daggers. Note that the [url=http://www.wowhead.com/quest=30116]Sharpening Your Fangs[/url] quest requires [u]60 Shadowy Gem Clusters[/u] [b][i]not[/i][/b] [u]60 Shadowy Gems[/u]. [s]That means when people are talking about your \"leftovers\" going towards your total in the end, that's wrong.[/s] That means your \"leftovers\" are the [b]intact clusters[/b] you loot from bosses. You're now looking at another 60 bosses total that you need to clear before you'll have enough clusters. That will take another 8 weeks. 1 Week for PP and Phase 1 daggers 7 Weeks (on average, could be longer or shorter depending on RNG) for Phase 2 daggers. 8 Weeks for Phase 3 daggers. Happy hunting! EDIT 2012.04.09 in response to below comment: It has been "},{"id":1671018,"r":19,"n":1,"b":"Just watched the video on Youtube, since I don't have a max level rogue and probably won't for quite a while. Those shiny spellcasters - the druids, the priests, mages, warlocks - they helped extinguish Ragnaros' rain of terror, their names declared by the Blue Dragonflight above Stormwind and Orgrimmar, bearers of Tarecgosa's legacy. The heroes who helped Wrathion in Pandaria, slaying Sha upon Sha and putting an end to the last gasp of one of the Old Ones, immortalized upon the arches of Mogu'shan Palace, long after its plundering and the breaking of the great siege. The doughty plate-clad fighters, wielders of power of holy, unholy, and sheer brawn, bore Shadowmourne from its origin of Arthas' long-abandoned weapon, became glorified and exalted amongst both Alliance and Horde. Those are the guys you remember, with their legacies of fame and fortune. We don't have such a flashy proof - no azure whelps following us around, no brilliant wings of multicoloured light, no screaming of souls or thunderous judgment of the storm - but we did our jobs anyway. Quietly. Over time, again and again, a well-positioned blade in the dark where one was needed, just so. Even dragons die, after all."},{"id":2266308,"r":3,"n":0,"b":"If you are lucky like me, to get [quest=30116] done at the Warmaster or before so you still can complete [quest=30118] in the same week, you might encounter a problem if you play on 10 man HC. It's confusing..."}]},{"a":5375,"c":[{"id":1375910,"r":7,"n":0,"b":"There are two ways to do this achievement. The once-a-day (easy) method and the win-TB-all-the-time (hard) method. The hard method consists of doing every single Peninsula daily, and then fighting and winning TB [b]at least[/b] three times per day. This seems like a lot of time investment, but there is a reason for winning TB beyond just the 250 rep you get for each victory. When your side wins TB, two quest NPCs spawn with various dailies for you to do. One of those two spawns is randomly chosen from a pool of NPCs (the other never changes) and each NPC in the pool has three daily quests unique to them. So if you've got the time, you can do not six TB victor dailies, but a grand total of 12 TB victor dailies (the default three plus three for each of the three possible NPC spawns) provided you catch each of the three NPCs each day. The easy method consists of winning TB once, doing the Island dailies, and then crossing over to the Peninsula to do those dailies. You'll gain less rep/day with this method, but it is more efficient over the long haul, as you aren't going back to TB multiple times per day for a shot at three extra dailies each time."}]},{"a":5376,"c":[{"id":1688640,"r":6,"n":0,"b":"Do the dailies in [zone=5389] and you can get this easy. The Beth kill SHOULD have put him over, but it didn't. :-/ Additionally, this rep can only be maxed out via heroic kills (up to 999 that is), as after I killed Shannox, I was at 305/999, and did not gain any additional rep for the two normal mode kills afterwards. This may be different when killing Domo and/or Rag, but [b]as of the time of this comment, killing the first four bosses on NORMAL will not kick you over to exalted nor give you rep beyond exalted.[/b]"},{"id":1526968,"r":8,"n":0,"b":"Mookosh has posted very solid information about gaining Avengers of Hyjal reputation. What I will do in this post is clarify in so far as possible areas he did not cover. Reputation gains from trash MOBs appears to be subject to bonuses from guild achievements. For example, Ancient Core Hounds and Molten Lords give 50 points of reputation but if the guild bonus applies to you they will give 10% more reputation of 55 points each. Reputation gained from killing bosses in Firelands is not, however, subject to such bonuses unless the figures posted elsewhere here on Wowhead already include those bonuses. According to the page devoted to each boss here at Wowhead, the first 4 bosses of the Firelands, Shannox, Beth'tilac, Lord Rhyolith and Alysrazor each give 275 reputation in normal mode, either 10- or 25-man, and double that, 550, in Heroic regardless of raid size. Thus clearing those 4 bosses gives 1100 Avengers reputation in normal mode and 2200 in Heroic. The next 2 bosses, Baleroc and Majordomo Staghelm, each give 440 reputation in normal mode for both raid sizes. There is no information posted for Heroic mode. I suspect that amount may also increase for Heroic but I don't yet know whether it doubles also. Even so, killing both Baleroc and Staghelm in normal mode would add 880 to your reputation for a 6-boss total of 1980. Wowhead also does not show the reputation gained from a Ragnaros kill in either normal or Heroic mode. If Blizzard has stuck to the reputation progression they've established I suspect that he will give 880 reputation in normal mode for a full clear reputation gain of 2860 though I am just speculating on that figure. However, if I've speculated correctly, one in normal mode would have to clear the equivalent of 7/7 7 times and the first 4 bosses in an eighth visit to reach 20999. After attaining that level of reputation with the Avengers of Hyjal one would have to kill a boss in Heroic mode, as Hanachan has pointed out, to reach exalted with the faction. Anyway, I am sure that others will soon correct me where I've gone wrong."},{"id":1554040,"r":18,"n":0,"b":"Starting with 4.3 [b]Guild Standards[/b] are again usable in Firelands. Unfortunately this requires you to have some sort of invisibility (feign death might work too. If someone tests it please let me know to edit the comment). All you need to do is find a Flamewaker Subjucator. This guy stands near a lava pool that also has 4 Flamewaker Animators channeling something onto an Unstable Magma. Once you go there you just have to kill him. He will give you 50 rep and the Animators will start buffing the Unstable Magma. However they will not keep you in combat. At this point just enter stealth and the Flamewaker Subjucator will respawn to start the process again. You can do this as many times as you need until you reach 11999/12000 honored. At this point you can start killing bosses until exalted. Edit: If you are a Night Elf you can use Shadowmeld to do this but considering it has a 2 min CD. It's not even worth considering but I figured I should mention it anyway. Edit 2: I just noticed that if you don't kill the Flamewaker Subjucator fast enough you will be kept in combat by something ( I assume it's the Animators) and you will have to Vanish or Shadowmeld to make him respawn.[/quote] For me as a Rogue, this was an awesome way to gain rep! You fly around any expansion mop-bfa doing any archaeology, converting your archaeology into crates that you can transfer into dwarven archaeology parts (if you're above level 600 archaeology) I recommend the former, as eastern kingdoms its 18/54 chance for your dig sites to spawn as dwarven, which i feel is pretty decent odds. The converted crates give about 6-8 dwarven fragments and take 40 or more fragments each. I personally did draenor dig sites for crate conversions a while, levelled to 700 and ended up with 74 dwarven crates which converted into only 2/7 of the parts of this achievement over like 5 hours. I then flew around eastern kingdoms and got the other 5 parts of the achievement in about 2 hours. And if youve never touched/levelled archaeology before you're definitely going to get all parts of this achievement before you can reach 600 to convert stuff if you just spam dwarven dig sites on eastern kingdoms. If you can afford it you should use Dwarf Rune Stones as often as you can, shouldn't take more than a few hours max."},{"id":6278840,"r":3,"n":2,"b":"Just wrapped [url=https://www.wowhead.com/achievement=4859/kings-under-the-mountain#comments]this [/url] up and it took me about 5–6 hours of actual digging. Digsites don’t rotate unless YOU clear them, so if you ignore the ones you don’t want, they literally sit there forever and block new spawns. What I did was just hit whatever the closest digsite was, even if it wasn’t Dwarf. Clearing the trash ones kept the cycle moving, and sometimes I’d get lucky and have 2+ Dwarf sites pop at once. Bonus: I made like 1–2k gold just from vendor junk while doing [url=https://www.wowhead.com/achievement=4859/kings-under-the-mountain#comments]this[/url], and even picked up a couple toys from the random non‑Dwarf sites.
